source: // TRAVELLER:[[- No active connections -[[Please perform link/handshake with compatible system for maximum usability.
target: // 旅人终端：[[- 无活动连接 -[[请与兼容系统建立连接/握手，以便充分使用本设备。

source: &1761 I know she'll do fine without me...
target: &1761 我知道，没有我，她也能做好……

source: Your colleague, Dr Max Lao. Probably the only other case-officer who can put up with your method of work. A technical jack-of-all-trades, and almost as unconventional as yourself when it comes to investigation.
target: 你的同事，麦克斯·劳博士。大概也是唯一能忍受你工作方式的案件专员。她是个技术全才，调查时几乎跟你一样不按常理出牌。

source: You'd be reluctant to say 'friend', as that would suggest a degree of emotional openness you're still unprepared to allow to anyone.
target: 你不太愿意称她为“朋友”，因为那意味着向她敞开心扉，而你还没准备好对任何人这样做。

source: Lao is looking for signs of what may have triggered the emergency.
target: 劳正在寻找线索，调查是什么引发了紧急情况。

source: Lao searches the office for clues as to the Mindjacker's location.
target: 劳在办公室里寻找意识劫持者行踪的线索。

source: Lao is already settled in at her desk. Might as well let her handle the case report.
target: 劳已经在桌前坐定。不如让她来写案件报告。

source: Lao appears comfortable here. You've always had a suspicion that she came from an affluent background, but personal histories are not something you've tended to discuss with her.
target: 劳在这里很自在。你一直怀疑，她出身富裕家庭，但你们很少谈起各自的过去。

source: Lao's occasional glances at the maid give you the impression she's worried it might make a break for it. You're probably just projecting.
target: 劳不时瞥向女仆，让你觉得她担心女仆会突然逃跑。也许只是你把自己的担忧投射到了她身上。

source: She may be one of the most gung-ho case specialists you've ever worked with, but the slaughter is making her visibly unsteady.
target: 她可能是你合作过最敢冲敢闯的案件专员之一，但眼前的屠杀仍让她明显有些站不稳。

source: Lao certainly handled herself well in getting up here, not that you'd ever doubted her.
target: 劳一路应对得当，顺利来到这里。当然，你从未怀疑过她的能力。

source: Lao stares at Vargas, apparently re-evaluating her earlier opinions of him in light of new information.
target: 劳盯着瓦尔加斯，似乎正根据新得到的信息，重新评价自己先前对他的看法。

source: Lao is enraptured - she stands in the physical presence of Central itself.
target: 劳满心惊叹。她正站在中枢本体面前。

source: Lao's attention is focused the chair on the platform.
target: 劳的注意力都放在平台上的椅子上。

source: Lao is prepared for a fight, but is visibly frustrated by the stand-off.
target: 劳已准备好动手，但眼前的僵局让她明显很烦躁。

source: Lao is watching you keenly - she's worried you might do something stupid in trying to help Latha.
target: 劳紧盯着你，担心你为了救拉塔，做出什么傻事。

source: You can see Lao's sense of alertness radiating from her like microwaves.
target: 劳周身透着警觉，简直像在向外辐射微波。

source: The other CEL agent doesn't look quite as intimidating as Regis - perhaps because she hasn't tried to kill you.
target: 另一个CEL探员看起来没有里吉斯那么吓人。也许是因为，她没试过杀你。

source: &1428 Let's go!
&1282 We've got to stop the simulation trapping Latha, somehow.
target: &1282 得想办法关闭那个模拟程序，别再让它困住拉塔。

source: &1214 What do you make of it, Lao?
target: &1214 劳，你怎么看？

source: &902 The station's been evacuated.
target: &902 车站已经疏散了。

source: &903 Better ask the corpsmen what's gone down.
target: &903 最好问问医务员，发生了什么。

source: &1763 Sorry, Max.
target: &1763 抱歉，麦克斯。

source: &26 Sir! You shot her!
target: &26 长官！你朝她开枪了！

source: &1764 Carry on, corpsman. Make sure she's safe until she comes around.
target: &1764 继续吧，医务员。她醒来之前，务必确保她的安全。

source: &27 Uh...yes...sir?
&1765 She's going to be out long enough for me to do what I have to.
target: &1765 她会昏迷足够久，让我做完该做的事。

source: &1766 She isn't going to need it.
target: &1766 她用不上它了。

source: &1215 Hey Lao, want this?
target: &1215 嘿，劳，要这个吗？

source: &904 Wouldn't do me any good - it's a signature weapon keyed to your DNA.
target: &904 给我也没用。这武器锁定了你的DNA。

source: &905 Besides, mine's bigger.
target: &905 再说，我的更大。

source: &1216 Hey Lao, can I split YOUR personality?
target: &1216 嘿，劳，我能把你的人格也分开吗？

source: &906 I don't have THAT much wetware-wiring in my head. I'm still human, y'know.
target: &906 我脑子里的湿件线路可没那么多。我还是人类，知道吗。

source: &1217 Technically.
target: &1217 从技术定义上说，是。

source: &1218 What do you make of this?
target: &1218 你怎么看这个？

source: &907 I had a friend at the academy, he'd drink this stuff as a dare.
target: &907 学院里有个朋友，打赌时会喝这东西。

source: &908 Ended up in a hospital once or twice.
target: &908 结果进过一两次医院。

source: &909 Is that...Giel Van der Waal's hand?
target: &909 那是……吉尔·范德瓦尔的手？

source: &910 Why the Hell did you pick that up?!
target: &910 你到底为什么把它捡起来？！

source: &1219 I thought it might be useful.
target: &1219 我觉得可能有用。

source: &911 As what, a snack? Since when do we collect BODY PARTS?
target: &911 有什么用，当零食？我们什么时候开始收集身体零件了？

source: &912 Aww, that's sweet. Must have been an expensive wedding.
target: &912 哎呀，真甜蜜。婚礼肯定花了不少钱。

source: &913 I don't know many people who could book the Notre Dame cathedral for it.
target: &913 能把巴黎圣母院包下来办婚礼的人，我可不认识几个。

source: &914 It's a silicon-graphene power cell. They're designed to charge really fast.
target: &914 硅-石墨烯电池。设计就是为了快速充电。

source: &915 Whoa, careful, you might hurt someone with that.
target: &915 哇，小心点，这东西会伤到人的。

source: &916 It's a century-old Chinese copy of a 176 year old US handgun.
target: &916 一百年前的中国仿制品，仿的是一把176年前的美国手枪。

source: &917 It'll have escaped registration by being classed as an 'antique' rather than a weapon.
target: &917 它被归为“古董”，而不是武器，所以才避开了登记。

source: &918 They'd have to go all the way out to the Savannah to find anywhere to fish around here.
target: &918 想在这附近找地方钓鱼，他们得一路跑到大草原去。

source: &919 When I was a kid, I used to make sculptures out of bent hangers.
target: &919 小时候，我会把衣架掰弯，做成雕塑。

source: &920 Nearly took my sister's eye out with one...
target: &920 有一次，差点戳瞎我姐妹的一只眼睛……

source: &1220 Do I need to make sure this doesn't get too close to your head?
target: &1220 得防着点，不能让这东西靠近你的脑袋吗？

source: &921 Wetware isn't affected by magnetic fields, not like that at least.
target: &921 磁场不会影响湿件，至少不会这么影响。

source: &922 You're not going to be warping my memory with strong magnets, anyway.
target: &922 总之，你没法用强磁铁扭曲我的记忆。

source: &1429 It's an access card. Better find out what it opens.
target: &1429 门禁卡。最好查查它能开什么。

source: &1221 Take this.
&312 You take this.
&1925 An adjustable magnetic coil, previously used to keep a piece of art floating in the air.
target: &1925 可调磁力线圈。之前用来让艺术品悬浮在空中。

source: &1222 There's no way to hold it on without a hook.
target: &1222 没有钩子，就没法固定在上面。

source: &1223 There, a magnet at the end of a fishing line.
target: &1223 好了，鱼线末端装上了磁铁。

source: &923 For catching...submarines?
target: &923 这是要钓……潜艇？

source: &1224 I don't think it needs magnetising.
target: &1224 我觉得它不需要磁化。

source: &1926 A steel coathanger. Until I pulled it out, it was jamming the floordrobe's mechanism.
target: &1926 钢制衣架。拔出来之前，它卡住了地柜的机械装置。

source: &1225 There we go. Now it's got an enormous hook.
target: &1225 好了。现在装上了一个巨大的钩子。

source: &1927 Apparently, the Van der Waals were outdoor sports enthusiasts. They'd have had to take this quite far inland to find any live fish, though.
target: &1927 范德瓦尔夫妇显然是户外运动爱好者。不过，要找到活鱼，他们得带着它深入内陆才行。

source: &1928 The rod doesn't seem to have a hook.
target: &1928 这根鱼竿好像没有钩子。

source: &1929 An expensive-looking fishing rod, with a hook constructed from a wire coat hanger.
target: &1929 看起来很贵的鱼竿，装着铁丝衣架做成的钩子。

source: &1930 An expensive fishing rod, with a powerful magnetic coil as 'bait'.
target: &1930 昂贵的鱼竿，用强力磁力线圈当“鱼饵”。

source: &1226 Now it's got one enormous hook.
target: &1226 现在装上了一个巨大的钩子。

source: That wouldn't make very good bait.
target: 这可不是合适的诱饵。

source: &1931 A kitchen knife, one of a set. This sort of blade takes me back to my days in medical school.
target: &1931 厨房刀具中的一把。这种刀刃，让我想起读医学院时的日子。

source: &924 Putting the empty power cell back in won't help.
target: &924 把没电的电池放回去，也没用。

source: &126 CI wetware systems beginning reboot. Beginning recovery from critical failure...
target: &126 CI湿件系统开始重启。开始从严重故障中恢复……

source: &127 Basic Input/Output executing MBR...Unified bootloader executing kernel...
target: &127 基本输入/输出系统正在执行MBR……统一引导程序正在执行内核……

source: &128 Kernel executing SBIN/INIT
target: &128 内核正在执行SBIN/INIT

source: &129 Calibrating CI State with UST...
target: &129 正在根据UST校准CI状态……

source: &130 Oh! Zat is better!
target: &130 哦！这样好多了！

source: &925 I know you're not keen on modern tech, but that's no reason to take it out on someone else's maid.
target: &925 我知道你不喜欢现代技术，可也不能拿别人家的女仆撒气。

source: &926 Go and punch your food machine at home, if you really feel like some luddism.
target: &926 真想反对技术进步，就回家揍你自己的食品机吧。

source: &927 What are you up to?
target: &927 你在干什么？

source: &1227 Just doing some surgery.
target: &1227 只是做点手术。

source: Picked up: Power Cell
target: 获得：电池

source: &1228 Do you think I can recharge the synth with my stunner?
target: &1228 你觉得，我能用电击枪给合成人充电吗？

source: &928 Afraid not. There's a layer of fake skin in the way.
target: &928 恐怕不行。中间隔着一层人造皮肤。

source: &929 Depending where you did it, you'd probably just burn out the more delicate systems.
target: &929 看你电哪里，可能只会把更脆弱的系统烧坏。

source: &1229 Hey, what do you make of this?
target: &1229 嘿，你怎么看这个？

source: &930 Uh...Charlie...she's not going to answer you.
target: &930 呃……查理……她不会回答你的。

source: &931 Not when she's out of charge like that.
target: &931 没电成这样，可答不了。

source: &1230 Yeah...I knew that.
&131 What is zat, monsieur?
target: &131 那是什么，先生？

source: &1231 Do you recognize it?
target: &1231 你认得这个吗？

source: &132 Nope! 'ow could I?
target: &132 不认得！我怎么会认得？

source: &133 Ah 'ave always been mounted in ze wall.
target: &133 我一直都装在墙上。

source: &134 Zey always 'ave loved Paris. Zey are planning to return next summer!
target: &134 他们一直很喜欢巴黎。打算明年夏天再去呢！

source: &135 Be careful, zis gel can get 'ot quickly!
target: &135 小心，这凝胶很快就会热起来！

source: &136 Ah, monsieur Giel will be 'appy to know you 'ad found zat.
target: &136 啊，吉尔先生知道您找到它，一定会很高兴。

source: &137 'e is always losing things!
target: &137 他总是丢东西！

source: &138 Oh, monsieur, please do not shoot!
target: &138 哦，先生，请别开枪！

source: &139 Monsieur, was zat taken from ze artwork outside?
target: &139 先生，那是从外面的艺术品上取下来的吗？

source: &140 Would you like me to 'ang up your jacket, monsieur?
target: &140 先生，要我替您挂好外套吗？

source: &141 Ah would always stay at 'ome when zey would go fishing.
target: &141 他们去钓鱼时，我总是留在家里。

source: &142 It gave me time to tidy!.
target: &142 正好有时间收拾！

source: &1232 You recognize this?
target: &1232 你认得这个吗？

source: &143 Uhm...perhaps, monsieur.
&144 But Ah should not discuss it.
target: &144 但我不该谈论这件事。

source: &1233 You saw what happened?
target: &1233 你看见发生了什么？

source: &145 Monsieur, Ah MUST not speak of what 'appens in ze bedroom.
target: &145 先生，我绝对不能谈论卧室里发生的事。

source: &146 Monsieur Giel 'as been quite clear!
target: &146 吉尔先生已经说得很清楚了！

source: &933 Talk about taking orders too literally.
target: &933 真是死抠命令的字面意思。

source: &147 Now what y'all got there, partner?
target: &147 伙计，你那儿拿的什么？

source: &148 Nope! How could I?
target: &148 不认得！我怎么会认得？

source: &149 I've always been stuck in that thar wall.
target: &149 我一直都困在那面墙里。

source: &934 She has a point.
target: &934 她说得有道理。

source: &150 Now that's not something to discuss.
target: &150 那个可不能拿来聊。

source: &151 Discussin' other folks' relationships, that's a recipe for trouble.
target: &151 聊别人家的关系，那是在给自己找麻烦。

source: &152 That stuff there's for cookin' with.
target: &152 那东西是做饭用的。

source: &153 Don't you go losin' that, a hand's a mighty difficult thing to replace!
target: &153 可别弄丢了，手这东西，可不好找替代品！

source: &154 What, you want a game of quick-draw?
target: &154 怎么，想比比谁拔枪快？

source: &155 Don't know what you plan on doing with that.
target: &155 不知道你打算拿它干什么。

source: &156 Are we going down the old fishin' hole?
target: &156 咱们要去老地方钓鱼吗？

source: &157 Well, sure I do! It's one o' them wussy automatics.
target: &157 当然认得！那种软蛋才用的自动手枪。

source: &158 Not a proper MAN'S gun. Gimme a Single-Action Army any day!
target: &158 不是男子汉该用的枪。要我说，单动陆军左轮才够味！

source: &1234 You know this, don't you? You saw what happened?
target: &1234 你认得，对吧？你看见发生了什么？

source: &159 Son, my job is NOT to help you nose around in the Van der Waals private affairs.
target: &159 小子，我的职责可不包括帮你打探范德瓦尔夫妇的私事。

source: &1235 Fine. We'll find someone more helpful.
target: &1235 好吧。我们找个肯帮忙的人。

source: &160 Ooh, that's interesting!
target: &160 哦，这东西有意思！

source: &200 Nope! How could I?
target: &200 不认得！我怎么会认得？

source: &201 I'm built into the wall. I barely see anything!
target: &201 我装在墙里，基本看不见什么！

source: &162 They had a great time back then!
target: &162 他们那时玩得可开心了！

source: &163 That's why they wanted a French maid!
target: &163 所以才想要个法国女仆！

source: &164 That's the stuff they use for cooking without Cheffie the Chef!
target: &164 没有厨师小厨的时候，他们就用那东西做饭！

source: &165 Hey, that's Mr Giel's hand! Where'd he leave that?
target: &165 嘿，那是吉尔先生的手！他把它落在哪儿了？

source: &166 Don't shoot! Hehe, just kidding, I know you wouldn't. You're my pal.
target: &166 别开枪！嘿嘿，开玩笑，我知道你不会。你是我的朋友嘛。

source: &167 Ooh, careful, I've got sensitive components!
target: &167 哦，小心，我的零件很娇贵！

source: &168 Ooh, careful, you could have someone's eye out with that!
target: &168 哦，小心，那东西会戳瞎别人眼睛的！

source: &169 Are we going fishing?
target: &169 我们要去钓鱼吗？

source: &1236 Does this ring any bells?
target: &1236 想起什么了吗？

source: &170 Oh yeah!
&171 It's what Mr Giel used when he...when I...
target: &171 吉尔先生用过这个，当他……当我……

source: &173 I remember...there was something about that...and Mr Giel...
target: &173 我记得……这东西跟……吉尔先生……

source: &174 Hnng...no, I'm sorry...
&175 There was something about his wine.
target: &175 跟他的酒有关。

source: &176 But I'm afraid my thing is food, not drink!
target: &176 可惜，我擅长的是食物，不是饮料！

source: &177 I don't know a thing about what they were doing to it!
target: &177 他们对酒做了什么，我一点也不知道！

source: &936 Maybe we should ask someone who knows their booze?
target: &936 也许该问问懂酒的人？

source: &937 Good work, Chantelle.
target: &937 干得好，尚特尔。

source: &178 Thanks, Dr Max!
target: &178 谢谢，麦克斯博士！

source: &938 My job'll be a lot easier if I can get Central to agree to take you on full-time.
target: &938 要是能说服中枢正式雇你，我干活儿就轻松多了。

source: &1238 That...makes me uncomfortable.
target: &1238 这……让我不太舒服。

source: &939 Chantelle?
&940 Damn. I'll see if I can get her up and running again once this is all resolved.
target: &940 该死。等这些事解决，我再看看能不能让她重新运转起来。

source: &1239 Hello?
&941 Hm...I think I know what's wrong with it.
target: &941 唔……我想我知道问题出在哪儿了。

source: A photograph of two men, a younger Giel and Dakarai Van der Waal, by an urban river. In the background, the Eiffel Tower is dwarfed by looming glass skyscrapers.
target: 照片上有两个男人，是更年轻时的吉尔和达卡莱·范德瓦尔，站在一条市内河流旁。背景里的埃菲尔铁塔，在高耸的玻璃摩天楼前显得格外矮小。

source: The back of the photograph has a note written by hand - 'The wedding, August 2071'
target: 照片背后手写着一句话：“婚礼，2071年8月”。

source: &1932 A human hand, covered in thermal gel from the kitchen. It's sizzling and crackling, as though from a barbecue.
target: &1932 一只人手，裹着厨房的控温凝胶，噼啪作响，像在烧烤。

source: &1933 A human hand, covered in thermal gel from the kitchen. It's warm enough that it might almost still be alive.
target: &1933 一只人手，裹着厨房的控温凝胶。温热得仿佛还活着。

source: &1934 Giel Van der Waal's cold, dead hand.
target: &1934 吉尔·范德瓦尔冰冷的断手。

source: You cover the hand in the hot gel. It begins to sizzle and burn.
target: 你给断手涂上高温凝胶，它开始滋滋作响，烧了起来。

source: &942 *sniff*...hmm, something smells good.
target: &942 *嗅嗅*……唔，什么东西这么香。

source: You cover the hand in the thermal gel, and it becomes noticeably warmer.
target: 你给断手涂上控温凝胶，它明显暖了起来。

source: You cover the hand in the thermal gel, and it begins to cool.
target: 你给断手涂上控温凝胶，它开始冷下来。

source: Password hint:[['Our special place'
target: 密码提示：[[“对我们特别的地方”（请用英文输入）

source: BIOMETRIC Security Details Completed
target: 生物识别安保详情：已完成

source: //ERROR: User Biometrics not approved
target: //错误：用户生物识别信息未获授权

source: &1240 It's definitely his hand, but the system won't recognize it.
target: &1240 明明就是他的手，可系统就是不认。

source: //ERROR: User biometrics not recognized
target: //错误：无法识别用户生物特征

source: You cover the bone in the thermal gel. Nothing seems to happen.
target: 你给骨头涂上控温凝胶，似乎什么也没发生。

source: You cover the bone in the hot thermal gel. It begins to sizzle and crack as the compounds within prepare for a chain reaction.

target: &323 我可不能一直拿着它们。

target: &329 说实话，我还从没在现实世界里见过火。

source: &330 I may not be one-hundred percent clear on paper, but I don't think that's how it works.
target: &330 我也许不完全了解纸，但觉得不是这么用的。

target: &157 代表4,5,β-三羟基-N-甲基苯乙胺，即肾上腺素的.mol文件。[[虽然你自己用不了它，别的系统或许兼容。

target: &333 我觉得这东西存不了它。

target: &158 浓稠的褐色糊糊，大概只含有维持人体所需的最低限度营养。

source: &334 I don't know how, but they've made it even worse than my food machine does.
target: &334 不知道他们怎么做的，居然比我家食品机做的还难吃。

source: &335 I can't just mix that in my hands!
target: &335 不能就在手里混合！

source: &337 A rubbery plastic sheet. Why would he have needed...?

&159 Thin, metal discs for getting things from the food machine.[[The fact that CEL are still using physical currency makes you shudder in revulsion, and makes you wonder what other kinds of backward practices they make use of here.

target: &339 不用叉子，这东西用吸管都能吃！

target: &340 我用那片橡胶般的塑料布，给它做了个握柄。

source: &341 As cool as it is, I don't think I can augment it any further.
target: &341 虽然挺酷，但应该没法再升级了。

target: &160 食品机里的叉子，外面包了几层那种橡胶般柔软的塑料布。

target: 没有可供连接的系统。

source: &569 Geez, talk about low-quality knockoffs made in Han factories.
target: &569 天哪，大汉工厂出产的劣质山寨货，真是名不虚传。

target: &570 只剩你和我了。

target: &201 在工厂追杀你的打手，显然也在这里工作。说明你找对了地方，可已经有人把这家伙打昏了，这又让你有些担心……

source: &352 Lightweight.
target: &352 真不禁打。

source: &202 Though you're not very worldly, you're pretty sure that this man is much more imposing than someone who'd normally be working the desk at an air-freight firm.
target: &202 虽然你不算见多识广，但你也能确定，这个男人比空运公司前台通常会雇用的人凶悍得多。

source: &1286 The camouflage sure ain't giving him an advantage anymore.
target: &1286 现在，伪装可帮不了他了。

source: &1287 He's not dead, but he's going to wake up with one Hell of a headache.
target: &1287 他没死，不过醒来后肯定头痛得要命。

source: &203 He's not carrying anything you can use, short of completely undressing him - you don't think you've got enough time to be that thorough.
target: &203 他身上没有能用的东西，除非把衣服都扒光。你觉得，没时间搜得那么彻底。

source: &353 Hello...
&3 We're closed.
target: &3 关门了。

source: &354 Can I just...?
target: &354 能不能让我……？

source: &4 No. Go away.
target: &4 不能。走开。

source: &355 You don't even...
target: &355 你都还没……

source: &5 No. It's too hot to argue.
target: &5 不行。太热了，懒得争。

source: &6 Get outta here, thrall.
target: &6 滚吧，迷奴。

source: &357 Hello.
&358 Guess that tranquiliser did its job.
target: &358 看来，镇静剂管用了。

source: &1288 Shame the optic camo's built into the uniform. I could use something like that right about now.
target: &1288 可惜光学迷彩内置在制服里。现在，我正好用得上那种东西。

source: &1289 Low-velocity, jacketed hollowpoint...they came prepared for a soft target...
target: &1289 低速被甲空尖弹……他们是冲着无装甲目标来的……

source: Picked up: Submachine Gun
target: 获得：冲锋枪

source: &1290 Any more'd just waste the power cell.
target: &1290 再来只会浪费电池。

source: &1291 He's too far away this second.
target: &1291 现在，他离得太远了。

source: &1292 One down...
&119 ...however many left to go. Don't count on taking them all on, though.
target: &119 ……还不知道剩多少。不过，别指望能跟他们所有人硬拼。

source: &734 Sure, if I feel like getting myself shot.
target: &734 当然，前提是我想吃枪子儿。

source: &359 I'm already as wired into him as I want to be.
target: &359 已经接入得够深了，我不想再深入他的脑内线路。

source: Connecting to Neural Wetware Wiring...
target: 正在连接神经湿件线路……

source: &360 It's amazing how many people don't put enough security on their Gibsons.
target: &360 没给吉布森接口配好安保的人，居然这么多。

source: &361 They assume they've got enough willpower to stop intruders on their own...
target: &361 他们觉得，光靠意志力就能挡住入侵者……

source: &1295 Damn, it's out of charge...

source: &684 While taking him down would mean one less obstacle, the stunner doesn't have the reach necessary to hit him from here.

target: &1484 我攻破他们的通信系统了！现在，它把我的旅人终端当作网络的一部分。

source: &1300 Can you still hear me, Nina?
target: &1300 妮娜，还能听到我吗？

source: &120 It's probably better if we talk the old-fashioned way, Charlie.
target: &120 查理，还是用老办法说话比较好。

source: &121 We don't want the others to think we're hiding something from them.
target: &121 总不能让其他人觉得，我们有什么事瞒着他们。

source: &1301 Perish the thought.
target: &1301 那可不能。

source: &1302 Nina, can you hear me?
target: &1302 妮娜，听得到吗？

source: &1303 No answer. Either it's not working, or she's just biding her time.
target: &1303 没回答。要么没连上，要么她在等时机。

source: &1183 Nina, can you still hear me?
target: &1183 妮娜，还能听见我吗？

source: &694 Either she's decided not to talk to you since you returned control of the power systems to Central, or Central itself has tracked her down...
target: &694 也许，你把供电系统控制权交还中枢后，她就决定不跟你说话了；也许，是中枢已经找到了她……

source: &138 We're getting a signal! The antenna's broadcasting.
target: &138 收到信号了！天线正在广播。

source: &139 Now use the controls in the turbine room to give us access to the tower's security.
target: &139 现在，用涡轮室的控制装置，让我们接入大厦安保。

source: &362 Fight my way out? Maybe in a sim, but not out here...
target: &362 杀出去？模拟里也许行，现实可不行……

source: Trying to hack a CEL corspman is probably a bad idea - you've no idea what kind of defense measures the Centralized Government equips its staff with.
target: 黑进CEL医务员的系统，多半不是个好主意。你完全不知道，中枢政府给员工配了什么防御措施。

source: &363 I don't think he'd want that.
target: &363 他应该不想要那个。

source: &221 Doctors Jeong and Chigwa are in the midst of a fast-paced discussion. With their completely different fields, you reckon it's likely to do with something outside of work.
target: &221 郑博士和奇格瓦博士正在热烈交谈。她们的专业完全不同，你觉得，大概聊的是工作以外的事。

source: You don't always care for Dr Jeong's sense of humor. Charlie's been through an awful lot since he left his home country.
target: 郑博士开的玩笑，有时让你不舒服。查理离开祖国以来，已经经历了太多。

source: &22 I'll just...get back to the decompiling.
target: &22 那我就……继续反编译了。

source: Over the past few weeks, you've gotten to know Dr Chigwa very well. You can understand why some might find her a little abrasive, but it's nice to work with someone so practical.
target: 过去几周，你已经很了解奇格瓦博士。你能理解，为什么有人觉得她说话有点冲，但跟这样务实的人共事，也挺好。

source: &36 Can it wait? I'm in the middle of dissecting Dr Vargas' brain.
target: &36 能等会儿吗？我正忙着解剖瓦尔加斯博士的大脑。

source: &37 With the fMRI scanner, of course.
target: &37 当然，是用功能磁共振扫描仪。

source: &222 Dr Baxter is apparently a workaholic, having gotten underway with the project even before having been briefed.
target: &222 巴克斯特博士显然是个工作狂。还没听项目介绍，就已经开工了。

source: &223 Looks like Baxter is talking *at* Charlie, rather than *with* him.
target: &223 看来，巴克斯特是在对着查理说个不停，而不是跟他交谈。

source: &695 The older man stares off into the void, his eyes moving from platform to platform.
target: &695 老人望着虚空，目光从一个平台移到另一个平台。

source: &696 He certainly looks like Dr Baxter, according to the background reports you were given.
target: &696 根据给你的背景报告，他看起来确实是巴克斯特博士。

source: &224 Better not. Charlie might slip out and leave you on the receiving end of Baxter's lecture. It's what you'd do in his place, after all.
target: &224 最好别。查理可能趁机溜走，把你留在这里听巴克斯特长篇大论。换成你，也会这么干。

source: &225 Charlie looks uncomfortable. You can't blame him, it's not the kind of lab environment he's used to - nobody's threatening his life.
target: &225 查理看起来很不自在。这也不能怪他，这种实验室环境跟他习惯的不同：没有人在威胁他的命。

source: &364 There's nothing else I can take in here. The rest is just wrecked car.
target: &364 这里没别的能拿了。剩下的就是车的残骸。

source: Picked up: Crowbar
target: 已拾取：撬棍

source: &365 A car-repair tool?
target: &365 修车工具？

source: &366 Probably what they'd claim it's for, at least.
target: &366 至少，他们大概会这么说。

target: &24 警告！警告！您离车辆太近了！

source: &25 PLEASE STEP AWAY FROM THE VEHICLE!
target: &25 请远离车辆！

target: &736 本市当前供水系统中，需要重点监测的危险化学物质清单。

source: &652 It's got chemical markers, formulas and breakdowns for programming scanning tools with what they're looking for.
target: &652 上面有化学标记、分子式和分解数据，可用来给扫描工具编程，告诉它们要找什么。

source: &859 The city's list of current hazardous chemicals to watch out for in the water supply.
target: &859 本市当前供水系统中，需要重点监测的危险化学物质清单。

target: &860 上面有化学标记、分子式和分解数据，可用来给扫描工具编程，告诉它们要找什么。

source: &653 A plastic credit chip, for those times you need to buy something without using the net.
target: &653 塑料信用芯片，不想通过网络付款时，可以用它买东西。

source: &654 I can sense in my wetware that it has around a couple of hundred Quanta still loaded.
target: &654 湿件能感觉到，里面还存着大约两百量子币。

source: &655 A sturdy metal tool I liberated from the wreck of that car.
target: &655 结实的金属工具，从那辆车的残骸里顺来的。

source: &656 In this kind of neighborhood, it *might* not actually have been for repairs.
target: &656 在这种街区，它原本的用途可能不是修车。

source: &678 The chip's made a connection to my wetware systems that allow it to be used in the Trance.
target: &678 芯片已接入我的湿件系统，所以能在迷境中使用。

source: &657 A standardized medical cartridge, dirty and scratched from being shared around for so long.
target: &657 标准医疗药剂筒。被人传来传去用得太久，弄得又脏又满是划痕。

source: NARQUINE - surgical anesthetic, 80mg Solution. Use only as directed by a physican or certified medical software. Do not operate heavy machinery or attempt to form new mind-machine connections while using NARQUINE.
target: NARQUINE——外科麻醉剂，80mg溶液。仅按医生或经认证医疗软件的指示使用。使用NARQUINE期间，请勿操作重型机械，或尝试建立新的脑机连接。

source: &367 Can I go in?
target: &367 我能进去吗？

source: &68 You got the water going again, so yeah.
target: &68 你让供水恢复了，当然能。

source: &69 We got all we need for more wetware.
target: &69 现在材料齐了，可以培育更多湿件。

source: &70 Hello?! You there? Where are ya?!
target: &70 喂？！在吗？你在哪儿？！

source: &368 You can't see me?
target: &368 你看不见我？

source: &71 Can't see anything with these lousy eyes they gave me.
target: &71 他们给我的这双破眼睛，什么都看不见。

source: &72 They ain't worth shit in the dark.
target: &72 黑灯瞎火的，屁用没有。

source: &73 Hey, I saw what you did to my aerial.
target: &73 嘿，你对我的天线干了什么，我可看见了。

source: &369 Uh...I'm sorry?
&74 SORRY?! Sorry ain't good enough.
target: &74 对不起？！光道歉可不够。

source: &75 You cost me a whole lotta overseas business.
target: &75 你害我丢了一大堆海外生意。

source: &76 You're barred, lady.
target: &76 女士，你别想再进来了。

source: &234 The venue's enormous bouncer glares at you with what you believe to be lofty contempt, though you've never been that good at reading human expressions.
target: &234 场所里壮硕的门卫瞪着你。你觉得，他的眼神里带着居高临下的鄙视，不过，你一直不太会看人类的表情。

source: &235 It's going to need a little work done.
target: &235 得修一修了。

source: &236 The expensive-looking car seems out of place in a neighborhood like this. It must be well-protected, if someone felt they could leave it on display.
target: &236 这辆看起来很贵的车，在这种街区显得格格不入。有人敢把它摆在外面，防护措施肯定很严密。

source: &237 Like most cars you've ever seen outside of the Trance, it appears to be an autodrive. Barely anyone bothers with manual controls anymore - good riddance, in your opinion.
target: &237 和你在迷境外见过的大多数车一样，它似乎是自动驾驶的。已经没什么人愿意手动开车了。你觉得，早该淘汰了。

source: &370 I don't think anything I can do is going to fix it.
target: &370 我觉得，自己怎么做都修不好它。

source: &39 I just want to make sure you're eating right!
target: &39 我只是想让你吃得健康！

source: &20 So, you object to me smashing you open?
target: &20 所以，你不让我把你砸开？

source: &40 It'd take some pretty serious damage to do that! I'm tough!
target: &40 那可得砸得够狠才行！我结实着呢！

source: &41 Only qualified T.H.E. Systems technicians can get me open.
target: &41 只有合格的T.H.E.系统技术人员才能把我拆开。

source: &21 Looks like messing with your software is my best bet, then.
target: &21 看来还是从你的软件下手比较有希望。

source: &5001 Will the machine work without you?
target: &5001 没了你，机器还能用吗？

source: &42 If I have an accident, the machine will continue to dispense.
target: &42 要是我出了意外，机器仍会继续供应食物。

source: &43 We don't want you starving in an emergency now, do we?
target: &43 紧急情况下，我们总不能让你饿肚子，对不对？

source: &44 Conchiglie! Farfalloni! Rotelle!
target: &44 贝壳面！大蝴蝶面！车轮面！

source: &22 Uh...what?
&45 Vermicelloni! Cannelloni! Penne! Rigatoni!
target: &45 粗线面！填馅筒面！斜管面！粗通心粉！

source: &23 That doesn't really answer my question.
target: &23 这好像没回答我的问题。

source: &46 Lasagne! Fusilli! Torchio! Marziani!
target: &46 千层面！螺旋面！压花卷面！火星人面！

source: &24 You're really, really annoying. You know that?
target: &24 你知道自己有多烦人吗？真的，特别烦。

source: &47 Address all concerns regarding T.H.E. avatar #2862 "Cheffie" to T.H.E. customer interactive regions.
target: &47 对T.H.E.虚拟化身#2862“小厨”的任何意见，请提交至T.H.E.客户互动专区。

source: &48 Ta-ta-takes one to know one!
target: &48 半、半、半斤八两嘛！

source: &49 Your mama!
&5002 What's on your recipe card now?
target: &5002 现在记忆卡里是什么食谱？

source: &50 On the menu today, we've got...
target: &50 今天的菜单是……

source: &51 Uh-oh, looks like the memory card's been taken out of the machine!
target: &51 哎呀，机器里的记忆卡好像被取出来了！

source: &52 I'm so sorry, I can't cook without my recipes!
target: &52 真抱歉，没有食谱我就没法做饭！

source: &26 Some masterchef you are.
target: &26 你可真是位大厨。

source: &53 If you can find some new recipes on a memory module, I'd be happy to have a go at them for you!
target: &53 只要你找到存着新食谱的记忆模块，我很乐意做给你尝尝！

source: &54 I live to serve!
target: &54 我为服务而生！

source: &55 Protein complex A-11!
target: &55 A-11蛋白复合物！

source: &56 ...protein complex E-168!
&57 ...and for dessert, sucro-gelatin complex C-11!
target: &57 ……甜点是C-11糖胶复合物！

source: &27 Sounds delicious.
target: &27 听着真好吃。

source: &58 If you want something a little different, don't forget -
target: &58 想换换口味的话，别忘了——

source: &59 You can always download new recipes for me to take a look at!
target: &59 随时都可以下载新食谱，让我学着做！

source: &60 I see there's some new recipe data!
target: &60 我看到新食谱的数据啦！

source: &61 It looks like iiiiiiiiiiiii
target: &61 看起来是iiiiiiiiiiiii

source: &62 iiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii
target: &62 iiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii
reason: 食品机受病毒影响后的故障拖音；源文与目标完全相同，明确保留声音字形，不计入中文翻译数量。

source: &63 rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr
target: &63 rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr
reason: 食品机受病毒影响后的故障拖音；源文与目标完全相同，明确保留声音字形，不计入中文翻译数量。
