source: &309 Apparently, whatever virus was riding that t-mail is doing some damage.
target: &309 看来那封迷境邮件带来的病毒，已经开始搞破坏了。

source: &28 You don't look so good!
target: &28 你看起来不太妙啊！

source: &65 It's no-no-nothing that can't be-be worked around!
target: &65 没、没、没事，总、总有办法解决！

source: &29 Sounds more like you need someone to put you out of your misery.
target: &29 听着倒像是该找人送你一程，早点解脱。

source: &50 Ciao.
&66 Goodb-b-b-wiedersehen!
target: &66 再、再、再——wiedersehen！

source: &67 Byeeeeeeee!
&102 Regis!
&1 Central's still giving us a negative on the aerostat.
target: &1 中枢还是不承认那艘浮空艇的存在。

source: &2 It's like it just...vanished.
target: &2 简直就像……凭空消失了。

source: &3 So, I thought I'd better give you a heads-up.
target: &3 所以，我觉得还是先来跟你说一声。

source: &1 Do you mind? I was in the middle of something.
target: &1 能不能别打扰我？我正忙着呢。

source: &2 How did you find me?
target: &2 你怎么找到我的？

source: &4 Central told me you'd be here, at Fulcrum Tower.
target: &4 中枢说你会在这里，支点大厦。

source: &5 Also, it said 'stop turning your traveller off'.
target: &5 它还说：“别再把旅人终端关掉了。”

source: &3 What a surprise. I like my privacy, though.
target: &3 真让人意外。可我喜欢有点隐私。

source: &4 That's why I come here.
target: &4 所以我才来这里。

source: &28 You hang around the Balconies much?
target: &28 你经常到阳台这儿来？

source: &104 I'm Dr Regis, this is Dr Lao. We've been assigned as crisis management.
target: &104 我是里吉斯博士，这位是劳博士。我们负责这次危机处置。

source: &1 Corpsman Durian, fourth network.
target: &1 第四网络，探员杜里安。

source: &75 Has it gotten any worse?
target: &75 情况有恶化吗？

source: &2 Not yet, but we've not heard any word since...
target: &2 暂时没有，不过自从……我们就没再听到消息了。

source: &105 Hey, I'm the only one here who hasn't got wiring in his head.
target: &105 喂，这里只有我脑子里没装线路。

source: &106 Central hasn't had the decency to update me.
target: &106 中枢连通知我一声都懒得。

source: &76 Oh. Sorry Charlie.
target: &76 哦。抱歉，查理。

source: &3 Well, it's another one, sir.
target: &3 又来了一个，长官。

source: &107 "Another" what?
target: &107 又来了个什么？

source: &4 A...uh...bomber.
target: &4 一个……呃……炸弹客。

source: &108 What do you mean, "another" one?
target: &108 什么叫“又”来了一个？

source: &77 This is, like, the fourth this year I know of.
target: &77 我知道的，今年这已经是第四个了。

source: &78 Central's been doing its best to keep public awareness down.
target: &78 中枢一直尽力压着消息，不让公众知道。

source: &5 I guess it doesn't want public panic about it.
target: &5 我想，它是不希望引起公众恐慌。

source: &109 Or it doesn't want people to think we haven't got it under control.
target: &109 或者，不想让人觉得局面已经失控了。

source: &110 So how do you know about it?
target: &110 那你怎么知道的？

source: &79 I *talk* to people. I've got a social life, unlike SOMEONE...
target: &79 我会跟别人聊天。跟某人不一样，我是有社交生活的……

source: &6 Central marked him when he tripped a chroma sensor.
target: &6 他触发了一个染色体传感器，被中枢识别出来了。

source: &7 Central locked down the trains and started an evacuation.
target: &7 中枢封锁了列车，开始疏散人群。

source: &8 It looks like he panicked and holed up in one of them.
target: &8 看样子他慌了，躲进了其中一列车里。

source: &111 Are you the one who spotted him?
target: &111 是你发现他的？

source: &9 No, sir. Central marked him when he tripped a sensor.
target: &9 不是，长官。他触发了传感器，是中枢识别出来的。

source: &10 Apparently his genome was flagged on a watchlist.
target: &10 据说他的基因组在监控名单上。

source: &80 They can profile potential suicide bombers by their DNA?
target: &80 光看DNA，就能筛出潜在的自杀式炸弹客？

source: &112 Certain kinds...
target: &112 有些类型可以……

source: &113 What do we know about the bomber's movement history?
target: &113 这个炸弹客之前的行踪查到了吗？

source: &81 Central's managed to pull his entire background on record.
target: &81 中枢把档案里他的全部背景都调出来了。

source: &114 In the ten minutes since it caught him?
target: &114 从发现他到现在，不过十分钟吧？

source: &82 He hasn't been in town long, apparently.
target: &82 看来他来这座城没多久。

source: &83 Came in two weeks ago, apparently on a medical treatment visa from Canada.
target: &83 两周前从加拿大来，拿的好像是就医签证。

source: &115 Spent most of his time in the Barrel, or the Northwest?
target: &115 大部分时间都待在筒楼区，或者西北城区？

source: &84 Yeah...how'd you figure?
target: &84 对……你怎么猜到的？

source: &116 Less surveillance. He's been trained, but still apparently scares easily.
target: &116 那边监控少。他受过训练，可看起来还是很容易受惊。

source: &117 Anyone in danger? Any hostages?
target: &117 有人处于危险中吗？有人质吗？

source: &85 Central's not mentioned any in the casefile.
target: &85 中枢的案件档案里没提。

source: &86 That either means there aren't any...
target: &86 要么是没有……

source: &118 ...or it doesn't consider them sufficiently important.
target: &118 ……要么是它觉得那些人不够重要。

source: &119 Probably wants the transit running again more than it cares about human life.
target: &119 它多半觉得恢复交通，比人命更重要。

source: &87 Sounds like he was surprised - didn't have time to take any.
target: &87 听起来他也措手不及，没时间抓人质。

source: &120 He's not thinking in terms of hostages. He was made as a weapon.
target: &120 他根本没考虑过人质。他是作为武器被制造出来的。

source: &88 Regis?
target: &88 里吉斯？

source: &121 He's a biobomber. The explosives are made of - they ARE - his bones.
target: &121 他是个人体炸弹。炸药是用他的骨头做的——或者说，骨头本身就是炸药。

source: &122 That's how he tripped a DNA sensor.
target: &122 所以他才会触发DNA传感器。

source: &123 Has the bomber issued any demands?
target: &123 炸弹客提出要求了吗？

source: &13 No sir, he hasn't.
target: &13 没有，长官。

source: &14 Every time we got close, he just started yelling.
target: &14 我们一靠近，他就开始大喊大叫。

source: &15 Threatened to "martyr" himself, kept calling us "heathens", and "federals".
target: &15 威胁说要“殉道”，还一直骂我们“异教徒”和“联邦走狗”。

source: &124 It means he's unstable.
target: &124 说明他的精神状态不稳定。

source: &89 But the fact he hasn't done it yet means...he's having second thoughts?
target: &89 可他到现在还没动手，是不是说明……他犹豫了？

source: &125 He didn't have a choice. He was made for this.
target: &125 他没得选。他生来就是为这件事准备的。

source: &126 Can you give me a description of the suspect?
target: &126 能描述一下嫌疑人的外貌吗？

source: &16 Blonde, about 1.6 meters.
target: &16 金发，大约1.6米高。

source: &17 Smart-cams showed him coming into the station in a green, hooded top.
target: &17 智能摄像头拍到他进站时，穿着一件绿色连帽上衣。

source: &18 Came in on crutches and a brace. Looks pretty sickly, if you ask me.
target: &18 他拄着拐杖，戴着支具。我看他病得不轻。

source: &90 You'd think they'd send someone more physically fit.
target: &90 还以为他们会派个身体好点的来。

source: &127 What's your take on it, Dr Lao?
target: &127 劳博士，你怎么看？

source: &91 Honestly? It's looking pretty lousy for him.
target: &91 说实话？他的处境很不妙。

source: &92 It doesn't look like he's got any human shields.
target: &92 看起来他也没有人质可当肉盾。

source: &93 I doubt an empty transit station was his intended target, either.
target: &93 我想，一座空交通站也不是他原本要袭击的目标。

source: &129 Very astute.
target: &129 观察得很敏锐。

source: &94 Charlie, we...ah...you're not going to like this.
target: &94 查理，我们……呃……你不会喜欢这消息的。

source: &95 Central's just bumped the priority. It wants the suspect neutralized.
target: &95 中枢刚刚调高了优先级。它要求消除嫌疑人的威胁。

source: &130 What?!
&131 What's Central's position on this?
target: &131 中枢是什么立场？

source: &96 You're asking for the AI's opinion? You must be getting soft.
target: &96 你居然开始征求人工智能的意见了？看来没以前那么抵触了。

source: &19 It agrees that the bomber poses a limited threat to public security.
target: &19 它也认为，这个炸弹客对公共安全的威胁有限。

source: &97 It's specified that it wants you to make the call, though.
target: &97 不过它特意说明，由你来做决定。

source: &98 Ah...you're not going to like this.
target: &98 啊……你不会喜欢这消息的。

source: &132 Do we have any support inbound?
target: &132 有支援过来吗？

source: &99 Afraid not. There's a SELECT team about ten minutes out,
target: &99 恐怕没有。有支SELECT小队，赶过来大约要十分钟，

source: &100 ...but Central doesn't give this case a high enough public-order cost to warrant it.
target: &100 ……但中枢认为，这起案件造成的社会秩序损失不足以动用他们。

source: &133 You mean it won't send backup because it doesn't want to WORRY people?
target: &133 你的意思是，它不想让人担心，所以连支援都不派？

source: &101 Sorry, Regis. And...ah...you're not going to like this.
target: &101 抱歉，里吉斯。而且……呃……你不会喜欢这消息的。

source: &134 "Neutralized" is a vague term.
target: &134 “消除威胁”是个很含糊的说法。

source: &135 I'm going to try to talk him down.
target: &135 我试试说服他投降。

source: &136 Apparently, I'm a counsellor to the suicidal today.
target: &136 看来今天，我得兼职开导想自杀的人了。

source: &137 It sounds like he's hesitating, I may be able to exploit that.
target: &137 听起来他在犹豫，我也许能利用这一点。

source: &138 But just in case...get to high ground.
target: &138 不过以防万一……你去高处。

source: &103 ...fine. You probably know what you're doing.
target: &103 ……好吧。你应该知道自己在做什么。

source: &139 The signal is "hope". Don't fire until you hear me say it.
target: &139 暗号是“希望”。听到我说之前，别开枪。

source: &104 "Hope". Got it.
&140 Keep the public away, and run one more check for bystanders in the station.
target: &140 把人群拦在外面，再检查一遍站里有没有旁人。

source: &141 We can't afford casualties if this goes wrong.
target: &141 万一出了岔子，我们不能让无辜的人伤亡。

source: &20 Will Central approve of this?
target: &20 中枢会同意吗？

source: &142 We don't have time to wait and find out.
target: &142 没时间等它答复了。

source: &143 Wish me luck.
target: &143 祝我好运。

source: &144 Public safety is our priority.
target: &144 公众安全优先。

source: &105 What's the plan?
target: &105 计划是什么？

source: &145 I'm going in. I'll keep him talking, and keep him stable.
target: &145 我进去，跟他多说几句，稳住他的情绪。

source: &146 Get to high ground, and be prepared to take the shot.
target: &146 你去高处，随时准备开枪。

source: &106 Understood.
&147 The signal is "hope". Wait until you hear it from me.
target: &147 暗号是“希望”。等我说出来再动手。

source: &107 I understand. I've got your back.
target: &107 明白。我会掩护你的。

source: &25 Yes, Doctor!
&1 What do you want, heathen?
target: &1 你想干什么，异教徒？

source: The sight is distressingly familiar. The brace, the weakened bones...the signs of tampering in a young man that brings back memories long buried.
target: 眼前的景象熟悉得令人心痛。支具，脆弱的骨骼……这个年轻人身上被改造过的痕迹，唤醒了深埋多年的记忆。

source: It seems that the best hope would be to leverage what you know about him - try to find some common ground.
target: 眼下最有希望的办法，似乎是利用你对他的了解，试着找到共同点。

source: &148 You sound like you're from America.
target: &148 听口音，你是美国来的吧。

source: &149 Am I right?
target: &149 我猜得对吗？

source: &150 Texas, I'd guess.
target: &150 我猜是得克萨斯。

source: &3 Yes. You're right.
target: &3 是的。你说得对。

source: &151 I thought so! I grew up there myself. Near Fort Worth.
target: &151 我就知道！我也是在那里长大的，沃思堡附近。

source: &152 What part do you hail from?
target: &152 你是哪里人？

source: &4 Ho...Houston.
target: &4 休……休斯敦。

source: &153 I can remember what it's like out there.
target: &153 我还记得，那边是什么样的。

source: &154 It's part of why I came here in the first place.
target: &154 我当初来这里，也有一部分是这个原因。

source: &155 I'm Dr Regis, by the way. Some folk call me Charlie.
target: &155 对了，我是里吉斯博士。也有人叫我查理。

source: &5 ...Thomas...Beckett
target: &5 ……托马斯……贝克特。

source: &156 Like the saint?
target: &156 跟那位圣人同名？

source: &157 Nice to meet y'all, Thomas!
target: &157 很高兴认识你，托马斯！

source: &158 My name's Dr Regis. I'm a CEL case-specialist.
target: &158 我是里吉斯博士，CEL办案专员。

source: &159 Central wants me to clear this up
target: &159 中枢让我来处理这件事。

source: &160 Want to tell me about yourself?
target: &160 愿意说说你自己的情况吗？

source: &6 I am a warrior for God and for justice.
target: &6 我是为上帝与正义而战的勇士。

source: &7 I am His hammer and weapon of war: with me He breaks nations!
target: &7 我是他的战锤，是他的兵器：他借我击碎列国！

source: &8 With me, He destroys kingdoms!
target: &8 他借我毁灭列邦！

source: &9 You may call me Thomas.
target: &9 你可以叫我托马斯。

source: &161 I'm Dr Regis. You are...?
target: &161 我是里吉斯博士。你是……？

source: &10 You may call me Thomas, heathen.
target: &10 你可以叫我托马斯，异教徒。

source: &162 Well, Thomas. You are under arrest.
target: &162 好吧，托马斯。你被捕了。

source: &163 You're charged with conspiracy to transport explosives with criminal intent.
target: &163 你被指控出于犯罪目的，密谋运输爆炸物。

source: &164 You do not have to say anything unless compelled by warrant.
target: &164 除非有令状强制要求，否则你有权保持沉默。

source: &165 Anything you say, do or think may be used against you in city tribunal.
target: &165 你的一切言语、行为和思想，都可能在本市法庭上成为对你不利的证据。

source: &166 You have the right to a public trial, except in instances of terrorism.
target: &166 除涉及恐怖主义的情形外，你有权接受公开审判。

source: &11 I don't bow to your illegitimate government, infidel.
target: &11 我不会向你们这非法政府低头，不信神的家伙。

source: &12 You lay one finger on me, and they won't be able to tell which piece was whose!
target: &12 你敢碰我一下，他们就连哪块肉是谁的都分不清了！

source: &167 So, how do you like the City?
target: &167 那么，你觉得这座城市怎么样？

source: &13 It's a wretched den of sin, like Sodom or Gomorrah.
target: &13 这是个污秽的罪恶巢穴，就像所多玛和蛾摩拉。

source: &168 Well, it's not my favorite, but I wouldn't go that far.
target: &168 我也不算多喜欢这里，不过还不至于这么说。

source: &169 I take it you're not here as a tourist.
target: &169 看来你不是来观光的。

source: &14 I'm here to do my duty, and strike a blow for the Lord!
target: &14 我来履行职责，为主奋力一击！

source: &170 Really? We're a long way out from the war, here.
target: &170 是吗？这里离那场战争可远着呢。

source: &171 Whole other continent, in fact.
target: &171 说实在的，都到另一个大陆了。

source: &15 I...yes, I know...
&16 But now I'm surrounded, and I must make use of what I have.
target: &16 可现在我被包围了，必须用上我拥有的一切。

source: &17 The fire within me!
target: &17 用上我体内的烈火！

source: &172 Okay, so you've got a bomb in your bones.
target: &172 好吧，也就是说，你的骨头里有炸弹。

source: &173 What is it you want?
target: &173 你到底想要什么？

source: &18 I want to bring the Kingdom of the Lord!
target: &18 我要让主的国度降临！

source: &19 I want the withdrawal of the Godless Federals from my homeland!
target: &19 我要让那些不信神的联邦军滚出我的家乡！

source: &174 By threatening a transit station in a city on another continent?
target: &174 靠威胁另一个大陆上一座城市的交通站？

source: &175 With no hostages?
target: &175 而且连人质都没有？

source: &21 I have you, now!
target: &21 现在你就是我的人质！

source: &176 I'm just another of the infidel drones.
target: &176 我不过也是个不信神的走狗。

source: &177 You know Central can replace me.
target: &177 你知道，中枢随时都能找人替代我。

source: &178 We have the station surrounded and evacuated.
target: &178 我们已经包围车站，疏散了人群。

source: &179 Even now, marksmen will be getting ready to shoot you down.
target: &179 此刻，狙击手已经在准备射杀你。

source: &180 There's nothing you can do to escape.
target: &180 你做什么都逃不掉。

source: &22 Only in the material.
target: &22 只是肉身逃不掉。

source: &23 I can let my soul loose upon this Godless city!
target: &23 我可以让灵魂降临这座不信神的城市！

source: &24 I am prepared to use the fire within me!
target: &24 我已经准备好，释放体内的烈火！

source: &181 No you're not. You're hesitating.
target: &181 你没有。你在犹豫。

source: &182 Otherwise, we wouldn't be having this conversation.
target: &182 否则，我们就不会站在这儿说话了。

source: &25 You have no right to judge me, infidel!
target: &25 你没资格评判我，异教徒！

source: &183 How's the scoliosis?
target: &183 你的脊柱侧弯怎么样了？

source: &26 I...what?
&184 And the osteoporosis, the rickets and the diabetes?
target: &184 还有骨质疏松、佝偻病和糖尿病呢？

source: &27 How do you..!?
target: &27 你怎么知道……？！

source: &185 It's a common side effect of sloppy prenatal genetic engineering.
target: &185 粗劣的产前基因改造，常常就有这些副作用。

source: &186 That, and having your body lay explosive nitrates in your bones instead of calcium.
target: &186 而且，他们让你的身体把爆炸性硝酸盐沉积到骨骼里，取代了钙。

source: &28 It's a test of our faith, only the truly worthy who can...
target: &28 这是对我们信仰的考验，只有真正配得上的人才能……

source: &187 It shows just how little the gengineers who made you cared about your health.
target: &187 这恰好说明，制造你的基因工程师有多不在乎你的健康。

source: &188 They made you to walk, and to carry a bomb in your bones.
target: &188 他们只想让你能走路，把骨头里的炸弹带到目的地。

source: &189 The fact that you're a living, feeling, thinking human was merely an inconvenience.
target: &189 至于你是个活生生、有感情、会思考的人，对他们来说只是个麻烦。

source: &190 You don't look well.
target: &190 你的气色很差。

source: &29 I don't want your pity!
target: &29 我不需要你的怜悯！

source: &30 Though my body is weak, my spirit is stronger than ever!
target: &30 我的肉身虽然虚弱，灵魂却比以往任何时候都强大！

source: &191 You look about ready to collapse.
target: &191 你看起来随时都会倒下。

source: &192 If you're the best they've got, no wonder they're losing.
target: &192 要是你已经是他们最好的了，也难怪他们打不赢。

source: &31 Shut up!
&193 A glorious crusade of stumbling invalids.
target: &193 一群走路都走不稳的病人，发动的光荣圣战。

source: &32 SHUT UP!
&194 You're mission's going to end, pretty soon.
target: &194 你的任务很快就要结束了。

source: &195 Whether we put an end to it, or you just plain old run out of steam.
target: &195 要么由我们来结束，要么你自己撑不住。

source: &33 Give up, sinner.
target: &33 放弃吧，罪人。

source: &34 Nothing will lead me from the path of the righteous!
target: &34 什么都不能让我偏离义人的道路！

source: &35 No matter what you think, you don't understand me at all!
target: &35 不管你怎么想，你根本不了解我！

source: &36 There have been times when I've lost faith...
target: &36 我也有过失去信仰的时候……

source: &37 But...I can't let this be one of them...
target: &37 但是……这次不能这样……

source: &196 I used to work with guys like you.
target: &196 我以前跟你这样的人打过交道。

source: &197 A whole lifetime ago...
target: &197 已经像是上辈子的事了……

source: &38 The Lord's warriors?
target: &38 主的战士？

source: &198 Something like that. Kids who'd been altered. Weaponized youth.
target: &198 差不多。被改造过的孩子，被变成武器的年轻人。

source: &199 You've grown up with so many health problems.
target: &199 你从小到大，一身的病。

source: &200 Groomed since birth for a noble "sacrifice".
target: &200 一出生，就被培养着准备一次崇高的“牺牲”。

source: &201 But this...does this seem like the glorious role you were promised?
target: &201 可是现在……这像是他们承诺给你的那种光荣使命吗？

source: &39 It is my duty to God, to sacrifice myself!
target: &39 牺牲自己，是我对上帝的责任！

source: &202 In an empty transit station, thanks to a piece of bad luck?
target: &202 因为倒霉，就得死在一座空交通站里？

source: &40 This wasn't where I was supposed to go...
target: &40 我本来不该来这里……

source: &41 But even the original target...it doesn't seem to fit with God's plan.
target: &41 可就连原本的目标……似乎也不符合上帝的旨意。

source: &203 I know how you're thinking.
target: &203 我知道你在想什么。

source: &204 You're wondering what you can do next.
target: &204 你在想，接下来还能怎么办。

source: &42 I can always sacrifice myself!
target: &42 我随时都可以献出自己！

source: &205 But all that'll do is wreck a train, and maybe kill one CEL agent.
target: &205 可那只会毁掉一列车，或许再搭上一个CEL探员。

source: &206 There are other options, you just need to know that they ARE available.
target: &206 你还有别的选择。你得知道，那些选择一直都在。

source: &207 Come on, you're trapped in here.
target: &207 得了，你已经困在这里了。

source: &208 If you go through with it, it won't be a victory for you.
target: &208 就算你真这么做，也算不上胜利。

source: &209 You'll have disrupted city transit for an hour.
target: &209 你不过让城市交通停上一小时。

source: &210 Thanks to Central, no-one will even hear about your involvement.
target: &210 有中枢在，甚至都不会有人知道是你做的。

source: &211 Don't be stupid, do the right thing.
target: &211 别干傻事，做正确的选择。

source: &43 The "right" thing? Okay, I can do that.
target: &43 “正确”的选择？好，我能做到。

source: &44 I can carry out my duty, for the Lord!
target: &44 我能为主履行职责！

source: &212 You've been used, manipulated.
target: &212 你被人利用了，被人操纵了。

source: &213 Your genes were altered before you were even born.
target: &213 还没出生，你的基因就被改造了。

source: &214 You never had a choice!
target: &214 你从来都没得选！

source: &45 It's a test of my faith!
target: &45 这是对我信仰的考验！

source: &215 Your parents probably didn't have a choice, either.
target: &215 你的父母，多半也没得选。

source: &216 If they didn't agree to do it for religious reasons...
target: &216 要是宗教理由说服不了他们……

source: &217 Well, I know that warlords can find even worse ways to persuade people.
target: &217 我知道，军阀总能找到更残酷的办法，让人答应。

source: &46 They...it...
&47 Mother and father were always so sad...
target: &47 父亲和母亲，总是那么悲伤……

source: &48 I couldn't understand it - I was going to do God's will.
target: &48 我那时不明白——我明明是要去遵行上帝的旨意。

source: &218 Whatever mission you were given, it's over.
target: &218 不管他们交给你的是什么任务，现在都结束了。

source: &219 Bombing a transit station won't help anybody.
target: &219 炸掉一座交通站，对谁都没有好处。

source: &49 I can fulfil my purpose!
target: &49 我能完成自己的使命！

source: &220 I just want a peaceful solution to this.
target: &220 我只想和平解决这件事。

source: &221 Nobody has to get hurt. Not even us.
target: &221 谁都不用受伤。我们也一样。

source: &50 Enough of your empty lies!
target: &50 够了，别再说这些空洞的谎话！

source: &222 Can you feel a tingle in the hairs on your neck?
target: &222 你有没有觉得，脖子后面有点发麻，汗毛都竖起来了？

source: &51 What?
&223 That'll be my partner, watching you through her rifle-scope.
target: &223 那是我的搭档，正透过步枪瞄准镜盯着你。

source: &224 As soon as she sees something going wrong, well, you can imagine what comes next.
target: &224 她一发现情况不对……接下来会怎么样，你应该想得到。

source: &52 Nobody is fast enough to stop divine fire!
target: &52 没有人来得及阻止神圣的烈火！

source: &225 I wouldn't be so sure, she's pretty quick.
target: &225 这可不一定。她的动作很快。

source: &53 Fine, then let us test her!
target: &53 好，那就让我们考验考验她！

source: &226 You know why I'm in here?
target: &226 你知道我为什么进来吗？

source: &54 As a spout for Babylon's lies?
target: &54 来替巴比伦散播谎言？

source: &227 I'm here to prevent a waste of life.
target: &227 我是来阻止生命白白被糟蹋的。

source: &228 If it was up to Central, a SELECT Team would have you shot down already.
target: &228 要是听中枢的，SELECT小队早就把你射杀了。

source: &229 I'm here because I care, because I don't want anyone to die.
target: &229 我在这里，是因为我在乎，因为我不想有人死。

source: &230 All life is valuable. Mine, yours, the people of this city.
target: &230 每个人的生命都值得珍惜。我的，你的，这座城市所有人的。

source: &55 There are still the enemies of -
target: &55 可还有主的敌人——

source: &231 I know how you feel about your "mission".
target: &231 我知道，你是怎么看待这份“使命”的。

source: &232 But it'd still be a waste if your life was ended,
target: &232 可如果你的生命就这样结束，仍然是白白浪费了，

source: &233 ...simply because Central got jumpy over what you MIGHT do.
target: &233 ……仅仅因为中枢害怕你可能会做的事。

source: &234 I'd rather see the positive potential.
target: &234 我宁愿相信，你也能做些有意义的事。

source: &235 You might come with me, and go on to live a rewarding life.
target: &235 你可以跟我走，以后过上充实、有意义的生活。

source: &236 If you want to get out of this alive, you're going to have to come with me.
target: &236 要想活着离开，你就得跟我走。

source: &56 You know me, you know my role.
target: &56 你了解我，也知道我的使命。

source: &57 My aim is to bring myself unto the Lord,
target: &57 我要把自己献给主，

source: &58 ...while I strike a blow against His enemies in Babylon.
target: &58 ……同时打击他在巴比伦的敌人。

source: &237 But WE aren't your enemies. I can only help you if you come with me.
target: &237 可我们不是你的敌人。只有你跟我走，我才能帮你。

source: &59 All who do not work towards His dominion are His enemy!
target: &59 不为他的统治效力的人，都是他的敌人！

source: &238 This is the last time I warn you.
target: &238 这是我最后一次警告你。

source: &239 Surrender, while you still can.
target: &239 趁还来得及，投降吧。

source: &60 Hah! I've heard your empty threats.
target: &60 哈！你那些空洞的威胁，我都听过了。

source: &61 Babylon is weak, decadent, Godless.
target: &61 巴比伦软弱、堕落，毫无信仰。

source: &62 You cannot stand against His dominion.
target: &62 你们无法抗拒主的统治。

source: &63 He shall reign on Earth!
target: &63 他必将在大地上掌权！

source: &240 It's been a difficult, complex day.
target: &240 今天真是艰难，又复杂。

source: &241 Apparently, I haven't been able to change your mind.
target: &241 看来，我没能让你改变主意。

source: &64 You can never mislead the truly faithful.
target: &64 真正虔诚的人，永远不会被你误导。

source: &242 In that case, I'm truly sorry,
target: &242 既然如此，我真的很抱歉，

source: &243 ...and I hope you'll forgive me.
target: &243 ……也希望你能原谅我。

source: &65 Pfft, you think you can -
target: &65 哼，你以为你能——

source: &66 But if I agreed to go with you...I'd have failed in my duty...
target: &66 可要是我跟你走……就辜负了自己的职责……

source: &67 I'd just be a prisoner in a strange land...
target: &67 我会成为异国他乡的囚徒……

source: &244 "For the Lord hears the needy and does not despise his own people who are prisoners."
target: &244 “因为耶和华听了穷乏人，不藐视被囚的人。”

source: &245 Psalms 69, verse 33.
&68 You're right...wherever I am, I'm always in the Lord's sight.
target: &68 你说得对……无论我在哪里，主都在看顾我。

source: &246 There are more ways to do His work than destruction.
target: &246 为他效力的办法，不只有毁灭。

source: &247 We can help you find it.
target: &247 我们能帮你找到别的路。

source: &248 We can probably even fix your bones.
target: &248 甚至也许能治好你的骨头。

source: &69 Alright...I shall not resist.
target: &69 好吧……我不会反抗。

source: &249 Thomas - you've made a wise choice.
target: &249 托马斯，你做了个明智的选择。

source: &250 More importantly, you've made it for yourself.
target: &250 更重要的是，这是你自己的选择。

source: &38 Hey, Lao.
&572 Yeah?
&39 I've lost count of the number of times the Mindjacker's struck.
target: &39 意识劫持者作案多少次，我都数不清了。

source: &712 In Newton, or globally?
target: &712 在牛顿市，还是全世界？

source: &40 Just a figure of speech. He's been on the rampage for too long.
target: &40 只是个说法。他已经猖狂太久了。

source: &41 But now he's in OUR territory...
target: &41 可现在，他到了我们的地盘……

source: &719 Should give us the advantage.
target: &719 应该能让我们占些优势。

source: &42 Do we have any ideas about our perp?
target: &42 对这个罪犯，有什么想法吗？

source: &2932 The fact that he's stealing data straight from living neural wiring is disturbing,
target: &2932 他直接从活人的神经接口里窃取数据，这确实让人不安，

source: &968 ...but it tells us a couple of important things.
target: &968 ……不过，也能看出几件重要的事。

source: &969 Well, previously-caught mindjackers have usually burnt out after one or two attacks.
target: &969 以前被抓住的意识劫持者，通常作案一两次就撑不住了。

source: &973 Sharing a whole-other's-brain worth of data is pretty taxing.
target: &973 承受另一个完整大脑的数据，负担可不小。

source: &43 So we're looking for someone with a really specialized wetware setup in their heads.
target: &43 所以，我们要找的人，脑子里装着一套非常特殊的湿件系统。

source: &44 Pity that won't tell us what they look like.
target: &44 可惜，这也看不出他长什么样。

source: &999 The other problem is how slippery this guy is.
target: &999 另一个问题，是这家伙太滑头了。

source: &1000 Only fragments of appearances on camera, no clear witnesses.
target: &1000 摄像头只拍到零星片段，也没有目击者看清楚他。

source: &45 Which means he's either a master of disguise...
target: &45 也就是说，他要么是伪装高手……

source: &1001 Or there's some pretty high-up collusion to hide him.
target: &1001 要么，有地位很高的人合谋帮他掩护。

source: &1002 That wouldn't surprise me if he were a business hire.
target: &1002 如果是企业雇的，我倒不意外。

source: &46 Still, after this many hits...he may start to slip.
target: &46 不过，干了这么多票……他也许要开始露马脚了。

source: &1003 Even if it's just his psyche breaking.
target: &1003 哪怕只是精神撑不住了。

source: &47 At least we've managed to link the previous mindjackings to one suspect.
target: &47 至少，我们已经把之前的意识劫持案，关联到了同一个嫌疑人身上。

source: &1004 It's the M.O. - historically, mindjackers have used some kind of external gear.
target: &1004 是作案手法。过去，意识劫持者通常会使用外部设备。

source: &1009 They use another system to extract, before storing it in their own neural tissue.
target: &1009 先用另一套系统抽取，再把数据存在自己的神经组织里。

source: &48 So, they'd need a terminal.
target: &48 所以，他们需要一台终端。

source: &1067 Which is usually how we catch them - it's conspicuous.
target: &1067 也正是靠这一点，我们通常能抓到他们。设备太显眼。

source: &49 But our mindjacker's not behaving the same way?
target: &49 可这个意识劫持者不一样？

source: &1101 No - his tools appear to be built into his own bodily wetware system.
target: &1101 不一样。他的工具似乎装在自身的湿件系统里。

source: &32 Some kind of resonance imager in his body, maybe.
target: &32 也许，体内装着某种共振成像装置。

source: &50 Whatever it is, it's less invasive as well.
target: &50 不管是什么，侵入性也更小。

source: &1117 Exactly. His victims suffer massive haemorrages, but no external injuries.
target: &1117 没错。受害者会大出血，却没有外伤。

source: &1536 State of the art, but a dead giveaway.
target: &1536 技术是顶尖的，可也把作案特征暴露无遗。

source: &51 So, Central predicted our Mindjacker was going to strike here...
target: &51 所以，中枢预测，意识劫持者会在这里下手……

source: &1341 You don't trust it?
target: &1341 你不信它？

source: &52 I just don't understand how it came to that conclusion.
target: &52 我只是不明白，它是怎么得出这个结论的。

source: &1377 Obviously we're doing our jobs right.
target: &1377 显然，我们的工作做对了。

source: &1378 We collect data, which Central interprets.
target: &1378 我们收集数据，中枢负责解读。

source: &1379 Based on that data, it maps a pattern.
target: &1379 再依据数据，找出规律。

source: &53 But why isn't it a pattern that WE could see?
target: &53 可为什么是我们看不出来的规律？

source: &1380 It's not only us, Central's got all of the city, the whole net to draw on!
target: &1380 它不只有我们的数据。整座城市，整个网络，都能供中枢利用！

source: &54 But it won't tell us how it's come to the conclusion where the Mindjacker will strike.
target: &54 可它不肯告诉我们，究竟是怎么判断意识劫持者会在哪儿下手的。

source: &55 Does it think we can't understand? Is it concealing something?
target: &55 它觉得我们听不懂？还是在隐瞒什么？

source: &1381 Just be glad we've got an advantage like Central.
target: &1381 有中枢这样的优势，你就知足吧。

source: &56 I still don't like it.
target: &56 我还是不喜欢。

source: &1382 You don't like that Central's predicted this, do you?
target: &1382 中枢预测到了这件事，让你不舒服，是吧？

source: &57 It's not how investigations are supposed to be done.
target: &57 查案不该是这么查的。

source: &1383 Admit it, you're afraid your job's going to be stolen by machines!
target: &1383 承认吧，你就是怕饭碗被机器抢走！

source: &1384 Kinda like weavers...factory workers...authors...
target: &1384 就像织工……工厂工人……作家……

source: &58 Just how old do you think I am? No, don't answer that.
target: &58 你到底觉得我有多老？不，别回答。

source: &59 I just don't like having that key bit of information kept from me.
target: &59 我就是不喜欢，有人把最关键的信息瞒着我。

source: &1385 You need to learn to work with Central.
target: &1385 你得学会跟中枢合作。

source: &1386 It's not our enemy! It works for us, as we work for it.
target: &1386 它不是我们的敌人！我们替它工作，它也替我们工作。

source: &128 Got any ideas where we can look next?
target: &128 有什么想法，接下来去哪儿查？

source: &1387 I thought you were supposed to be the lead on this case!
target: &1387 这案子不是该由你负责吗！

source: &1388 Hm...we could look into that other lead...what was his name...
target: &1388 嗯……可以查查另一条线索……那个人叫什么来着……

source: &648 Giel Van der Waal?
target: &648 吉尔·范德瓦尔？

source: &1389 Yeah, that's the one.
&462 I thought Van der Waal made it pretty clear he wasn't going to speak to us.
target: &462 范德瓦尔不肯跟我们谈，已经说得很明白了吧。

source: &1390 Might just be the way you handled him.
target: &1390 也许只是因为，你跟他说话的方式不对。

source: &1391 Tact is apparently not your strong point.
target: &1391 显然，委婉不是你的长处。

source: &464 I like to speak my mind.
target: &464 我喜欢直说。

source: &1392 I'll contact him and see if he's more open to persuasion.
target: &1392 我会联系他，看看能不能说服他。

source: &1393 He might cooperate if you're not there threatening him with physical injury.
target: &1393 你不在场威胁要揍他，也许他就肯合作了。

source: &503 He's a dyed-in-the-wool felon. He deserves worse.
target: &503 他是个彻头彻尾的罪犯，吃苦头也是活该。

source: &1394 But if he can help us...
target: &1394 可如果他能帮我们……

source: &567 Alright, see what you can do.
target: &567 好吧，看看你能做些什么。

source: &913 That locked door is the only other way out.
target: &913 那扇锁着的门，是唯一的其他出口。

source: &1079 Can you ask Central to unlock it remotely?
target: &1079 能让中枢远程把它打开吗？

source: &1395 Afraid not. It's an old-style keypad, nothing to connect to the system.
target: &1395 恐怕不行。这是老式密码键盘，没东西能连上系统。

source: &1081 The Mindjacker's apparently gotten through.
target: &1081 意识劫持者显然已经过去了。

source: &1396 He might have taken the code straight from his victim's memory.
target: &1396 他可能直接从受害者的记忆里拿到了密码。

source: &1397 Maybe we can find someone to ask?
target: &1397 也许，能找个人问问？

source: &1082 This late? There's nobody else in the office who'd know...
target: &1082 这么晚？办公室里已经没别人知道了……

source: &1399 Looks like we've found our latest casualty.
target: &1399 看来，我们找到最新的受害者了。

source: &1084 Damn it. Why him, though?
target: &1084 该死。可为什么是他？

source: &1400 I was wondering the same thing. We're assuming the Mindjacker's a data-thief.
target: &1400 我也在想。我们假定，意识劫持者是个数据窃贼。

source: &1401 The usual MO would be to target valuable info he can sell on the black market.
target: &1401 通常，他应该瞄准能在黑市上卖掉的有价值信息。

source: &1097 But this guy...he was an HR administrator.
target: &1097 可这个人……是个人力资源主管。

source: &1402 Apparently a very good one, but not the kind who'd be let in on company secrets.
target: &1402 显然，他很能干，但还轮不到接触公司的秘密。

source: &1098 We'll just have to ask the Mindjacker when we catch him...
target: &1098 抓到意识劫持者的时候，再问他吧……

source: &1200 That body on the sidewalk...
target: &1200 人行道上那具尸体……

source: &1403 We need to take a look at it.
target: &1403 我们得去看看。

source: &1404 That would have been a LONG fall.
target: &1404 那可得从很高的地方摔下来。

source: &1406 He must have been in the wrong place at the wrong time.
target: &1406 他一定是在不对的时候，出现在了不对的地方。

source: &1407 Came across the Mindjacker in the middle of what he was doing.
target: &1407 正撞上意识劫持者在作案。

source: &1203 Paid for it heavily, too.
target: &1203 也为此付出了惨重的代价。

source: &1204 Animus Organics...
target: &1204 阿尼姆斯有机公司……

source: &1408 That's what the sign says.
target: &1408 牌子上是这么写的。

source: &1409 They're one of the city's largest computational-biotech firms.
target: &1409 这是城里最大的生物计算技术公司之一。

source: &1205 What do they make?
target: &1205 他们生产什么？

source: &1410 Wetware, mostly. Wouldn't be grown here, probably in Eurofed.
target: &1410 主要是湿件。应该不是在这里培养的，很可能在欧洲联邦。

source: &1206 This place is just the offices?
target: &1206 这里就只是办公室？

source: &1411 Regional headquarters, Central tells me.
target: &1411 中枢说，这里是地区总部。

source: &1412 Do we know why it predicts the next attack will take place here?
target: &1412 知道它为什么预测，下次袭击会发生在这里吗？

source: &1207 It won't share that with us. "Need to know."
target: &1207 它不肯告诉我们。“按需知情。”

source: &1208 A high-tech firm like this must have secrets worth something to a Mindjacker.
target: &1208 这样的高科技公司，总该有些秘密，值得意识劫持者出手。

source: &1209 Wetware, huh?
&1413 Yeah, specifically for forming neural connections between systems. The blue stuff.
target: &1413 嗯，专门用来在系统之间建立神经连接，就是那些蓝色的东西。

source: &1414 The nanomachines keeping the modern world running.
target: &1414 让现代世界运转的纳米机器。

source: &1210 It's funny, when I think "nanomachine", I picture tiny gears and turbines.
target: &1210 真有意思。一想到“纳米机器”，我脑子里就是微型齿轮和涡轮。

source: &1211 When really, they're just bits of proteins and macromolecules.
target: &1211 可实际上，它们只是些蛋白质和大分子。

source: &1415 They still perform all kinds of mechanical tasks.
target: &1415 也一样能完成各种机械工作。

source: &1416 Just...smaller...
target: &1416 只是……更小罢了……

source: &1212 I guess I'm technically more of an expert in them than you are.
target: &1212 严格说来，我对它们应该比你更在行。

source: &1248 I used to *make* them for a living.
target: &1248 我以前可是靠*制造*它们吃饭的。

source: &1417 Yeah, but you wouldn't know what to do with them anymore.
target: &1417 是啊，可现在你已经不知道该怎么用了。

source: &1418 Organic computing - that's *my* field.
target: &1418 有机计算，那可是*我的*领域。

source: &1267 Let me know if you find anything.
target: &1267 找到什么，告诉我一声。

source: &1419 Will do, Regis.
target: &1419 会的，里吉斯。

source: &37 This is Regis. Come in, Central.
target: &37 我是里吉斯。中枢，请回应。

source: &78 Central, standing by.
target: &78 中枢，待命中。

source: &1268 Status report, Central.
target: &1268 中枢，报告情况。

source: &86 All operations within Centralized Emergency Logistics nominal.
target: &86 中枢应急后勤的所有工作正常开展。

source: &242 Anti-civil activity index within tolerance at point-zero-zero-four.
target: &242 危害公共秩序的活动指数为零点零零四，处于容许范围。

source: &243 Weather forecast: dry, highs of twelve celsius, UV index of eight...
target: &243 天气预报：干燥，最高气温十二摄氏度，紫外线指数为八……

source: &1269 Uh...less general. Updates on the case?
target: &1269 呃……别那么笼统。案子有什么进展？

source: &254 No new data, Dr Regis.
target: &254 没有新的数据，里吉斯博士。

source: &1278 Okay...thanks...
&1339 You don't usually make predictions on high-level cases like this, Central.
target: &1339 中枢，你通常不对这种重大案件作预测。

source: &1347 What's different about this one?
target: &1347 这次有什么不同？

source: &255 Limited progress was being made through conventional investigation.
target: &255 常规调查的进展有限。

source: &256 To expedite the investigation, I was tasked to provide more direct oversight.
target: &256 为加快调查，我受命提供更直接的监督。

source: &1348 Hey, are you saying we can't do our jobs right by ourselves?
target: &1348 嘿，你是在说我们靠自己就做不好工作？

source: &257 I am a civic-coordination AI, Dr Regis, with responsibility for 9.4 million inhabitants.
target: &257 里吉斯博士，我是城市统筹人工智能，负责940万居民。

source: &258 Slander of colleagues would produce no gains for the city.
target: &258 诋毁同事，不会给城市带来任何收益。

source: &259 A fact which, on occasion, I would hope you would pay more attention to.
target: &259 关于这一点，我希望你有时也能多留意一些。

source: &1350 What made you think the Mindjacker was going to strike here?
target: &1350 你为什么认为，意识劫持者会在这里下手？

source: &260 The professionalism of the attacks suggests that these are not merely random targets.
target: &260 袭击的专业程度表明，这些并非随机目标。

source: &261 Though the reasoning behind the attacks remains vague, patterns form from previous incidents.
target: &261 虽然袭击动机尚不明确，但以往事件已经呈现出规律。

source: &262 The probability of tonight's attack was sufficient that it warranted investigation.
target: &262 今晚发生袭击的概率，已足以支持展开调查。

source: &1353 Obviously you're using data gathered by myself and Dr Lao.
target: &1353 显然，你用了我和劳博士收集的数据。

source: &1363 But since *we* haven't found a pattern in our work,
target: &1363 可既然*我们*没有从自己的工作中找出规律，

source: &1366 I guess that you've got more sources than us?
target: &1366 那你应该还有更多情报来源吧？

source: &263 Correct. However, that information remains classified.
target: &263 正确。不过，那些信息仍属机密。

source: &1367 Huh. What a surprise.
target: &1367 哼，真让人意外。

source: &264 You remain skeptical, Dr Regis?
target: &264 你仍有怀疑，里吉斯博士？

source: &1369 It's not how I think of detective work, Central.
target: &1369 中枢，我不认为查案该这么查。

source: &1370 I don't believe human behavior's something you can just...map.
target: &1370 我不相信，人的行为可以直接……描成一张图。

source: &265 Two centuries of research in probabilistic sociology would disagree.
target: &265 两个世纪的概率社会学研究，并不认同你的看法。

source: &1188 We'll see.
&1371 What's your take on the case, Central?
target: &1371 中枢，你对这个案子有什么看法？

source: &266 An individual of unknown origin is prosecuting a global series of attacks.
target: &266 一名来历不明的个体，正在全球范围实施一系列袭击。

source: &267 These involve the removal of data from the minds of victims.
target: &267 袭击涉及从受害者的心智中移除数据。

source: &268 Invariably, the speed of the process has had a deleterious and fatal effect...
target: &268 无一例外，抽取过程的速度均造成了严重且致命的损害……

source: &1372 Yes, those are the facts, but what's your OPINION on the matter?
target: &1372 对，这些是事实，可你对这件事的看法是什么？

source: &269 All we have are facts, Dr Regis.
target: &269 我们掌握的只有事实，里吉斯博士。

source: &270 These must be analysed in order to apprehend those responsible.
target: &270 必须分析这些事实，才能抓捕责任人。

source: &1373 And THAT is why AIs would make lousy detectives.
target: &1373 所以我才说，人工智能会是很糟糕的警探。

source: &271 CEL retains an investigative corps of specialists such as yourself, Dr Regis.
target: &271 CEL仍保留由你这样的专家组成的调查队伍，里吉斯博士。

source: &272 Your role is in no danger, you can be assured.
target: &272 你的职位没有危险，请放心。

source: &1449 I never said I thought it was.
target: &1449 我又没说我担心这个。

source: &273 Though you may not be neurally linked, and I am unable to directly access your mental activity...
target: &273 虽然你没有神经连接，我也无法直接读取你的精神活动……

source: &274 ...a lot can be learned about an individual's thoughts by observation.
target: &274 ……但通过观察，仍能了解一个人的许多想法。

source: &1471 What do we know about Animus Organics?
target: &1471 关于阿尼姆斯有机公司，我们知道多少？

source: &275 Biotech firm, manufacturer of computational wetware and other biomechanical products.
target: &275 生物技术企业，生产计算湿件及其他生物机械产品。

source: &276 First publicly traded stock in August 2044, currently sitting board members include...
target: &276 于2044年8月首次公开上市。目前董事会成员包括……

source: &1705 Okay, maybe that's a bit too much.
target: &1705 好吧，可能有点太详细了。

source: &1723 Why do we think the Mindjacker's going to strike here?
target: &1723 为什么认为意识劫持者会在这里下手？

source: &277 The projection has been based upon previous targets.
target: &277 预测依据的是以往的目标。

source: &278 Using a Markov/Jermyn distribution map, outlying variables can be...
target: &278 使用马尔可夫/Jermyn分布图，离群变量可被……

source: &1724 Statistics aren't really my thing, Central.
target: &1724 中枢，统计可不是我的强项。

source: &279 You would have been unsatisfied with "it's beyond your comprehension".
target: &279 如果我说“超出你的理解能力”，你也不会满意。

source: &1727 I...guess you're right.
target: &1727 我……想你是对的。

source: &1829 Much as I hate to say it, it looks like you were right, Central.
target: &1829 虽然不愿这么说，可看来你说对了，中枢。

source: &1830 We've got a mindjacking victim in the offices.
target: &1830 办公室里有一个意识劫持受害者。

source: &280 Avery Girbach, 32, regional HR supervisor.
target: &280 埃弗里·吉尔巴赫，32岁，地区人力资源主管。

source: &1873 That's...correct...
&281 As expected. Attack patterns are matching probability mapping.
target: &281 符合预期。袭击规律与概率模型吻合。

source: &1874 It doesn't look like the Mindjacker's gotten far.
target: &1874 意识劫持者好像没走远。

source: &1875 There's only one other way out besides the elevator.
target: &1875 除了电梯，这里只有另一条出路。

source: &282 Please continue your investigation.
target: &282 请继续调查。

source: &283 Swift resolution of this case will greatly enhance civic welfare.
target: &283 尽快解决此案，将极大改善市民福祉。

source: &1876 Central, we have a bystander casualty.
target: &1876 中枢，有一名无关人员遇害。

source: &1877 Doesn't appear to have been mindjacked, so it may be unrelated. Still...
target: &1877 看起来没有被意识劫持，所以可能与此案无关。不过……

source: &284 A most troubling turn of events.
target: &284 事态的变化令人十分不安。

source: &1878 That's an understatement.
target: &1878 这话还轻了。

source: &285 This is, after all, an unexpected variable.
target: &285 毕竟，这是一个预料之外的变量。

source: &1879 An unexpected-?! A man is DEAD, Central!
target: &1879 预料之外的——？！死了一个人，中枢！

source: &286 And as a result, probability projections have become less stable.
target: &286 因此，概率预测变得更加不稳定。

source: &287 Proceed with caution, Dr Regis.
target: &287 请谨慎行事，里吉斯博士。

source: &1880 Central, the Mindjacker made his escape via lifting gear.
target: &1880 中枢，意识劫持者用起吊设备逃走了。

source: &1881 He fled the roof, and met up with an aerostat above.
target: &1881 他离开屋顶，登上了停在上方的一艘浮空艇。

source: &288 No records have shown an aerostat present at that time.
target: &288 没有记录表明，当时有浮空艇在场。

source: &1882 We BOTH saw it, me and Lao.
target: &1882 我们两个都看见了！我和劳。

source: &289 You are advised to pursue other lines of inquiry.
target: &289 建议你追查其他线索。

source: &290 I shall begin pattern analysis to determine likely future targets.
target: &290 我将开始规律分析，判断未来可能的目标。

source: &1883 You're not even going to look into it?
target: &1883 你连查都不查？

source: &1884 I thought you might say something like that.
target: &1884 我就知道你会这么说。

source: &1885 Central, the door to the roof is locked.
target: &1885 中枢，通往屋顶的门锁着。

source: &1886 We believe the Mindjacker may have fled this way.
target: &1886 我们认为，意识劫持者可能从这里逃走了。

source: &1887 Can you get it open?
target: &1887 你能打开它吗？

source: &291 Accessing Animus Organics Security loop...
target: &291 正在接入阿尼姆斯有机公司的安保回路……

source: &292 It appears that this door is not connected to the general security systems.
target: &292 这扇门似乎未接入总体安保系统。

source: &293 The means of access is likely held by senior staff.
target: &293 进入方式很可能由高级员工掌握。

source: &1888 Real helpful, Central.
target: &1888 真有帮助啊，中枢。

source: &294 You are most welcome, Dr Regis.
target: &294 不必客气，里吉斯博士。

source: &1870 Regis out.
target: &1870 里吉斯，通话结束。

source: &1420 The Mindjacker!
target: &1420 意识劫持者！

source: &1889 Freeze! CEL agents!
target: &1889 别动！CEL探员！

source: &1890 CEL doesn't appreciate people shooting at its agents!
target: &1890 CEL可不喜欢有人朝它的探员开枪！

source: &1421 If you cut it out, maybe we'll put in a good word for you!
target: &1421 你要是停手，也许我们会替你说几句好话！

source: &1891 Lay down your weapon, and put your hands above your head!
target: &1891 放下武器，双手举过头顶！

source: &1422 Does that ever work?
target: &1422 这话有用过吗？

source: &1892 Sometimes. It was worth a try!
target: &1892 有时候。试一下总没坏处！

source: &1893 You are under arrest, on suspicion of illegal trafficking of neural data,
target: &1893 你涉嫌非法贩运神经数据，现将你逮捕，

source: &1894 ...breaking and entering, and homicide!
target: &1894 ……还有非法侵入和杀人！

source: &1423 Let's not forget SHOOTING AT CEL AGENTS!
target: &1423 别忘了，还有朝CEL探员开枪！

source: &1895 The only way off this rooftop is down.
target: &1895 离开这个屋顶，唯一的办法就是往下。

source: &1896 Either with us, or over the edge.
target: &1896 要么跟我们下去，要么从边上跳下去。

source: &1424 Frankly, the second one's fine by me!
target: &1424 说真的，我完全不介意第二种！

source: &1897 I think I've found the office manager's contact.
target: &1897 我想，我找到办公室经理的联系方式了。

source: &1425 See if he'll help us.
target: &1425 看看他肯不肯帮忙。

source: &1426 Remember: be consistent when you're talking to him.
target: &1426 记住，跟他说话时，前后要一致。

source: &1 Mrmph...wha? Who is this?
target: &1 唔……什么？谁啊？

source: &2 Do you have any idea what time it is?
target: &2 你知道现在几点吗？

source: &1898 Mr Atwood, my name is Dr Regis. I'm an investigator for CEL.
target: &1898 阿特伍德先生，我是里吉斯博士，CEL的调查员。

source: &3 I...uh...what?
&4 I mean...what's happened?
target: &4 我是说……出什么事了？

source: &1899 I just need to ask you a couple of questions about your workplace.
target: &1899 我只是需要问你几个有关工作场所的问题。

source: &5 Oh nuke, you're calling from the office...
target: &5 哦，该炸的，你是从办公室打来的……

source: &6 What's happened?
target: &6 出什么事了？

source: &1900 We're investigating a serious incident in your workplace.
target: &1900 你工作的地方发生了严重事件，我们正在调查。

source: &1901 I need to ask you a few questions.
target: &1901 我需要问你几个问题。

source: &7 Oh nuke, what's happened?
target: &7 哦，该炸的，出什么事了？

source: &1902 We're on the trail of a dangerous felon.
target: &1902 我们正在追踪一名危险罪犯。

source: &1903 He's killed dozens before, and without your help, he's going to escape.
target: &1903 他已经杀了几十个人。如果没有你的帮助，他就要逃走了。

source: &8 Oh God, what's happened?
target: &8 天哪，出什么事了？

source: &1904 Don't worry, you're not in trouble.
target: &1904 别担心，你没惹麻烦。

source: &1905 We need access to the roof stairwell in your office.
target: &1905 我们需要进入你们办公室里通往屋顶的楼梯间。

source: &9 Wait, how do I know you're really a CEL agent?
target: &9 等等，我怎么知道你真的是CEL探员？

source: &10 I can't just give out the code to anyone!
target: &10 我不能随便把密码告诉别人！

source: &1906 We need to get up to the roof from your office.
target: &1906 我们需要从你们办公室前往屋顶。

source: &1907 We have reason to believe someone we're pursuing has made their way up.
target: &1907 我们有理由相信，追踪的那个人已经上去了。

source: &11 Oh, jeez...well, uh, I'm the one with the code,
target: &11 哦，天哪……呃，密码确实在我这里，

source: &12 ...but management's ordered me not to let people up there.
target: &12 ……可管理层不准我放人上去。

source: &13 That's why we've got the lock in the first place.
target: &13 所以，我们才给门上了锁。

source: &1908 Two of your colleagues have been killed on-site.
target: &1908 你的两位同事已经在现场遇害。

source: &1909 We're tracking the murderer, and we're pretty sure he's fled to the roof.
target: &1909 我们正在追踪凶手，基本确定他逃到了屋顶。

source: &14 What?! Bu...who?!
&1910 We need access to the roof, as quickly as possible.
target: &1910 我们需要尽快进入屋顶。

source: &1911 What's the code for the access-door in your office?
target: &1911 你们办公室里，那扇通道门的密码是什么？

source: &1912 You have nothing to worry about, you're perfectly safe.
target: &1912 不用担心，你现在十分安全。

source: &1913 We just need your help.
target: &1913 我们只是需要你的帮助。

source: &1914 I'm transmitting my credentials to your terminal.
target: &1914 我正在把身份证明发送到你的终端。

source: &16 So...you're really a CEL agent?
target: &16 所以……你真的是CEL探员？

source: &17 I guess I *can't* say no, then...
target: &17 那我想，我也*不能*拒绝了……

source: &18 The roof access code is 6167.
target: &18 屋顶的通行密码是6167。

source: DOORCODE
reason: 内部成就标识；全部脚本引用作为unlockAch参数，沿用原键以保持成就匹配

source: &1915 Thanks. Other CEL agents may contact you later for more information.
target: &1915 谢谢。之后其他CEL探员可能还会联系你，询问更多情况。

source: &19 I...I'm sorry.
target: &19 我……对不起。

source: &20 I don't want to say anything until I've got a lawyer.
target: &20 找到律师之前，我什么都不想说。

source: &21 It's just...y'know...gotta think of my own safety as well...
target: &21 就是……你知道的……我也得考虑自己的安全……

source: &1916 This is a serious incident, Mr Atwood.
target: &1916 这是一起严重事件，阿特伍德先生。

source: &1917 Time is slipping away, and a serial killer might be as well.
target: &1917 时间在流逝，一个连环杀手也可能溜走。

source: &22 Wha...really?
target: &22 什么……真的？

source: &1918 We need your assistance to bring him in.
target: &1918 我们需要你的协助，才能把他抓住。

source: &1919 Do you think you'll be able to help us?
target: &1919 你能帮我们吗？

source: &23 Sure, sure...I'll do what I can.
target: &23 好，好……我会尽力。

source: &24 You want the roof code? It's 6167.
target: &24 你要屋顶的密码？是6167。

source: &25 Sure...no problem.
target: &25 好……没问题。

source: &26 Wait a sec...
&27 Serial killers? In the Animus office?
target: &27 连环杀手？在阿尼姆斯办公室里？

source: &28 Girbach, this is real unprofessional of you.
target: &28 吉尔巴赫，你这么做可太不专业了。

source: &29 Come on, I know you didn't want to work tonight,
target: &29 得了，我知道你今晚不想工作，

source: &30 ...but there's a REASON you're not allowed up on the roof.
target: &30 ……可不准你上屋顶，是有原因的。

source: &31 You almost had me, but pretending to be a CEL agent...that's desperate.
target: &31 我差点信了。可假扮CEL探员……你还真是没招了。

source: &1920 Damn.
&1921 Do you want CEL agents bringing you in as well?
target: &1921 你也想让CEL探员把你带走吗？

source: &1922 All this stalling, I might think you're working with the killer!
target: &1922 这么拖延，我都要怀疑你跟凶手是一伙的！

source: &32 N-no! I...I just...
target: &32 不、不是！我……我只是……

source: &1923 Quickly! What's the code?!
target: &1923 快点！密码是什么？！

source: &863 Thanks.
&34 I...I'm not saying anything!
target: &34 我……什么都不会说！

source: &35 Take it up with my lawyer.
target: &35 跟我的律师说去吧。

source: &1924 Great, NOW he grows a spine.
target: &1924 真好，他现在倒有骨气了。

source: &251 Hey, Max.
&108 What's up?
&252 Give me an update on the mindjacking case.
target: &252 意识劫持案查得怎么样了？

source: &6 Lab's come back with the report on the body at Animus.
target: &6 阿尼姆斯那具尸体的检验报告出来了。

source: &253 We can definitely link that one to our investigation?
target: &253 能确定这起也跟我们查的案子有关？

source: &110 Same M.O. - victim was wired, brain burnt but not consistent with a straightforward murder.
target: &110 手法一样。死者植入了湿件，脑部遭到烧毁，但又不像是单纯为了杀人。

source: &111 More like a rapid, intrusive - and destructive - brain scan.
target: &111 更像是一次快速、强行侵入大脑的扫描，而且造成了破坏。

source: &254 So we're still going with 'memory theft' rather than elaborate assassinations?
target: &254 所以我们还是认为，这是在‘窃取记忆’，而不是精心策划的暗杀？

source: &112 Exactly. No conclusive patterns on targets, I'm afraid.
target: &112 没错。可惜，受害人的选择规律还是没查出来。

source: &113 Van der Waal said he would give us a lead on the next victim, though.
target: &113 不过，范德瓦尔说他能提供下一个受害人的线索。

source: &255 So much for him "retiring" from organized crime.
target: &255 看来他所谓的退出黑道，也就那么回事。

source: &256 How are you holding up?
target: &256 你还好吧？

source: &114 I'm ok. A little hungry.
target: &114 没事，就是有点饿。

source: &257 I meant about what happened at the station.
target: &257 我是说，车站发生的事。

source: &115 I think *you* did the hard work on that one!
target: &115 那次出力最多的可是你！

source: &116 Don't let it go to your head, though!
target: &116 不过你可别太得意啊！

source: &117 I'll manage. Sometimes...some people just need to be brought down.
target: &117 我能应付。有时候……有些人就是非得放倒不可。

source: &118 I think I'm more concerned about how YOU are.
target: &118 我倒是更担心你。

source: &119 Are you sure you don't need to see a doctor after that?
target: &119 经历了那种事，你真不用去看看医生？

source: &258 You've got a brain for wetware systems, right?
target: &258 你脑子挺擅长处理湿件系统，对吧？

source: &120 Don't you mean 'full of' wetware systems?
target: &120 你是想说，我脑子里全是湿件系统吧？

source: &259 Hah. This isn't just me being offensive.
target: &259 哈。这次可不是挖苦你。

source: &260 Can you have a word with the door controls?
target: &260 能跟门控系统打个招呼吗？

source: &121 I'll see what I can do.
target: &121 我试试看。

source: Connection formed:[/(VdW Apartment)/ Security
target: 连接已建立：[／（范德瓦尔公寓）／安保系统

source: &122 Got it!
&123 I reset the password. It's now 'password1'.
target: &123 密码重置了。现在是‘password1’。

source: VDWLAO
reason: 内部成就标识；全部脚本引用作为unlockAch参数，沿用原键以保持成就匹配

source: &261 I'm just glad you're on our side now.
target: &261 还好你现在是我们这边的。

source: &124 Damn straight. I could probably make a lot more money if I turned to crime.
target: &124 那可不。我真要去干违法的事，肯定比现在赚得多。

source: &262 Any idea what's wrong with the maid?
target: &262 看得出那个女仆出了什么问题吗？

source: &125 I couldn't even get a return signal out of it.
target: &125 我连个回应信号都收不到。

source: &126 My guess would be that it's run out of power.
target: &126 我猜是没电了。

source: &263 Any way we can fix that?
target: &263 有办法解决吗？

source: &127 It's supposed to charge itself, but apparently it hasn't managed to do that.
target: &127 按说它会自己充电，可显然没充上。

source: &264 How? We can't haul that thing to a socket!
target: &264 怎么充？我们总不能把那玩意儿扛到插座旁边吧！

source: &128 Mm...We'll have to charge the power cell itself.
target: &128 嗯……得直接给它的电池充电。

source: &129 In a platform like that, the cell's usually in the upper torso, about where the heart would be.
target: &129 这种机体的电池一般在胸腔上部，差不多是心脏的位置。

source: &265 You reckon that'd be easier to charge?
target: &265 那样充起来方便些？

source: &130 It's only about as big as your fist. Just have to get it out of her.
target: &130 电池就拳头那么大。从她身体里取出来就行。

source: &266 That's an expensive synth they've got.
target: &266 他们买的这个合成人可不便宜。

source: &131 It can do all sorts, I tranced a demo.
target: &131 功能多着呢。我在迷境里看过演示。

source: &132 It's probably anatomically accurate, too.
target: &132 身体构造大概也是照着真人来的。

source: &97 Excuse me?
target: &97 什么意思？

source: &133 Well, they won't tell your secrets,
target: &133 毕竟，它们不会把你的秘密说出去，

source: &134 ...you're not going to traumatise them no matter what you do.
target: &134 ……而且不管你做什么，也不会给它们留下心理创伤。

source: &135 So, Mr and Mr Van der Waal probably got it to join in once in a while.
target: &135 所以，范德瓦尔两位先生买她，大概是想偶尔一起玩玩。

source: &267 ...but...why would...?
&136 I forget, you didn't grow up with synthetics.
target: &136 差点忘了，你小时候还没接触过合成人。

source: &268 Great. As soon as he decides to cooperate, this happens.
target: &268 真行。他刚答应配合，就出了这种事。

source: &137 How important was he to the mindjacking case?
target: &137 他对意识劫持案有多重要？

source: &269 He used to act as kind of an "agent" for criminal activities.
target: &269 他以前算是犯罪活动的‘经纪人’。

source: &270 He'd set people up with the right specialists for jobs.
target: &270 谁要干一票，他就帮忙找合适的行家。

source: &138 So, you thought he might have known who the Mindjacker was?
target: &138 所以，你觉得他可能知道意识劫持者是谁？

source: &271 Or who'd hired them.
target: &271 或者知道是谁雇的。

source: &272 He claimed he knew nothing, that he'd "retired".
target: &272 他一口咬定什么也不知道，说自己已经‘退休’了。

source: &273 Maybe someone came after him because he changed his mind...
target: &273 也许是他改了主意，有人才找上门……

source: &274 The body is Dakarai Van der Waal?
target: &274 这具尸体是达卡莱·范德瓦尔？

source: &139 That's right, Big Fat Van der Waal's husband.
target: &139 对，大胖子范德瓦尔的丈夫。

source: &140 Apparently shot several times, and landed face-down in the water.
target: &140 看样子中了好几枪，脸朝下跌进了水里。

source: &141 Ironic. He used to be an olympic swimmer - lived and died in the water!
target: &141 真讽刺。他以前是奥运游泳选手，生前在水里，死后也在水里！

source: &275 You'd heard of him?
target: &275 你听说过他？

source: &142 I used to follow his career, when I was in the 100 meter freestyle team at Grove Academy.
target: &142 我在格罗夫学院的百米自由泳队时，一直关注他的比赛。

source: &276 Isn't Grove an all-boys school?
target: &276 格罗夫不是男校吗？

source: &143 Yes. I was one at the time.
target: &143 是啊。我那时候也是男生。

source: &144 You're not the only one with secrets, Regis!
target: &144 有秘密的可不止你一个，里吉斯！

source: &7 It is, and at the time, I fit right in.
target: &7 是男校，我当时正好符合条件。

source: &5 ...wait, you used to be *male*?
target: &5 ……等等，你以前是男的？

source: &8 Surprised?
target: &8 很意外？

source: &6 Well, I...I wouldn't have guessed.
target: &6 呃，我……真看不出来。

source: &9 I'll take that as a compliment!
target: &9 我就当你是在夸我了！

source: &7 Whoever did your changeover must have been one hell of a gengineer!
target: &7 给你做性别转换的，肯定是个了不起的基因工程师！

source: &8 What was it? Baseline resequence with a pseudo-viral vector?
target: &8 用的什么办法？以拟病毒为载体，重新编排基础基因序列？

source: &10 The field's come a long way since you were in med-school, Regis.
target: &10 你读医学院那会儿的技术，早就过时了，里吉斯。

source: &11 Took a few other procedures, as well.
target: &11 还做了几项其他手术。

source: &12 Newton's the best place in the world for that kind of work, though.
target: &12 不过，这方面的技术，牛顿市确实是全世界最好的。

source: &9 Can't argue with the results, though.
target: &9 总之，这效果无可挑剔。

source: &13 You frequently do, almost every day!
target: &13 你倒是挺爱挑的，差不多天天都挑！

source: &10 Hah. You know what I mean.
target: &10 哈。你知道我在说什么。

source: &278 Wait, wait, so you used to be a man?
target: &278 等等，等等，所以你以前是男人？

source: &145 A *boy*. Changed when I was 16.
target: &145 是男孩。我十六岁就做了转换。

source: &279 Why did you do that?
target: &279 为什么要这么做？

source: &146 I guess it started as teenage rebellion.
target: &146 起初大概是青春期叛逆吧。

source: &147 But then I found it kind of suited me.
target: &147 后来却发现，这样还挺适合我。

source: &280 I suppose that explains a lot.
target: &280 那很多事就说得通了。

source: &148 What are you suggesting?
target: &148 你想说什么？

source: &281 Well, sometimes you come across as a little...unfeminine.
target: &281 就是，你有时候看起来有点……不像个姑娘。

source: &149 Wow, check out Mr Old-World Values here!
target: &149 哇，瞧瞧这位旧时代价值观的代言人！

source: &282 Says the girl with a tech-fetish and a gigantic rifle.
target: &282 这话居然出自一个迷恋科技、扛着巨型步枪的姑娘。

source: &283 Why didn't I know about this sooner?
target: &283 你怎么一直没告诉我？

source: &150 You didn't ask.
target: &150 你又没问。

source: &151 Besides, it's not something I normally talk about.
target: &151 再说，这也不是我平时挂在嘴边的事。

source: &152 You've been opening up a lot more than usual today, too.
target: &152 今天你也比平时坦诚了不少。

source: &153 So now I figure we're even.
target: &153 所以，我想我们这下扯平了。

source: &11 You'd never mentioned the sex-change before.
target: &11 你以前从没提过性别转换的事。

source: &14 It's never come up - you're not much for small talk.
target: &14 一直没聊到嘛，你又不怎么爱闲聊。

source: &15 I understand how personal that garden is to you.
target: &15 我知道，那座花园对你来说有多重要。

source: &16 And, I appreciate how difficult it probably was to open up about it.
target: &16 也知道，愿意向我说起那些事，对你一定很不容易。

source: &12 So you thought you'd reciprocate with something in your own past?
target: &12 所以，你也想分享一段自己的过去？

source: &17 Pretty much, yeah.
target: &17 差不多就是这样。

source: &13 ...thanks, Max.
target: &13 ……谢谢你，麦克斯。

source: &284 What information does the database have on Van der Waal?
target: &284 数据库里有范德瓦尔的什么资料？

source: &154 Hm...mostly just biographical.
target: &154 嗯……主要是个人履历。

source: &155 Born in the South African Fed, rich family background.
target: &155 生于南非联邦，家境富裕。

source: &285 Criminal ties?
target: &285 跟犯罪组织的联系呢？

source: &156 Naturally. Married Olympic athlete Dakarai Dhalamini in '51.
target: &156 当然有。五一年与奥运选手达卡莱·达拉米尼结婚。

source: &286 Some reckon he was fleeing mob ties in the FSAS or EU.
target: &286 有人认为，他来这里是为了摆脱 FSAS 或 EU 那边的黑帮关系。

source: &157 Most media instances just show them both as philanthropists.
target: &157 媒体报道大多把他们俩描绘成慈善家。

source: &158 Lots of arts funding, charity work, that sorta thing.
target: &158 资助艺术、做慈善，诸如此类。

source: &287 Still kept in touch with his underworld connections, though.
target: &287 不过，他跟黑道上的熟人可一直没断联系。

source: &288 That's how he could source "talent" for wealthy clients who needed it.
target: &288 所以，那些有钱的客户需要‘人才’时，他才找得到。

source: &289 What do you make of the pistol in the pool?
target: &289 泳池里那把手枪，你怎么看？

source: &159 Could be linked to the case, perhaps a murder weapon.
target: &159 可能跟案子有关，也许就是凶器。

source: &160 Going to wait for forensics to recover it?
target: &160 要等鉴证人员来捞吗？

source: &290 Might be better to get it ourselves. It could be useful.
target: &290 还是自己拿上来比较好，可能用得着。

source: &161 Well, I'm not going fishing around in there for it.
target: &161 反正我可不会下去摸来摸去找那把枪。

source: &162 You may be my boss, but there are limits!
target: &162 你是我上司没错，但也不能什么都让我干！

source: &291 Why do you think someone would lock their refrigerator?
target: &291 你觉得，什么人会给冰箱上锁？

source: &163 Same reason you'd lock anything else. Something valuable inside it?
target: &163 跟锁别的东西一样，里面有值钱的东西呗？

source: &292 But...what?
target: &292 可……什么东西呢？

source: &164 Some people keep wetware at low temperatures to stop GG's.
target: &164 有些人把湿件放在低温环境里，防止出现灰蛊。

source: &293 And "GG's" are...?
target: &293 ‘灰蛊’是什么？

source: &165 Oh, Grey Goo - catastrophic exponential reproduction.
target: &165 就是灰蛊灾难。不断以指数级增殖，最后酿成灾难。

source: &166 Under certain conditions, the fabricators in the wetware make more of themselves.
target: &166 在某些条件下，湿件里的制造单元会复制自身。

source: &294 And low temperatures prevent that?
target: &294 低温能阻止这种情况？

source: &167 Not really, but higher temperatures definitely accelerate the growth.
target: &167 倒也不能，不过高温肯定会加速增殖。

source: &168 People like to think they're in control, though.
target: &168 但人们总喜欢觉得，一切尽在掌握嘛。

source: &295 The terminal built into that piano must be older than I am.
target: &295 那架钢琴上的终端，怕是比我年纪还大。

source: &169 It's a virginal, not a piano. It's more like a harpsichord.
target: &169 那是维吉纳琴，不是钢琴。它更接近羽管键琴。

source: &296 Like I said, it's less impressive you know that when you can run a search in your head.
target: &296 我说过，你能直接在脑子里搜索，知道这些也就没那么了不起了。

source: &297 I tried using Van der Waal's hand on the biometric security, but it didn't work.
target: &297 我试过拿范德瓦尔的手去解锁生物识别系统，可没用。

source: &170 Maybe because it's DEAD?
target: &170 也许因为那只手已经死了？

source: &298 How would an old terminal like that know?
target: &298 那么老的终端，怎么分辨得出来？

source: &171 How do YOU check if someone's alive?
target: &171 换你，你怎么判断一个人是死是活？

source: &299 With the scanner in my Traveller.
target: &299 用旅人终端里的扫描仪。

source: &172 Eurgh...if you had to do it BY HAND?
target: &172 呃……要是让你亲自动手检查呢？

source: &173 That bomber...he was American, wasn't he?
target: &173 那个炸弹客……是美国人吧？

source: &300 He certainly had the accent. Sounded Texan.
target: &300 口音是没错，听着像得克萨斯人。

source: &174 Did you know him?
target: &174 你认识他？

source: &301 Doctor Lao, Texas is an enormous place.
target: &301 劳博士，得克萨斯大得很。

source: &302 I do not happen to know every single other person who lived there.
target: &302 我总不可能认识那里住过的每一个人。

source: &303 And besides, I left well before he would have been born.
target: &303 再说，他出生以前，我就离开很久了。

source: &175 Do you ever regret doing that?
target: &175 你有没有后悔过离开那里？

source: &304 Not for a second.
target: &304 一秒钟都没有。

source: &305 Especially after seeing how it's gotten now.
target: &305 尤其是看过那里如今的样子之后。

source: &176 There's more to what was between you and that kid, wasn't there?
target: &176 你跟那个孩子之间，还有别的事，对吧？

source: &177 Like you said, you'd never met him before...but it seemed personal to you.
target: &177 你说以前没见过他……可看起来，这件事触到了你的痛处。

source: &306 You're very perceptive, Dr Lao. It's useful for an investigator.
target: &306 你的观察力很敏锐，劳博士。做调查很需要这一点。

source: &178 You want me to stop asking?
target: &178 你不想让我再问了？

source: &307 *sigh* ...there's a reason that kids like him - and hundreds others - exist.
target: &307 唉……他，还有几百个跟他一样的孩子，之所以会存在，是有原因的。

source: &308 It's not because the seditionists thought weaponizing the human body was the biggest innovation since air-power...
target: &308 原因并不是那些叛乱分子觉得，把人体改造成武器，是空中作战之后最大的创新……

source: &309 ...but the engineers they got to MAKE these kids, for whatever reason, didn't say "no".
target: &309 ……而是他们找来制造这些孩子的工程师，不管出于什么原因，都没有说‘不’。

source: &179 Regis, I...
&310 You could say I knew him TOO well, inside and out. THAT is what bothers me.
target: &310 可以说，我对他太了解了，从里到外都了解。这才是让我难受的事。

source: &311 Doesn't that synth have a holographic memory?
target: &311 那个合成人不是有全息记忆吗？

source: &312 Why does it want a mnemonic?
target: &312 为什么还需要提示才能想起来？

source: &180 I suppose the new personality's having trouble interpreting the maid's way of forming memories.
target: &180 我猜，新的人格程序不太能读懂女仆存储记忆的方式。

source: &181 If we could find something RELATED to the incident to jog its memory...
target: &181 要是能找到跟那件事有关的东西，帮她回忆一下……

source: &313 It would be like pointing it to the right place on a tape?
target: &313 就像给她指出磁带上该找的那一段？

source: &182 What's a tape?
target: &182 磁带是什么？

source: &314 Uh...never mind. Just feeling really old.
target: &314 呃……算了。忽然觉得自己真老了。

source: &315 What do you think happened, from what we've seen so far?
target: &315 根据目前看到的情况，你觉得发生了什么？

source: &183 The marks on the gun suggest Van der Waal shot his husband.
target: &183 看枪上的痕迹，可能是范德瓦尔开枪打了自己的丈夫。

source: &316 And the walls, and the windows, the bed, the door, the pictures...
target: &316 还打了墙、窗户、床、门、画……

source: &184 Maybe a domestic dispute?
target: &184 也许是家庭纠纷？

source: &185 We don't really know how things were here.
target: &185 我们并不了解他们家的情况。

source: &317 He wasted a lot of shots.
target: &317 他打空了好多枪。

source: &318 Do you think he missed all those times?
target: &318 你觉得那些都是没打中？

source: &186 Or he was shooting at something else, and happened to hit Dakarai.
target: &186 也可能他在朝别的东西开枪，碰巧打中了达卡莱。

source: &319 What do you think of the apartment?
target: &319 这套公寓，你怎么看？

source: &187 Expensive and tasteless. I'm not keen on the decor, either.
target: &187 很贵，也很没品味。装修我也不喜欢。

source: &320 You mean the bloodsplatter?
target: &320 你说的是那些血迹？

source: &188 No, the actual decor. I tranced an interview, said his husband decorated it all.
target: &188 不是，就说装修。我在迷境里看过访谈，整个屋子都是他丈夫布置的。

source: &189 Apparently, this is just their city place.
target: &189 而且，这还只是他们在城里的住处。

source: &190 They've got a much larger house out in the Savannah.
target: &190 他们在大草原上还有一栋大得多的房子。

source: &321 So he let Dakarai run riot with the design here?
target: &321 所以，这里就随达卡莱折腾了？

source: &191 Apparently. He should have stuck to swimming.
target: &191 看来是这样。他还是专心游泳比较好。

source: &322 Why do they always give automeals that lousy personality?
target: &322 为什么自动食品机总是装着这么讨厌的人格程序？

source: &192 It's supposed to be helpful.
target: &192 设计上是为了帮你忙。

source: &323 Helpful or not, it creeps the hell out of me.
target: &323 帮不帮忙另说，反正它让我浑身不自在。

source: &193 Then go for a Freedom Foods machine, rather than a T.H.E.
target: &193 那你就买自由食品的机器，别买 T.H.E. 的。

source: &194 They've got no personality at all.
target: &194 它们根本没有人格程序。

source: &324 Bah...whatever happened to actual cooking?
target: &324 唉……亲手做饭怎么就没人干了？

source: &195 Ugh, with your hands? That's so unsanitary...
target: &195 咦，用手做？那多不卫生啊……

source: &14 Any luck with the Mindjacker's airship?
target: &14 意识劫持者的浮空艇，有线索了吗？

source: &18 Still nothing. Like I said, it's just...vanished.
target: &18 还是没有。我说过，就像……凭空消失了一样。

source: &15 And Central still claims there wasn't anything there at all.
target: &15 中枢却还坚称，那里从来就没有浮空艇。

source: &19 But we SAW it, Regis.
target: &19 可我们亲眼看见了，里吉斯。

source: &16 Exactly. Something's not right.
target: &16 没错。这里头有问题。

source: &17 I wonder if Central's hiding something.
target: &17 不知道中枢是不是在隐瞒什么。

source: &20 Why do you hate Central, Charlie?
target: &20 查理，你为什么这么讨厌中枢？

source: &18 What? I don't *hate* Central...
target: &18 什么？我可没说讨厌中枢……

source: &21 You're always arguing with it. I've seen you sabotage more cameras than anyone.
target: &21 你总跟它吵架。我见过的人里，就数你弄坏的摄像头最多。

source: &22 It does so much for Newton - the city runs like a well-oiled machine!
target: &22 它为牛顿市做了那么多，整座城市运转得井井有条！

source: &19 Maybe. But I think it's working in inappropriate areas.
target: &19 也许吧。但我觉得，它管了不该管的事。

source: &23 What would count as "inappropriate" for a city coordinator?
target: &23 作为城市协调者，有什么事是它‘不该管’的？

source: &20 Like this. Fundamentally, policing is a human matter.
target: &20 比如这件事。归根结底，执法是人的事。

source: &21 Machines and synthetics don't commit crimes.
target: &21 机器和合成人不会犯罪。

source: &22 I don't expect them to be able to understand how perpetrators think and act.
target: &22 我不指望它们能理解，罪犯究竟在想什么，又会怎么做。

source: &24 So...you're old fashioned?
target: &24 所以……你就是观念太老了？

source: &25 You'd rather not talk about it.
target: &25 你不想谈这件事。

source: &26 Maybe later?
target: &26 那改天再聊？

source: &325 Keep at it, Max.
target: &325 继续查吧，麦克斯。

source: &196 Can do, Regis.
target: &196 没问题，里吉斯。

source: &197 We should check around, first.
target: &197 我们应该先四处检查一下。

source: &326 What?
&198 We need to get a look in at it ourselves, before the crimescene people wreck it!
target: &198 趁勘查现场的人还没把这里弄乱，我们得自己先看一遍！

source: &327 Good idea.
&199 ...really?
&328 Well, yes!
&200 Who are you, and what have you done with Charlie Regis?
target: &200 你是谁？你把查理·里吉斯怎么了？

source: &329 What do you mean?
target: &329 什么意思？

source: &201 You're unusually cavalier today. You got something on your mind?
target: &201 你今天胆子特别大。是不是有什么心事？

source: &202 I mean, I know you don't usually care what Central thinks about regulations, but...
target: &202 我知道，你平时也不在乎中枢怎么看那些规章，可是……

source: &330 I'm not sure that's a good idea.
target: &330 我不确定这是不是个好主意。

source: &331 Central's already going to be pretty mad at us for the station.
target: &331 车站那件事，已经够让中枢生我们的气了。

source: &203 I think the result you got will make up for that!
target: &203 你处理得那么好，肯定能抵过的！

source: &204 I'll take the rap. I took him down.
target: &204 责任我来担。是我开的枪。

source: &205 Then we create some positive results for today we can show to Central!
target: &205 那我们今天就再做出点成绩，拿给中枢看！

source: &206 If we do this, we can salvage any leads we find here.
target: &206 自己先查，至少能把这里的线索保住。

source: &332 Absolutely not.
target: &332 绝对不行。

source: &207 Why not?
&333 It's completely unprofessional.
target: &333 这完全不符合办案规范。

source: &334 And Central is already going to be pretty mad at us.
target: &334 况且，中枢已经够生我们的气了。

source: &335 Well, as mad as an AI can get.
target: &335 当然，前提是人工智能也会生气。

source: &208 I think you can play your success at the station. It'll balance it.
target: &208 你可以拿车站的成果说事，将功抵过嘛。

source: &209 Look, I'll take the rap.
target: &209 听着，责任我来担。

source: &210 We need this, or it'll be weeks before Civil Investigation finds and files what we came here for.
target: &210 我们得自己查。不然等民事调查部门找到我们要的东西，再录入档案，都得几个星期了。

source: &211 After what happened at the station, I don't think it can get any worse!
target: &211 车站都闹成那样了，我不觉得还能更糟！

source: &212 They're not going to fire YOU, anyway.
target: &212 反正它总不会开除你。

source: &336 This time, I think it could help us get a lead on our investigation.
target: &336 这次先自己查，也许真能找到我们案子的线索。

source: &337 Besides, all the time we waste, the Mindjacker may have found their next victim.
target: &337 再说，我们每耽误一点时间，意识劫持者就可能找到下一个受害人。

source: &213 I like this Regis.
target: &213 我喜欢这样的里吉斯。

source: &214 Let's get investigating.
target: &214 开始调查吧。

source: You feel glad that Max suggested it, and not you. Now you have the free reign you need to find that device the voice wanted.
target: 你庆幸这个主意是麦克斯提出来的。现在，你可以放手去找那个声音要的装置了。

source: &338 We've just found the scene of at least two murders.
target: &338 我们刚发现的这个现场，至少发生了两起谋杀。

source: &339 Central's going to be tied up with the bomber.
target: &339 中枢忙着处理炸弹客的事，抽不开身。

source: &340 It'll take hours for anyone else from CEL to be sent out.
target: &340 等 CEL 再派人来，得好几个小时。

source: &341 And damn regulations - these men deserve a resolution!
target: &341 规章见鬼去吧，这两个人的死总得有个交代！

source: &215 Wow, I've never seen you get so impassioned.
target: &215 哇，头一次见你这么激动。

source: &216 Those old-world values of yours are useful sometimes after all!
target: &216 看来你那套旧时代的价值观，偶尔也挺有用！

source: Apparently, she thought it was sufficiently in-character of you.
target: 看来，她觉得你的这番表现很符合你的性格。

source: &342 Alright. The longer we hang around, the further ahead of us the Mindjacker gets.
target: &342 好吧。我们在这里拖得越久，意识劫持者就把我们甩得越远。

source: &217 Let's salvage what we can from here, then!
target: &217 那就先把能找的线索找出来！

source: Your display of hesitancy appears to have convinced Max that you didn't already know this was going to be a murder investigation.
target: 你这番犹豫似乎让麦克斯相信，你事先并不知道这次来是为了调查谋杀案。

source: &343 I agree. We saved a life, and stopped the bombing.
target: &343 我同意。我们救了一个人，也阻止了爆炸。

source: &344 I think Central will cut us enough slack.
target: &344 我想，中枢会宽容一些。

source: &345 I'm the old hand. It was my call.
target: &345 我是老资历了，是我做的决定。

source: &346 And it's my fault we couldn't save him.
target: &346 没能救下他，也是我的责任。

source: &218 You always have this huge responsibility complex.
target: &218 你总是把责任往自己身上揽。

source: &219 Whoever's fault it was, can we at least agree to get started here?
target: &219 不管是谁的责任，我们先开始调查，好吗？

source: &347 Alright...I need better results now...
target: &347 好吧……这次我得拿出更好的结果……

source: &220 Right. Let's get to it.
target: &220 好，开始吧。

source: You wonder for a moment if she has a point about your feelings of responsibility. You dismiss it equally as quickly.
target: 你有那么一瞬间觉得，她说你太爱揽责任，也许有点道理。但你随即就抛开了这个念头。

source: &348 It was just so...
target: &348 刚才那实在是……

source: &349 Alright. Central's already going to be furious about this.
target: &349 好吧。反正这件事已经够让中枢大发雷霆了。

source: &350 And what's the worst it can do to us?
target: &350 它还能把我们怎么样？

source: &221 To you, anyway. You're untouchable.
target: &221 是把你怎么样吧。你可是没人动得了。

source: &351 Fine. But we have to be careful.
target: &351 好吧。但一定要小心。

source: &352 If you can avoid touching it,
target: &352 能不碰的东西，

source: &222 ...don't touch it. I know the drill.
target: &222 ……就别碰。规矩我懂。

source: You guess that this is the only way to find the device the voice wanted, before someone else visits the crimescene. At least now Max doesn't know how desperate you really are to search the apartment yourself.
target: 要赶在其他人到现场前，找到那个声音要的装置，恐怕只能这么做了。至少，麦克斯现在还不知道你有多急着亲自搜查这套公寓。

source: &353 It's not a good idea.
target: &353 这不是个好主意。

source: &223 Look, if you don't want any more trouble with Central, I'll take this one.
target: &223 听着，你要是不想再跟中枢惹麻烦，这次我来。

source: &224 It'll be all on me.
target: &224 所有责任都算我的。

source: &354 But really, you're just using that as an excuse to get me to do the hard work?
target: &354 不过，你其实只是找个借口，让我干那些麻烦事吧？

source: &225 You know me too well.
target: &225 还是你懂我。

source: &355 Fine. Make sure to mention that I was just here in an "advisory capacity."
target: &355 好吧。记得说清楚，我来这里只是‘提供咨询意见’。

source: &226 Let's get to it, then!
target: &226 那就开始吧！

source: &1 Bonjour, monsieur.
target: &1 Bonjour，先生。

source: &2 Hey, y'all.
target: &2 嘿，你们好啊。

source: &3 Hiiiii!!!
&356 Uh...hello.
&357 Who are you?
&4 Je m'appelle Chantelle, Ah am Monsieur Giel et Monsieur Dakarai's maid!
target: &4 我叫尚特尔，是吉尔先生和达卡莱先生的女仆！

source: &227 You're a synthetic maid?
target: &227 你是合成人女仆？

source: &5 Pardon, Madamoiselle? Ah do not understand.
target: &5 Pardon，小姐？我不明白。

source: &228 A synth.
&6 Excusez-moi, what is a "synth"?
target: &6 请原谅，‘合成人’是什么？

source: &358 It certainly stays in character.
target: &358 她还真是入戏啊。

source: &7 Ah 'elp ze masters with zere 'ouse'old things.
target: &7 我帮主人们打理家务。

source: &229 And where were you made?
target: &229 那你是在哪儿制造的？

source: &8 Madamoiselle! Ah was born en France!
target: &8 小姐！我可是在法国出生的！

source: &230 Yeah, because all French people I know run on graphene power cells.
target: &230 是啊，我认识的法国人，全都靠石墨烯电池运转。

source: &9 Ah'm the hired help.
target: &9 我是雇来帮忙的。

source: &10 Ah clean up around here.
target: &10 负责收拾这个家。

source: &11 Them boys are messy. Need a WOMAN's touch around here.
target: &11 那俩小子邋遢得很，这里得有个女人来打理。

source: &231 Well, this is...different.
target: &231 好吧，这个……挺不一样的。

source: &12 Well, when they get messy, right...
target: &12 就是，他们把家里弄乱了，对吧……

source: &13 I clean up the apartment, right...
target: &13 我就来收拾公寓，对吧……

source: &14 ...and anything else that needs doing around here!
target: &14 ……还有这里其他需要做的事！

source: &15 I'm here to make EVERYONE happy, whatever it takes!
target: &15 我就是要让每个人都开心，不管用什么办法！

source: &233 Geez, it's like giving amphetamines to a synth.
target: &233 天啊，跟给合成人喂了安非他命似的。

source: &360 No wonder they only keep this personality in food machines.
target: &360 难怪这种人格程序只装在食品机里。

source: &361 What can you tell me about the Van der Waals?
target: &361 关于范德瓦尔夫夫，你知道些什么？

source: &16 Zey are ze best employers a young French girl could 'ope to 'ave.
target: &16 对一个年轻的法国姑娘来说，再没有比他们更好的雇主了。

source: &362 Are zey...uh...are they really?
target: &362 是吗……呃……真是这样？

source: &17 Quite so, monsieur. So loving!
target: &17 千真万确，先生。他们多有爱心啊！

source: &18 And with such exquisite taste!
target: &18 品味也那么高雅！

source: &234 Wow, they must have got this one customized for sycophancy.
target: &234 哇，他们肯定专门定制了这个拍马屁的功能。

source: &363 Do you know anyone who might want to hurt them?
target: &363 你知道有谁想伤害他们吗？

source: &19 Oh no monsieur, zey are beloved by all!
target: &19 当然没有，先生，人人都爱他们！

source: &20 They're a strange pair.
target: &20 他俩挺古怪的。

source: &235 We can tell that from the decor.
target: &235 光看装修就知道了。

source: &21 They're trying to get away from their connections to organized crime.
target: &21 他们想跟犯罪组织撇清关系。

source: &364 You've overheard a bit about this?
target: &364 你听到过他们谈这个？

source: &22 Oh yeah, they've been trying to go legit for years.
target: &22 当然，这么多年，他们一直想转行做正经生意。

source: &23 But with Giel, it was always "just one more" job.
target: &23 可吉尔总说，‘再干最后一票’。

source: &24 They're great fun! I like them a lot!
target: &24 他们可有意思了！我好喜欢他们！

source: &365 Any other thoughts on them?
target: &365 关于他们，你还有什么想法？

source: &25 I like you guys, too! You're fun as well!
target: &25 我也喜欢你们呀！你们也很有意思！

source: &236 Is there anything you DON'T like?
target: &236 有什么是你不喜欢的吗？

source: &26 Nope!
&366 What the Hell happened upstairs?
target: &366 楼上到底发生了什么？

source: &27 'Ow do you mean, monsieur?
target: &27 您指什么，先生？

source: &237 The rooms' recent redecoration. "Shades of Giel" everywhere.
target: &237 房间刚刚重新‘装修’过，到处都涂着‘吉尔色’。

source: &367 And the body of Dakarai Van der Waal, shot to pieces, in the tub.
target: &367 还有浴池里达卡莱·范德瓦尔的尸体，都快被打成筛子了。

source: &368 Any opinions on this?
target: &368 你有什么看法？

source: &28 Oh, monsieur, Ah cannot discuss this.
target: &28 哦，先生，我不能谈这件事。

source: &29 Ah 'ave been told, most strictly, not to discuss what goes on upstairs.
target: &29 我接到了非常严格的命令，不能谈论楼上的事。

source: &369 Even if it includes the double-homicide of your owner?
target: &369 就算你的两位主人都被杀了，也不能谈？

source: &30 Ah 'ave my orders. What would monsieur Giel think if I went against them?
target: &30 我得遵守命令。要是我违背了，吉尔先生会怎么想？

source: &238 Probably not a great deal, anymore.
target: &238 现在嘛，他大概也想不了什么了。

source: &370 She doesn't quite seem to get what's happened.
target: &370 她好像还没弄明白发生了什么。

source: &239 Might not have been written with a comprehension of abstracts like "death".
target: &239 她的程序里也许就没有‘死亡’这种抽象概念。

source: &371 Two men have been killed upstairs.
target: &371 楼上有两个人被杀了。

source: &372 There's blood and human remains all over the room, and all over you.
target: &372 房间里到处都是血和人体残骸，你身上也有。

source: &373 If you weren't directly involved, then you're at least a material witness.
target: &373 即使你没有直接参与，你也至少是个重要证人。

source: &31 Ah am sorry monsieur, Ah cannot say what 'appens upstairs.
target: &31 对不起，先生，我不能谈论楼上的事。

source: &32 Monsieur Giel, 'e values 'is privacy greatly.
target: &32 吉尔先生非常重视自己的隐私。

source: &374 How about we take you down to CEL and manually pull your memory apart?
target: &374 那我们把你带到 CEL，直接拆开读取你的记忆，怎么样？

source: &240 Regis, it's a synth. Threatening it won't help.
target: &240 里吉斯，她是合成人。威胁她没用。

source: &375 What do you do around here?
target: &375 你在这里负责什么？

source: &33 Ah do ze cleaning, ze cooking, and ze shopping!
target: &33 我负责打扫、做饭，还有采购！

source: &376 And that's it?
target: &376 仅此而已？

source: &34 Monsieur, it would not be proper for me to say!
target: &34 先生，这种话我可不方便说！

source: &241 So, you ARE a sexbot.
target: &241 所以，你还真是个性爱机器人。

source: &35 Mon Dieu! 'ow dare you infer such a thing!
target: &35 Mon Dieu！您怎么能这么想！

source: &36 Ah am ze apartment's drinks machine.
target: &36 我是这套公寓的酒水机。

source: &37 Ah provide suggestions for ze finest wines and spirits zey 'ave.
target: &37 我会从他们珍藏的葡萄酒和烈酒里，推荐最好的佳酿。

source: &377 But...you're the maid?
target: &377 可……你不是女仆吗？

source: &38 Ah...hm...oh, mon dieu, zis is most confusing!
target: &38 我……嗯……哦，天哪，这可太让人糊涂了！

source: &39 Ah am ze apartment's food machine.
target: &39 我是这套公寓的食品机。

source: &40 From mah position in ze wall, I can create ze finest recipes available.
target: &40 我安装在墙里，可以烹制最精美的料理。

source: &378 Weren't you just the French maid a moment ago?
target: &378 你刚才不还是法国女仆吗？
