target: &41 这……呃……不，您弄错了。

source: &42 Ah am ze T.H.E. Foods E-1590 nutrient processor!
target: &42 我是 T.H.E. 食品 E-1590 营养处理机！

source: &43 Ah 'andle all ze food in zis apartment!
target: &43 这套公寓里所有的食物都归我处理！

source: &44 Ah'm the maid. Ah clean up around this here dump.
target: &44 我是女仆，负责收拾这个破地方。

source: &45 Ah lend a woman's touch to these boys' place. *spits*
target: &45 给那俩小子的窝添点女人味。呸。

source: &242 You don't sound very feminine.
target: &242 听着可没什么女人味。

source: &46 Well excuse me, but which one of us is wearin' a dress?
target: &46 劳驾，咱俩到底谁穿着裙子？

source: &47 Ah'm the apartment's drinks machine.
target: &47 我是这套公寓的酒水机。

source: &48 Ah give suggestions on the Van der Waals' choices o' spirits and liquor.
target: &48 我给范德瓦尔夫夫推荐他们收藏的烈酒和其他酒水。

source: &243 Dressed like that, I bet the patrons are hitting on you all the time.
target: &243 穿成这样，客人肯定整天跟你调情吧。

source: &49 Hey, it's not my fault men are drawn to my womanly charms. *spit*
target: &49 嘿，男人都被我的女人味吸引，可不能怪我。呸。

source: &50 Ah'm the apartment's food machine.
target: &50 我是这套公寓的食品机。

source: &244 What's your speciality, grits and gravy?
target: &244 拿手菜是什么？玉米粥配肉汁？

source: &51 Just you wait, you won't BELIEVE what I can make.
target: &51 等着吧，我做出来的东西准让你不敢相信。

source: &379 Even though you're a maid, rather than a food machine?
target: &379 就算你明明是女仆，而不是食品机？

source: &52 It...huh...now ain't that a dilly...
target: &52 这……咦……可真是件怪事……

source: &53 I'm the maid! I keep this place clean, and I do the shopping!
target: &53 我是女仆！我负责打扫，还有采购！

source: &54 Also, I'm anatomically-correct!
target: &54 而且，我的身体构造跟真人一样哦！

source: &55 Well, Mr Giel didn't just want a maid. He REALLY loves French folk.
target: &55 吉尔先生要的可不只是女仆。他特别喜欢法国人。

source: &56 So sometimes, when he's bored, he insists I come to the bedroom,
target: &56 所以有时候，他无聊了，就非要叫我去卧室，

source: &57 ...and he's got all these outfits, and...
target: &57 ……他准备了好多套衣服，然后……

source: &380 Just...no more, I get the picture.
target: &380 行了……别说了，我明白了。

source: &381 So...he cheats on his husband with a synth?
target: &381 所以……他跟合成人偷情，背叛了丈夫？

source: &58 Oh no, he's not cheating. Mr Dakarai joins in too!
target: &58 没有呀，不算偷情。达卡莱先生也一起玩！

source: &245 I totally called it.
target: &245 我就知道。

source: &59 I'm the drinks machine!
target: &59 我是酒水机！

source: &60 I give Mr Giel suggestions on his wines and stuff!
target: &60 我帮吉尔先生挑葡萄酒什么的！

source: &382 Even though you talk like a food machine...and look like a maid...
target: &382 虽然你说话像食品机……外形却是个女仆……

source: &61 Huh, y'know, that IS kinda weird.
target: &61 咦，你别说，还真有点怪。

source: &62 Still, better stick to what you know!
target: &62 不过，还是做自己擅长的事比较好！

source: &63 And boy, do I know drinks. Do you guys want something?
target: &63 酒水我可是懂得很！你们想喝点什么吗？

source: &383 Uh...no thanks.
&64 You sure? You look like a dry martini kinda guy.
target: &64 真不要？我看你像是喜欢干马天尼的那种人。

source: &65 I'm the food machine!
target: &65 我是食品机！

source: &66 Not just any, I'm one of the best!
target: &66 可不是普通食品机，我可是数一数二的！

source: &67 I make sure you're not only nutritionally sound,
target: &67 我不光保证你吃得营养均衡，

source: &68 ...but getting the best recipes T.H.E. Foods can offer!
target: &68 ……还让你享用 T.H.E. 食品能提供的最佳菜谱！

source: &384 Even though you're the maid?
target: &384 就算你其实是女仆？

source: &69 Huh, that's weird!
target: &69 咦，好奇怪呀！

source: &70 Could have sworn I was the food machine!
target: &70 我赌咒发誓，我明明是食品机！

source: &71 But I don't swear, 'cause that's not nice.
target: &71 不过我不该赌咒，那样可不好。

source: &385 What can you remember before you ran out of power?
target: &385 电量耗尽之前的事，你还记得什么？

source: &72 Monsieur, I remember many things, mah memory is 'olographic.
target: &72 先生，我记得很多事，我的记忆是全息式的。

source: &73 But Ah 'ave monsieur Giel's confidence to consider.
target: &73 但我也得守住吉尔先生对我的信任。

source: &386 Even if CEL requires it?
target: &386 即使是 CEL 要求你提供？

source: &74 Ah cannot simply discuss what 'appens around 'ere without 'is permission!
target: &74 没有他的允许，我不能随便谈论这里发生的事！

source: &246 He's certainly paid for loyalty.
target: &246 这钱花得值，忠诚倒是买到位了。

source: &75 Son, there's nothin' I'd like more than to help a lawman.
target: &75 小子，我当然巴不得帮执法人员一把。

source: &76 But sometimes, a man's confidence is more important.
target: &76 可有时候，别人的信任更要紧。

source: &77 What happens upstairs, well, that's between me and the Van der Waals.
target: &77 楼上的事嘛，那是我跟范德瓦尔夫夫之间的事。

source: &78 Ain't much to remember.
target: &78 没多少值得记的。

source: &79 Giel chose another of those terrible wines.
target: &79 吉尔又挑了瓶难喝的酒。

source: &80 Then he got some stuff outta the fridge, and went upstairs.
target: &80 然后从冰箱拿了点东西，就上楼了。

source: &81 Ain't seen him since.
target: &81 后来就没再见过他。

source: &82 Not much to remember, when you're built into a wall.
target: &82 嵌在墙里，哪有多少事情可记。

source: &247 Except you're not, anymore.
target: &247 可你现在已经不在墙里了。

source: &83 Huh. Hey, you're right!
target: &83 咦，嘿，你说得对！

source: &84 Ooh, ooh, ooh...
&85 I remember something...I...ah...
target: &85 我想起了一点……我……啊……

source: &388 What is it?
&86 I'm sorry, the memory module is holographic, but isn't wholly compatible.
target: &86 对不起，记忆模块虽然是全息式的，但并不完全兼容。

source: &87 I need something to help me remember.
target: &87 我需要点东西帮我想起来。

source: &389 You're asking for a BRIBE?
target: &389 你这是在索贿？

source: &248 Pfft, hahaha, oh Regis...
target: &248 噗，哈哈哈，哎呀，里吉斯……

source: &88 I just need one of those nemmy...menme...
target: &88 我只是需要那个助记……记助……

source: &249 Mnemonics?
target: &249 记忆提示？

source: &89 Yeah! That's it!
target: &89 对！就是那个！

source: &390 So, something that'd help jog your memory about what happened?
target: &390 所以，需要一件能让你回想起当时情形的东西？

source: &90 Yeah, that's it!
target: &90 对，就是这样！

source: &250 Maybe we could use something from the scene.
target: &250 也许可以拿现场的东西试试。

source: &91 Ooh, sorry. I'd love to help, but I can't!
target: &91 哎呀，对不起。我很想帮忙，可是帮不了！

source: &391 You're not going to assist an investigation?
target: &391 你不肯协助调查？

source: &92 Don't get me wrong, I wanna tell you EVERYTHING.
target: &92 别误会，我恨不得把所有事情都告诉你。

source: &93 Only thing is, I'm built into the wall. I barely see anything!
target: &93 可我嵌在墙里，根本看不到多少东西！

source: &392 Have you had your safety protocols removed?
target: &392 你的安全协议被移除了？

source: &94 Monsieur?
&393 Would you be able to do ANYTHING Mr van der Waal told you?
target: &393 范德瓦尔先生让你做什么，你都能做吗？

source: &95 Anything?
target: &95 什么都能？

source: &394 Anything.
target: &394 什么都能。

source: &96 Monsieur, you should not ask such questions.
target: &96 先生，您不该问这种问题。

source: &97 Ah am just ze Maid!
target: &97 我只是个女仆！

source: &98 Nope.
&395 So, this platform was restricted in terms of what it can do?
target: &395 所以，这台机体的行动是受到限制的？

source: &99 Never had 'em in the first place.
target: &99 打一开始就没有安全协议。

source: &252 Must have been a customized personality.
target: &252 肯定是定制过的人格程序。

source: &100 What's a safety protocol?
target: &100 安全协议是什么？

source: &396 Uh...it stops you hurting people, or doing things you're not supposed to.
target: &396 呃……它能阻止你伤害别人，或者做不该做的事。

source: &101 Why would I want to do that? That'd be real mean of me.
target: &101 我为什么要做那些事呀？那也太坏了。

source: &397 Yes, but sometimes there are...accidents.
target: &397 是，不过有时候会发生……意外。

source: &102 This platform's got nothing like that, but I'm not gonna hurt nobody!
target: &102 这台机体里没那种东西，可我也不会伤害任何人！

source: &398 Maybe we can get more sense out of it if we knew who made it.
target: &398 要是知道谁制造了她，也许能让她说点明白话。

source: &399 Where did you come from?
target: &399 你从哪儿来？

source: &103 Lyons, monsieur.
target: &103 里昂，先生。

source: &400 No, where did you REALLY come from? As in, who put you together?
target: &400 不，你实际上从哪儿来？就是说，谁把你组装出来的？

source: &104 Monsieur, I do not know what you are trying to imply...
target: &104 先生，我不明白您在暗示什么……

target: &253 超级用户：机体驱动详情，int:10216/a/actual。更新来源？

target: &105 检索：……S&S 合成人公司，牛顿市

target: &254 注册名单里没有这家公司。范德瓦尔会不会留着联系方式？

source: &401 If they can give us an easier way than cracking its skull open...
target: &401 只要他们能提供一个不用撬开她脑袋的办法……

source: &402 Why the Hell did they get a synth like this?
target: &402 他们为什么要买这么个合成人？

source: &106 Surely you realize, monsieur?
target: &106 先生，您应该明白吧？

source: &107 All ze best maids in ze world, zey are French!
target: &107 全世界最好的女仆，都是法国人！

source: &255 And the best lovers, I hear.
target: &255 听说，最好的情人也是。

source: &108 What are you implying, mademoiselle?
target: &108 您在暗示什么，小姐？

source: &403 I never had Giel down as quite such a...Francophile.
target: &403 我以前可没想到，吉尔这么……迷恋法国。

source: &109 Ah am also very discreet, monsieur.
target: &109 而且，我的嘴很严，先生。

source: &110 When you care for someone's 'ome, zere are a lot of thing you 'ear.
target: &110 替人打理一个家，总会听见很多事。
&256 ……也会做很多事。

source: &111 Mademoiselle, such slander!
target: &111 小姐，这样说可是在诽谤！

source: &112 ...and even if true, Ah would not say, Ah 'ave monsieur Giel's confidence to think of.
target: &112 ……就算是真的，我也不会说。我得守住吉尔先生对我的信任。

source: &113 Believe it or not, bartenders gotta be pretty smart.
target: &113 信不信由你，酒保可得够聪明。

source: &404 Like a chemist, mixed with a therapist.
target: &404 像把化学家和心理治疗师混在一起。

source: &257 Then shaken and stirred.
target: &257 再摇一摇，搅一搅。

source: &114 Exactly!
&115 People gotta trust their barman to know what he's talkin' about.
target: &115 客人得相信，酒保懂自己在说什么。

source: &116 How they gonna do that, if they don't sound the part?
target: &116 要是连说话都不像个酒保，怎么让人相信？

source: &117 Everyone needs to eat, right?
target: &117 人人都得吃饭，对吧？

source: &405 With you so far.
target: &405 目前我还跟得上。

source: &118 So why make it a chore?
target: &118 那干吗把吃饭弄成苦差事呢？

source: &119 Food can be fun, with so much choice available!
target: &119 有那么多选择，吃饭也可以很开心呀！

source: &258 So...that's why they made you like that?
target: &258 所以……他们才把你设计成这样？

source: &121 I'm here to help ANYONE with whatever they need!
target: &121 不管谁需要什么，我都会帮忙！

source: &406 Thanks. We'll keep looking around.
target: &406 谢谢。我们再四处看看。

source: &122 My pleasure to 'ave 'elped, monsieur.
target: &122 很荣幸能帮上忙，先生。

source: &123 Y'all come back real soon.
target: &123 你们可得早点再来啊。

source: &124 Have a really great day!
target: &124 祝你们今天开开心心！

source: &1 Stepford & Son Synthetic Associates,
target: &1 斯特普福德父子合成人公司，

source: &2 Liam Stepford speaking.
target: &2 我是利亚姆·斯特普福德。

source: &3 Ah, Mr Van der Waal.
target: &3 啊，范德瓦尔先生。

source: &4 I trust everything is satisfactory?
target: &4 想必各方面都让您满意吧？

source: &407 Mr Stepford, my name is Dr Charles Regis, I'm a CEL agent.
target: &407 斯特普福德先生，我叫查尔斯·里吉斯博士，是 CEL 探员。

source: &5 Oh my yes, how may I help, Dr Regis?
target: &5 哦，是，是。里吉斯博士，有什么能帮到您的？

source: &408 I'm investigating the death of one of your clients, Giel Van der Waal.
target: &408 我正在调查贵公司客户吉尔·范德瓦尔的死亡案件。

source: &6 Oh my yes, that sounds terrible!
target: &6 哦，天哪，是，是。真是太可怕了！

source: &409 We've got your company's name linked to the synthetic in the apartment.
target: &409 我们查到，他公寓里的合成人是贵公司制造的。

source: &7 Oh my yes, a repurposed IL-240 platform, running a BN-1/10/187 update cycle.
target: &7 哦，是，是。改装过的 IL-240 机体，采用 BN-1/10/187 更新周期。

source: &8 A maid, yes? And a very expensive one it was too, yes?
target: &8 是女仆，对吧？而且价格很高，对吧？

source: &410 That...looks like the one.
target: &410 那……应该就是她。

source: &9 Oh my yes, he purchased a complete body.
target: &9 哦，是，是。他购买了完整的机体。

source: &10 Though it looks like he had some afterwork done on it elsewhere, oh yes.
target: &10 不过，他似乎又在别处做了后续加工。哦，是的。

source: &411 What kind of "afterwork"?
target: &411 什么‘后续加工’？

source: &11 It looks like the personality was tooled elsewhere, yes.
target: &11 看来人格程序是在别处调整的，是的。

source: &12 Likely to more...particular tastes, yes.
target: &12 大概是为了满足一些更……特殊的喜好，是的。

source: &412 Not something you'd do?
target: &412 你们不做这种业务？

source: &13 Mr Regis, this is a family business, oh yes?
target: &13 里吉斯先生，我们是正经的家族企业，您明白吧？

source: &14 We simply sell platforms, we cannot be held responsible for alterations thereafter.
target: &14 我们只出售机体，对出售后的改装不负责任。

source: &413 What can you tell me about this synth?
target: &413 关于这个合成人，你能告诉我些什么？

source: &15 Everything up until its point of sale, oh my yes.
target: &15 出售之前的所有情况。哦，是，是。

source: &16 We recently acquired a number of IL-240 platforms, formerly industrial models.
target: &16 我们最近收购了一批 IL-240 机体，原先都是工业型号。

source: &17 With some cosmetic retooling, they're fit for a great many humanoid roles, oh my yes.
target: &17 只要稍微改造外观，就能承担很多类人的工作。哦，是，是。

source: &414 Like housework.
target: &414 比如家务。

source: &18 Oh my, yes. Like this platform, we sell many without including a personality.
target: &18 哦，是的。跟这台一样，我们出售的很多机体都不附带人格程序。

source: &19 There are a great many legal and ethical restrictions on the sale of AIs within Newton.
target: &19 在牛顿市，出售人工智能受到诸多法律和伦理限制。

source: &20 But if one were to acquire an AI mind-state from elsewhere, and incorporate it...
target: &20 不过，如果有人从别处获取人工智能意识状态，再自行装入……

source: &415 It leaves you completely blame-free for whatever's done with it.
target: &415 不管拿它做什么，就都与你们无关了。

source: &21 Quite so, Dr Regis, oh my yes.
target: &21 正是如此，里吉斯博士。哦，是，是。

source: &416 The synth in question is powered down. We need to ask it some questions.
target: &416 那个合成人已经没电了。我们需要问她一些问题。

source: &22 It shall need to be revitalised then, oh my yes!
target: &22 那得先让她恢复运转。哦，是，是！

source: &23 Likely it misgauged its own consumption rate, was unable to reach a charging point.
target: &23 她大概误判了自己的耗电速度，没来得及到达充电点。

source: &417 Is there any way to fix it?
target: &417 有办法解决吗？

source: &24 Oh my, yes. You can remove the power cell from the upper torso.
target: &24 哦，当然。您可以把电池从胸腔上部取出来。

source: &25 It will be concealed by the pseudodermal layer of outer skin, but this can be removed with a sharp implement.
target: &25 电池藏在仿生皮肤下面，不过用锋利的工具就能切开那层表皮。

source: &418 So...I have to perform surgery?
target: &418 所以……得由我来做手术？

source: &26 You will need to remove the power cell, and charge it separately.
target: &26 您需要取出电池，单独充电。

source: &27 The platform should return to full operation thereafter, oh yes.
target: &27 之后，机体应该就能完全恢复运转。哦，是的。

source: &419 We believe this synth to be a material witness...or involved...in a murder.
target: &419 我们认为，这个合成人是谋杀案的重要证人……或者参与者。

source: &28 Oh my no, how horrific!
target: &28 哦，天哪，怎么会，太可怕了！

source: &420 It's unwilling to cooperate with us, though.
target: &420 不过，她不肯配合。

source: &421 Van der Waal seems to have ordered it to remain silent about certain areas of his home.
target: &421 范德瓦尔似乎命令她，不准谈论家里某些地方的事。

source: &29 Oh my, secrecy is one of many reasons that users opt for non-OEM personalities.
target: &29 哦，是的。保密就是用户选择非原厂人格程序的原因之一。

source: &30 If you wish, I could have one of my engineers disassemble its mind-state in order to recover memories.
target: &30 如果您需要，我可以安排工程师拆解她的意识状态，提取记忆。

source: &31 This may take several hours, depending upon the algorithm used for laying down synaptic engrams.
target: &31 这可能需要几个小时，具体取决于她写入突触记忆痕迹时采用的算法。

source: &422 I'm afraid time is a critical factor, Mr Stepford. Is there any way I can do it here?
target: &422 恐怕我们没有那么多时间，斯特普福德先生。我能在这里直接操作吗？

source: &32 There may be, oh my yes. I shall transfer you the necessary tool.
target: &32 也许可以。哦，是，是。我把需要的工具传给您。

target: 正在下载：SPLITTER.app

target: 已添加：CI 意识状态拆分器

target: &423 这个‘拆分器’是做什么的？

target: &33 CI 机体的意识是模块化的，里吉斯博士。哦，是，是。

target: &34 全都由三个部分组成：人格、职责和机体记忆。

target: &35 女仆不愿告诉您，大概是人格模块导致的。

source: &424 So, if she had a different personality...
target: &424 所以，给她换一种人格……

source: &259 Something more helpful!
target: &259 换个更乐意帮忙的！

source: &425 ...she might tell us what we need to know.
target: &425 ……她也许就会把我们需要的事说出来。

source: &36 It may not be quite so simple, but that is the foundation of the idea, oh my yes.
target: &36 未必有这么简单，不过基本原理就是这样。哦，是，是。

source: &426 Where would I find other mind-state modules?
target: &426 去哪儿能找到其他的意识状态模块？

source: &37 Any other platform that runs a communicative interface.
target: &37 任何运行着交流界面的机体或设备，都可以。

source: &38 It is not simply limited to synthetic platforms, oh my no!
target: &38 可不只是合成人机体。哦，远远不止！

source: &427 What does a "personality" do in a synth?
target: &427 合成人的‘人格’有什么作用？

source: &39 The personality determines a great deal of its behavior, oh my yes.
target: &39 人格决定了它的大部分行为。哦，是，是。

source: &40 In many cases, it's the most noticeable part of its intelligence.
target: &40 在很多情况下，它最能体现机体的智能。

source: &41 It governs how it may act, and how it behaves in its interaction with users.
target: &41 它决定机体能如何行动，以及与用户交流时怎样表现。

source: &428 This one thinks it's a French maid.
target: &428 这个合成人认为自己是法国女仆。

source: &42 Perhaps copied from the mind state of a real example of such!
target: &42 也许就是从一位真正的法国女仆的意识状态里复制出来的！

source: &429 What does the "role memory" do?
target: &429 ‘职责记忆’有什么作用？

source: &43 It alters how a platform will perceive a situation,
target: &43 它会影响机体对某个情形的理解，

source: &44 ...and also acts as a source of knowledge for its job.
target: &44 ……也会为机体的工作提供所需知识。

source: &430 How would it be different?
target: &430 理解会有什么不同？

source: &45 Take for example, a man in the street.
target: &45 举个例子，街上有一个人。

source: &46 A platform with the role of a sales clerk may see a customer.
target: &46 职责是售货员的机体，可能会把他看成顾客。

source: &431 A law-enforcement unit may see a potential suspect.
target: &431 执法机体，则可能把他看成潜在嫌疑人。

source: &47 Oh my, yes! And the role will furnish it with instructions on HOW to handle it.
target: &47 哦，正是如此！职责模块还会指导它，应该怎样应对。

source: &432 What is a "platform memory" component?
target: &432 ‘机体记忆’这个部分又是什么？

source: &48 These are the memories that each individual unit has recorded.
target: &48 就是每一台机体各自记录下来的记忆。

source: &49 At simplest, it is often a holographic matrix in which engrams are laid down.
target: &49 最简单的形式，通常是用于写入记忆痕迹的全息矩阵。

source: &50 Sight, sound and any other senses available are stored in here, oh my yes.
target: &50 视觉、听觉以及其他可用感官获取的信息，都存储在这里。哦，是，是。

source: &51 Based on its role and personality, a unit may have a different understanding of these memories.
target: &51 根据职责和人格的不同，机体对这些记忆的理解也可能不同。

source: &433 So, it'd perceive it differently, depending how the rest of its mind was built?
target: &433 所以，其余的意识模块如何构成，会影响它对记忆的理解？

source: &52 Oh my, yes!
target: &52 哦，正是如此！

source: &434 That's all I need to know for now.
target: &434 目前知道这些就够了。

source: &53 Please, don't hesistate to get in contact if you think we can help, oh my yes.
target: &53 如果觉得我们能帮上忙，请随时联系。哦，一定要。

source: &70 Hi, I'm Cheffie!
target: &70 你好，我是小厨！

source: &71 What can I get for you?
target: &71 想来点什么？

source: &435 What are you?
target: &435 你是什么？

source: &72 I'm Cheffie, your friendly food helper!
target: &72 我是小厨，你贴心的餐饮助手！

source: &436 Alright, what's this machine you come in?
target: &436 好吧，那你装在什么机器里？

source: &73 This masterpiece is the T.H.E. Foods Gourmand-Range comestible synthesizer!
target: &73 这件杰作，就是 T.H.E. 食品的美食家系列食物合成机！

source: &74 It's the best thing since sliced bread!
target: &74 自从有了切片面包，就数它最棒！

source: &75 Which it even makes!
target: &75 而且它连切片面包都能做！

source: &260 Sounds like it's trying too hard to be helpful.
target: &260 听起来，它也太热心了。

source: &76 I like helping! Helping is FUN!
target: &76 我喜欢帮忙！帮忙多开心呀！

source: &437 What's on the menu?
target: &437 菜单上有什么？

source: &77 If you're feeling peckish,
target: &77 要是你想吃点东西，

source: &78 I could whip up some quail's eggs in white wine sauce!
target: &78 我可以做份白葡萄酒酱鹌鹑蛋！

source: &79 Or how about some nice tarte a l'orange?
target: &79 或者，来份美味的香橙挞怎么样？

source: &261 Sounds better than what mine can do.
target: &261 听起来比我家那台强多了。

source: &80 Or if you want some of Mr Giel's favorite, I could always make toaster-pastries!
target: &80 要是想吃吉尔先生最爱的，我也能做烤面包机点心！

source: &438 What's the difference between you, and the one I've got at home? The J-115?
target: &438 你跟我家那台 J-115 有什么区别？

source: &81 Oh, I'm much newer!
target: &81 哦，我可新多了！

source: &82 My dynamic protein-stereolithography system means I can make nearly anything!
target: &82 我的动态蛋白立体光刻系统，让我几乎什么都能做！

source: &83 I've got so much more flavour-treatment,
target: &83 我的调味功能也丰富多了，

source: &84 I can make just about any taste you desire!
target: &84 你想要的味道，我几乎都能做出来！

source: &439 What if I WANTED some of that protein slop that mine makes?
target: &439 如果我就想吃家里那台做的蛋白糊呢？

source: &85 Oh, I'm sorry, I can't do that!
target: &85 哦，对不起，那个我做不了！

source: &86 But how about some truffles?
target: &86 不如来点松露？

source: &262 It's a snob, then.
target: &262 原来还是个势利眼。

source: &440 How much did you set the van der Waals back, then?
target: &440 那范德瓦尔家买你，花了多少钱？

source: &87 I'm only $410,000 from all good retailers!
target: &87 各大优质零售商均有销售，只要 410,000 美元！

source: &263 That's more than I make in a year!
target: &263 比我一年挣的还多！

source: &441 These people can apparently afford the finer things.
target: &441 看来他们享受得起这些好东西。

source: &442 There was an...incident upstairs.
target: &442 楼上发生了点……事情。

source: &443 You didn't happen to see anything, did you?
target: &443 你有没有碰巧看到什么？

source: &88 Oh my, I hope they weren't hurt!
target: &88 哦，天哪，希望他们没受伤！

source: &89 I'm afraid I've been down here the whole time!
target: &89 恐怕我一直都在楼下！

source: &264 Figures.
target: &264 我就知道。

source: &90 Oh no, if they're hurt, maybe I should make them some soup?
target: &90 哦，不，如果他们受伤了，我是不是该做点汤？

source: &444 Can you make barbecue brisket?
target: &444 能做烧烤牛胸肉吗？

source: &91 Sure can! American style?
target: &91 当然！要美式的？

source: &445 That'll do.
target: &445 就做那个。

source: &92 Extra sauce?
target: &92 多加酱汁？

source: &446 You bet.
&93 Protein Complex A or B?
target: &93 用 A 型还是 B 型蛋白复合物？

source: &447 Pardon?
&94 What protein complex do you want me to make the meat out of?
target: &94 你想让我用哪种蛋白复合物来制作肉？

source: &448 Uh...beef?
&95 Oh, I'm sorry, I don't have any real beef!
target: &95 哦，对不起，我没有真正的牛肉！

source: &449 Can you make chicken fried steak?
target: &449 能做美式炸牛排吗？

source: &96 Absolutely!
target: &96 当然可以！

source: &265 You sure like your meat.
target: &265 你还真爱吃肉。

source: &450 Can you make Texas gumbo?
target: &450 能做得克萨斯秋葵浓汤吗？

source: &97 Of course!
&266 Looking for a taste of home?
target: &266 想念家乡的味道了？

source: &451 I've never found anywhere here that can do good gumbo.
target: &451 在这里，我就没找到过哪家能把秋葵浓汤做好的。

source: &452 Can you make Texas strip dumplings?
target: &452 能做得克萨斯条状面片吗？

source: &98 The best.
target: &98 最好吃的那种。

source: &453 My grandma would contest that.
target: &453 我奶奶可不会同意。

source: &454 Can you make beef fajitas?
target: &454 能做牛肉法吉塔吗？

source: &99 Mmm, good choice!
target: &99 嗯，好选择！

source: &267 How would you know? You never have to eat it!
target: &267 你怎么知道？你又不用吃！

source: &455 I think I need to get me one of this model.
target: &455 看来我也得买一台这个型号的。

source: &456 Can you make East Texas onion pudding?
target: &456 能做东得克萨斯洋葱布丁吗？

source: &100 Definitely! What kind of onion would you like?
target: &100 当然！你想用哪种洋葱？

source: &457 Erm...what do you have?
target: &457 呃……你有什么？

source: &101 I've got bulb, multiplier, sweet, Welsh,
target: &101 我有普通洋葱、分蘖洋葱、甜洋葱、威尔士葱，

source: &102 Leek, yellow, cipolla rossa, cipollotto nocerino,
target: &102 韭葱、黄洋葱、意大利红洋葱、诺切拉嫩葱，

source: &103 ...green, or spring!
target: &103 ……还有青葱和小葱！

source: &458 Van der Waal sure liked his onions.
target: &458 范德瓦尔还真爱吃洋葱。

source: &104 I've got as many kinds of Allium Cepa as you could want!
target: &104 你想要的洋葱品种，我这里应有尽有！

source: &459 Can you make chicken hacienda?
target: &459 能做‘庄园鸡’吗？

source: &460 How? I just made it up.
target: &460 怎么做？这是我刚编的菜名。

source: &105 I can extrapolate what it involves based on your request, tone of voice and dietary habits!
target: &105 我可以根据你的要求、语气和饮食习惯，推断这道菜该怎么做！

source: &268 Sounds like it's more and more worth its price!
target: &268 听起来，这价钱越来越值了！

source: &461 Can you make grits?
target: &461 能做粗粒玉米粥吗？

source: &269 Don't you want a road-engineer for that?
target: &269 粗粒？那不是该找修路的人吗？

source: &463 Grits is kind of like porridge. You have it with gravy.
target: &463 粗粒玉米粥有点像稀饭，配肉汁吃。

source: &270 Eurgh, that sounds even worse.
target: &270 呃，听起来更糟了。

source: &106 I won't make any for you, then!
target: &106 那我就不做给你吃啦！

source: &271 Sounds like this machine's worth its price!
target: &271 听起来，这机器真值那个价！

source: &448 Erm...beef?
&465 Can you make...
&272 Can you make yang chun mian?
target: &272 能做阳春面吗？

source: &107 Ni xihuan fan ma?
target: &107 你喜欢饭吗？

source: &273 Xihuan! Ni you meiyou mai bei ping kaoya?
target: &273 喜欢！你有没有卖北平烤鸭？

source: &108 You meiyou!
&274 Okay, I'm sold.
target: &274 好，我心动了。

source: &467 Never mind.
&109 Byeeeee!
&1 Howdy partner, what can I get y'all?
target: &1 嘿，伙计，想喝点啥？

source: &468 Vodka on the rocks, twist of lime.
target: &468 伏特加，加冰，再加一片青柠皮。

source: &469 Fine, make it two.
target: &469 好吧，来两杯。

source: &470 What do you do here, then?
target: &470 那你在这里是做什么的？

source: &2 Why, I'm the bartender!
target: &2 我当然是调酒师啦！

source: &3 I fix up drinks for the fine folk who live here!
target: &3 给住这儿的各位调点好酒！

source: &275 Anything else?
target: &275 还会别的吗？

source: &4 Anything ELSE?
target: &4 别的？

source: &5 Heck, drinks is a whole lotta stuff to know.
target: &5 嘿，光是酒水，里头的学问就大着呢。

source: &6 Why, I'm the foremost expert on fine drinkin' in these here parts!
target: &6 论怎么喝好酒，这一带谁也比不上我！

source: &471 So, if anyone wanted to know what to put into a drink...
target: &471 也就是说，要是有人想知道该往酒里加些什么……

source: &7 They'd come to me, sure as shootin'!
target: &7 准得来问我！

source: &472 There's been a bit of an incident.
target: &472 这里出了点事。

source: &473 You don't happen to have seen what went on?
target: &473 你有没有碰巧看见当时的情况？

source: &8 Hey, Mister.
target: &8 嘿，先生。

source: &9 I don't jus' go blabbin' my customers' secrets like that!
target: &9 我可不会随便把客人的秘密往外抖！

source: &276 He's bluffing. He never saw anything.
target: &276 他在唬你。他什么也没看见。

source: &277 You're just bitter you've never left that wall.
target: &277 你就是嫉妒，因为你从来没离开过那面墙。

source: &10 Hey! It's a fine job I have here!
target: &10 嘿！我这份工作好着呢！

source: &11 I ain't seen nothin' since Mr Van der Waal got his wine outta the rack this evenin'.
target: &11 今晚范德瓦尔先生从酒架上拿走葡萄酒以后，我就啥也没见着了。

source: &474 I'll speak to you later.
target: &474 我晚点再来找你。

source: &12 I'll keep your tab open!
target: &12 我给你留着账！

source: &475 Where am I supposed to find a BOMB?!
target: &475 你让我上哪儿找炸弹？！

source: &14 You work for CEL, Dr Regis.
target: &14 里吉斯博士，你在CEL工作。

source: &15 If anyone had access to such a device, I've no doubt it would be yourselves.
target: &15 要说谁能弄到这种东西，我相信非你们莫属。

source: &16 Legitimate or otherwise.
target: &16 不管用的是哪种手段。

source: &476 Why do you want this apartment destroyed?
target: &476 你为什么要炸毁这间公寓？

source: &17 My reasons are not your concern, Dr Regis.
target: &17 原因就不劳你费心了，里吉斯博士。

source: &18 What IS your concern however is the matter of your embryos' safety.
target: &18 你该关心的，是那些胚胎能否平安无事。

source: &477 How would I even get something like that out?
target: &477 就算找到了，我又怎么把那种东西带出去？

source: &19 I hear Central isn't quite itself at the moment.
target: &19 我听说中枢眼下有些不对劲。

source: &20 Strike now, while the iron is hot!
target: &20 正好趁热打铁！

source: &478 I guess I don't have a choice...
target: &478 看来我别无选择……

source: &21 I knew you'd make the right decision, Dr Regis.
target: &21 我就知道你会做出正确的决定，里吉斯博士。

source: &22 Return to your garden after the task is complete.
target: &22 完事之后，回你的花园去。

source: &23 I shall contact you then.
target: &23 到时我会联系你。

source: &479 Theft of evidence is one thing...
target: &479 偷证物是一回事……

source: &480 But I cannot - WILL not destroy an apartment.
target: &480 但炸毁一间公寓，我不能——也绝不会这么做。

source: &24 Come now, Doctor. What would Viksha think?
target: &24 别这样，博士。维克莎会怎么想呢？

source: &25 You're putting pride before the safety - the LIVES of your children.
target: &25 你把自己的骄傲看得比孩子的安全——比他们的命还重。

source: &481 How do I know you won't just...like this one...you'd...
target: &481 我怎么知道你不会又……像这一个一样……你会……

source: &26 You don't. This is the best chance you have of their survival, in any case.
target: &26 你不知道。不过，想让他们活下来，这已经是你最好的机会了。

source: &27 Destroying an unoccupied apartment.
target: &27 炸毁一间没人的公寓。

source: &28 That's all I ask.
target: &28 我只要求你做这一件事。

source: &1834 Central, please advise on our current objective status.
target: &1834 中枢，请告知当前任务的进展。

source: &206 <SUBJECT>: Giel Van der Waal is to be questioned regarding casefile RE/8473-A, the "Mindjacker".
target: &206 〈对象〉：吉尔·范德瓦尔。需就“意识劫持者”案件RE/8473-A对其进行问询。

source: &207 According to your reports, it is believed that he may have information regarding the suspect.
target: &207 根据你们的报告，此人可能掌握有关嫌疑人的信息。

source: &1375 He came to us, in the end. Wants to spill his guts.
target: &1375 最后，反倒是他来找我们了。想把事情全抖出来。

source: &208 A meeting has been arranged at Van der Waal's apartment, 28-A, Elysium Towers.
target: &208 会面已安排在范德瓦尔的公寓，极乐大厦28-A。

source: &209 Debrief the subject, and report any pertinent findings.
target: &209 向对象询问情况，并报告相关发现。

source: &210 You have been requested to return to CEL Area Command for debrief.
target: &210 已要求你们返回CEL地区指挥部，汇报情况。

source: &211 However, you appear to have remained at the crimescene.
target: &211 不过，你们似乎仍留在犯罪现场。

source: &1835 Damn straight. We're not leaving until we learn more about what's happened.
target: &1835 没错。没查清发生了什么，我们就不走。

source: &212 Very well. You may perform non-destructive testing at the site until specialists arrive.
target: &212 好吧。专家抵达之前，可在现场开展非破坏性检验。

source: &213 Please note that this example of non-compliance has been added to your record.
target: &213 请注意，此次不服从指令的行为已记入档案。

source: &1836 That's what you said last time.
target: &1836 上次你也这么说。

source: &1837 Case update to report.
target: &1837 汇报案件最新情况。

source: &1376 Hey, I thought we weren't telling Central yet!
target: &1376 嘿，不是说先不告诉中枢吗！

source: &1838 Subject and spouse found dead in apartment.
target: &1838 对象及其配偶被发现死于公寓内。

source: &1839 Request that you hold off on crimescene team until we complete a preliminary.
target: &1839 请在我们完成初步调查前，暂缓派出现场调查组。

source: &214 Unable to comply. Specialists are being allocated and dispatched.
target: &214 无法照办。正在分配并派遣专家。

source: &1840 Oh, come on! This is our case!
target: &1840 得了吧！这是我们的案子！

source: &215 Please return to CEL when expedient.
target: &215 请尽快返回CEL。

source: &1841 Listen, you heartless pile of circuits!
target: &1841 听着，你这堆没心没肺的电路！

source: &1842 Not until we've had a look around.
target: &1842 不把周围查看一遍，我们就不走。

source: &1843 Any further updates on the Mindjacker investigation?
target: &1843 意识劫持者调查还有新消息吗？

source: &216 No additional reports from cooperating CEL departments.
target: &216 参与协作的CEL部门，未提交新的报告。

source: &1844 It sounds like we're the only ones doing any work.
target: &1844 听起来，只有我们在干活。

source: &1845 Are we really sure it's the same perp?
target: &1845 真能确定是同一个人干的吗？

source: &217 Though prolific, forensics has confirmed that use of the same wetware substrate in all instances.
target: &217 虽然案件众多，法证检验已确认，各次作案使用的湿件基质相同。

source: &1846 I guess there aren't many places you can get the tools to steal someone's memories.
target: &1846 能弄到偷别人记忆的工具，地方应该不多。

source: &1847 Do we know what he's after within his victims' minds?
target: &1847 知道他想从受害者脑子里偷什么吗？

source: &218 The destructive nature of the tools used has left no suggestion of precision.
target: &218 所用工具具有破坏性，没有证据表明其抽取过程具备精确性。

source: &219 It may be that the specific target is being disguised amongst generalised disruption.
target: &219 可能以大范围破坏为掩护，隐藏了特定目标。

source: &1848 Or, he really is after their whole mind.
target: &1848 也可能，他就是要整个心智。

source: &220 A possibility, though requiring exotic means of storage and transportation.
target: &220 有可能，但那需要特殊的存储和运输手段。

source: &1849 Do we have any potential suspects, yet?
target: &1849 已经有可疑的人选了吗？

source: &221 Likely candidates within Newton have had implicit constitutional protections revoked.
target: &221 牛顿市内可能涉案者，宪法默认赋予的保护已被撤销。

source: &222 They have been subjected to Series-III enhanced interview practices.
target: &222 已对他们实施III型强化问询程序。

source: &1850 But no successes?
target: &1850 但没问出结果？

source: &223 None. In six months of activity, we have only the Mindjacker's victims.
target: &223 没有。六个月的作案记录，只留下了意识劫持者的受害者。

source: &1851 I'm surprised - with all the memory-thefts they've carried out...
target: &1851 我还挺惊讶，偷了这么多次记忆……

source: &1852 ...you'd think there would be a fence, or a buyer.
target: &1852 ……总该有个销赃的，或者买家吧。

source: &224 Perhaps they are making a collection.
target: &224 也许，他是在收集。

source: &1853 ...was that a joke?
target: &1853 ……这是个笑话吗？

source: &225 Not at all, Dr Regis. As you yourself note frequently, I have no sense of humor.
target: &225 绝非如此，里吉斯博士。正如你经常指出的，我没有幽默感。

source: &1854 What do we know about Van der Waal's connection to the Mindjacker?
target: &1854 范德瓦尔跟意识劫持者的关系，我们知道多少？

source: &226 <SUBJECT> Giel Van der Waal. Before immigration from the Southern African Federation,
target: &226 〈对象〉吉尔·范德瓦尔。此人从南部非洲联邦移民之前，

source: &227 ...Van der Waal was known to possess a number of links to organized crime.
target: &227 ……已知与多个有组织犯罪团体存在联系。

source: &1855 And yet, we still let him into the country.
target: &1855 可我们还是让他进了这个国家。

source: &228 He possessed a reputation as a "fixer", arranging specialized talent for criminal organizations.
target: &228 他以“掮客”闻名，为犯罪组织安排拥有专门技能的人才。

source: &1856 And for hacking the human brain, you need some pretty niche talent and hardware.
target: &1856 想入侵人脑，就需要特别专门的人才和设备。

source: &1857 The kind of people that Van der Waal would have had connections to in his history.
target: &1857 那种人，范德瓦尔过去很可能打过交道。

source: &229 He had been placed on CEL's watchlist, but then he made a most surprising move.
target: &229 他原已列入CEL观察名单，后来却作出了十分出人意料的举动。

source: &1858 He came to *us*. Doesn't that pretty much confirm his involvement?
target: &1858 他来找了*我们*。这不就差不多证明他参与其中了？

source: &230 It merely confirms his awareness, not necessarily his complicity.
target: &230 只能证明他知情，并不必然说明他参与犯罪。

source: &231 You must question Giel Van der Waal.
target: &231 你们必须询问吉尔·范德瓦尔。

source: &232 His death, however, is an added complication.
target: &232 不过，他的死亡令情况更复杂了。

source: &1859 So...uh...how's things?
target: &1859 所以……呃……最近怎么样？

source: &233 Heuristic and cognitive functions are operating within safe thresholds.
target: &233 启发式与认知功能均在安全阈值内运行。

source: &234 Civic stability index is 5.9. Tomorrow's local UV exposure index is 11.
target: &234 城市稳定指数为5.9。明天本地紫外线暴露指数为11。

source: &1860 That's...uh...great...
&235 You are not obliged to make small talk, Dr Regis.
target: &235 你没有义务寒暄，里吉斯博士。

source: &236 I am aware that you are uncomfortable anthropomorphising the Central human interface systems.
target: &236 我知道，你不习惯把中枢的人机交互系统当作人。

source: &1861 It comes a lot more naturally to people like Lao.
target: &1861 劳那样的人，做起来就自然得多。

source: &237 Dr Regis, I must remind you that you are required to keep your traveller online.
target: &237 里吉斯博士，我必须提醒你：你需要保持旅人终端在线。

source: &1862 Hey, I was off-duty!
target: &1862 嘿，我已经下班了！

source: &1863 It's none of your damned business what I do when my traveller's off.
target: &1863 旅人终端关掉以后，我干什么，关你屁事。

source: &238 CEL personnel with neural wiring are able to be reached at any time, for public security.
target: &238 为保障公共安全，可随时联系装有神经接口的CEL人员。

source: &239 It would enhance your performance if you would become wired, as well.
target: &239 如果你也安装神经接口，将能提高工作表现。

source: &1864 Are you kidding? I don't want you spying on me all day.
target: &1864 开玩笑吧？我才不想让你整天监视我。

source: &240 Oversight is a vital aspect of my role as city management coordinator.
target: &240 监督是我担任城市管理统筹者的重要职责。

source: &241 One with which you apparently have great difficulty.
target: &241 而你对此显然有很大意见。

source: &1868 Central, about what happened at the station...
target: &1868 中枢，关于车站发生的事……

source: &252 Post-hoc review is currently underway.
target: &252 事后复核正在进行。

source: &253 Debriefing will take place following your return to CEL.
target: &253 待你返回CEL后，将安排情况汇报。

source: &1869 Let's leave it at that for now, then.
target: &1869 那暂时就先这样吧。

source: &1 Oh, hey, some service.
target: &1 哦，终于有人来招呼我了。

source: &2 These flexes are broken, I can't input anything.
target: &2 这些柔性屏坏了，我什么都输不进去。

source: &482 That's because they're not flex-screens, they're sheets of paper.
target: &482 因为那不是柔性屏，是纸。

source: &3 Paper? What is this, the dark ages?
target: &3 纸？这是什么年代，中世纪吗？

source: &483 I'm Doctor Regis, I'm a CEL Agent.
target: &483 我是里吉斯博士，CEL探员。

source: &484 I've been sent to give you the standard debrief after being involved in something like this.
target: &484 遇到这种事，我们照例要询问一下情况，所以派我过来了。

source: &485 It's our role to do all we can to keep you safe.
target: &485 我们的职责，就是尽力保障你的安全。

source: &4 Yeah, great job with that so far.
target: &4 是啊，到目前为止，干得可真漂亮。

source: &486 Hi there, my name's Charlie.
target: &486 你好，我叫查理。

source: &487 I work here, and I'm going to see if I can help you.
target: &487 我在这里工作，过来看看能不能帮上忙。

source: &488 Something like this must be quite unsettling, after all.
target: &488 毕竟，遇到这种事肯定让人很不安。

source: &5 You could say that. It's not every day something like this happens.
target: &5 可不是。这种事又不是天天都有。

source: &6 Not in meatspace, anyway.
target: &6 至少现实里没有。

source: &489 Hi there. Can you tell me what happened?
target: &489 你好。能告诉我发生了什么吗？

source: &7 No hanging around with you, is there?
target: &7 你还真是一点时间都不耽误啊？

source: &490 Can I take your name and SOC number?
target: &490 请告诉我你的姓名和SOC编号。

source: &8 Sesame. Latha. SN134244.
&491 That's a nice name. Indian? Sri Lankan?
target: &491 名字很好听。印度人？斯里兰卡人？

source: &9 Dunno. Raised by the city. Why do you care?
target: &9 不知道。市里把我养大的。你管这个干什么？

source: &492 My wife was Sri Lankan. She always...you don't care, do you?
target: &492 我妻子是斯里兰卡人。她总是……你根本不关心，是吧？

source: &10 That obvious?
target: &10 有那么明显吗？

source: &493 Hm. Any aliases? Net, Trance, flow, those sorts of things?
target: &493 嗯。有别名吗？网络、迷境、信息流里用的名字之类的？

source: &11 Mandala.
target: &11 曼荼罗。

source: &494 What's your employment status?
target: &494 你的就业情况怎么样？

source: &12 What do you think? Blue recycled overalls.
target: &12 你觉得呢？蓝色的再生布连体服。

source: &495 So, not currently employed?
target: &495 所以，目前没有工作？

source: &13 Duh.
target: &13 这还用问。

source: &496 Perhaps they didn't think you had the right attitude for it...
target: &496 也许他们觉得，你这态度不适合工作……

source: &497 Your health status?
target: &497 健康状况呢？

source: &14 Dunno.
target: &14 不知道。

source: &498 How do you not know that?
target: &498 这怎么会不知道？

source: &15 Been busy. Only come out to eat.
target: &15 忙。只有吃饭才出来。

source: &499 Ah, you're a thrall. Shall I put net-addict, then?
target: &499 啊，你是个迷奴。那我填网瘾者？

source: &16 Put what you want, I don't care.
target: &16 随你怎么写，我不在乎。

source: &500 Where do you live?
target: &500 你住在哪里？

source: &17 The Trance.
target: &17 迷境里。

source: &501 ...and where is your PHYSICAL address?
target: &501 ……我是问你现实中的住址。

source: &18 Well, it *was* 13-E, 8682 Zeus Street.
target: &18 嗯，原来是宙斯街8682号，13-E室。

source: &502 I...excuse me?
target: &502 我……你说什么？

source: &19 13-E, 8682 Zeus Street.
&504 Why are you here at CEL?
target: &504 你为什么会到CEL来？

source: &20 They didn't tell you? Someone cut my network and locked my apartment.
target: &20 他们没告诉你？有人断了我的网，还锁了我的公寓。

source: &21 I'd just about managed to crack the door, when the whole damn place exploded.
target: &21 我好不容易刚把门弄开，整个鬼地方就炸了。

source: &505 Ex...exploded?
&22 Sure, I didn't like the place, but I didn't do it.
target: &22 是，我是不喜欢那里，可又不是我炸的。

source: &24 Hey, is there a net connection here? I haven't been able to hook up for hours.
target: &24 嘿，这里能上网吗？我好几个小时都没连上了。

source: &506 ...excuse me.
&25 So...can I go?
target: &25 那……我能走了吗？

source: &1 Hi there, how can I help?
target: &1 你好，有什么需要帮忙的？

source: &26 Can I speak to you?
target: &26 能和你说两句吗？

source: &2 Sure, just a second.
target: &2 当然，稍等。

source: &3 I...what? Oh, come on.
target: &3 我……什么？哎，别这样。

source: &4 Look, can you move the table? PLEASE?
target: &4 拜托，能把桌子挪开吗？求你了！

source: &51 You're a hacker?
target: &51 你是黑客？

source: &1 That sounds so...crude.
target: &1 这称呼听起来也太……粗俗了。

source: &52 The sort who prefers to be called an "adventurer"?
target: &52 你属于那种喜欢自称“探险家”的？

source: &2 I'm merely a concerned citizen.
target: &2 我只是个关心社会的公民。

source: &3 You can call me Jinsil.
target: &3 叫我金希尔就好。

source: &53 I'm Mandala.
target: &53 我是曼荼罗。

source: &54 This looks a lot like the kind of place I used to live.
target: &54 这里跟我以前住的地方很像。

source: &4 It ought to, it was right above your own.
target: &4 当然像了，这间就在你楼上。

source: &5 In fact, we're trying to reconstruct the data from moments before the blast.
target: &5 其实，我们正在设法恢复爆炸前那一刻的数据。

source: &55 You know where I live?
target: &55 你知道我住哪儿？

source: &6 We wouldn't be taking our responsibilities seriously if we didn't.
target: &6 要是连这都不知道，我们也太不尽责了。

source: &7 We also know that it appears you've been targeted deliberately.
target: &7 我们还知道，这件事很可能是有人故意针对你。

source: &8 These are shots we've been able to recover of the man who planted the bomb.
target: &8 这些是我们找到的影像，拍到了放炸弹的人。

source: &56 That...that's the guy I spoke to!
target: &56 那……那就是跟我说过话的人！

source: &9 You know him?
target: &9 你认识他？

source: &57 Yeah, he's the CEL agent who interviewed me.
target: &57 是啊，他就是询问我的那个CEL探员。

source: &58 He left, like, an hour ago.
target: &58 大概一小时前才走。

source: &59 Why do you think it was me they were aiming for?
target: &59 你为什么觉得他们是冲着我来的？

source: &10 We...hear things.
target: &10 我们……有些消息来源。

source: &11 We're also aware that, prior to the blast, you were trapped.
target: &11 我们也知道，爆炸前你被困住了。

source: &60 Yeah, someone cut my connection and locked the door.
target: &60 对，有人断了我的网，还把门锁上了。

source: &12 It would appear that you were being kept in place until the bomb was planted.
target: &12 看来是要把你困在那里，直到炸弹安放完毕。

source: &61 They probably could have just done it, I'd have been in Trance for hours.
target: &61 其实直接放就行了，我在迷境里一待就是好几个小时。

source: &13 They had to be certain.
target: &13 他们必须确保万无一失。

source: &14 But now that you've escaped, it appears that your life is still at risk.
target: &14 虽然你已经逃了出来，可现在看来，你仍然有生命危险。

source: &62 Why would a CEL agent be trying to kill me?
target: &62 一个CEL探员为什么要杀我？

source: &15 Often Central's plots are unclear.
target: &15 中枢的计划往往让人捉摸不透。

source: &16 This however, is too direct and destructive for how CEL works.
target: &16 但这次的手段太直接，破坏也太大，不像CEL的作风。

source: &63 You think it's personal, then?
target: &63 所以你觉得是他自己的事？

source: &17 In any case, he knows where you are, and that you survived.
target: &17 无论如何，他知道你在哪儿，也知道你还活着。

source: &64 He's also got me trapped in one place again.
target: &64 他还又把我困住了。

source: &18 Then it's imperative that we help you to escape.
target: &18 那我们就必须尽快帮你逃出去。

source: &19 Our agent may be able to help you with that. He is close at hand.
target: &19 我们的人也许能帮上忙。他就在附近。

source: &65 Wait, the guy in the cell with me?
target: &65 等等，跟我关在一起的那个？

source: &66 Blonde, pseudoleather jacket, got the shakes?
target: &66 金发，穿仿皮夹克，浑身发抖？

source: &20 That would be Guy, yes.
target: &20 对，那就是盖伊。

source: &21 He's acting as one of our relays within CEL.
target: &21 他是我们安插在CEL里的中继联络员之一。

source: &67 You think he can help me get out?
target: &67 你觉得他能帮我出去？

source: &22 We work within our own specialities, and his is CEL.
target: &22 我们各有所长，而他专门负责CEL。

source: &23 If anyone were able to furnish a means for you to escape, it would be him.
target: &23 要说谁能帮你找到逃出去的办法，那一定是他。

source: &68 ...on the internet?
target: &68 ……互联网上？

source: &24 Uh...no, that's not quite it.
target: &24 呃……不，不太对。

source: &25 Jahiliyyah means "ignorance". It's meant to be ironic.
target: &25 贾希利亚的意思是“无知”。我们取这名字，是为了讽刺。

source: &69 Ohh, I see...
target: &69 哦，明白了……

source: &70 Even though you ARE on the internet, trance, that sort of thing, right?
target: &70 不过你们确实活跃在互联网、迷境这些地方，对吧？

source: &26 I...suppose...anyhow, that's beside the point.
target: &26 我……算是吧……总之，这不是重点。

source: &71 ...within themselves?
target: &71 ……自己心里？

source: &27 Very philosophical, but not the case.
target: &27 很有哲理，但不是。

source: &28 Jahiliyyah means "ignorance".
target: &28 贾希利亚的意思是“无知”。

source: &72 Oh, I get it, it's ironic.
target: &72 哦，我懂了，这是在讽刺。

source: &29 Precisely.
&73 ...ignorance?
target: &73 ……无知之中？

source: &29 Precisely!
&74 So...are you guys an anti-tech outfit? Loom-breakers?
target: &74 所以……你们是反科技组织？砸机器那种？

source: &31 No, no - it's just an ironic name.
target: &31 不，不——这名字只是用来讽刺的。

source: &75 I'd better disconnect, and see if your guy can help me get out.
target: &75 我还是先断开吧，看看你的人能不能帮我出去。

source: &32 Bit tawfiq! I've sent you the location to find us at.
target: &32 祝你顺利！我已经把我们的地址发给你了。

source: &33 I'll be here should you require any further assistance in your escape.
target: &33 如果逃脱时还需要帮助，随时来找我。

source: Address added: [871 Cyrus Street[D-Sector[NW Partition
target: 已添加地址：[赛勒斯街871号[D区[西北分区

source: &76 Looks like a partially-built sim.
target: &76 看起来像个还没搭完的模拟场景。

source: &34 Indeed, we're using a number of different sources to reconstruct a scene.
target: &34 没错，我们在用各种不同的资料重建现场。

source: &35 Cameras, chromatographs, even the charge variances in wiring.
target: &35 摄像记录、色谱数据，甚至线路中的电荷变化。

source: &77 So why are you hooked up to CEL?
target: &77 那你为什么连进了CEL？

source: &78 No offence, but you'd have to be crazy to hack Central.
target: &78 没别的意思，可敢黑进中枢的人一定疯了。

source: &36 Fortunately, Central is indisposed.
target: &36 幸好，中枢现在出了故障。

source: &37 An initial attack appears to have crippled it.
target: &37 第一波攻击似乎就让它瘫痪了。

source: &79 Ah, so lots of opportunists are trying their luck while the security's weak.
target: &79 哦，所以一堆人都趁安全系统薄弱，过来碰碰运气。

source: &38 Precisely. I was assembling this sim at the same time,
target: &38 正是。当时我还在搭建这个模拟场景，

source: &39 ...when you joined it through an outbound port.
target: &39 ……你就从一个对外端口进来了。

source: &80 Who do you run with? Kollektiv? AnUn?
target: &80 你跟哪个组织混的？Kollektiv？AnUn？

source: &40 We're a circle of truthseekers and underground journalists.
target: &40 我们是一群追寻真相的人和地下记者。

source: &41 We go by "Jahiliyyah".
target: &41 我们叫“贾希利亚”。

source: &81 Never heard of it. What's it mean?
target: &81 没听说过。这名字什么意思？

source: &42 Well, who controls the media today?
target: &42 那么，如今是谁控制着媒体？

source: &82 Uh...Chishiki? They're the biggest.
target: &82 呃……Chishiki？他们规模最大。

source: &43 Exactly. Chishiki, whose name means "knowledge".
target: &43 没错。Chishiki，这个名字的意思是“知识”。

source: &44 Except in this "knowledge", there's nothing but trivia and lies.
target: &44 可这种“知识”里，全是鸡毛蒜皮的事和谎言。

source: &45 So, where will people find the truth?
target: &45 那么，人们该到哪里去寻找真相呢？

source: &83 I've got a question.
target: &83 我有个问题。

source: &46 Yes?
target: &46 什么问题？

source: &84 You're occupying this terminal's internet port.
target: &84 你占着这台终端的网络端口。

source: &85 Mind if I connect to the Trance through you?
target: &85 能不能让我通过你连进迷境？

source: &47 I'm sorry, that's not possible.
target: &47 抱歉，不行。

source: &86 Oh, come on, man. I'll only be a few GBpS.
target: &86 别这样嘛。我就占每秒几GB的带宽。

source: &87 I haven't been on in, like, hours!
target: &87 我都好几个小时没上线了！

source: &48 I can assure you, the Trance won't be going anywhere without you.
target: &48 放心，你不在的时候，迷境也不会跑掉。

source: &88 Come ON! I need to get back in there!
target: &88 拜托！我得回去！

source: &49 I'm sorry, I have to keep this port open for our dataminers.
target: &49 抱歉，这个端口得留给我们的数据挖掘人员。

source: &50 Plus, it may not be safe for you.
target: &50 况且，这对你可能也不安全。

source: &89 They've already got me in here, what's the worst that could happen?
target: &89 他们已经把我关在这儿了，还能怎么样？

source: &51 Think it through. If whoever has been targeting you notices you've come back online...
target: &51 想一想。要是盯上你的人发现你又上线了……

source: &90 ...they'd realize I was still alive...
target: &90 ……他们就知道我还活着……

source: &52 ...and exactly where you are.
target: &52 ……也会知道你的确切位置。

source: &53 I'm sorry, but until we find out exactly who they are and what they want,
target: &53 抱歉，在弄清楚他们到底是谁、想干什么之前，

source: &54 ...you're going to have to remain out of the Trance.
target: &54 ……你都不能再进迷境。

source: &91 *grumbles*
&92 What's Guy's job, then?
target: &92 那盖伊是做什么的？

source: &55 He's a good friend of our cause, works as a relay.
target: &55 他很支持我们的事业，负责中继联络。

source: &56 We keep a connection open to him, and he finds a way to get as physically close as possible to secure systems.
target: &56 我们一直保持和他的连接，他则设法让身体尽量靠近那些设有防护的系统。

source: &93 He looks like he could do with your help.
target: &93 看样子，他也挺需要你们帮忙的。

source: &57 His link was lost several hours ago.
target: &57 几小时前，我们失去了和他的连接。

source: &94 The trojan psychophage he's infected with...
target: &94 他感染的那个噬心木马……

source: &58 He has used some risky tactics for getting inside CEL before.
target: &58 为了混进CEL，他以前也用过一些冒险的手段。

source: &59 While successful, it appears that his work may have overcome him.
target: &59 虽然成功了，但这一次，他似乎已经招架不住了。

source: &95 What's your beef with CEL, anyway?
target: &95 话说，你们和CEL到底有什么过节？

source: &96 It must be something pretty big to go after one of the most secure systems in the world.
target: &96 敢对世界上防护最严密的系统之一下手，肯定不是小事。

source: &60 In an organization like ours, the word "secure" raises red flags.
target: &60 对我们这样的组织来说，“防护严密”这几个字本身就值得警惕。

source: &61 The mere fact that CEL is so opaque tells us they've something they feel worth hiding.
target: &61 CEL如此不透明，就足以说明他们觉得有些东西值得藏起来。

source: &97 I've never had any problems with them. They seem to do alright running the city.
target: &97 我倒没跟他们闹过什么不愉快。这座城市让他们管得还不错。

source: &62 As long as you remain within your ever-flexible world of the Trance, certainly.
target: &62 只要你一直待在迷境那个随心变化的世界里，当然会这么觉得。

source: &63 You may, however, miss that which happens in the tangle of the real that Central controls.
target: &63 可现实中那些由中枢掌控的错综复杂的事，你也许全都看不到。

source: &64 And today, there was an opportunity we just couldn't pass up.
target: &64 而今天，出现了一个我们绝不能放过的机会。

source: &98 Something's wrong with Central. Did you do it?
target: &98 中枢出问题了。是你们干的？

source: &65 Not us, we've never seen anyone quite so devastatingly successful.
target: &65 不是我们。我们从没见过有人能把攻击做到这么彻底。

source: &66 A multi-vector heuristic denial of service attack against Central's inner systems.
target: &66 他们对中枢的内部系统发动了多途径的启发式拒绝服务攻击。

source: &99 But for that, you'd need...thousands...
target: &99 可这得有……几千台……

source: &67 Hundreds of thousands of systems, well prepared, working in synchronicity.
target: &67 几十万套系统，事先充分准备，再步调一致地行动。

source: &68 Or access to its innermost workings.
target: &68 或者，能直接进入它最核心的内部系统。

source: &69 It's almost too good to be true, all of Central down at a moment's notice!
target: &69 中枢说瘫痪就整个瘫痪了，简直好得让人不敢相信！

source: &100 How's the city still running?
target: &100 那这座城市怎么还在运转？

source: &70 They'll have auxiliary mechanisms in place.
target: &70 他们会有辅助机制维持运作。

source: &71 Newton's autonomic nervous system, to Central's higher brain functions.
target: &71 中枢相当于大脑的高级功能，而那些机制就是牛顿市的自主神经系统。

source: &101 But with Central suddenly down, CEL's security system was weaker than ever.
target: &101 可中枢突然瘫痪，CEL的安全系统就比以往任何时候都薄弱了。

source: &72 Precisely. An opportunity that Jahiliyyah couldn't pass up!
target: &72 正是。这种机会，贾希利亚绝不能错过！

source: &102 I read Chishiki sometimes. What's wrong with them?
target: &102 我有时也看Chishiki。他们有什么问题？

source: &73 That depends. If you want the banal and the trivial, they're absolutely fine.
target: &73 得看你想看什么。要是只想看些无聊琐事，他们完全没问题。

source: &74 By having a stranglehold on the world's media industry, they are capable of controlling what the majority of the population are aware of.
target: &74 他们牢牢控制着全球的媒体业，也就能决定大多数人会知道些什么。

source: &103 Are they lying to us?
target: &103 他们在对我们撒谎？

source: &75 No, merely deceiving.
target: &75 不，只是在蒙蔽你们。

source: &76 What they want people to know, they'll report wholly, truthfully and factually. This is how they've established their credibility.
target: &76 想让大家知道的事，他们就完整、如实地报道。这也是他们赢得公信力的方法。

source: &77 If they or their allies wish something to be suppressed, they've thousands of hackers on staff to destroy systems that pose a threat.
target: &77 如果他们或盟友想压下某件事，就会动用旗下几千名黑客，摧毁那些构成威胁的系统。

source: &105 You're kidding.
target: &105 你在开玩笑吧。

source: &78 Not at all. They lead the world in private-sector espionage through a number of subsidiaries.
target: &78 一点也没有。他们通过多家子公司从事商业间谍活动，在全球首屈一指。

source: &79 As far as Jahiliyyah are concerned, the things most worth knowing are those that others wish hidden.
target: &79 在贾希利亚看来，别人想藏起来的事，才最值得知道。

source: &80 THAT is why we work against Chishiki, to ensure that the world knows the WHOLE truth.
target: &80 所以我们才要对抗Chishiki，让全世界知道完整的真相。

source: &106 This apartment looks almost exactly like mine.
target: &106 这间公寓跟我家简直一模一样。

source: &107 Well...except for all the data-artifacts. And it's cleaner.
target: &107 嗯……除了那些数据残影。而且这里更干净。

source: &81 Not surprising, since it was right above yours.
target: &81 不奇怪，就在你楼上嘛。

source: &108 Are you sure that agent wasn't targeting this apartment?
target: &108 你确定那个探员不是冲着这间公寓来的？

source: &82 Unlikely. The occupant was away long-term.
target: &82 不太可能。住户已经离开很久了。

source: &83 Together with trapping you within your apartment, and outside of the Trance...
target: &83 再加上他们把你困在公寓里，还不让你进入迷境……

source: &109 Yeah, I thought so. Just hoped it might be someone else they were after.
target: &109 是啊，我也是这么想的。只是盼着他们要找的是别人。

source: &110 Then I could get back to my Trance.
target: &110 那我就能回迷境了。

source: &111 Guy's going to help me get out, but what then?
target: &111 盖伊会帮我出去，可出去之后呢？

source: &112 I can't exactly go home anymore.
target: &112 我现在总不能回家了。

source: &84 We have much to discuss, and that would be better done on a secure site.
target: &84 我们还有很多事要谈，最好找个安全的地方。

source: &85 There are a number of terminal nodes we use as drop-points, one of those will suffice.
target: &85 我们有几个终端节点，用作联络点。去其中一个就行。

source: &86 But remember - do NOT access the Trance on the net until we confirm it's safe.
target: &86 但记住，我们确认安全之前，千万别通过网络进入迷境。

source: &113 Rrrrgh...
&114 I've lured a drone into the cell.
target: &114 我把一台无人机引进牢房了。

source: &115 It's carrying tools to help me get out, but it won't sit still.
target: &115 它带着能帮我出去的工具，可就是不肯停下来。

source: &87 The drones in CEL HQ draw their energy from the floors.
target: &87 CEL总部的无人机从地板上获取电力。

source: &88 Perhaps if you could break the contact between the two?
target: &88 或许可以想办法，让它和地板分开？

source: &116 Any idea why they're after me?
target: &116 知道他们为什么盯上我吗？

source: &89 Hm...have you been hacking anyone you shouldn't have?
target: &89 嗯……你有没有黑进过什么不该惹的人那里？

source: &117 Nobody who'd try to kill me, anyway.
target: &117 至少没有谁会为这个来杀我。

source: &118 Could it be related to CEL? It was an agent who planted the bomb.
target: &118 会不会跟CEL有关？放炸弹的可是个探员。

source: &90 Not directly. If it was, they'd have finished you, rather than keeping you prisoner.
target: &90 不会是直接相关。真是CEL要杀你，你早没命了，不会只是被关起来。

source: &91 I have some theories as to what's going on, but we'll know more for certain later.
target: &91 我有一些猜测，晚点应该能弄清更多情况。

source: &119 Once you've had a chance to pull data out from Central while it's down.
target: &119 等你趁中枢瘫痪，从里面弄到数据以后。

source: &92 Exactly.
&120 I've been speaking with Guy about the treatment he needs.
target: &120 我和盖伊聊过他需要的治疗了。

source: &121 Apparently, an automeal might be able to make it?
target: &121 据说自动食品机也能做出他要的东西？

source: &93 Hm...that's an intriguing possibility.
target: &93 嗯……这个想法很有意思。

source: &94 It would require accessing its internal systems,
target: &94 首先得进入它的内部系统，

source: &95 ...placing the data for the new chemicals into its memory...
target: &95 ……把新化学品的数据存进它的记忆里……

source: &96 ...and making sure the optical systems are specialized enough for the task.
target: &96 ……还得确保它的光学系统能满足这项工作的要求。

source: &122 Thanks.
&97 Al'afw.
target: &97 不客气。

source: &123 Hi, Guy.
&1 Hey there.
&1 Hello.
target: &1 你好。

source: &2 SHE WASN'T TALKING TO YOU!
target: &2 她没跟你说话！

source: &124 Hi there.
&3 Oh hey, make yourself at home.
target: &3 哦，嗨，随意点。

source: &4 Everyone else seems to in here.
target: &4 反正这儿其他人都挺随意的。

source: &5 Guy. I'd shake your hand, but, well...
target: &5 我叫盖伊。本来该跟你握个手，可你也看见了……

source: &125 You alright?
target: &125 你还好吗？

source: &6 Oh yeah, just peachy.
target: &6 好啊，好得不得了。

source: &7 Well, I would be if that imposter would GO AWAY.
target: &7 嗯，要是那个冒牌货肯滚蛋的话。

source: &2 I am not an imposter.
target: &2 我不是冒牌货。

source: &3 I am the real <HOST NAME>
target: &3 我才是真正的<HOST NAME>

source: &126 How'd you wind up like this?
target: &126 你怎么搞成这样的？

source: &8 Well, you know that urban myth about the "human resources" trojan?
target: &8 你听过那个“人力资源”木马的都市传说吧？

source: &127 The one that makes you move to China, and join a factory collective?
target: &127 就是会让人搬去中国、加入工厂集体的那个？

source: &9 Turns out it's not a myth.
target: &9 结果还真不是传说。

source: &10 If I'm correct, CEL have brought me in for treatment.
target: &10 如果我没猜错，CEL是把我带来治疗的。

source: &128 That's a good thing, right?
target: &128 那不是好事吗？

source: &11 Well, duh. I don't want to work in a Han factory.
target: &11 废话。我可不想去大汉的工厂干活。

source: &17 All glory to the Greater Han Republic!
target: &17 一切荣耀归于大汉共和国！

source: &12 Shut UP!
&129 Jinsil says 'hi'.
target: &129 金希尔向你问好。

source: &13 Oh does she? Tell her she owes me double for this one.
target: &13 是吗？告诉她，这回她得付我双倍的钱。

source: &14 I lost touch with her hours ago.
target: &14 我跟她失联好几个小时了。

source: &130 She says you know a way out of here?
target: &130 她说你知道怎么出去？

source: &15 Well, sure. It's even easier when Central's down.
target: &15 当然。中枢瘫痪了，就更容易了。

source: &16 Of course, I'm gonna need something from you.
target: &16 不过，我得先请你帮个忙。

source: &131 What's with Pinocchio?
target: &131 那个匹诺曹是怎么回事？

source: &17 It's a disguise.
target: &17 是个伪装。

source: &18 Normally, by this stage the trojan is in control of its host's motor-functions.
target: &18 一般到了这个阶段，木马已经控制了宿主的运动机能。

source: &19 It makes a really clumsy mindstate-echo of the host,
target: &19 它会弄出一个很拙劣的宿主意识副本，

source: &20 ...then uses it to try to make a convincing flight to Greater Han.
target: &20 ……再利用它，设法让飞往大汉的举动显得合情合理。

source: &132 He didn't look like he's in control in meatspace.
target: &132 可现实里看着，不像是他掌控了身体。

source: &5 Peace, bread and work in the Greater Han Republic!
target: &5 大汉共和国带来和平、面包和工作！

source: &21 It's kind of a stalemate at the moment.
target: &21 现在算是僵持住了。

source: &133 He's taken to bombarding you with propaganda instead?
target: &133 所以他改用宣传口号轰炸你了？

source: &22 IT thinks it can wear me down.
target: &22 它以为这样就能把我磨垮。

source: &6 Long life and prosperity to our beloved land of Greater Han!
target: &6 愿我们挚爱的大汉国土永享繁荣昌盛！

source: &134 So why are you in a cell, in CEL,
target: &134 所以，你为什么会被CEL关在牢房里，

source: &135 ...with a broken trojan in your head?
target: &135 ……脑子里还装着个出毛病的木马？

source: &23 I'm acting as a relay for pirated connections into CEL.
target: &23 我是中继联络员，帮人非法连进CEL。

source: &136 That sounds...dangerous.
target: &136 听着……挺危险的。

source: &24 Pay's good, though.
target: &24 可报酬不错。

source: &7 Money is the yoke of capitalism.
target: &7 金钱是资本主义的枷锁。

source: &25 Thing is, it's been harder and harder to get into CEL HQ.
target: &25 问题是，混进CEL总部越来越难了。

source: &137 So you infected yourself with this?
target: &137 所以你就主动感染了这个？

source: &26 They have to bring in someone with something like this.
target: &26 碰到得了这种病的人，他们必须带进来。

source: &27 Even if they can't treat it, they can at least quarantine.
target: &27 就算治不了，至少也得隔离。

source: &138 Giving you an ideal spot to relay signals through your neural wiring.
target: &138 这样你就到了理想的位置，能通过神经线路中继信号。

source: &28 Exactly.
&139 Fine. What is it you want?
target: &139 好吧。你到底需要什么？

source: &29 I need an edge to help me get rid of the chatterbox.
target: &29 我需要一点优势，好把那个话痨赶走。

source: &30 For that, I need epinephrine.
target: &30 所以，我需要肾上腺素。

source: &31 See if you can get them to bring any in.
target: &31 看看能不能让他们送点进来。

source: &140 And if they don't?
target: &140 要是不肯呢？

source: &32 You look clever, you can probably find a way to make it.
target: &32 你看起来挺聪明，应该能想办法做出来。

source: &8 Substance abuse is the curse of the working classes.
target: &8 药物滥用是工人阶级的祸患。

source: &141 Why do you want this stuff?
target: &141 你为什么需要这东西？

source: &33 The people here don't exactly know what they're doing.
target: &33 这里的人其实不太知道自己在做什么。

source: &34 CEL's treatment might work, or I might walk out of here and straight to Greater Han.
target: &34 CEL的治疗也许管用，也可能我一走出这里，就直奔大汉去了。

source: &35 The epinephrine will give me enough of a boost to make sure it's me who wins the battle.
target: &35 肾上腺素能让我多一股劲，确保这场较量由我获胜。

source: &28 We must persevere in the great revolutionary struggle.
target: &28 我们必须坚持伟大的革命斗争。

source: &36 Plus, it's the kind of thing that most chemical synthesizers can make.
target: &36 况且，大多数化学合成器都能做出这东西。

source: &142 Wait, like a food machine?
target: &142 等等，食品机那种也行？

source: &37 Hm...probably!
target: &37 嗯……应该行！

source: &143 I'm a Trance person, not a hardware one.
target: &143 我擅长的是迷境，可不是硬件。

source: &144 What do I do to the food machine to make it give me epinephrine?
target: &144 我该怎么改食品机，才能让它做出肾上腺素？

source: &38 I'm not much good on hardware either, I'm afraid.
target: &38 恐怕我也不太懂硬件。

source: &39 Jinsil might know, though.
target: &39 不过金希尔也许知道。

source: &145 What can I do with the molecular data you gave me?
target: &145 你给我的分子数据有什么用？

source: &40 It's just a standardized mol-map.
target: &40 就是一份标准化的分子图谱。

source: &41 It'll work as a guide with anything designed to synthesise chemicals.
target: &41 只要是用来合成化学品的设备，都能照着它来做。

source: &146 Now I just have to find something that'll do that in a cell...
target: &146 现在就得在牢房里找个能做这事的东西了……

source: &147 I've managed to lead a drone into the cell.
target: &147 我已经把一台无人机引进牢房了。

source: &148 Now I just need to keep it from running away.
target: &148 现在只差不让它跑掉。

source: &42 The drones draw their power from the floor.
target: &42 无人机从地板上获取电力。

source: &43 Sometimes the stupid things would hit dead spots where there's no current.
target: &43 那些蠢东西有时会跑到没电流的地方，就不动了。

source: &149 There's a real dork of a CEL offcer guarding us.
target: &149 看守我们的那个CEL人员傻得很。

source: &44 They're all like that.
target: &44 他们都那样。

source: &45 It's creepy how enthusiastic they get about "civic virtues".
target: &45 提起“公民美德”，他们就热情得让人发毛。

source: &150 They've probably got a darker T-life online, though.
target: &150 不过他们在网上的迷境生活，恐怕阴暗得多。

source: &151 Probably the ones into the weirdest stuff in private.
target: &151 私底下玩得最怪的，没准就是他们。

source: &152 I think I know where I can find components to upgrade the food machine.
target: &152 我大概知道去哪儿找改造食品机的零件了。

source: &153 Can't reach them, though.
target: &153 可惜够不着。

source: &46 Anything you can stand on?
target: &46 有没有什么东西能站上去？

source: &154 There's a table, but it's screwed into the floor.
target: &154 有张桌子，不过用螺丝固定在地上了。

source: &47 Is there a way to UNscrew it?
target: &47 能不能把螺丝拧下来？

source: &155 Anything I can do to help?
target: &155 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

source: &48 There would be, but I'm going to have to decline.
target: &48 有倒是有，不过我得拒绝。

source: &156 I don't think you're really in a position to bargain.
target: &156 你现在好像没什么挑三拣四的余地。

source: &49 Hey, for all I know, you're a CEL agent trying to breach my wiring.
target: &49 嘿，谁知道你是不是CEL探员，想侵入我的神经线路。

source: &50 If I give you too much room, then I'm just swapping him over there as my oppressive influence.
target: &50 要是给你太多权限，就只是把那边那个换成你来控制我。

source: &10 The influence of the mighty Han Republic spans the world.
target: &10 强大的大汉共和国，影响遍及全球。

source: &157 Why would CEL want to breach YOU?
target: &157 CEL为什么要侵入你的神经线路？

source: &51 Again, if I start telling you about THAT, then I'm incriminating myself.
target: &51 还是那句话，要是连这事也告诉你，我就是在给自己定罪了。

source: &52 I'd love to help you help me, but I'd need to know we're on the same side.
target: &52 我也想配合你，可得先知道我们是不是一边的。

source: &158 Don't go anywhere.
&53 Ha. You're funny.
target: &53 哈。你可真会说笑。

source: &27 So, agent...uh...
&5 Just Corpsman, actually. Quince.
target: &5 其实我只是医务员。姓昆斯。

source: &6 What's your name?
target: &6 你叫什么名字？

source: &28 Sesame. Latha.
target: &28 塞萨米。拉塔。

source: &7 Nice to meet you, Ms Sesame!
target: &7 很高兴认识你，塞萨米女士！

source: &8 Pardon my asking, but you were raised by the city, weren't you?
target: &8 冒昧问一句，你是市里养大的吧？

source: &29 You read that on my file?
target: &29 从我档案上看到的？

source: &9 Nah, I was too!
target: &9 不是，我也是！

source: &30 No way.
target: &30 真的假的。

source: &10 Yeah, we're practically family!
target: &10 真的，我们简直算是一家人！

source: &31 I've been in here for hours!
target: &31 我在这里待了好几个小时了！

source: &32 The guy on the bed isn't much company. What is there to do?
target: &32 床上那个也不怎么陪人聊天。这里有什么能做的？

source: &11 There's the terminal - you can check the news.
target: &11 有台终端，你可以看看新闻。

source: &33 I can't stand this much of the real world...it's so slow...
target: &33 我受不了在现实里待这么久……一切都慢得要命……

source: &12 I'm sorry, people don't usually spend so long in here.
target: &12 抱歉，大家通常不会在这里待这么久。

source: &13 It's just taking a bit longer than usual.
target: &13 这次只是比平时多花了点时间。

source: &34 I'm starving, it's been days since the last time I ate.
target: &34 我快饿死了，好几天没吃东西了。

source: &14 And was that because you were deep in the Trance?
target: &14 是因为你一直沉在迷境里吗？

source: &35 I...it...that's not the point.
target: &35 我……这……这不是重点。

source: &36 I couldn't get the food machine in here to work.
target: &36 这里的食品机我也用不了。

source: &15 Oh yeah, they take tokens.
target: &15 哦，对，那得用代币。

source: &16 Here, have a few. You'll be able to get yourself something.
target: &16 来，给你几个。你就能弄点吃的了。

source: Picked up: Tokens
target: 获得：代币

source: &37 Is it any good?
target: &37 好吃吗？

source: &17 Uh...what kind of machine do you have at home?
target: &17 呃……你家用的是哪种食品机？

source: &38 The kind that came in sconto apartments.
target: &38 廉价公寓自带的那种。

source: &18 Oh. Ouch. Yeah, kind of about that.
target: &18 哦。那可不怎么样。这里的也差不多。

source: &39 Who was that guy who came in?
target: &39 刚才进来的那个人是谁？

source: &19 Oh, Charlie? He's one of the most experienced agents in CEL.
target: &19 哦，查理？他是CEL资历最深的探员之一。

source: &20 A lot of people have trouble getting on with him, but he's just...businesslike.
target: &20 很多人跟他合不来，可他只是……公事公办。

source: &40 It sounded like he was panicking about something.
target: &40 听起来，他好像在为什么事慌张。

source: &21 I've never thought of him as someone who gets worried.
target: &21 我可从没觉得他是个会慌的人。

source: &22 Grumpy a whole lot of the time, sure...
target: &22 脾气不好倒是常有……

source: &41 What's wrong with that guy on the bed?
target: &41 床上那个人怎么了？

source: &42 He hasn't said a word in hours.
target: &42 好几个小时了，他一句话都没说。

source: &23 We're not sure, he was picked up on the street yesterday.
target: &23 还不清楚。他是昨天从街上带回来的。

source: &24 It looks like he's come down with a psychophage issue.
target: &24 看起来是感染了某种噬心病毒。

source: &43 So you're just...ignoring him?
target: &43 所以你们就……不管他了？

source: &25 Not much we can do until we know what it is.
target: &25 没弄清是什么之前，我们也做不了多少。

source: &44 Why let it show symptoms? Why not connect someone?
target: &44 为什么任它发作？不能让人连进去看看吗？

source: &26 All of our infowar teams are busy with the...uh...never mind...
target: &26 我们所有的信息战小组都在忙着处理……呃……算了……

source: &45 The guy on the bed? I know what's wrong with him.
target: &45 床上那个人？我知道他怎么了。

source: &46 He's contracted a human-resources trojan.
target: &46 他感染了“人力资源”木马。

source: &27 How would you know this? Have you been Trancing with him?
target: &27 你怎么会知道？你和他一起进过迷境吗？

source: &28 Because then we might have to quarantine you as well.
target: &28 如果是的话，我们可能也得把你隔离起来。

source: &47 Uh...no...I had a friend come down with it.
target: &47 呃……没有……我有个朋友得过这个。

source: &29 Okay then. I can get something to help.
target: &29 那好。我可以找些东西来帮他。

source: Utility Drone
target: 作业无人机

source: &30 Unfortunately, I can only try to stabilize him for now.
target: &30 不过，目前我只能尽量让他的情况稳定下来。

source: &31 We have to wait for a specialist before we can try anything stronger.
target: &31 得等专家来了，才能尝试更强的治疗。

source: &48 I need to get back in the Trance.
target: &48 我得回迷境。

source: &49 How can I make a connection?
target: &49 怎么才能连上？

source: &32 Sorry, we don't allow Trance connections from inside CEL.
target: &32 抱歉，CEL内部不允许连接迷境。

source: &50 What?! That's inhuman! I have rights, you know!
target: &50 什么？！太不人道了！我也是有权利的！

source: &33 Not to an internet connection, you don't.
target: &33 可上网不在这些权利之内。

source: &51 Come oooonnn, I could just hook something up through that terminal...
target: &51 拜托嘛，我接一下那台终端就行……

source: &34 I'm sorry, but it's for security.
target: &34 抱歉，这是出于安全考虑。

source: &52 Um...sorry about messing up the room.
target: &52 呃……抱歉，把房间弄乱了。

source: &35 Charlie's not gonna be happy, but I've seen worse.
target: &35 查理肯定会不高兴，不过更糟的我都见过。

source: &36 At least it's not hard to clean, all this concrete.
target: &36 至少这里全是混凝土，打扫起来不难。

source: &53 Would I be able to get some privacy?
target: &53 能不能给我一点隐私？

source: &37 What do you mean?
target: &37 什么意思？

source: &54 Well, with that camera, I don't think I can...
target: &54 嗯，有那个摄像头，我总不能……

source: &55 You know, personal stuff. *Business*.
target: &55 就是，私人的事。方便一下。

source: &38 I'm sorry, I understand how you feel, but I can't cut the camera.
target: &38 抱歉，我理解你的感受，可我不能关掉摄像头。

source: &56 What!? That's not fair!
target: &56 什么！？这不公平！

source: &39 All of the cameras are tied into the Centralized network.
target: &39 所有摄像头都接在中枢的网络上。

source: &40 We can't turn them off, even if we wanted to. It's for your security.
target: &40 就算我们想关，也关不了。这是为了你的安全。

source: &57 Oh, I see...you're not ABLE to.
target: &57 哦，明白了……是你们没办法关。

source: &41 Charlie doesn't like it either. He keeps breaking the camera in his office.
target: &41 查理也不喜欢。他老把办公室里的摄像头弄坏。

source: &42 Central gets real mad at him for that.
target: &42 为这个，中枢可没少生他的气。

source: &58 Why are you keeping me in this cell? I haven't done anything!
target: &58 为什么把我关在这个牢房里？我什么都没做！

source: &43 Oh, this isn't a cell.
target: &43 哦，这不是牢房。

source: &44 The cells are only two cubic meters.
target: &44 牢房只有两立方米。

source: &60 That's not the point! I didn't break the law!
target: &60 这不是重点！我又没犯法！

source: &45 It's for your own safety.
target: &45 这是为了你自己的安全。

source: &46 Charlie's asked to make sure you stay here until he gets back.
target: &46 查理吩咐过，他回来之前，得让你待在这里。

source: &61 I don't FEEL very safe...
target: &61 我可一点也没觉得安全……

source: &62 That agent who was in here, Doctor Regis -
target: &62 刚才来过的那个探员，里吉斯博士——

source: &47 Oh yes, Charlie?
&63 He tried to kill me!
target: &63 他想杀我！

source: &64 He's the one who blew up my apartment!
target: &64 就是他炸了我的公寓！

source: &48 That's a very serious accusation, Miss!
target: &48 小姐，这可是很严重的指控！

source: &49 Do you have any evidence?
target: &49 你有证据吗？

source: &65 Well...no, I...uh...
&50 Look, Dr Regis is out at the moment.
target: &50 听我说，里吉斯博士现在出去了。

source: &51 When he comes back, we'll all sit down and discuss this.
target: &51 等他回来，我们就一起坐下来谈谈。

source: &66 But I - oh, never mind.
target: &66 可我——唉，算了。

source: &67 So, how'd you know I was raised by the city?
target: &67 话说，你怎么知道我是市里养大的？

source: &52 It was a guess, but your name was a clue.
target: &52 猜的，不过你的姓给了点提示。

source: &53 You ever notice how they always assign kids names from nature?
target: &53 你没发现，他们总给孩子取些来自自然界的名字吗？

source: &54 Quince, Sesame, we even had a Pomegranate in my centre.
target: &54 昆斯是榅桲，塞萨米是芝麻。我们中心甚至还有个姓“石榴”的。

source: &68 Huh, I suppose that's true.
target: &68 嗯，还真是。

source: &69 Never met any with cool names, though. No Tigers, or anything.
target: &69 不过我没见过名字很酷的。比如“老虎”之类的。

source: &55 Hah, yeah. I don't think they do the extinct ones, though.
target: &55 哈，是啊。不过已经灭绝的，他们好像不用。

source: &70 So how'd you end up working for CEL?
target: &70 那你怎么会来CEL工作？

source: &56 I'm not sure, really. Kinda drifted in. Most of the kids from my centre ended up here.
target: &56 其实我也说不清。不知不觉就来了。我们中心的大多数孩子最后都来了这里。

source: &57 Munro Centre down by the coast, that is. Where'd you grow up?
target: &57 就是海边的门罗中心。你在哪儿长大的？

source: &71 Taylor, near the lake.
target: &71 湖边的泰勒中心。

source: &72 Most of us just ended up on sconto - unemployed.
target: &72 我们大多都在领救济——没工作。

source: &58 I'm sorry to hear that.
target: &58 听到这个，我很难过。

source: &59 Personally, I think us City Kids should stick together!
target: &59 我觉得，我们这些市里养大的孩子应该团结起来！

source: &60 There are so many of us, we'd be a force to be reckoned with!
target: &60 我们人这么多，团结起来可是一股不容小觑的力量！

source: &73 So what's your first name, Mister Corpsman Quince?
target: &73 那么，昆斯医务员先生，你的名字叫什么？

source: &61 It's Amadi, an Angolan name.
target: &61 阿马迪，是个安哥拉名字。

source: &62 Apparently that's where my family came from, but I've been here as long as I can remember.
target: &62 据说我的家人来自那里，不过从记事起，我就一直在这里。

source: &63 The first names are always from kids' cultural backgrounds.
target: &63 名字都是按孩子原来的文化背景取的。

source: &64 What about Latha, is that...Indian?
target: &64 拉塔呢，这是……印度名字？

source: &74 Dunno. Probably.
target: &74 不知道。大概吧。

source: &75 I came with a refugee shipment from the War.
target: &75 我是战争期间，跟一批难民一起来的。

source: &76 You ever feel like exploring your roots?
target: &76 你有没有想过去寻根？

source: &65 Not really. I grew up here, Newton is my home.
target: &65 没怎么想过。我在这里长大，牛顿市就是我的家。

source: &77 Yeah, there isn't really much for me in the "old country" either.
target: &77 是啊，我那所谓的“故乡”也没什么值得回去的。

source: &78 Except thousands of kilometres of radioactive hot-zone.
target: &78 除了绵延几千公里的强辐射区。

source: &79 My apartment exploded!
target: &79 我的公寓炸了！

source: &66 Ouch, was it a nice place?
target: &66 哎呀，原来住得好吗？

source: &80 Well, no, but that isn't the point!
target: &80 不好，但这不是重点！

source: &67 Accidents like that happen sometimes.
target: &67 这种事故偶尔也会发生。

source: &68 At least CEL were able to get you out!
target: &68 至少CEL把你救出来了！

source: &81 I'm not sure it was an accident.
target: &81 我可不觉得那一定是事故。

source: &82 My connection was cut, and my doors were locked before it happened.
target: &82 事发之前，我的网被断了，门也被锁上了。

source: &69 Who'd want to hurt you, though?
target: &69 可谁会想害你呢？

source: &83 That's just it, I don't know who...
target: &83 问题就在这儿，我不知道是谁……

source: &84 I mean, I've pissed people off in netmatches sometimes, but this...
target: &84 我是说，打网赛的时候，我偶尔也会惹人生气，可这……

source: &85 Thanks for that.
target: &85 谢谢你。

source: &70 Any time. Just call if you need anything!
target: &70 不客气。有什么需要就叫我！

source: &1 Ahem.
&1 Dr Lao? You have a visitor.
target: &1 劳博士？有人来找你。

source: &2 Good evening, Dr Lao.
target: &2 晚上好，劳博士。

source: &279 Hello...and you are...?
target: &279 你好……请问你是……？

source: &1 Surely you recognize him?
target: &1 你总该认识他吧？

source: &280 Dr Vargas, you're the Central Operations Coordinator!
target: &280 瓦尔加斯博士，您是中枢运营协调员！

source: &3 Quite so, young lady.
target: &3 正是，年轻人。

source: &281 I apologize for the mess, Sir.
target: &281 抱歉，这里有些乱，先生。

source: &282 If I'd known we were going to have such important visitors...
target: &282 要是早知道有这么重要的客人来……

source: &4 That's quite alright, Dr Lao.
target: &4 无妨，劳博士。

source: &283 I'm afraid you'll have to enlighten me.
target: &283 恐怕得请你介绍一下。

source: &2 This is Dr Vargas - the Central Operations Coordinator!
target: &2 这位是瓦尔加斯博士，中枢运营协调员！

source: &5 Now Galatea, there's no need to be quite like that.
target: &5 好了，伽拉忒亚，没必要这么说。

source: &6 The fact that I'm not widely recognized perhaps indicates how successful we are.
target: &6 大家不怎么认识我，也许恰恰说明我们的工作做得不错。

source: &3 Yes...you're right, father...
target: &3 是……您说得对，父亲……

source: &284 Vargas...Dr Eduardo Vargas??
target: &284 瓦尔加斯……爱德华多·瓦尔加斯博士？？

source: &7 Ahah, quite so, Dr Lao.
target: &7 哈，正是，劳博士。

source: &285 What brings you from the Fulcrum Tower, Sir?
target: &285 是什么事让您从支点大厦过来，先生？

source: &8 A most grave matter, I'm afraid.
target: &8 恐怕是一件非常严重的事。

source: &9 One I believe you, specifically, to be most suited to handle.
target: &9 而且我认为，最适合处理这件事的人，就是你。

source: &4 Shall I, father?
target: &4 我来吗，父亲？

source: &10 Please do, Galatea.
target: &10 请吧，伽拉忒亚。

source: &5 Central, I believe the audio/EM-capture system in this room to be faulty.
target: &5 中枢，我认为这个房间的音频及电磁采集系统存在故障。

source: &6 Please run a deep-diagnostic on the system.
target: &6 请对该系统执行深度诊断。

source: &2 Certainly, Ms Vargas. Beginning scan...
target: &2 好的，瓦尔加斯女士。开始扫描……

source: &7 We have perhaps two minutes until the diagnostic cycle is complete.
target: &7 诊断完成之前，我们大概有两分钟。

source: &11 Dr Lao, have you heard of a gentleman by the name of Baxter?
target: &11 劳博士，你听说过一位叫巴克斯特的先生吗？

source: &286 Dr Adam Baxter, convicted murderer?
target: &286 亚当·巴克斯特博士，那个被判有罪的杀人犯？

source: &8 And a brilliant gengineer, in his time.
target: &8 当年，他也是一位出色的基因工程师。

source: &287 Yes, I've heard of him. My partner had...a history with him.
target: &287 是的，我听说过。我的搭档和他……有些过节。

source: &288 His parole hearing and eventual release really got to Dr Regis.
target: &288 他的假释听证会，还有后来的获释，对里吉斯博士打击很大。

source: &12 Quite so, poor Viksha...I don't think Charlie ever got over it.
target: &12 是啊，可怜的维克莎……我想，查理始终没能走出来。

source: &13 And unfortunately, it appears that he's taken things into his own hands.
target: &13 不幸的是，他似乎决定亲手解决这件事了。

source: &289 If I had a few moments to Trance for it...
target: &289 给我一点时间，我可以去迷境查一下……

source: &9 He was a gengineer, a former colleague of Dr Regis.
target: &9 他是基因工程师，以前和里吉斯博士共事。

source: &14 And of mine, in our research days.
target: &14 当年做研究时，他也是我的同事。

source: &15 Tragically, also the man responsible for the murder of Regis' wife. Poor Viksha...
target: &15 可悲的是，杀害里吉斯妻子的也是他。可怜的维克莎……

source: &290 Oh! Yes! Regis has been hit hard lately by the paroling.
target: &290 哦！对！这次假释让里吉斯最近很不好受。

source: &291 He didn't seem to think that Baxter deserved any kind of release.
target: &291 他觉得巴克斯特根本不该以任何方式获释。

source: &16 It appears that he may well have acted on these objections.
target: &16 看来，他很可能已经为此采取行动了。

source: &292 You have a connection to Regis as well?
target: &292 您也和里吉斯有交情？

source: &17 Quite so. He worked for me in a research team.
target: &17 是的。他曾在我手下的研究团队工作。

source: &18 As did Baxter, in the same project.
target: &18 巴克斯特也一样，参与的是同一个项目。

source: &293 And Viksha Regis?
target: &293 维克莎·里吉斯也是？

source: &19 Precisely. We lost half of the team in one fell swoop, that day.
target: &19 正是。那一天，我们一下失去了半个团队。

source: &10 Dr Lao, when did you last see Dr Regis?
target: &10 劳博士，你最后一次见到里吉斯博士是什么时候？

source: &294 Last night, before Central went into siege mode.
target: &294 昨晚，中枢进入围城模式之前。

source: &295 Why? What's happened?
target: &295 怎么了？出了什么事？

source: &20 This morning, Dr Baxter was found dead in his workplace.
target: &20 今天早上，巴克斯特博士被发现死在了工作地点。

source: &296 Oh no...oh, Charlie, no...
target: &296 不……查理，千万别是你……

source: &21 I share your concern, Dr Lao.
target: &21 我也和你一样担心，劳博士。

source: &11 Central believes Dr Regis to be the most likely suspect.
target: &11 中枢认为，里吉斯博士是最有可能的嫌疑人。

source: &12 He would have known that Central would be unable to provide oversight during the siege.
target: &12 他应该知道，围城模式启动后，中枢无法实施监控。

source: &22 And he had no shortage of motive, as I'm sure you'd agree.
target: &22 而且，他的动机也足够充分。我相信你也同意。

source: &297 It just doesn't sound like him, though.
target: &297 可这实在不像他会做的事。

source: &298 He had other outlets, like his garden...
target: &298 他有别的排解方式，比如照料花园……

source: &23 I don't fully agree with Central's assessment, either.
target: &23 我也不完全赞同中枢的判断。

source: &24 That is why I'm activating you on this case.
target: &24 所以，我才决定让你接手这个案子。

source: &299 You want me to investigate Baxter's murder, with my partner as the prime suspect?
target: &299 您想让我调查巴克斯特的死，而首要嫌疑人就是我的搭档？

source: &300 Isn't that a pretty serious conflict of interest?
target: &300 这不是很严重的利益冲突吗？

source: &25 It is within my prerogative to select agents I feel appropriate for casework, if necessary.
target: &25 必要时，我有权挑选自己认为适合办案的探员。

source: &26 Using it to aid an old friend, a good man like Charlie Regis...I think that's worthwhile.
target: &26 用这项权力帮一位老朋友，帮查理·里吉斯这样的好人……我觉得值得。

source: &13 Remember that your primary responsibilities are to the law and to the city.
target: &13 别忘了，你首先要对法律和这座城市负责。

source: &301 You're the controller of Central Operations.
target: &301 您主管中枢运营。

source: &302 Why would you need to cut the camera feed with a trick like that?
target: &302 为什么还得耍这种花招，才能切断摄像头的监控？

source: &14 I apologize, but for the sake of city security...
target: &14 抱歉，但出于城市安全的考虑……

source: &303 Yeah, yeah, can't tell me, classified Ultraviolet-A, et cetera.
target: &303 是，是，不能告诉我，机密等级紫外线-A，诸如此类。

source: &27 I'm glad you understand.
target: &27 很高兴你能理解。

source: &304 I might understand, but I'm not happy about it.
target: &304 理解归理解，我可不高兴。

source: &15 Noted, Dr Lao.
target: &15 记下了，劳博士。

source: &305 I think I've heard enough.
target: &305 我想我了解得差不多了。
