source: &28 That's good to hear. I'll have Galatea T-Mail the case data to you.
target: &28 那就好。我会让伽拉忒亚通过迷境邮件，把案件资料发给你。

source: &29 If I can be of any further help, don't hesitate to drop by my office.
target: &29 如果还有需要我帮忙的地方，随时来我办公室。

source: &16 At the top of the Fulcrum Tower. Make an appointment beforehand.
target: &16 在支点大厦顶层。请事先预约。

source: &3 Diagnostic cycle of monitoring systems complete. No wetware or firmware anomalies detected.
target: &3 监控系统诊断完毕。未检测到湿件或固件异常。

source: &4 However, please ask Dr Regis to stop obstructing the lens assembly.
target: &4 不过，请让里吉斯博士停止遮挡镜头组件。

source: &30 I wish you luck with your work, Dr Lao.
target: &30 祝你工作顺利，劳博士。

source: &31 For Regis' sake...
target: &31 为了里吉斯……

source: Autosave
target: 自动存档

source: &306 Looks like a lot of cartridges for the injector.
target: &306 看起来有不少注射器用的药剂筒。

source: &307 Huh...non-binary...a quaternary data-string?
target: &307 嗯……不是二进制……这是四进制的数据串？

source: &1 What do you mean?
target: &1 什么意思？

source: &308 My wetware systems are interpreting the genomes of these plants as sections of an audio file.
target: &308 我的湿件系统把这些植物的基因组，识别成了音频文件的片段。

source: &309 He's used the DNA to store information!
target: &309 他用DNA储存了信息！

source: &2 Hm. You think so?
target: &2 嗯。你这么认为？

source: &310 It's incomplete. The two samples only make up a third of the data.
target: &310 还不完整。这两个样本只占全部数据的三分之一。

source: &311 But M and L, my initials?
target: &311 可是M和L，正好是我名字的首字母？

source: &312 This can't be a coincidence. He's left a message!
target: &312 这不可能是巧合。他留下了一段留言！

source: &3 What does it say?
target: &3 留了什么？

source: &313 Not sure, yet. I could probably construct the whole message, if I can find where he's hidden the rest of it.
target: &313 还不清楚。只要找到他藏起的其余部分，应该就能拼出完整留言。

source: &4 Safe to say, it's in the other plants he's gengineered.
target: &4 想也知道，就藏在他改造过的其他植物里。

source: &5 Here, take this. You can sample DNA from the plants around the lab.
target: &5 来，拿着这个。用它给实验室里的植物采集DNA。

source: &6 If you run out of sampling cartridges, you can reload it at this console.
target: &6 采样筒用完了，可以在这台控制台上补充。

source: &314 Thanks. How long would it take to sample everything in the lab?
target: &314 谢谢。给实验室里所有植物都采样，要多久？

source: &7 Oh, only a couple of years. We have over eleven-thousand subjects.
target: &7 哦，也就两年左右吧。这里有一万一千多个研究对象。

source: &8 You're better off looking for specimens that would fill the gaps in the clue he left.
target: &8 你最好根据他留下的线索，找出能补全空缺的标本。

source: Picked up: DNA Sampler
target: 获得：DNA采样器

source: &9 Make it quick, I'm busy.
target: &9 长话短说，我忙着呢。

source: &315 What's your role here?
target: &315 你在这里负责什么？

source: &10 I'm the supervisor for the telepresence-factoring labs.
target: &10 我主管远程临场代工实验室。

source: &11 Most of it's automatic, I just make sure it's all running like it should.
target: &11 大部分工作都是自动完成的，我只负责确保一切正常运转。

source: &316 Sounds like a big responsibility.
target: &316 听起来责任不小。

source: &12 Hah. It's a lousy job most of the time.
target: &12 哈。大多数时候，这份工作都糟透了。

source: &13 TP is where management sticks people they don't want in public-facing roles.
target: &13 管理层不想让谁去接触公众，就把谁塞进TP部门。

source: &317 You're not happy with it?
target: &317 你不喜欢这份工作？

source: &14 For the last few years, my career has been one disaster after another.
target: &14 过去几年，我的事业接连遭殃。

source: &15 I'm just glad it's plateaued into some kind of stability.
target: &15 能停在这里，多少稳定下来，我已经很庆幸了。

source: &318 Can you tell me what happened?
target: &318 能告诉我发生了什么吗？

source: &16 Baxter got killed.
target: &16 巴克斯特被杀了。

source: &319 ...in any more detail?
target: &319 ……能详细点吗？

source: &17 When we started this afternoon, a whole lotta samples had been tampered with.
target: &17 今天下午开工时，我们发现一大堆样本被动过手脚。

source: &18 We tried to call Baxter to find out what the hell was going on in the specimen bank.
target: &18 我们想联系巴克斯特，问问标本库里到底怎么回事。

source: &320 And he didn't answer?
target: &320 他没回应？

source: &19 He didn't. Turned out the door to the specimen bank was locked, too.
target: &19 没有。后来发现，标本库的门也锁上了。

source: &321 You haven't seen the body?
target: &321 你没见过尸体？

source: &20 Nope, not in person, if that's what you mean.
target: &20 没有。如果你是问有没有亲眼见过的话。

source: &21 We got the camera feed online,
target: &21 我们接通了监控画面，

source: &22 But it was obvious that Baxter wasn't going to be coming out.
target: &22 可很明显，巴克斯特不可能自己走出来了。

source: &322 When did you last see him?
target: &322 你最后一次见到他是什么时候？

source: &23 Hm...guess it could've been...Wednesday?
target: &23 嗯……大概是……星期三？

source: &323 So...he *could* have been killed any time in the past three days?
target: &323 所以……过去三天里的任何时候，他都有可能被杀？

source: &24 Hm...I guess, but it wouldn't fit with everything else.
target: &24 嗯……也许吧，可这样就和其他情况对不上了。

source: &324 What's the purpose of this lab? Plant studies?
target: &324 这间实验室是做什么的？研究植物？

source: &25 Yes and no. It's a TP lab - telepresence.
target: &25 算是，也不全是。这是TP实验室，也就是远程临场实验室。

source: &26 There's a lot of research that's not exactly legal in some countries.
target: &26 很多研究在某些国家并不合法。

source: &325 But in Newton, pretty much anything goes.
target: &325 可在牛顿市，基本上什么都能做。

source: &27 Exactly. If someone in the EU needs research done on something hazardous, infectious or endangered,
target: &27 正是。比如欧盟有人需要研究危险、有传染性或濒危的东西，

source: &28 ...they send the orders here, and we carry out the testing.
target: &28 ……就把要求发过来，由我们进行实验。

source: &326 What sort of research?
target: &326 什么样的研究？

source: &29 Mostly, we make new angiosperms from scratch.
target: &29 我们主要从零开始创造新的被子植物。

source: &30 That's "flowering plants" to you.
target: &30 跟你说白了，就是“开花的植物”。

source: &327 Gee, thanks. Why would people want new flowers?
target: &327 哎呀，谢谢。为什么有人想要新的花？

source: &31 Sometimes, it's a drug delivery method.
target: &31 有时，是为了输送药物。

source: &32 The earliest commercial examples were fruit that grew packed with insulin.
target: &32 最早商业化的例子，是富含胰岛素的水果。

source: &33 A lot of new wetware begins its life as gengineered fruit, too.
target: &33 许多新湿件，一开始也是在基因改造的水果里培育的。

source: &328 Must be awkward if they cross-pollinate in the wild.
target: &328 要是在野外交叉授粉，肯定很麻烦。

source: &34 And a legal headache. Part of our job is making sure the copy-protection works.
target: &34 法律上也很头疼。确保防复制机制有效，也是我们的工作之一。

source: &329 Copy protection in plants? Ouch.
target: &329 植物也要防复制？真够呛。

source: &330 Aside from yourself, who else works in this laboratory?
target: &330 除了你，还有谁在这间实验室工作？

source: &35 There's my intern, Martin Niester. Operates the factoring line.
target: &35 我的实习生，马丁·尼斯特。负责操作代工生产线。

source: &36 If you meet him, it's easy to see why they put him in here.
target: &36 见到他，你就明白为什么要把他安排在这里了。

source: &37 And until recently, there was Dr Baxter.
target: &37 此外，直到不久前，还有巴克斯特博士。

source: &331 Tell me about Mr Niester.
target: &331 跟我说说尼斯特先生吧。

source: &38 He came over from Eurofed on a study program.
target: &38 他参加交流学习项目，从欧洲联邦过来的。

source: &39 He's...well, he's young. I guess we were all like that in our youth.
target: &39 他……唉，还年轻。我想我们年轻时都那样。

source: &332 Good colleague?
target: &332 共事起来怎么样？

source: &40 He's alright. He got on board with that annoying maladist trend.
target: &40 还行。他迷上了那股讨厌的病症主义风潮。

source: &41 He knows how to follow instructions, so I let him get on with it.
target: &41 他知道怎么照指示做事，我也就随他去了。

source: &333 His visa's still active?
target: &333 他的签证还有效？

source: &42 Dr Lao, we do NOT employ undocumented illegals in this lab.
target: &42 劳博士，我们实验室可不会雇用无证的非法移民。

source: &334 Just have to check, I'm sure you understand.
target: &334 只是例行核实，相信你能理解。

source: &335 Tell me about Dr Baxter.
target: &335 跟我说说巴克斯特博士吧。

source: &43 Ugh. He was bad enough to work with in the sixties.
target: &43 唉，六十年代跟他共事，就已经够难受了。

source: &44 As part of his parole, they stuck a governor in his head.
target: &44 假释条件之一，就是在他脑子里植入限制器。

source: &45 Since then it's like talking to a badly-written synthetic.
target: &45 从那以后，跟他说话就像在和一个程序写得很差的合成人聊天。

source: &336 You don't care for him a great deal?
target: &336 你不太喜欢他？

source: &46 That man killed Vicky. Frankly, he deserved what he got.
target: &46 那个人杀了维琪。说实话，他就是活该。

source: &337 But you still work with him?
target: &337 可你还是跟他共事？

source: &47 He worked FOR me. It was another part of his parole.
target: &47 是他在我手下工作。那也是他的假释条件之一。

source: &48 Vickerman's management persuaded Centralized Government that his skills were going to waste in prison.
target: &48 维克曼的管理层说服了中枢政府，认为把他关在监狱里是浪费才能。

source: &49 The company wanted him supervised by someone who knew him - hence, they dragged my sorry ass in.
target: &49 公司想找个认识他的人监督他，所以就把我这个倒霉鬼拖来了。

source: &338 What did you have him doing?
target: &338 你让他做些什么？

source: &50 He organized the specimen bank. It's the kind of thing we could just leave him at for hours on end. Days, sometimes.
target: &50 整理标本库。那种工作，可以让他一连忙上好几个小时。有时是几天。

source: &51 Really, it could just be done by the facility's AI, but I had to give him SOMETHING.
target: &51 其实设施里的AI就能做，可我总得给他找点事。

source: &339 Otherwise you'd have to talk to him?
target: &339 不然就得跟他聊天了？

source: &52 EXACTLY.
&340 You've got a keen mind. What's your take on this?
target: &340 你头脑很敏锐。这件事你怎么看？

source: &53 Hey, I'm not the detective, young lady.
target: &53 嘿，我可不是侦探，年轻人。

source: &54 You know what I think? I think Regis did what they oughta have done twenty years ago.
target: &54 你想知道我的看法？我觉得里吉斯做了他们二十年前就该做的事。

source: &341 Why do you say that?
target: &341 为什么这么说？

source: &55 Seems logical.
target: &55 很合逻辑。

source: &56 We've got him coming into the labs on security, then we've got him coming out an hour later.
target: &56 监控拍到他走进实验室，然后一小时后走了出去。

source: &57 When we get here, we've got Baxter's corpse contaminating the specimen bank.
target: &57 等我们到了这里，巴克斯特的尸体已经把标本库污染了。

source: &58 Well, something strange.
target: &58 嗯，还有件怪事。

source: &59 Since we got in, we keep finding samples that have been tampered with.
target: &59 到这里以后，我们不断发现被人动过手脚的样本。

source: &60 Looks like he spent his hour here messing up the genomes of our specimens.
target: &60 看来，他在这里的那一小时，都用来把我们的标本基因组弄乱了。

source: &342 That quickly?
&61 If anyone was good enough to do it that fast, it'd be Charlie.
target: &61 要说谁有本事这么快做到，那就是查理了。

source: &343 You knew Regis as well?
target: &343 你也认识里吉斯？

source: &62 Yeah, I was on a research team with him and his wife back in the sixties.
target: &62 是啊，六十年代，我和他还有他妻子在同一个研究团队。

source: &63 Baxter too.
target: &63 巴克斯特也在。

source: &344 You've apparently known him a long time. Does this seem like something Regis would do?
target: &344 看来你认识他很久了。这像是里吉斯会做的事吗？

source: &64 Ugh, after what he did to Vicky...I'd have strangled Baxter too.
target: &64 唉，巴克斯特对维琪做了那种事……换我也会掐死他。

source: &65 I tell you, if he did do it, I wouldn't blame him one bit.
target: &65 我跟你说，就算真是他干的，我也一点都不会怪他。

source: &345 Do you think he did it, though?
target: &345 可你认为真是他做的吗？

source: &66 I don't know...he was always kind of shady.
target: &66 不知道……他这个人，一直有点让人摸不透。

source: &346 Tell me about it.
target: &346 可不是嘛。

source: &67 They made him do some...real awful stuff out in the Hotzones.
target: &67 他们曾让他在强辐射区做过一些……非常可怕的事。

source: &347 Such as?
&68 Let's just say his escape led to a whole lot of people being jailed for war crimes.
target: &68 这么说吧，他逃出来以后，很多人因为战争罪进了监狱。

source: &348 You seem preoccupied.
target: &348 你好像一直在忙什么。

source: &69 That obvious, huh?
target: &69 有那么明显啊？

source: &70 We found a couple of specimens that Regis tampered with in his hour here.
target: &70 我们发现了两个标本，是里吉斯在这里的那一小时动过手脚的。

source: &71 So, I gotta run through the catalogue and dig out the backups.
target: &71 所以，我得翻一遍目录，把备份找出来。

source: &349 Sounds straightforward.
target: &349 听着不难。

source: &72 Not when there's eleven-thousand samples to take!
target: &72 要是有一万一千个样本要采，就没那么简单了！

source: &73 I could punch Regis for this.
target: &73 为这事，我真想揍里吉斯一拳。

source: &74 Though I want to shake his hand for Baxter, so it kinda evens out.
target: &74 不过，为了巴克斯特的事，我又想跟他握个手。算是抵消了。

source: &350 What's been done to the samples?
target: &350 样本被怎么改动了？

source: &75 He's used a customized viral vector to add huge amounts of "junk" DNA to their genomes.
target: &75 他用定制的病毒载体，往它们的基因组里加入了大量“垃圾”DNA。

source: &76 These are the last two I found; Medioflorens Interensis, and Linaceae Lawsonis
target: &76 这是我最后找到的两个：Medioflorens Interensis和Linaceae Lawsonis。

source: &351 May I have a look?
target: &351 我能看看吗？

source: &77 Do you think it'll help?
target: &77 你觉得会有帮助？

source: &352 Just a hunch...
target: &352 只是有个直觉……

source: &353 So, how do I build more of the message?
target: &353 那么，怎么拼出更多的留言？

source: &78 You've got to use the sampling tool to get DNA from the plants around the lab.
target: &78 用采样工具，从实验室里的植物上采集DNA。

source: &79 The sampler can take three readings before it needs to be reloaded.
target: &79 采样器每次补充后可以采三次。

source: &80 In some areas of the lab, the atmospheric controls will prevent the reading being taken.
target: &80 实验室有些区域的环境控制系统，会阻止你采集样本。

source: &354 Apparently he wants me to find certain samples.
target: &354 看来，他要我找的是特定的样本。

source: &355 I've got to think about where I'm going to find them.
target: &355 我得想想去哪里找。

source: &81 Darn right. We've got a whole lot of "A" right now.
target: &81 可不是。现在我们这里到处都是“A”。

source: &356 I tried talking to your intern. It wasn't helpful.
target: &356 我试着和你的实习生聊了聊，没什么用。

source: &82 Oh, never mind that, he's got aphasia.
target: &82 哦，别在意，他有失语症。

source: &357 Isn't that treatable?
target: &357 那不能治吗？

source: &83 Oh yes, he just gave it to himself.
target: &83 当然能，他是自己把自己弄成这样的。

source: &84 It's what the kids are into these days.
target: &84 现在的年轻人就爱玩这个。

source: &358 Crippling neurological disorders?
target: &358 严重影响生活的神经疾病？

source: &85 Yes and no. "Maladism", they call it.
target: &85 算是，也不全是。他们叫它“病症主义”。

source: &86 They give themselves old diseases, it only lasts about a week each time.
target: &86 他们让自己体验过去的疾病，每次只持续一周左右。

source: &359 And you let him do that?
target: &359 你就让他这么做？

source: &87 He's not public-facing, and as long as it doesn't get in the way of his work.
target: &87 他又不用接待公众，只要不妨碍工作就行。

source: &88 I figure we all did things the old folks thought were stupid back when we were kids.
target: &88 我想，我们小时候也都做过一些让老人觉得很蠢的事。

source: &360 I need to ask Niester about the tampered specimens.
target: &360 我得问尼斯特，那些被动过手脚的标本是怎么回事。

source: &361 How do I cure his aphasia?
target: &361 怎么治好他的失语症？

source: &89 Well, you wouldn't really CURE it, he doesn't actually have the disease.
target: &89 其实谈不上治好，他并没有真的得病。

source: &90 It's essentially wetware designed to occupy the Wernicke and Broca's regions of the brain.
target: &90 本质上，是用湿件占据大脑的韦尼克区和布罗卡区。

source: &91 This then produces the symptoms of the disease. That's what they're going for.
target: &91 这样就会出现相应的疾病症状。他们要的就是这个。

source: &362 I can't wait a week for the wetware to break down!
target: &362 我可不能等一周，让湿件自行分解！

source: &92 Find a way to break it down early, then.
target: &92 那就想办法让它提前分解。

source: &93 If we've got an emergency contamination, we use Hydroxypyruvate Isomerase.
target: &93 遇到紧急污染，我们会用羟基丙酮酸异构酶。

source: &94 It's an enzyme that instructs the fabricators in wetware to disassemble themselves.
target: &94 这种酶会指示湿件里的制造单元自行解体。

source: &363 I can't get into the airlock.
target: &363 我进不了气闸。

source: &95 The airlock and the growth lab are secure areas.
target: &95 气闸和培养实验室都是管制区域。

source: &96 We grow potentially hazardous organisms beyond those doors.
target: &96 那些门后培育的生物，可能有危险。

source: &364 I'm trying to conduct an investigation, here!
target: &364 我可是在这里调查案件！

source: &365 Don't make me get a warrant from Central.
target: &365 别逼我去找中枢申请搜查令。

source: &97 I'm sorry, Central would likely agree with us.
target: &97 抱歉，中枢多半也会赞同我们的做法。

source: &98 We can't just give anyone access to the growth lab.
target: &98 我们不能随便让人进入培养实验室。

source: &366 Not even a CEL agent?
target: &366 CEL探员也不行？

source: &99 I'd need a pretty damn good reason.
target: &99 那也得有个足够充分的理由。

source: &367 The airlock won't let me take the "O" sample out.
target: &367 气闸不让我把“O”样本带出来。

source: &368 I can't get it out to the sequencer.
target: &368 我没法把它拿到测序仪那里。

source: &100 Oh no...it'll be one of the copyrighted ones.
target: &100 哎呀……那一定是受版权保护的样本。

source: &101 Corporate users of the lab can be rather sensitive.
target: &101 使用这间实验室的企业，对这类事很敏感。

source: &369 But I've got access to the growth lab!
target: &369 可我已经有权进入培养实验室了！

source: &102 But not for taking those samples out, I'm afraid.
target: &102 恐怕，那不包括把那些样本带出来。

source: &103 In this lab, that's restricted to myself, or Martin.
target: &103 在这间实验室里，只有我和马丁有这个权限。

source: &370 Will you remove it for me?
target: &370 那你能帮我带出来吗？

source: &104 Sure, once I'm done with this.
target: &104 当然，等我忙完这个就行。

source: &105 Just give me a few hours.
target: &105 给我几个小时。

source: &371 So, you worked with Regis and his wife, as well as Baxter.
target: &371 所以，你跟里吉斯夫妇，还有巴克斯特都共事过。

source: &372 Did you also work for Dr Vargas?
target: &372 你也在瓦尔加斯博士手下工作过？

source: &106 That pompous ass? Yeah, I worked "for" him.
target: &106 那个自命不凡的混蛋？是啊，我为他“工作”过。

source: &373 You don't care for him?
target: &373 你不喜欢他？

source: &107 He was a competent researcher, but he LIVES for politics.
target: &107 他做研究是有本事，可他满脑子都是政治。

source: &108 Everything was always about making the world a better place.
target: &108 什么事都要扯到让世界变得更美好。

source: &374 And you don't think it should be better?
target: &374 你不觉得世界应该更美好吗？

source: &109 It's a nice idea, just not realistic.
target: &109 想法是不错，只是不现实。

source: &110 And what we ended up making, it was...actually, never mind.
target: &110 而我们最后造出来的，是……算了，当我没说。

source: &375 I got a "growth matrix" out of the specimen bank, but I can't sample any DNA from it.
target: &375 我从标本库拿出了一份“生长基质”，可采不到它的DNA。

source: &111 There isn't any DNA to sample, yet.
target: &111 因为还没有DNA可采。

source: &112 If something's particularly hazardous, we store it as a growth matrix to prevent accidental germination.
target: &112 特别危险的东西，我们会以生长基质的形式保存，免得意外萌发。

source: &376 But it has DNA later?
target: &376 但之后会有DNA？

source: &113 Yeah, a growth matrix uses wetware to construct seeds from scratch, which THEN grow.
target: &113 对。生长基质利用湿件，从零构建种子，然后种子才会生长。

source: &114 Oh God, are you...planning on PLANTING a growth matrix?
target: &114 天啊，你该不会……打算把生长基质种下去吧？

source: &377 Uhh...no...of course not...that would be dangerous, of course...
target: &377 呃……没有……当然不会……那当然很危险……

source: &378 What happens in the specimen bank?
target: &378 标本库是做什么的？

source: &115 It's where the samples of plants and growth matrices are stored.
target: &115 存放植物样本和生长基质的地方。

source: &116 There's a huge library of subjects to work with, natural and man-made.
target: &116 里面有大量可供研究的对象，既有天然的，也有人造的。

source: &379 And that's where Baxter worked?
target: &379 巴克斯特就在那儿工作？

source: &117 Yeah...it's not exactly taxing.
target: &117 是啊……也不怎么费力。

source: &118 I wanted to see what he could do since they put a governor in him.
target: &118 我想看看，植入限制器之后，他还能做些什么。

source: &380 You left him to work alone in there?
target: &380 你就让他一个人在里面工作？

source: &119 I'll be honest, he was not a pleasant man to talk to.
target: &119 说实话，跟他聊天实在不愉快。

source: &381 I wonder why Regis hid a message inside the DNA of these plants.
target: &381 不知道里吉斯为什么要把留言藏在这些植物的DNA里。

source: &121 DNA's been used as a data-storage medium before.
target: &121 以前就有人用DNA储存数据。

source: &122 Rather than on-off binary, DNA would be quaternary bits - adenine, guanine, thymine and cytosine.
target: &122 不同于只有开和关的二进制，DNA是四进制的：腺嘌呤、鸟嘌呤、胸腺嘧啶和胞嘧啶。

source: &123 If he'd just left a message on one of the systems, though - or even on paper...
target: &123 不过，要是他直接把留言放在某个系统里，甚至写在纸上……

source: &382 Then someone could have destroyed or erased it.
target: &382 就可能被人毁掉或抹去。

source: &383 Short of burning down the entire lab, they'd have no way to be sure they'd destroyed a message hidden like this.
target: &383 像这样把留言藏起来，除非烧掉整间实验室，否则没人能确定自己已经把它毁了。

source: &124 Especially since he's scrambled so many of the other samples as camouflage.
target: &124 更何况，他还弄乱了那么多其他样本作为掩护。

source: &384 He needs to make sure it's found - and based on the layout, he wants ME to find it.
target: &384 他必须确保留言被找到。而从安排来看，他希望找到的人是我。

source: &387 Why didn't the facility's CI detect Baxter's vitals suddenly failing?
target: &387 设施里的CI为什么没发现巴克斯特的生命体征突然衰竭？

source: &388 It's a potentially hazardous environment in here.
target: &388 这里可是潜在的危险环境。

source: &138 We were wondering that as well.
target: &138 我们也在想这个问题。

source: &139 This afternoon, we noticed the monitoring systems in the samples lab was in recursion.
target: &139 今天下午，我们发现样本实验室的监控系统陷入了递归循环。

source: &140 All hell broke loose when the CI suddenly realized what had happened.
target: &140 等CI突然发现出了什么事，整个地方顿时乱成了一团。

source: &389 So either you've got a technical fault with the software/wetware interfacing...
target: &389 所以，要么是软件与湿件的接口出了技术故障……

source: &141 Which is unlikely, given how much they cost.
target: &141 考虑到它们的价格，那不太可能。

source: &390 ...or someone breached the security systems to cover Baxter's murder.
target: &390 ……要么是有人侵入了安全系统，掩盖巴克斯特被杀的事。

source: &391 That gives me more hope. Regis would have no idea how to do that.
target: &391 那倒让我多了点希望。里吉斯根本不知道怎么做这种事。

source: &392 What sort of research were you conducting in the sixties?
target: &392 六十年代，你们在做什么研究？

source: &142 You mean with Charlie and his wife?
target: &142 你是说，我和查理夫妇？

source: &143 You might not believe it, but we were the people behind Central.
target: &143 你也许不信，但中枢就是我们造出来的。

source: &393 Central...the city-governing AI, Central?
target: &393 中枢……就是管理这座城市的那个AI，中枢？

source: &144 The same. Newton was looking for a coordinator AI.
target: &144 就是它。牛顿市当时想要一个统筹全市的AI。

source: &145 Vargas put together a team, including the new Mr & Mrs Regis.
target: &145 瓦尔加斯组建了一个团队，其中就有新婚的里吉斯夫妇。

source: &394 Nuke me...Regis never mentioned anything about this!
target: &394 我的天……里吉斯从来没提过这件事！

source: &146 It wasn't a happy memory for him.
target: &146 对他来说，那不是一段愉快的回忆。

source: &147 He left after the...unpleasantness.
target: &147 那场……不幸发生之后，他就走了。

source: &148 We finished the project a few months later.
target: &148 几个月后，我们完成了项目。

source: &395 Huh...might explain why he hates Central's guts.
target: &395 嗯……难怪他那么恨中枢。

source: &149 Is that all?
target: &149 还有事吗？

source: &396 For now.
target: &396 暂时没有。

source: &150 Then if you'll excuse me, I'll get back to work.
target: &150 那失陪了，我得接着干活。

source: &397 Hi there.
&398 My name's Dr Max Lao, I'm a CEL case-specialist.
target: &398 我是麦克斯·劳博士，CEL办案专员。

source: &399 You're not making any sense.
target: &399 我完全听不懂你在说什么。

source: &400 Are you alright?
target: &400 你还好吗？

source: &401 Can I get your name?
target: &401 请问你叫什么名字？

source: &403 What's your role at this facility?
target: &403 你在这里负责什么？

source: &405 What happened here?
target: &405 这里发生了什么事？

source: &407 I give up.
&1 Yeah?
target: &1 什么事？

source: &409 I'm CS-Dr Lao. I've been tasked with this investigation.
target: &409 我是办案专员劳博士，负责调查这起案件。

source: &2 Martin Niester. I've been tasked with the factoring lab.
target: &2 马丁·尼斯特。我负责代工实验室。

source: &410 You work with Dr Chigwa?
target: &410 你和奇格瓦博士共事？

source: &3 I work *for* Chigwa, I'm just the intern.
target: &3 是在奇格瓦手下工作。我只是实习生。

source: &4 Means I get stuck with all the lousy jobs she won't do.
target: &4 所以她不想做的那些烂活，全都归我。

source: &411 I understand, I was an intern once.
target: &411 我理解，我也当过实习生。

source: &5 So what's a CS? You a detective?
target: &5 办案专员？就是侦探吗？

source: &412 "Case-Specialist", so yes, I guess you could say that.
target: &412 就是专门处理案件的。对，你可以这么理解。

source: &6 Cool.
&413 I'd like to hear from you what happened.
target: &413 我想听你说说发生了什么。

source: &7 So, we came in this afternoon for the late shift, right?
target: &7 我们今天下午来上晚班，对吧？

source: &8 I check on the factoring line, and it turns out the specimens are nuked-up.
target: &8 我检查代工生产线，结果发现标本全弄坏了。

source: &414 In what sense?
target: &414 怎么个坏法？

source: &9 They don't match the catalogue anymore, not how they're supposed to be.
target: &9 跟目录对不上了，已经不是原来该有的样子。

source: &10 I figured Baxter nuked it up again, so I checked the feed.
target: &10 我以为巴克斯特又搞砸了，就看了眼监控。

source: &415 That's when you found the body?
target: &415 那时你发现了尸体？

source: &11 Yeah, but Chigwa won't let me get a look.
target: &11 对，可奇格瓦不让我去看。

source: &12 Told me to get back to work while she called CEL.
target: &12 她让我回去干活，自己去联系CEL。

source: &13 Hey, can I get a look at the body with you?
target: &13 嘿，我能跟你一起去看看尸体吗？

source: &416 I'm afraid not. Official procedure, and...stuff.
target: &416 恐怕不行。公务程序，还有……诸如此类的规定。

source: &14 Bummer.
target: &14 真扫兴。

source: &417 Why'd you go and give yourself aphasia?
target: &417 你为什么要让自己得失语症？

source: &15 Not just that, there are loads of syndromes. It's Maladism, man.
target: &15 不只是失语症，还有一大堆别的综合征。这叫病症主义，懂吗。

source: &418 Aren't diseases like that dangerous, though?
target: &418 可那样的疾病，不是很危险吗？

source: &16 It's not permanent, man. We ain't STUPID.
target: &16 又不是永久的。我们又不傻。

source: &17 Wetware nodes in the body create the SYMPTOMS of things we want.
target: &17 身体里的湿件节点，会制造我们想体验的症状。

source: &18 Which you went and broke. Gee, thanks.
target: &18 然后被你给毁了。可真谢谢你啊。

source: &420 In any case, they're temporary, then?
target: &420 所以，无论如何，这些症状都是暂时的？

source: &19 Exactly.
&421 I still don't get it. What's the hook for "Maladism"?
target: &421 我还是不懂。“病症主义”到底有什么吸引力？

source: &20 Man, you old folk never get things like MD.
target: &20 你们这些老人，根本不懂病症主义这种东西。

source: &21 Mosta these syndromes are diseases that are completely curable.
target: &21 这些病，大部分都是能彻底治好的。

source: &22 They just don't happen anymore. Society says "no" to them.
target: &22 只是现在没人得了。社会不允许它们存在。

source: &423 So...it's countercultural? An act of rebellion?
target: &423 所以……是反主流文化？一种反抗？

source: &23 Exactly! Diseases like that make the establishment uncomfortable.
target: &23 没错！这种疾病会让当权者不舒服。

source: &24 They don't want it to be a part of their society.
target: &24 他们不想让它们出现在自己的社会里。

source: &25 But we show them they can't ever get rid of it completely.
target: &25 可我们让他们知道，这东西永远不可能彻底消失。

source: &424 You're rubbing their faces in it, then.
target: &424 所以，你们是在故意给他们难堪。

source: &26 And in another way, it's kinda retro.
target: &26 另一方面，也算是一种复古。

source: &27 Illnesses like that're what shaped society! The Black Death made Europe what it is.
target: &27 社会就是被这些疾病塑造的！没有黑死病，就没有今天的欧洲。

source: &425 Gotta appreciate the classics.
target: &425 经典值得欣赏。

source: &28 For a lot of us, it's also about who's hardest.
target: &28 对我们很多人来说，也是在比谁更能扛。

source: &29 Posers go for little things, like botulism or influenza.
target: &29 装样子的，只敢玩些小病，比如肉毒中毒或流感。

source: &30 But you know someone's got real nodes on them if they can stand a month with HIV.
target: &30 能带着HIV熬一个月的，才算真有种。

source: &426 So, what other diseases have you tried?
target: &426 那你还体验过哪些病？

source: &31 Oh loads of them. Parkinsons, syphillis, tuberculosis...
target: &31 多着呢。帕金森病、梅毒、结核……

source: &32 Last month it was Hansen's disease.
target: &32 上个月是汉森病。

source: &427 Wait, leprosy?
target: &427 等等，麻风病？

source: &33 Yeah, if you're a zift. Hansen's is the real name.
target: &33 老古董才这么叫。汉森病才是正经名字。

source: &428 Sounds like quite a selection.
target: &428 花样还真不少。

source: &34 It's why I came to study in Newton.
target: &34 我就是为这个来牛顿市学习的。

source: &35 Eurofed's just starting to get into MD-culture, even talking about banning it.
target: &35 欧洲联邦才刚开始接触病症主义文化，甚至还在讨论要不要禁。

source: &36 Newton's where it's at for it. You guys are a lot cooler about what you let people do.
target: &36 玩这个，就得来牛顿市。你们这儿允许做的事，可开明多了。

source: &429 On an individual basis, certainly.
target: &429 就个人自由而言，确实如此。

source: &430 That's pretty much the founding philosophy here.
target: &430 这差不多就是这座城市的立城理念。

source: &431 Dr Chigwa tells me that some of the specimens have been tampered.
target: &431 奇格瓦博士说，一些标本被人动过手脚。

source: &37 Oh yeah, I found one of those.
target: &37 哦，是啊，我就发现了一个。

source: &38 Man, couldn't he have just killed the guy WITHOUT messing up my work?
target: &38 那家伙就不能只杀人，别把我的工作也搞乱吗？

source: &432 I need to find it. Which specimen was it?
target: &432 我需要找到它。是哪一个标本？

source: &39 Oh. Uh...Acoraceae Braziliera.
target: &39 哦。呃……Acoraceae Braziliera。

source: &40 When I found it, I just thought Baxter was nuking it up again.
target: &40 发现的时候，我还以为巴克斯特又搞砸了。

source: &433 What did you do with it?
target: &433 你怎么处理它的？

source: &41 I just sent it back to the specimen lab.
target: &41 我直接把它送回了标本实验室。

source: &42 Should be there in the sample store.
target: &42 应该就在那里的样本储藏区。

source: &434 I already found that one.
target: &434 那个我已经找到了。

source: &43 Oh. Well, get off my back, then!
target: &43 哦，那就别烦我了！

source: &435 I need to remove the Orchidaceae Isotria sample from the growth room.
target: &435 我需要把Orchidaceae Isotria的样本带出培养室。

source: &436 Thing is, the airlock told me it was copyrighted, then blasted me with gas.
target: &436 可气闸说它受版权保护，然后朝我喷了气。

source: &44 Yeah, that one belongs to Tiphal, they're waaaay touchy about it.
target: &44 对，那是蒂法尔的。他们对这东西可敏感了。

source: &45 Only lab staff are able to remove it for factoring.
target: &45 只有实验室员工能把它带出来，送去代工。

source: &437 Could you get the sample for me?
target: &437 你能帮我拿到样本吗？

source: &46 Hey, no way man.
target: &46 嘿，想都别想。

source: &47 I'm already on two strikes for taking stuff out of the lab.
target: &47 因为把东西带出实验室，我已经吃过两次警告了。

source: &438 So, you *could*, but you won't?
target: &438 所以，你有权限，只是不肯？

source: &48 Sorry man. Chigwa already thinks I'm stealing stuff.
target: &48 抱歉。奇格瓦已经觉得我在偷东西了。

source: &49 There's a huge street market for things like sparkfruit, or cracked wetware.
target: &49 火花果、破解过的湿件这类东西，在街头可有个庞大的市场。

source: &439 Hey, the pipes in the growth lab are leaking.
target: &439 嘿，培养实验室的管道漏了。

source: &50 Aw, nuke it, again?
target: &50 啊，该死，又来了？

source: &51 Better go fix it before Chigwa starts yelling.
target: &51 得赶紧修，不然奇格瓦又要骂人了。

source: &440 So, you're an intern here? How's that?
target: &440 所以，你在这里实习？感觉怎么样？

source: &52 It sucks. The work's boring, and Chigwa's like Napoleon reborn.
target: &52 糟透了。工作无聊，奇格瓦又像拿破仑转世。

source: &441 And yet you still do it?
target: &441 可你还是做下去了？

source: &53 Yeah, I'm on a gengineering doctoral course at Krakow.
target: &53 是啊，我在克拉科夫读基因工程博士。

source: &54 A year interning in Newton'll put me way ahead.
target: &54 在牛顿市实习一年，能让我领先别人一大截。

source: &55 Plus, nowhere in the world's got an M-D culture like this city.
target: &55 况且，全世界也找不到像这里这样的病症主义文化。

source: &442 What's your personal opinion of Dr Baxter?
target: &442 你个人对巴克斯特博士怎么看？

source: &56 He didn't talk much. One nuked-up guy.
target: &56 他话不多。整个人都不太对劲。

source: &57 Chigwa told me he'd been released from jail?
target: &57 奇格瓦说，他刚从监狱出来？

source: &58 Looked like he had a Governor in his head.
target: &58 看起来，他脑子里装了限制器。

source: &443 That's correct. It affected his behavior?
target: &443 没错。那影响了他的行为？

source: &59 Dude, that's an understatement.
target: &59 何止是影响。

source: &60 That mawkin was like a zombie. One time, I dropped a whole sample-tray in his lab...
target: &60 那家伙简直像个僵尸。有一次，我在他实验室里摔了一整盘样本……

source: &61 Anyone else woulda yelled at me. He started to get mad, then looked just about ready to puke.
target: &61 换谁都会骂我。他刚要发火，看起来就快吐了。

source: &444 The Governor inhibited violent thought. He'd been serving a murder sentence.
target: &444 限制器会抑制暴力念头。他之前服的是谋杀罪的刑。

source: &62 Aw, no way! Who'd he whack?
target: &62 啊，不是吧！他干掉了谁？

source: &445 That's confidential.
target: &445 这属于机密。

source: &63 Man, that's unfair. You're a tease.
target: &63 这不公平。你就吊人胃口吧。

source: &446 What are you making?
target: &446 你在制造什么？

source: &64 The production line? I'm not making them.
target: &64 生产线上的那些？不是我做的。

source: &65 They were assembled in C-Lab, now they're on their way to shipping.
target: &65 它们在C实验室里组装，现在准备发货了。

source: &66 I take random samples to check they're up to spec.
target: &66 我随机取些样本，检查它们是不是符合规格。

source: &447 They're okay?
target: &447 它们都没问题？

source: &67 Mostly. That guy who killed Baxter screwed up a whole lotta specimens.
target: &67 大部分没问题。杀巴克斯特的那家伙，弄坏了好多标本。

source: &68 I have to be way careful on this run.
target: &68 这一批，我得特别小心。

source: &448 How do young people go about getting sick these days?
target: &448 现在的年轻人都是怎么让自己生病的？

source: &69 It's a lot harder, but that shows it's a choice.
target: &69 难多了，不过这也说明是我们自己的选择。

source: &70 We use wetware to create symptoms, like the aphasia.
target: &70 我们用湿件制造症状，比如失语症。

source: &71 The wetware I had for that was programmed to lodge in the Broca and Wernicke regions of the brain.
target: &71 我那个湿件经过编程，会停留在大脑的布罗卡区和韦尼克区。

source: &449 So, it's not REALLY Broca's aphasia...
target: &449 所以，不是真正的布罗卡失语症……

source: &72 Same symptoms, though.
target: &72 症状一样就是了。

source: &450 You'd buy wetware nodes from...shops?
target: &450 这些湿件节点，你们是去……商店买？

source: &73 Nah, find hobby GG-programmers through the trance, they're always looking to sell.
target: &73 不是。在迷境里找基因编程爱好者，他们总想卖点东西。

source: &74 It's like a contest, they're always releasing new syndromes, competing with each other.
target: &74 跟比赛似的，他们不断推出新综合征，互相较劲。

source: &75 You looking to get into it?
target: &75 你也想玩？

source: &451 Not really my scene, thanks.
target: &451 我不太喜欢这套，谢谢。

source: &452 Sorry about sticking you with that injector.
target: &452 抱歉，用注射器扎了你一下。

source: &76 Nuke, yeah! You should be!
target: &76 可不是！你就该道歉！

source: &77 It's dangerous to just dose someone with chems like that!
target: &77 随便给人注射化学药剂，很危险的！

source: &78 What?!
&454 It's funny when the "lab safety" side overrides the "teen rebel" side.
target: &454 挺有意思的。一提实验室安全，你这叛逆少年就像变了个人。

source: &455 What do you think of Dr Chigwa?
target: &455 你觉得奇格瓦博士怎么样？

source: &79 She's a hard-ass, but she knows what she's doing.
target: &79 她是挺凶的，不过她知道自己在做什么。

source: &80 Kinda think she feels wasted working here.
target: &80 我觉得，她有点嫌在这里工作是大材小用。

source: &456 What can you tell me about Dr Baxter?
target: &456 关于巴克斯特博士，你能告诉我些什么？

source: &81 Not much. He only started here a coupla weeks ago.
target: &81 不多。他几周前才来这里。

source: &82 Chigwa dropped him in the specimen lab, and kinda left him here.
target: &82 奇格瓦把他安排在标本实验室，就基本让他一直待在那里了。

source: &457 She neglected him?
target: &457 她不管他？

source: &83 Nah, he just barely left.
target: &83 不是，他自己就很少离开。

source: &84 Coulda been a workaholic, but I think he just couldn't focus on anything else.
target: &84 可能是工作狂，可我觉得，他只是没法把注意力放在别的事上。

source: &458 Did he ever talk about his past with you?
target: &458 他跟你谈过自己的过去吗？

source: &85 Man, he didn't even talk to me period, 'bout anything.
target: &85 他根本就不跟我说话，什么都不说。

source: &459 Remind me, what was that specimen you found?
target: &459 再说一遍，你发现的是哪个标本？

source: &86 Geez, what are you, senile?
target: &86 天啊，你是老糊涂了吗？

source: &87 It was Acoraceae Braziliera.
target: &87 Acoraceae Braziliera。

source: &460 I think there might be a problem in the growth lab...
target: &460 培养实验室可能出了点问题……

source: &461 I kinda...sorta...planted that Xenofungus from the growth matrix.
target: &461 我好像……算是……把生长基质里的异生菌种下去了。

source: &88 Oh, AWESOME. That stuff is hella toxic.
target: &88 哦，太棒了。那东西毒性可强了。

source: &89 Nukes nerve tissue up like nothing else.
target: &89 破坏神经组织，没什么比它更厉害。

source: &462 You sound strangely upbeat about environmental catastrophes.
target: &462 对这种环境灾难，你倒是莫名其妙地乐观。

source: &90 Naw man, it's cool, this shit happens all the time.
target: &90 没事，这算什么。这种事常有。

source: &91 Management gives us time off whenever they run decon.
target: &91 每次清除污染，管理层都会给我们放假。

source: &463 Don't take this the wrong way...
target: &463 别误会我的意思……

source: &464 ...but you don't look like any researcher I've ever seen.
target: &464 ……可你跟我见过的研究员，一点都不像。

source: &92 Well, you don't look like any detective I ever saw.
target: &92 嗯，你跟我见过的侦探也不像。

source: &465 What's that supposed to mean?
target: &465 什么意思？

source: &93 You're way hotter.
target: &93 你性感多了。

source: &467 You aim to make a career out of gengineering?
target: &467 你打算以基因工程为职业？

source: &94 Yeah, I'm going to hook up with a friend in Amsterdam.
target: &94 对，我打算去阿姆斯特丹，跟一个朋友合作。

source: &95 He started a T-Business selling tailored wetware mods,
target: &95 他在迷境做生意，卖定制的湿件改装品，

source: &96 it's gotten so big that he needs a real gengineer for the company.
target: &96 现在生意大到，公司需要一个真正的基因工程师了。

source: &468 Making anything in particular?
target: &468 专门制造哪一类？

source: &97 He mostly does modded wetware for neuro-wiring.
target: &97 他主要做神经线路用的改装湿件。

source: &98 I plan to bring M-D to the Western Eurofed.
target: &98 我计划把病症主义带到欧洲联邦西部。

source: &469 Aside from the wetware-induced illnesses...
target: &469 除了那些由湿件引起的疾病……

source: &470 ...do you have any other bio-modifications?
target: &470 ……你还有其他生物改造吗？

source: &100 Nope. Hundred percent HoSa.
target: &100 没有。百分之百HoSa。

source: &471 HoSa?
target: &471 HoSa？

source: &101 Homo Sapiens. Geez, you old people...
target: &101 智人，Homo Sapiens。唉，你们这些老人……

source: &472 Alright, I'll let you get back to your job.
target: &472 好了，不耽误你工作了。

source: &102 Uh-huh, whatever.
&473 Dr Vargas, I'd like to ask you a few questions, if I may.
target: &473 瓦尔加斯博士，如果可以，我想问您几个问题。

source: &32 Certainly, my dear. Anything I can do to help.
target: &32 当然，亲爱的。能帮得上的，我一定帮。

source: &474 What would you describe your role here as, Dr Vargas?
target: &474 您在这里主要负责什么，瓦尔加斯博士？

source: &17 This is publicly-available information, Dr Lao.
target: &17 这些都是公开信息，劳博士。

source: &33 Now, Galatea, it is a reasonable question.
target: &33 好了，伽拉忒亚，这是个合理的问题。

source: &34 For the past eighteen years, I've held the role of Controller of Centralized Government.
target: &34 过去十八年，我一直担任中枢政府主管。

source: &35 I ensure that Central, our city-governance CI, is functioning within parameters.
target: &35 中枢是负责治理这座城市的CI，我负责确保它在规定范围内正常运行。

source: &475 What would you say your political function within the city is?
target: &475 那么，您在本市承担什么政治职能？

source: &36 None at all.
target: &36 完全没有。

source: &37 The elected Council formulates city policy.
target: &37 城市政策由民选议会制定。

source: &38 It is merely Central's role to execute this, and ensure the day-to-day well being of the city.
target: &38 中枢只负责执行，并保障城市日常运转与民生。

source: &18 And it is fa- Dr Vargas' role to maintain Central's operations.
target: &18 而父——瓦尔加斯博士，负责维持中枢的运作。

source: &19 Surely you're already aware of this, Dr Lao?
target: &19 这些你应该已经知道了吧，劳博士？

source: &476 Just wanted to get it from the source.
target: &476 只是想听本人说一遍。

source: &39 Sometimes, our desire to remain outside the political spectrum has led to rumors.
target: &39 有时候，我们想置身政治之外的愿望，反倒引起了一些传言。

source: &40 We are not, however, the secret puppetmasters behind the government of Newton.
target: &40 不过，牛顿市政府背后的秘密操纵者，并不是我们。

source: &477 I shouldn't count you as my "boss", then?
target: &477 所以，我不该把您当作我的“上司”？

source: &20 Dr Lao!
target: &20 劳博士！

source: &41 Haha, heavens no, my dear. If anything, we are equals on an administrative footing.
target: &41 哈哈，当然不是，亲爱的。真要说的话，我们的行政级别是平等的。

source: &42 Central acts as "director" for both of our operations though.
target: &42 不过，我们两个部门都由中枢担任“主管”。

source: &478 How long have you known Dr Regis?
target: &478 您认识里吉斯博士多久了？

source: &43 Since...mm...2067. He joined a research project of mine.
target: &43 从……嗯……2067年开始。他加入了我的一个研究项目。

source: &44 He was a good man then, very principled.
target: &44 那时他是个好人，很有原则。

source: &479 And now?
&45 I've no doubt goodness remains.
target: &45 我毫不怀疑，他仍然心存善意。

source: &46 Though since joining CEL, I feel that he expresses this solely through his work.
target: &46 不过加入CEL之后，我觉得他只在工作中表现这一点了。

source: &480 Do you know about his garden? On Tier 42 of this building?
target: &480 您知道他的花园吗？就在这栋楼的42层。

source: &47 Ah yes, I've been there myself, a couple of times.
target: &47 啊，知道，我亲自去过几次。

source: &48 Though I hope we can keep that between us, Dr Lao.
target: &48 不过，劳博士，希望这事只限于我们之间。

source: &481 What did you think of it?
target: &481 您觉得怎么样？

source: &49 It is...certainly an interesting way of coping with grief.
target: &49 这……确实是一种有趣的方式，用来排解悲痛。

source: &50 Though that it has lasted so long is perhaps cause for concern.
target: &50 不过，持续了这么久，也许确实让人担忧。

source: &482 What can you tell me about this incident?
target: &482 关于这起事件，您能告诉我什么？

source: &51 Currently, not a great deal. Hence why you have been tasked with this investigation.
target: &51 目前，知道的并不多。所以才派你调查。

source: &52 Dr Baxter has been found murdered in his workplace,
target: &52 巴克斯特博士被发现死于工作地点，遭人谋杀，

source: &53 ...and Dr Regis was caught entering and leaving the facility by their security infrastructure.
target: &53 ……而那里的监控系统拍到了里吉斯博士进出设施的画面。

source: &483 How about a background to the case? A history?
target: &483 案件背景呢？之前发生过些什么？

source: &54 Baxter has been responsible for the murder of Viksha Regis.
target: &54 巴克斯特曾杀害维克莎·里吉斯。

source: &21 Charles Regis' wife.
target: &21 查尔斯·里吉斯的妻子。

source: &55 He was caught and convicted, and until recently had been serving a sentence for the crime.
target: &55 他被捕并被判有罪，直到不久前，都在为此服刑。

source: &484 I'm aware of this so far, yes.
target: &484 是的，这些我已经知道。

source: &56 He had recently been paroled, with the Vickerman corporation as a sponsor.
target: &56 最近，在维克曼公司的担保下，他获准假释。

source: &57 I can only imagine Regis' feelings on the matter...
target: &57 我只能想象，里吉斯对此会是什么心情……

source: &22 Violent, no doubt.
target: &22 肯定很想动手。

source: &58 But I knew Charlie Regis, and I know what kind of man he was.
target: &58 但我认识查理·里吉斯，也知道他是怎样的人。

source: &59 "Justice" is his motivator, but with his background...out in the hotzones...
target: &59 “正义”是他的动力，可考虑到他的经历……在强辐射区的那些经历……

source: &485 You worry that this might have been his idea of justice?
target: &485 您担心，这就是他心目中的正义？

source: &60 Precisely. That, my dear, is why I need you to investigate this case.
target: &60 正是，亲爱的。这就是我需要你调查此案的原因。

source: &61 Before Central jumps to any conclusions to the matter.
target: &61 在中枢贸然下结论之前。

source: &486 You mentioned Regis' wife, Viksha?
target: &486 您提到里吉斯的妻子，维克莎？

source: &62 Ah yes, Vicky. She was a student of mine in the fifties, in Buenos Aires.
target: &62 啊，是的，维琪。五十年代，在布宜诺斯艾利斯，她曾是我的学生。

source: &63 She spent several years working for the UN in hotzones around the world.
target: &63 她曾为联合国工作多年，去过世界各地的强辐射区。

source: &64 When she had finished, she was the natural choice for the project I was just commencing.
target: &64 她结束那份工作时，自然就成了我刚启动的项目的最佳人选。

source: &487 He never really spoke about her.
target: &487 他几乎从不谈她。

source: &65 They were very much in love.
target: &65 他们彼此深爱。

source: &66 It pains me greatly to see a man so afflicted by a loss.
target: &66 看见一个人被失去挚爱的痛苦折磨成这样，让我十分难过。

source: &488 She was a gengineer as well?
target: &488 她也是基因工程师？

source: &67 Yes and no, she specialized in organic computing.
target: &67 算是，也不全是。她专攻有机计算。

source: &68 A field perhaps more closely aligned to your own.
target: &68 这个领域，也许跟你的专业更接近。

source: &489 Though Regis has an obvious motive,
target: &489 虽然里吉斯的动机很明显，

source: &490 ...can you think of anyone else who might have a reason to do this?
target: &490 ……但您能想到，是否还有别人也有理由这样做？

source: &69 I shall be honest, Dr Baxter was not an easy man to work with.
target: &69 坦白说，巴克斯特博士并不是个容易共事的人。

source: &70 There were many who disliked him in his time, though none I knew could call him his "enemy".
target: &70 当年不喜欢他的人很多，不过据我所知，没有谁称得上他的“仇敌”。

source: &491 You mentioned a project that Viksha was recruited for...
target: &491 您说，维克莎是为一个项目招募来的……

source: &23 I'm afraid that's classified.
target: &23 抱歉，那属于机密。

source: &71 Galatea, how can we help if we block every question?
target: &71 伽拉忒亚，每个问题都不许问，我们还怎么帮忙？

source: &72 It was a project that utilized the expertise of both Viksha and Charles.
target: &72 这个项目用到了维克莎和查尔斯两个人的专业知识。

source: &73 Essentially, we were studying organic interfacing in large-scale computing.
target: &73 简单来说，我们在研究大规模计算中的有机接口。

source: &492 Large-scale, as in...city Coordination Intelligences...like Central?
target: &492 大规模，比如……城市统筹智能……中枢这样的？

source: &74 On this matter, I can answer no further.
target: &74 关于这件事，我不能再回答了。

source: &493 What was your opinion of Dr Baxter?
target: &493 您对巴克斯特博士怎么看？

source: &75 As a scientist, twenty years ago he was peerless in his field.
target: &75 作为科学家，二十年前，他在自己的领域无人能及。

source: &494 But as a human being...?
target: &494 可作为一个人呢……？

source: &76 He...did not take refusal well.
target: &76 他……不太能接受被拒绝。

source: &77 This, apparently, is what led to his...breakdown...
target: &77 显然，这导致了他的……崩溃……

source: &495 And the murder that followed that.
target: &495 还有随后的谋杀。

source: &78 Precisely. I have not spoken to him personally since the trial however.
target: &78 正是。不过，自审判之后，我就没有亲自和他说过话。

source: &79 I'm afraid I couldn't enlighten you about his recent state of mind.
target: &79 恐怕，我无法告诉你他最近的心理状态。

source: &496 I examined Dr Baxter's body at the laboratory.
target: &496 我在实验室检查了巴克斯特博士的尸体。

source: &24 What did you find?
target: &24 你发现了什么？

source: &497 He's been decapitated, his head smashed in.
target: &497 他的头被砍下，还被砸烂了。

source: &80 My goodness!
&498 I've taken initial readings, but they're proving inconclusive. Even time of death.
target: &498 初步检测还没有明确结果，连死亡时间也无法确定。

source: &499 The lab's environment is throwing the chromatographs.
target: &499 实验室的环境干扰了色谱检测。

source: &500 Once he's been moved to CEL for autopsy, we should get a clearer picture of what happened.
target: &500 等尸体送到CEL做尸检，应该就能更清楚地知道发生了什么。

source: &501 Dr Chigwa sends her regards.
target: &501 奇格瓦博士向您问好。

source: &81 Ah, how is she? Enjoying her directorship, I trust.
target: &81 啊，她怎么样？想必当主管当得很愉快吧。

source: &502 She hates the job, and regrets everything she's ever done.
target: &502 她讨厌这份工作，而且后悔自己做过的一切。

source: &82 Oh my, such a drastic reaction. Perhaps I shall have a word with the city's labs.
target: &82 哦，反应这么强烈。也许我该跟市里的实验室谈一谈。

source: &25 I'll see if they've anything more to her liking.
target: &25 我看看，有没有更合她心意的职位。

source: &83 It is no coincidence that Baxter was moved under her supervision.
target: &83 巴克斯特被调到她手下，并非巧合。

source: &26 In fact, it was a condition of his parole.
target: &26 事实上，那是他的假释条件之一。

source: &84 Tatsumoto made a good case for employing Baxter for his prodigious talents, in the city's interest.
target: &84 Tatsumoto提出了很有说服力的理由，认为雇用巴克斯特、发挥他的卓越才能，符合城市利益。

source: &85 However, I felt that measures needed to be taken to ensure that he would not offend again.
target: &85 不过，我认为仍需采取措施，确保他不会再次犯罪。

source: &27 Including both supervision, and a neural Governor.
target: &27 包括有人监督，以及植入神经限制器。

source: &28 Tatsumoto knew of Chigwa's history with Baxter.
target: &28 Tatsumoto知道奇格瓦和巴克斯特过去的关系。

source: &86 They assured us her presence would guarantee a close watch be kept on him.
target: &86 他们向我们保证，有她在，就能确保他受到严密监督。

source: &503 Dr Vargas, I really need to ask -
target: &503 瓦尔加斯博士，我实在得问一句——

source: &504 In my office, why DID you cut Central's feed?
target: &504 在我办公室里，您到底为什么切断了中枢的监控？

source: &29 That's classified, Dr Lao.
target: &29 那属于机密，劳博士。

source: &87 I'm afraid I cannot give you a complete answer on that subject.
target: &87 恐怕，这个问题我不能完整回答。

source: &88 ...but a number of factors regarding yesterday's network attack have raised concerns.
target: &88 ……不过，昨天的网络攻击中，有几个因素令我们担忧。

source: &89 Not least, the timing. It may be that Central's administration has been compromised.
target: &89 尤其是时机。中枢的管理系统可能已被入侵。

source: &505 You believe it's linked to Baxter's murder?
target: &505 您认为，这和巴克斯特被杀有关？

source: &30 What makes you say that?
target: &30 你为什么这么说？

source: &506 You cut the camera when talking to me about it.
target: &506 您跟我谈这件事的时候，切断了摄像头。

source: &507 You were concerned that whoever may have compromised Central would find out what we were discussing.
target: &507 您担心，入侵中枢的人会知道我们在谈什么。

source: &90 Hah! Well, I have no fear of the quality of CEL's investigative staff, now.
target: &90 哈！这下，我可不担心CEL调查人员的水平了。

source: &508 I learned from the best.
target: &508 名师出高徒。

source: &509 It's a fantastic view from up here.
target: &509 这里的景色真是绝佳。

source: &91 Isn't it? That's why I choose to work from up here.
target: &91 是吧？所以我才选择在这里办公。

source: &31 The only part higher in Fulcrum Tower is Central's operating center.
target: &31 支点大厦里，唯一比这里更高的就是中枢运行中心。

source: &510 You could probably see all the way to Mombasa on a clear day.
target: &510 天气晴朗的时候，应该能一直看到蒙巴萨。

source: &511 I'm certainly aware of your role in the city, Dr Vargas.
target: &511 瓦尔加斯博士，您在本市的职责，我当然清楚。

source: &512 But who is your lovely assistant?
target: &512 不过，这位可爱的助手是谁？

source: &92 Aha, of course you haven't been properly introduced.
target: &92 啊，对，还没有正式介绍过。

source: &93 This is my daughter, Galatea. She fills the role of my administrative support.
target: &93 这是我的女儿，伽拉忒亚。她负责协助我的行政工作。

source: &32 I'm being groomed for succession, apparently.
target: &32 看来，他们在培养我接班。

source: &94 Oh, don't put it like that. You make it sound so...dynastic.
target: &94 哦，别这么说。你把这事说得好像……世袭似的。

source: &95 That certainly is not what we wish to represent.
target: &95 我们当然不希望给人这样的印象。

source: &513 What was your field, before going into politics?
target: &513 从政之前，您是做什么研究的？

source: &96 I was a computer scientist, and a lecturer at Buenos Aires.
target: &96 我是计算机科学家，也在布宜诺斯艾利斯任教。

source: &97 In the sixties, the government of Newton was looking for research administrators.
target: &97 六十年代，牛顿市政府正在寻找研究管理人员。

source: &98 It eventually transpired that this role, in itself, was a kind of test.
target: &98 后来才发现，这项职务本身，也算是一场考验。

source: &33 The City Council was looking for suitable individuals to manage Newton's new CI.
target: &33 市议会在寻找合适的人，来管理牛顿市的新CI。

source: &514 Central?
&99 Yes and no, it was what eventually BECAME Central.
target: &99 算是，也不全是。那个东西，后来才成为中枢。

source: &515 Dr Vargas, have you heard of mindjacking?
target: &515 瓦尔加斯博士，您听说过意识劫持吗？

source: &34 Excuse me?
&100 I'm afraid I have not, Dr Lao. What is it?
target: &100 恐怕没有，劳博士。那是什么？

source: &516 It's the case Regis and I were working on, lately.
target: &516 就是我和里吉斯最近在调查的案子。

source: &517 A number of individuals had their brains flash-wiped by a destructive copying technique.
target: &517 有人使用破坏性的复制技术，瞬间清空了多名受害者的大脑。

source: &101 That sounds most appalling, Dr Lao.
target: &101 听起来实在骇人，劳博士。

source: &102 Does it pertain to this case?
target: &102 和这起案件有关吗？

source: &518 Not that I'm aware of, sir. It might give someone a reason to frame Regis though.
target: &518 据我所知，没有，先生。不过，这可能给人提供陷害里吉斯的理由。

source: &519 Especially if they thought that we were getting too close.
target: &519 尤其是，如果他们觉得我们已经查得太近了。

source: &103 So...perhaps Regis is a victim of attempted character assassination?
target: &103 所以……也许有人在试图毁掉里吉斯的名声？

source: &104 To use Baxter as a means of doing so would be drastic...
target: &104 为此拿巴克斯特下手，手段未免太极端了……

source: &520 Why don't you believe that Dr Regis is responsible for Baxter's death?
target: &520 您为什么不认为里吉斯博士该对巴克斯特的死负责？

source: &105 I cannot say for certain that he is not, Dr Lao.
target: &105 我无法确定他没有责任，劳博士。

source: &106 I simply hold on to the hope that he is not.
target: &106 我只是仍然希望，他没有。

source: &521 My investigation has brought up an interesting find.
target: &521 调查中，我发现了一件有趣的事。

source: &522 It appears that, while he was at the lab, Regis took the time to alter some of the specimens there.
target: &522 看来，里吉斯在实验室的时候，还抽空改动了那里的一些标本。

source: &107 Really? That is most peculiar.
target: &107 是吗？真是奇怪。

source: &523 Even moreso, he appears to have hidden a quaternary data-string in the genomes of these subjects.
target: &523 更奇怪的是，他似乎在这些研究对象的基因组里，藏了一串四进制数据。

source: &35 What does the data contain?
target: &35 数据里有什么？

source: &524 An audio/visual message, but it's still fragmented.
target: &524 一段视听留言，不过目前还不完整。

source: &525 I believe that Regis was trying to leave a message directed at myself, regarding what happened.
target: &525 我认为，里吉斯想就当时发生的事，给我留一段话。

source: &108 This is a remarkable find, Dr Lao.
target: &108 这是个了不起的发现，劳博士。

source: &109 Please, continue your work. This may clear up what really happened in that laboratory.
target: &109 请继续调查。这也许能弄清，那间实验室里究竟发生了什么。

source: &526 While I was speaking to Dr Chigwa, she told me about Central.
target: &526 和奇格瓦博士交谈时，她告诉了我一些关于中枢的事。

source: &527 Apparently, both Charlie and Viksha Regis were involved in its creation?
target: &527 看来，查理和维克莎·里吉斯都参与了它的创造？

source: &36 Dr Lao, that's classified!
target: &36 劳博士，那属于机密！

source: &110 I believe we can trust her, Galatea.
target: &110 我相信可以信任她，伽拉忒亚。

source: &111 Indeed, I brought Viksha on to the project at its inception.
target: &111 的确，项目刚开始时，我就把维克莎招了进来。

source: &112 She recommended Charlie - they were not married, at this stage.
target: &112 她推荐了查理。当时，他们还没有结婚。

source: &528 This is...unbelievable. He doesn't exactly have a high regard for Central.
target: &528 这真是……难以置信。他可不怎么欣赏中枢。

source: &113 I suppose I can sympathise. It is an unhappy association, for him.
target: &113 我想，我能理解。对他来说，这段联系并不愉快。

source: &114 Yet he will not allow himself the glorious reputation in history he deserves
target: &114 可他始终不肯接受自己应得的历史荣誉，

source: &115 As one of those who created Central, an AI like none before.
target: &115 毕竟，他参与创造了中枢，一个前所未有的AI。

source: &529 Thank you, Dr Vargas. You've been most helpful.
target: &529 谢谢您，瓦尔加斯博士。您帮了大忙。

source: &116 Anything I can do to help.
target: &116 能帮得上的，我一定帮。

source: &1 -arlie, ca - ear me?
&507 Barely.
&508 I can't see you - where are you?
target: &508 我看不见你，你在哪儿？

source: &2 In your head.
target: &2 在你脑子里。

source: &509 What the Hell are you doing in my HEAD?!
target: &509 你在我脑子里搞什么鬼？！

source: &3 That bottle you just drank - it was full of wetware.
target: &3 你刚喝的那瓶东西，里面全是湿件。

source: &4 They were programmed to construct a transceiver in the small bones of your inner-ear.
target: &4 它们经过编程，会在你内耳的小骨头里建造一个收发器。

source: &510 That bottle I drank - that's what did this?
target: &510 是我喝的那瓶东西，把我弄成这样的？

source: &5 Exactly. You ingested a wetware builder-node colony.
target: &5 没错。你吞下了一群湿件构建节点。

source: &511 It's not permanent, is it?
target: &511 不是永久的吧？

source: &6 No, it'll break itself down in a couple of weeks.
target: &6 不是，过两周左右就会自行分解。

source: &7 You have bigger problems at the moment, though.
target: &7 不过，你现在有更大的麻烦。

source: &512 You've apparently found me already.
target: &512 看来你已经找到我了。

source: &513 Why talk to me this way?
target: &513 为什么用这种办法跟我说话？

source: &8 Security - there's a pretty big crisis about to land right on top of you.
target: &8 为了安全。马上就有个大麻烦落到你头上了。

source: &514 My location's been compromised?
target: &514 我的位置暴露了？

source: &9 I'm afraid so. There's a strike team surrounding the building as we speak.
target: &9 恐怕是。就在我们说话的时候，一支突击队正在包围这栋楼。

source: &10 We need to get you out of there.
target: &10 我们得让你逃出去。

source: &11 The sewer access on the factory floor hasn't been secured.
target: &11 工厂车间的下水道入口还没被封住。

source: &12 It's your best chance for an escape route!
target: &12 那是你最有希望的逃生路线！

source: &516 If what you're saying's true, I'm about to be outnumbered and outgunned.
target: &516 如果你说的是真的，我马上就要面对人数和火力都占优势的敌人。

source: &13 Don't worry - you're probably one of the few people I know who's smart enough to get out of something like this.
target: &13 别担心，我认识的人里，有本事从这种局面逃出去的可不多，你就算一个。

source: &517 ...do you know me?
&14 You could say that...come on, get moving!
target: &14 可以这么说……快，动起来！

source: &518 How do I know you're not trying to lead me into a trap?
target: &518 我怎么知道，你不是想把我引进陷阱？

source: &15 Good old Charlie, cynical as usual.
target: &15 还是那个老查理，一如既往地多疑。

source: &16 I obviously know where you are already, don't I?
target: &16 我显然已经知道你在哪儿了，不是吗？

source: &17 I'm on your side, but there's a strike team about to storm the building who aren't.
target: &17 我站在你这边，可那支马上要冲进来的突击队可不是。

source: &519 Damn, they found me?
target: &519 该死，他们找到我了？

source: &520 You still there?
target: &520 你还在吗？

source: &18 I go where you go.
target: &18 你去哪儿，我就去哪儿。

source: &19 Can't get rid of me.
target: &19 甩不掉我的。

source: &20 Need something?
target: &20 需要什么？

source: &21 I hear you.
target: &21 我听着呢。

source: &521 Perhaps it was my mistake first for drinking that bottle,
target: &521 也许，我一开始就不该喝那瓶东西，

source: &522 but how do I know I can trust you?
target: &522 可我怎么知道，自己能不能相信你？

source: &22 It's either me, or the guys with the kill-on-sight order.
target: &22 要么相信我，要么相信那帮接到“发现你就开枪”命令的人。

source: &23 Besides, what sort of person would I be if I didn't help out an old pal?
target: &23 再说，要是连老朋友都不帮，我成什么人了？

source: &523 Do I know you?
target: &523 我认识你？

source: &24 You should. We've spent years working together.
target: &24 应该认识。我们一起工作过好几年。

source: &524 Is this...Lao?
&25 Come on, you've got to get moving!
target: &25 快点，你得行动起来！

source: &525 How did they manage to find me?
target: &525 他们是怎么找到我的？

source: &26 Sorry, I can't help you with that.
target: &26 抱歉，这个我也帮不了你。

source: &27 All I know is, they're after you.
target: &27 我只知道，他们在追你。

source: &526 Did you get my message?
target: &526 你收到我的留言了吗？

source: &28 Message? Nah.
target: &28 留言？没有。

source: &29 I just know the kind of places you like to hide in - but your garden wouldn't do for this one, would it?
target: &29 我只是知道你喜欢躲在哪类地方。这回，你的花园肯定不行，对吧？

source: &30 Match that against which of your favorite spots are being raided by Crisis Teams, and boom!
target: &30 再看看你那些常去的地方里，哪个正被危机小组突袭，就成了！

source: &31 Instant Regis.
target: &31 里吉斯，这不就找到了。

source: &528 So, you haven't heard my side of the Baxter story?
target: &528 所以，巴克斯特的事，你还没听过我的说法？

source: &32 Save it for later. First we've got to get you out of there.
target: &32 留到以后再说。先得让你逃出去。

source: &529 What do you know about this facility?
target: &529 关于这处设施，你知道些什么？

source: &33 Hm...old TVNA factory, used to make synths there.
target: &33 嗯……以前是TVNA的工厂，用来制造合成人。

source: &34 Cleared out when the Aurora hit. Most of that part of town stayed abandoned even to this day.
target: &34 极光事件发生后就撤空了。直到今天，那一带的大部分地方都还荒废着。

source: &35 It's the kind of place low-lifes and thralls hide in.
target: &35 地痞和迷奴就爱躲在这种地方。

source: &530 Anything useful?
target: &530 有什么有用的东西？

source: &36 A lot of the stuff in it's probably been scavenged already, but you might find something useful.
target: &36 里面很多东西，大概早被人捡走了。不过你也许还能找到点有用的。

source: &37 Plus, it's an old building. Be careful, a lot of it is unstable.
target: &37 况且这是座老楼。小心点，很多地方都不稳了。

source: &531 Maybe I can use that to my advantage.
target: &531 也许可以利用这一点。

source: &532 How am I supposed to get past an armed agent I can't even see?
target: &532 一个全副武装的探员，连看都看不见，我怎么绕过去？

source: &38 Bet you wish you had some of that adaptive camouflage too, huh?
target: &38 你肯定也想弄套那种自适应迷彩吧？

source: &533 It has its limits. Only really works in dry conditions.
target: &533 那东西也有限制。只有在干燥环境里才真正有效。

source: &534 Plus, you have to know how to use it properly. It's only the surface pattern that changes.
target: &534 而且，得知道怎么正确使用。变化的只是表面图案。

source: &39 Still pretty neat. Get some of that out, I know a guy who'd give you a couple-thousand $s just for the camoshirt.
target: &39 还是挺厉害的。弄一件出来，我认识个人，光那件迷彩衫就愿意出两千美元左右。

source: &535 How exactly am I supposed to get out of here?
target: &535 我到底该怎么从这里出去？

source: &40 There's an exit to the sewers on the factory floor level.
target: &40 工厂车间那一层，有个通往下水道的出口。

source: &536 What makes you think they haven't blocked that off too?
target: &536 你凭什么觉得，他们没把那里也堵上？

source: &41 This raid was a rush-job. I don't think they've known where you are for very long.
target: &41 这次突袭很仓促。我觉得，他们发现你的位置也没多久。

source: &42 They're gambling that they can eliminate you before you have time to think.
target: &42 他们在赌，能在你来得及思考之前干掉你。

source: &537 I hate to disappoint you, but I'm not exactly prepared either.
target: &537 恐怕要让你失望了，我也没怎么准备。

source: &43 Yeah, but you've got MY help. That puts you kilometres ahead.
target: &43 是啊，可你有我帮忙。光这一点，就能甩开他们几条街。

source: &538 That's one big laser they've got.
target: &538 那台激光器可真大。

source: &44 If it's not on the production line, it was probably just used for protoyping.
target: &44 要是不在生产线上，大概只是用来做原型的。

source: &539 Looks like someone made a real mess with it.
target: &539 看来，有人用它弄得一团糟。

source: &45 Probably didn't have time to fix it before the Aurora hit.
target: &45 大概还没来得及修好，极光事件就发生了。

source: &46 Maybe it'd be useful if you can power it up again?
target: &46 要是能重新通电，也许就能派上用场？

source: &540 Why are the power systems in this place still online?
target: &540 这里的供电系统为什么还在运行？

source: &47 It's only been 11 years since the Aurora.
target: &47 距离极光事件，也才十一年。

source: &48 If nobody's switched it on since then, the City's probably just never noticed they were still connected.
target: &48 要是从那以后就没人开过机，市里大概根本没发现，它们还连在电网上。

source: &541 I guess the factory's standby would be a drop in the ocean in terms of the city's power.
target: &541 工厂的待机耗电，相比整座城市的用电量，大概只是沧海一粟。

source: &49 It's not like they're short on it. Newton's a net exporter in the region.
target: &49 电力又不紧缺。牛顿市在这一带是电力净出口方。

source: &542 I guess you can do that when you're the only one in the neighborhood with orbiting solar arrays.
target: &542 毕竟，这一带就我们有轨道太阳能阵列，做得到也不奇怪。

source: &50 If the factory's still working, you might be able to use that strategically.
target: &50 如果工厂还能运行，你也许可以拿它做点战术上的文章。

source: &543 The manipulator arm won't work.
target: &543 机械臂动不了。

source: &544 It tells me it's locked.
target: &544 它提示已经锁定。

source: &51 What am I, tech support? Hang on a second...
target: &51 我成技术支持了？等一下……

source: &52 Yeah, the system map says its master override is at the end of the production line.
target: &52 对，系统图上显示，生产线尽头有它的主控解锁装置。

source: &545 Now I just need to find that, too.
target: &545 现在我还得把那个也找到。

source: &53 Big double doors on the balcony overlooking the factory floor. Can't miss it.
target: &53 在俯瞰车间的阳台上，有扇大双开门。不会看漏的。

source: &546 You didn't know about the lock on the sewer exit?
target: &546 你不知道下水道出口上了锁？

source: &54 They must have put it in place when they launched the raid.
target: &54 肯定是发动突袭时才装上的。

source: &55 No wonder they've got no patrols in the sewer.
target: &55 难怪下水道里没有巡逻的人。

source: &547 Any ideas on getting it open?
target: &547 怎么把它弄开，有什么主意吗？

source: &56 For a lock that big, you're going to need something industrial-scale.
target: &56 那么大的锁，得用工业级的东西对付。

source: &548 I'm still a little worried about what I drank.
target: &548 喝下去的东西，还是有点让我担心。

source: &57 It won't do you any harm. It's just a constructor node.
target: &57 不会伤害你，只是个构建节点。

source: &549 Yeah, but thousands of molecule-sized machines building a radio in my head...
target: &549 是，可几千个分子大小的机器，在我脑子里造收音机……

source: &550 That'd bother any sane man.
target: &550 正常人都会介意。

source: &58 If you'd gone and gotten yourself wired years ago, we wouldn't have to do this.
target: &58 要是你几年前就装了神经接口，我们也不必这么做。

source: &59 Plus, this is more secure. We're operating on a bespoke fractal encoding.
target: &59 况且，这样更安全。我们用的是定制的分形编码。

source: &551 These armed men...
target: &551 那些武装人员……

source: &60 It must be difficult, having to escape your own colleagues from CEL.
target: &60 要躲开CEL里自己的同事，肯定不好受。

source: &552 That's the thing - they're NOT CEL Crisis Team agents.
target: &552 问题就在这里，他们根本不是CEL危机小组的探员。

source: &553 They're equipped and armed like them, but they're not the real deal.
target: &553 装备和武器都像，可他们不是正牌的。

source: &61 How can you be sure?
target: &61 你怎么能确定？

source: &554 Central has other means of handling the possibility of rogue agents.
target: &554 要处理可能叛变的探员，中枢另有办法。

source: &555 Its actions are...precise, surgical, even if not what we'd normally think of as 'moral'.
target: &555 它的行动……很精准，像外科手术一样，即使通常不符合我们所谓的“道德”。

source: &556 This whole thing is like a blunt instrument. A sledgehammer for a wasp.
target: &556 可这整件事，像是在用蛮力。拿大锤砸黄蜂。

source: &62 Okay, so you don't think it's Central, but why aren't these men CEL?
target: &62 好吧，你觉得不是中枢干的，可为什么说这些人不是CEL？

source: &557 If they were, this operation would have been a whole lot better planned.
target: &557 真是他们，这次行动肯定会计划得周全得多。

source: &558 There'd be a isomap of the building, they'd know exactly where I was to begin with.
target: &558 他们会有这栋楼的等距地图，一开始就知道我具体在哪儿。

source: &559 These guys can handle a weapon, but they're just geared up like a Crisis Team.
target: &559 这些人会用武器，但只有装备像危机小组。

source: &63 Hm...that's an interesting theory. I'll check some leads on that.
target: &63 嗯……这个推断很有意思。我去查查相关线索。

source: &560 Plus, if they WERE CEL, I'd have a much harder time doing what I need to escape...
target: &560 再说，真要是CEL，我想做那些逃生所必需的事，也会困难得多……

source: &561 Jesus, there's so much graffiti in here.
target: &561 天哪，这里怎么有这么多涂鸦。

source: &64 A decade of kids breaking in, or just hacking maintenance drones to make their art for them.
target: &64 十年来，孩子们不断闯进来，或是干脆黑进维修无人机，让它们替自己画。

source: &65 Even so, you have more important things to worry about - like not being killed.
target: &65 不过，你有更重要的事要操心，比如别被杀了。

source: &562 I know, but still...
target: &562 我知道，可还是……

source: &66 It's a real insight into how your mind works, Regis.
target: &66 里吉斯，你的脑子怎么想的，这下可看出来了。

source: &563 Kind of gives you an appreciation of the clean bits.
target: &563 这么一看，反倒能体会到干净地方的好。

source: &564 Sure, sometimes they feel sterile, but this...
target: &564 是，有时干净得像没了生气，可这里……

source: &67 Some people would say it's more "free".
target: &67 有些人会说，这样更“自由”。

source: &565 I just think it's a mess. It was like this last time I was here too.
target: &565 我只觉得乱。上次来这里，也是这副样子。

source: &566 We caught a hacker who kept rewriting adverts around the city.
target: &566 我们抓到一个黑客，他一直在篡改全城的广告。

source: &68 You'd better get moving, or a patrol might catch you.
target: &68 你最好赶紧走，不然巡逻的人可能会发现你。

source: &568 Right, right...
&5102 Regis!
&569 It's good to see you in the flesh as well, Lao.
target: &569 当面见到你，感觉也不错，劳。

source: &530 What do you mean, "in the flesh"?
target: &530 什么叫“当面”？

source: &570 ...you weren't the one sending messages through a transceiver in my head?
target: &570 ……不是你通过我脑子里的收发器，给我传话的？

source: &69 No, she wasn't.
target: &69 不是她。

source: &531 No, I wasn't.
&70 You thought I was HER?
target: &70 你以为我是她？

source: &571 Well, it seemed like that.
target: &571 嗯，听起来像是。

source: &532 Seemed like what? Who are you talking to?
target: &532 听起来像是什么？你在跟谁说话？

source: &572 I...never mind.
&573 You found my message in the DNA?
target: &573 你找到了我藏在DNA里的留言？

source: &533 Eventually. You could have been a little less abstruse.
target: &533 总算找到了。你本可以少绕些弯子的。

source: &574 I had to make sure you'd be the one to find it.
target: &574 我得确保找到它的人是你。

source: &575 Plus, if someone else did manage to get into it...
target: &575 而且，万一别人也找到了……

source: &534 They'd probably think you meant to meet up where our first CASE was...
target: &534 他们大概会以为，你要在我们第一次办案的地方碰面……

source: &535 ...rather than where you CAUGHT me the first time.
target: &535 ……而不是你第一次抓到我的地方。

source: &576 Looks like they found me anyway.
target: &576 看来，他们还是找到我了。

source: &71 There's why, looks like she's downloaded an interceptor.
target: &71 原因就在这里。看来，她下载了一个窃听程序。

source: &72 Even *I* can see the signal coming off it.
target: &72 连我都能看见它发出的信号。

source: &577 Uh...Max, the voices say you've been bugged.
target: &577 呃……麦克斯，那个声音说，你被窃听了。

source: &536 What?! Wait a second...
&537 Ah, nuke - an interceptor!
target: &537 啊，该死，是窃听程序！

source: &538 So...you've been getting help from "the voices"?
target: &538 所以……一直是“那些声音”在帮你？

source: &539 Isn't that usually a sign of stress?
target: &539 这通常不是压力过大的征兆吗？

source: &578 Hah. It's someone communicating by radio.
target: &578 哈。是有人用无线电跟我通信。

source: &579 Someone who knows me, apparently. But if it wasn't you...
target: &579 看来，那人认识我。不过，要是不是你……

source: &540 Definitely wasn't. I just found the message you left in the DNA.
target: &540 肯定不是我。我只是找到了你留在DNA里的话。

source: &73 Don't worry, I'm someone you can trust.
target: &73 别担心，我是你可以信任的人。

source: &74 Not so sure about her, though - there's an interceptor riding her wiring.
target: &74 不过，她就不好说了，她的神经线路里藏着个窃听程序。

source: &75 They probably found out where you were as soon as she did.
target: &75 她一找到你，他们大概也就知道你在哪儿了。

source: &580 Can you disable it?
target: &580 你能把它停掉吗？

source: &541 Easily, now that I know it's there.
target: &541 知道它在，就很容易。

source: &543 Okay, it's isolated.
target: &543 好了，已经隔离了。

source: &76 I can confirm that. They won't be tracking her any further.
target: &76 我可以确认。他们没法再追踪她了。

source: &544 I've no idea when it started riding me.
target: &544 我都不知道，它什么时候潜进我身上的。

source: &545 Must have been while I was investigating the...uhm...
target: &545 肯定是在我调查那起……呃……

source: &546 ...the...murder...at the plant lab.
target: &546 ……那起……植物实验室的谋杀案时。

source: &581 Any idea where you picked it up?
target: &581 知道在哪儿被植入的吗？

source: &547 It would have needed to get past both my checks, and Central's.
target: &547 它得同时绕过我和中枢的检查才行。

source: &548 Whoever did this knew what they were doing.
target: &548 做这事的人，知道自己在干什么。

source: &582 Or had access to Central's permissions database.
target: &582 或者，他能访问中枢的权限数据库。

source: &583 Is it still a threat?
target: &583 它现在还会构成威胁吗？

source: &549 No, they wouldn't have gotten anything while I've been in the sewer.
target: &549 不会。我在下水道里的这段时间，他们也收不到任何东西。

source: &550 There isn't any signal down here.
target: &550 这里没有信号。

source: &77 The interceptor isn't broadcasting any more.
target: &77 窃听程序已经不再发送信号了。

source: &584 You've fixed it?
target: &584 你解决了？

source: &551 Yeah, it's been isolated.
target: &551 对，已经隔离了。

source: &585 It wasn't me, Max.
target: &585 不是我干的，麦克斯。

source: &552 I know, Regis. I didn't think it was, but...
target: &552 我知道，里吉斯。我也不觉得是你，可……

source: &553 You're the only person I can think of who would have wanted him dead.
target: &553 我能想到想让他死的人，只有你。

source: &554 And frankly, I don't think anyone would've blamed you after what he did!
target: &554 说实话，他做了那种事，就算你动手了，也没人会怪你！

source: &555 But after what you tried to do with the bomber, last night...
target: &555 可昨晚，你对那个炸弹客……

source: &587 What about it?
&556 You tried to save his life.
target: &556 你试着救他的命。

source: &557 Even though he'd come here, intending to murder as many as he could!
target: &557 尽管他来到这里，就是为了尽可能多杀些人！

source: &588 It was the right thing to do...
target: &588 那是我应该做的……

source: &558 I've worked with you long enough to know how you work, Regis.
target: &558 我跟你共事这么久，知道你的做事方式，里吉斯。

source: &559 What Baxter did didn't drive you to revenge.
target: &559 巴克斯特做的事，并没有让你走向复仇。

source: &560 It's motivated you to try and make the world a better place.
target: &560 反而让你努力把世界变得更好。

source: &561 I know that taking a life isn't easy.
target: &561 我知道，夺走一条命并不容易。

source: &562 After all, I...put down the bomber last night.
target: &562 毕竟，昨晚我……击毙了那个炸弹客。

source: &589 Max, I'd ordered you to, Central had ordered you to...
target: &589 麦克斯，是我命令你，中枢也命令了你……

source: &563 And I knew he was out to bring death to the city.
target: &563 而且，我知道他就是想给这座城市带来死亡。

source: &564 But still, it wasn't easy. There's no way to fix ending a life.
target: &564 可即使这样，也不容易。结束一条生命，就再也没法挽回。

source: &565 I KNOW you Regis, and I know that's how you think too.
target: &565 我了解你，里吉斯。我知道，你也是这么想的。

source: &566 You wouldn't have killed him. I'm certain.
target: &566 你不会杀他。我很确定。

source: &567 I don't think you killed him, but he IS affecting you.
target: &567 我不觉得是你杀了他，可他确实影响着你。

source: &568 His parole...it really got to you.
target: &568 他的假释……对你的打击真的很大。

source: &569 You've been so reckless with your safety, your life.
target: &569 你对自己的安全、自己的命，实在太不当回事了。

source: &570 The way you handled the bomber...it was like...
target: &570 你对付炸弹客的方式……就像……

source: &590 Like what?
target: &590 比如什么？

source: &571 Like you were trying to provoke him. Like you wanted to go out in a blaze of glory.
target: &571 就像在故意激怒他。像是想轰轰烈烈地死一回。

source: &591 I...don't think...
&573 I don't think you'd have taken it out on Baxter.
target: &573 我不觉得，你会拿巴克斯特出气。

source: &574 If you took it out on anyone, it would be yourself.
target: &574 真要拿谁出气，那也是你自己。

source: &592 Be honest, Max. Do you think I did it?
target: &592 跟我说实话，麦克斯。你觉得是我干的吗？

source: &575 Regis, I'm not the one you need to...
target: &575 里吉斯，你真正该问的人不是……

source: &593 Do you think I did it?!
target: &593 你觉得是我干的吗？！

source: &576 If I didn't know you like I did, I might.
target: &576 要不是这么了解你，我也许会这么想。

source: &577 After what Baxter did, nobody would blame you. Except Central.
target: &577 巴克斯特做了那种事，没人会怪你。除了中枢。

source: &594 Thank you for your opinion, Max.
target: &594 谢谢你，麦克斯。

source: &595 You're probably thinking more clearly than I am right now.
target: &595 你现在大概比我清醒。

source: &596 What do you think we ought to do next?
target: &596 接下来，你觉得我们该怎么办？

source: &578 I guess "turn yourself in" isn't an option?
target: &578 看来，“去自首”不是个可选的办法？

source: &579 Well, we need to see if we can find out who really DID kill Baxter.
target: &579 那我们得设法找出，到底是谁杀了巴克斯特。

source: &598 And why they've sent a strike team to hunt me down.
target: &598 还有，为什么派突击队来追杀我。

source: &78 If I might interrupt your happy reunion, I believe I may be able to help.
target: &78 打断一下你们这场愉快的重逢，我想，我也许能帮忙。

source: &599 You can? How?
target: &599 你能？怎么帮？

source: &580 The voices again?
target: &580 又是那些声音？

source: &79 My organization is aware of links between this attack, and Dr Baxter's murder.
target: &79 我的组织已经知道，这次袭击和巴克斯特博士被杀之间，有着某些联系。

source: &600 What?! How?
target: &600 什么？！怎么回事？

source: &80 I believe we must discuss this somewhere more secure.
target: &80 我想，我们必须找个更安全的地方谈。

source: &81 1181 Shenley Boulevard, Southeast Network. 16th floor. Come around the back.
target: &81 东南网络区，申利大道1181号，16楼。从后面绕过来。

source: &601 Hey, mysterious voice.
target: &601 嘿，神秘的声音。

source: &602 Any thoughts on our next plans?
target: &602 接下来有什么建议？

source: &82 So glad to hear my input is appreciated.
target: &82 很高兴，你们还看重我的意见。

source: &603 You seem to know a lot more about what's happening than I do right now.
target: &603 眼下发生了什么，你好像比我清楚得多。

source: &83 Very astute.
target: &83 很敏锐。

source: &604 Wait, how do we know we aren't just walking into an ambush?
target: &604 等等，我们怎么知道，自己不是在往埋伏里走？

source: &605 Can we trust you?
target: &605 能相信你吗？

source: &84 Well, Charlie, I *have* just saved your life.
target: &84 查理，我才刚救了你的命。

source: &85 Plus, we have information to put you on the right track.
target: &85 况且，我们有线索，能让你们找对方向。

source: &606 Alright. We'll come.
target: &606 好，我们会去。

source: &86 Leave Dr Lao. Come alone.
target: &86 留下劳博士，你一个人来。

source: &87 Pardon?
&607 Lao comes too. She's the only one I know I can trust right now.
target: &607 劳也得去。现在，只有她是我确定能信任的人。

source: &88 Hm...very well. See you soon, Charlie.
target: &88 嗯……好吧。一会儿见，查理。

source: &608 We need to find out what's going on. You seem to have a better picture than us.
target: &608 我们得弄清楚到底怎么回事。你看起来比我们更了解情况。

source: &609 And I guess you've been looking out for me so far.
target: &609 而且，到目前为止，你好像一直在照应我。

source: &610 You say I know you?
target: &610 你说我认识你？

source: &89 And I, you, Charlie.
target: &89 而我也认识你，查理。

source: &1 Hey!
&2 No entry.
target: &2 不准进。

source: &86 Excuse me? I'm trying to get into the Trance den.
target: &86 什么？我想进迷境馆。

source: &3 And *I'm* stopping you.
target: &3 我就是在拦你。

source: &87 What!? Why?
target: &87 什么！？为什么？

source: &4 Maybe I don't like the look of you. Maybe we're full.
target: &4 也许我看你不顺眼，也许里面满了。

source: &5 Either way, shove off.
target: &5 反正，你走吧。

source: &88 Come on, there must be something I can do to get in.
target: &88 拜托，肯定有什么办法能让我进去。

source: &89 What do I need to do?
target: &89 我该做什么？

source: &6 Hah. We get that a lot.
target: &6 哈，这话我们常听。

source: &7 Some thrall drags themself up here, says they'll do *anything*.
target: &7 总有迷奴拖着身子爬过来，说自己什么都肯做。

source: &8 Shows how desperate you people are.
target: &8 你们有多饥渴，这就看出来了。

source: &90 Can I pay to get in?
target: &90 能付钱进去吗？

source: &9 I dunno.
target: &9 不知道。

source: &10 CAN you pay to get in?
target: &10 你付得起吗？

source: &11 Exactly. You wouldn't be dressed up in sconto-blue overalls if you could.
target: &11 就是啊。真付得起，你也不会穿着那身救济蓝连体服了。

source: &12 You ain't even got SHOES.
target: &12 你连鞋都没有。

source: &92 Maybe I could do something for you...?
target: &92 也许，我能帮你做点什么……？

source: &13 Hah. I like 'em skinny, but you look like you'd break a bone if someone LOOKED at you too hard.
target: &13 哈。我是喜欢瘦的，可你这样，别人多看两眼，都像是要断根骨头。

source: &14 You wouldn't believe how many greasy thralls try to get in that way, though.
target: &14 不过，想靠这招进去的脏兮兮迷奴，多得你都不敢信。

source: &93 I...what? No! Ew, no! I meant hacking!
target: &93 我……什么？不！恶心，才不是！我说的是黑进系统！

source: &15 Hm...city utilities *did* cut the water again.
target: &15 嗯……市政公用部门还真又把水停了。

source: &94 What happened to the water?
target: &94 供水怎么了？

source: &16 Bills weren't being paid.
target: &16 水费没交。

source: &17 I needed all my quanta to pay off the bookies after Pakistan lost last month's game.
target: &17 上个月巴基斯坦输了比赛，我的量子币全拿去还庄家了。

source: &95 Gambling debts?
&18 Hey, like you're in a position to judge anyone, *thrall*.
target: &18 嘿，说得好像你有资格评判别人似的，迷奴。

source: &19 Anyway, Central Utilities shut down the water. Now we can't grow any more wetware.
target: &19 总之，中枢公用部门停了水。现在我们没法再培育湿件了。

source: &96 What do you want me to do about the water supply?
target: &96 供水的事，你想让我怎么办？

source: &97 I'm a hacker, not a plumber.
target: &97 我是黑客，又不是水管工。

source: &20 The flow's controlled by a terminal in the sewer.
target: &20 水流由下水道里的一台终端控制。

source: &21 I want you to breach it, and get my water back.
target: &21 我要你黑进去，让我的水重新流起来。

source: &98 This place looks like a dump.
target: &98 这地方看起来真破。

source: &22 You're one to talk, girl. Bet yours is worse.
target: &22 姑娘，你还好意思说。我打赌你家更破。

source: &99 Uh...so, what happens here?
target: &99 呃……这里是做什么的？

source: &23 It's a Trance den. People come here to hook up.
target: &23 迷境馆。大家来这里接入迷境。

source: &100 I always do it at home...did do it at home...
target: &100 我一直在家里……以前一直在家里……

source: &24 People can't always do it there, though.
target: &24 可不是每个人都能在家里进。

source: &25 Maybe their partner don't want them doing it no more.
target: &25 也许，另一半不想让他再这么干。

source: &26 Maybe they're some thrall who promised their probation officer they'd stay clean.
target: &26 也许，某个迷奴答应了缓刑监督员，不会再沉迷。

source: &101 So, you're selling privacy?
target: &101 所以，你卖的是隐私？

source: &27 Bingo.
target: &27 答对了。

source: &28 It don't need to be pretty. Once you're in the machine, you don't care 'bout how it looks.
target: &28 不需要多漂亮。连进机器之后，谁还在乎外面长什么样。

source: &102 What's with your arm?
target: &102 你的手臂是怎么回事？

source: &103 It's all...metal...
&29 Lost it in the war. One of the wars, on biochem duty.
target: &29 战争里丢的。某场战争，执行生化任务的时候。

source: &30 Turned out that 'cause of the shots they gave me, they couldn't just grow me a new one.
target: &30 结果，就因为他们给我打过那些针，没法直接给我长出一条新的。

source: &31 Same reason I can't get wired, either. Allergic to the stuff.
target: &31 我不能装神经接口，也是同一个原因。对那玩意儿过敏。

source: &104 But you run a Trance den?
target: &104 可你开的却是迷境馆？

source: &32 Ain't that just the definition of irony?
target: &32 这不就叫讽刺吗？

source: &33 The arm's great, but the eyes they gave me ain't worth shit.
target: &33 手臂是挺好，可他们给的眼睛根本就是垃圾。

source: &105 Come on, man. I need to get back in the Trance!
target: &105 拜托，我得回迷境！

source: &106 It's important!
target: &106 这很重要！

source: &34 That didn't work for the half-dozen other thralls who've tried it today.
target: &34 今天已经有六个迷奴试过这招了，都没用。

source: &35 It sure ain't gonna work for you.
target: &35 你也别指望会有用。

source: &107 There's supposed to be a public terminal on the corner over there.
target: &107 那边街角，原本应该有台公共终端的。

source: &108 I guess because of all the wires running from where it used to be into the cellar...
target: &108 不过，原来放终端的地方，接出一堆线通进地下室……

source: &36 ...you reckon I know something about it?
target: &36 ……所以，你觉得我知道点什么？

source: &37 You think maybe I stole the terminal, and am now using it to run a pirated Trance environment for profit?
target: &37 你觉得，我偷了终端，现在用它经营盗版迷境环境挣钱？

source: &109 Uh...maybe?
&38 Hah. You're pretty sharp.
target: &38 哈。你挺机灵。

source: &110 You're not very nice.
target: &110 你真不友善。

source: &39 Don't need to be, not to thralls.
target: &39 不需要，尤其是对迷奴。

source: &40 They'll keep coming back anyway.
target: &40 反正他们还会再来。

source: &111 That's quite an assumption.
target: &111 你倒是挺自信。

source: &41 You sure ain't proving me wrong.
target: &41 你可没证明我说错了。

source: &112 So, you're not wired? You can't connect?
target: &112 所以，你没装神经接口？连不上？

source: &42 Nope. Been allergic to neural wiring since the war.
target: &42 连不上。从打仗那会儿，就对神经接口过敏了。

source: &113 This seems like a strange thing to be doing then, running a Trance den.
target: &113 那你开迷境馆，还真是奇怪。
