source: &114 You can't even experience the world you've built for these people!
target: &114 你给这些人搭的世界，自己却连体验都做不到！

source: &43 Means I can't get addicted to it, either.
target: &43 也就意味着，我不会上瘾。

source: &44 Best kind of insurance.
target: &44 最好的保险。

source: &115 What was it you wanted me to do, again?
target: &115 你想让我做什么来着？

source: &45 All that trancing fry your memory?
target: &45 泡迷境把你的记忆都烧坏了？

source: &46 Find the city utilities terminal in the sewer, and get my water running again.
target: &46 找到下水道里的市政公用终端，让我的水重新通上。

source: &116 Oh, yeah. I remember.
target: &116 哦，对。想起来了。

source: &47 Go on, get moving!
target: &47 快去，别磨蹭！

source: &117 Why don't you hack the water yourself?
target: &117 你为什么不自己黑进供水系统？

source: &118 You haven't got my skills?
target: &118 没我这么有本事？

source: &48 You think a lot of yourself, don'tcha?
target: &48 你还挺看得起自己，是吧？

source: &49 I ain't wired. Can't breach systems like that on the go.
target: &49 我没装神经接口，不能走到哪儿都直接侵入那种系统。

source: &119 Ah, that makes sense.
target: &119 啊，有道理。

source: &50 Also, means I got deniability if they just catch some thrall messing around with it.
target: &50 再说，他们要是只逮到一个迷奴在那儿乱搞，我就能撇清关系了。

source: &51 "No officer, I didn't have nothin' to do with it."
target: &51 “没有，警官。我跟这事一点关系都没有。”

source: &120 Hmph.
&121 What's with the antenna?
target: &121 那个天线是怎么回事？

source: &122 The one under the neon lights.
target: &122 就是霓虹灯下面那个。

source: &52 Not everyone here's a local.
target: &52 这里可不全是本地人。

source: &53 Some people ain't lucky enough to live in a city like Newton.
target: &53 不是谁都有运气，住在牛顿市这样的地方。

source: &123 International connections?
target: &123 国际连接？

source: &54 Exactly. People in Newton can join this hub through the net.
target: &54 没错。牛顿市的人可以通过网络，连进这个枢纽。

source: &55 Some states, they monitor the usual net connections.
target: &55 有些国家会监控普通的网络连接。

source: &56 So, they bounce their connection in via satellite.
target: &56 所以，他们就借卫星绕过来。

source: &124 What are other countries monitoring for?
target: &124 别的国家都在监控什么？

source: &57 Greater Han likes to control the news and history.
target: &57 大汉喜欢控制新闻和历史。

source: &58 Concord is looking for anti-corporate opinion.
target: &58 康科德在查反企业的言论。

source: &59 Eurofed has strict definitions about what counts as "acceptable" entertainment.
target: &59 欧洲联邦严格规定了，什么才算“可接受”的娱乐。

source: &125 That's...barbaric...
target: &125 那也……太野蛮了……

source: &60 Defeats the point of the net, doesn't it?
target: &60 网络存在的意义，不就被毁了吗？

source: &61 But thanks to pirate net, they can never stop the signal.
target: &61 不过，多亏了地下网络，他们永远封不住信号。

source: &126 Who's that man with the beard?
target: &126 那个留胡子的男人是谁？

source: &62 Oh man, I can't catch a break.
target: &62 唉，就不能让我消停点。

source: &63 That guy comes around here, yelling about repenting, and Jesus...
target: &63 那家伙老来这里，嚷着什么悔改、耶稣……

source: &64 He's scaring away my customers!
target: &64 他把我的客人都吓跑了！

source: &127 Can't you get rid of him?
target: &127 不能把他赶走吗？

source: &65 What am I gonna do, call CEL?
target: &65 怎么赶？找CEL来？

source: &66 If I leave the door, some thrall's gonna sneak in.
target: &66 我一离开门口，就有迷奴会偷偷溜进去。

source: &67 Quit hangin' around.
target: &67 别在这儿磨蹭。

source: &128 Alright, alright, I'm going...
target: &128 好，好，我这就走……

source: &1 Evening.
target: &1 晚上好。

source: &160 Something bothering you?
target: &160 有什么烦心事？

source: &2 That obvious, huh?
target: &2 有那么明显吗？

source: &161 I can see it right through the Trance. What's up?
target: &161 隔着迷境都看得出来。怎么了？

source: &3 Well, I gotta come out to these dens to Trance, right?
target: &3 嗯，我得出来，到这种迷境馆才能接入，对吧？

source: &4 Except the last couple of times, it's not gone so well.
target: &4 可最近几次，都不怎么顺利。

source: &162 Wiring problems?
target: &162 神经接口有问题？

source: &5 Worse. Someone keeps going through my pockets while I'm under.
target: &5 更糟。我在迷境里的时候，总有人翻我的口袋。

source: &6 I disconnect, and find someone's gone with all my quanta.
target: &6 一断开连接，就发现量子币全被人拿走了。

source: &163 Geez, sorry to hear.
target: &163 真倒霉，听着都难受。

source: &164 Poverty's my answer to that problem.
target: &164 我解决这个问题的办法，就是没钱。

source: &7 Hah. This time, I'm hiding it.
target: &7 哈。这次，我把钱藏起来了。

source: &8 They won't find ANY money on me.
target: &8 在我身上，他们一分钱都找不到。

source: &165 This your usual haunt?
target: &165 你平常就在这里玩？

source: &9 First time here, actually.
target: &9 其实，第一次来。

source: &10 There's a place on Nyasa that I used to go to.
target: &10 以前我常去尼亚萨那边的一家。

source: &166 This is my first time here, too.
target: &166 我也是第一次来。

source: &167 I stopped going to dens after I matriculated.
target: &167 毕业以后，我就不去迷境馆了。

source: &11 I can understand, some people just prefer the freedom of the open web.
target: &11 能理解，有些人就是更喜欢开放网络里的自由。

source: &12 But you get a different kind of atmosphere in these smaller, local servers.
target: &12 不过，这种小型本地服务器，气氛又不一样。

source: &168 You like the server this den's got running?
target: &168 你喜欢这家迷境馆的服务器？

source: &13 It's alright. There's only so much you can do with a repurposed terminal, though.
target: &13 还行。毕竟用的是改装终端，能做到的有限。

source: &169 No doubt legitimately acquired.
target: &169 想必是合法取得的。

source: &14 No doubt. Still, they've got a bar, a dancefloor, and a bunch of games running.
target: &14 想必是。不过，这里有酒吧、舞池，还有不少游戏。

source: &15 And I love the way you can just stare off the edge into...forever.
target: &15 而且，我喜欢站在边缘往外看，就那么一直看到……无穷远。

source: &170 Why'd you choose this place, if you don't mind me asking?
target: &170 不介意的话，能问问你为什么选这家？

source: &16 My folks have been trying to get me to cut down.
target: &16 我爸妈一直想让我少泡点迷境。

source: &171 Fortunately, something I've not had to deal with - no folks.
target: &171 幸好，我不用操心这个，我没爸妈。

source: &17 So, I can't Trance at home. I have to use dens.
target: &17 所以，我不能在家接入，只能来迷境馆。

source: &18 The further from home the dens are, the better.
target: &18 离家越远越好。

source: &19 Why'd you come here?
target: &19 你为什么来这里？

source: &172 I'm on the run from a CEL agent who's trying to kill me.
target: &172 一个CEL探员想杀我，我正在逃命。

source: &173 My underground contact told me to meet here.
target: &173 我的地下联络人，让我来这里碰面。

source: &20 Haha, you're funny.
target: &20 哈哈，你真会开玩笑。

source: &174 What's with those guys hogging the dancefloor?
target: &174 那些霸占舞池的人怎么回事？

source: &21 From what I can tell, they're celebrating.
target: &21 看起来是在庆祝。

source: &22 They've got a cycle of drinking down here, and partying up there.
target: &22 他们在下面喝酒，再上去狂欢，就这么来回转。

source: &175 Any idea what's got them in such a good mood?
target: &175 知道什么事让他们这么高兴吗？

source: &23 I dunno, some sport thing. Big win, apparently.
target: &23 不知道，某个体育比赛。好像赢得挺漂亮。

source: &24 I haven't really paid attention to that stuff since I started Trancing.
target: &24 接触迷境以后，我就没怎么关注那些事了。

source: &176 I know the feeling.
&177 Hey, um...I don't know how to tell you this...
target: &177 嘿，呃……我都不知道该怎么告诉你……

source: &25 What is it?
target: &25 怎么了？

source: &178 Well, I was just offline a second ago. Y'know, finding some food.
target: &178 嗯，刚才我下线了一会儿。去找点吃的。

source: &179 Anyway, I saw...this guy...going through your stuff in the sofa.
target: &179 总之，我看见……有个人……在沙发上翻你的东西。

source: &26 Oh nuke, he found it? Damn...
target: &26 该死，他找到了？妈的……

source: &27 What did he look like?
target: &27 他长什么样？

source: &180 You been Trancing long?
target: &180 你接触迷境很久了？

source: &28 Not really, only got wired last year.
target: &28 没有，去年才装的神经接口。

source: &29 My friends were raving about the Trance, and eventually I gave in.
target: &29 朋友们把迷境夸得天花乱坠，最后我也忍不住了。

source: &181 It was a good choice, wasn't it?
target: &181 选得不错，对吧？

source: &30 The BEST. The Trance was a whole new experience, a whole new world.
target: &30 好得不能再好。迷境是全新的体验，全新的世界。

source: &31 Before, the net was just...the net. Now...
target: &31 以前，网络就是……网络。可现在……

source: &182 It's thoughts, feelings, media, all as a living world.
target: &182 思想、感受、媒体，都成了一个活生生的世界。

source: &32 A waking dream, full of EVERYTHING. Made of other minds.
target: &32 一个清醒的梦，什么都有，由别人的心智构成。

source: &183 Welcome to my world.
target: &183 欢迎来到我的世界。

source: &33 I started to spend a whole lot of time in here, after that.
target: &33 那以后，我开始在这里花上大量时间。

source: &34 Sure, I dropped out of my postgrad course, but...
target: &34 是，我是读研究生时退学了，可……

source: &184 What do you know about that guy at the table?
target: &184 桌边那个人，你知道些什么？

source: &35 The one who looks like Ali Baba?
target: &35 那个看着像阿里巴巴的？

source: &36 I probably know less than you do, since you were talking to them.
target: &36 你还跟人家聊过，我知道的大概比你还少。

source: &185 Have they met anyone else?
target: &185 那人见过其他人吗？

source: &37 Nope. Joined the server a couple of hours ago.
target: &37 没有。几小时前进的服务器。

source: &38 Just been sitting there. Hasn't even ordered a drink.
target: &38 一直坐在那里，连杯喝的都没点。

source: &39 Whoever they are, they must be VERY patient.
target: &39 不管是谁，耐心肯定很好。

source: &186 What do you think of the walking can-opener outside the den?
target: &186 迷境馆外那个会走路的开罐器，你觉得怎么样？

source: &40 Leon? He's alright.
target: &40 莱昂？他还行。

source: &41 He fought in Singapore, doesn't like to talk about it though.
target: &41 他在新加坡打过仗，不过不喜欢谈。

source: &187 Don't you think it's odd, someone without wiring running a Trance den?
target: &187 一个没装神经接口的人开迷境馆，你不觉得奇怪吗？

source: &42 It's good for security, I guess.
target: &42 我觉得，这对安全挺好。

source: &43 Means he's always on guard.
target: &43 说明他一直在看着。

source: &188 You're still worried, though?
target: &188 可你还是担心？

source: &44 Yeah...thieves are tricky...
target: &44 是啊……小偷可狡猾了……

source: &189 Interesting avatar you've got there.
target: &189 你的化身挺有意思。

source: &45 Thanks. Apparently, I'm an "idealist".
target: &45 谢谢。据说我属于“理想派”。

source: &190 So, it's based around your perfect self-image?
target: &190 就是照着心目中最完美的自己来设计？

source: &46 Exactly! Screw months of diet and exercise.
target: &46 没错！谁还要花几个月节食、锻炼。

source: &191 Or millions of quanta of surgery and nanoplasty.
target: &191 或是花上几百万量子币，做手术和纳米整形。

source: &47 You're one as well?
target: &47 你也是这一派？

source: &192 I never really thought about it that way.
target: &192 我倒从没这么想过。

source: &193 I just thought this looked cool.
target: &193 只是觉得这样看着很酷。

source: &194 He was in blue sconto-overalls. Real tatty.
target: &194 他穿着蓝色救济连体服，破破烂烂的。

source: &48 Nuke it, a city kid?
target: &48 该死，市里养大的孩子？

source: &49 There are so many of them, how am I supposed to find him?
target: &49 他们那么多，我怎么找到他？

source: &195 Probably better to start looking sooner.
target: &195 最好还是早点开始找。

source: &50 You're right. Thanks for your help.
target: &50 你说得对。谢谢你帮忙。

source: &51 There just aren't enough decent people like you in the city anymore.
target: &51 城里像你这样的好人，已经不多了。

source: // USER HAS DISCONNECTED:[CaptainCheese969
target: // 用户已断开连接：[CaptainCheese969

source: &197 A big guy...lots of muscle.
target: &197 一个大块头……肌肉很多。

source: &52 Wait, did he have an animated snake tattoo on his arm? White hair?
target: &52 等等，他手臂上有条会动的蛇形纹身吗？白头发？

source: &198 He...might have?
&53 Nuke, I know who it was.
target: &53 该死，我知道是谁了。

source: &54 I'm going to KILL that asshole when I get home.
target: &54 等回家，我非杀了那个混蛋不可。

source: &55 Exes, right?
target: &55 前任啊，你懂的。

source: &199 He sounds like a terrible individual.
target: &199 听起来，他真是个烂人。

source: &56 Thanks for your help.
target: &56 谢谢你帮忙。

source: &200 An older guy...maybe in his fifties.
target: &200 一个上了年纪的人……大概五十多岁。

source: &201 Blue jacket, gray pants, crazy look in his eyes.
target: &201 蓝夹克，灰裤子，眼神疯疯癫癫的。

source: &57 Geez, you know the city's gone to Hell when it's the old people doing this.
target: &57 天啊，连老人都干这种事，这座城市真是没救了。

source: &58 They can't connect to the Trance, so they take advantage of those who can.
target: &58 他们进不了迷境，就占那些能进去的人的便宜。

source: &202 It's...so typical...
target: &202 真是……太典型了……

source: &59 I'd better get after him.
target: &59 我得去追他。

source: &203 I've got RAM trouble - what was it bothering you, again?
target: &203 我内存有点问题。你在为什么事烦心来着？

source: &60 Thieves. Every time I Trance, I get my RL-inventory wiped.
target: &60 小偷。每次进迷境，我现实里的背包就被清空了。

source: &204 But you've got a plan, this time?
target: &204 可这次，你有办法了？

source: &61 Exactly - I've got it stashed somewhere secure.
target: &61 没错，我把钱藏在了安全的地方。

source: &62 Still...three Truggings in a row...
target: &62 可还是……一连遭了三次“迷劫”……

source: &205 Trugging? Oh, Trance-mugging. Clever.
target: &205 迷劫？哦，趁人进迷境时抢劫。挺巧的。

source: &63 Smothering the worry with humor isn't working either, unfortunately.
target: &63 可惜，用笑话压住担心，也不管用。

source: &206 Let me get back to you.
target: &206 我晚点再来找你。

source: &64 Sync you later.
target: &64 回头再连。

source: &207 I used to have an automeal kind of like you.
target: &207 我以前有台自动食品机，有点像你。

source: &208 She got her recipes off a memory card. What about you?
target: &208 她的食谱是从记忆卡里读的。你呢？

source: &13 I got all the usuals built in already.
target: &13 常见的那些，我这里早就内置了。

source: &14 Plus a few extras, this being the Trance and all.
target: &14 另外还有些特别的，毕竟这里是迷境嘛。

source: &209 How do you mean?
target: &209 什么意思？

source: &15 People can be a little more adventurous about what they choose in here.
target: &15 在这里点东西，大家可以大胆一点。

source: &210 I guess the law - or even physics - doesn't really matter here!
target: &210 我想，在这里，法律甚至物理定律都没那么重要了！

source: &16 As long as I got the formula, I can fix it up for ya!
target: &16 只要有配方，我就能给你调出来！

source: &211 A glass of your finest estrogen, sir.
target: &211 先生，来一杯你们最好的雌激素。

source: &17 Getting in touch with your feminine side, missy?
target: &17 想找找自己女性的一面，姑娘？

source: &212 Just what are you implying?
target: &212 你这话什么意思？

source: &18 Nothin' at all, ma'am.
target: &18 什么意思都没有，女士。

source: Picked up: Estrogen
target: 获得：雌激素

source: &213 You'd better not be!
&214 I'm feeling adventurous.
target: &214 我想冒个险。

source: &215 Sulfuric acid, please.
target: &215 请来杯硫酸。

source: &19 Comin' right up!
target: &19 马上就来！

source: Picked up: Sulfuric Acid
target: 获得：硫酸

source: &20 Don't spill that, now!
target: &20 可别洒了！

source: &216 Benzene for me, please.
target: &216 我要苯，谢谢。

source: &21 You'll find it has quite a unique kick!
target: &21 这东西的劲儿，可是别具一格！

source: Picked up: Benzene
target: 获得：苯

source: &22 Let me know when y'all's eyesight comes back.
target: &22 等你能重新看见东西了，告诉我一声。

source: &217 Cuba libre, my man.
target: &217 伙计，来杯自由古巴。

source: &23 Here ya go!
Picked up: Cuba Libre
target: 获得：自由古巴

source: &218 Give me a nuclear winter.
target: &218 给我来杯核冬天。

source: &24 On the rocks?
&219 Wouldn't be a nuclear winter without ice.
target: &219 没有冰，还能叫核冬天吗？

source: &25 Or radioactive fallout, but that'd be goin' a bit far to mix in.
target: &25 还有放射性尘埃，不过真往酒里加，就有点过头了。

source: Picked up: Nuclear Winter
target: 获得：核冬天

source: &220 A Black-ICE Tea...do I have to hack it before I can drink it?
target: &220 来杯黑冰茶……喝之前得先黑进去吗？

source: &26 Lady, with drinks like these, they're the ones hacking YOU.
target: &26 女士，喝这种东西，被入侵的可就是你了。

source: Picked up: Black ICE Tea
target: 获得：黑冰茶

source: &221 Before yesterday, I hadn't really spoken much with AIs.
target: &221 昨天之前，我还真没怎么跟AI聊过。

source: &222 Do you ever get the urge to do more?
target: &222 你有没有想过，多做点别的事？

source: &27 How do y'all mean?
target: &27 什么意思？

source: &223 Well, I mean, you're stuck in here, or in a drinks machine.
target: &223 就是说，你被困在这里，或是在一台酒水机里。

source: &224 Ever wanted to get out, see the rest of the Trance?
target: &224 没想过出去，看看迷境里其他地方？

source: &28 Missy, I sell drinks.
target: &28 姑娘，我是卖酒的。

source: &29 Unlike you, I have a defined raison d'etre.
target: &29 跟你不一样，我存在的意义可是明明白白的。

source: &30 If I weren't doing that...well, I just wouldn't feel right!
target: &30 不做这个……嗯，我才会觉得不对劲！

source: &225 You like it here?
target: &225 你喜欢这里？

source: &31 Better than the last job.
target: &31 比上一份工作好。

source: &32 There's more space in here, that's for sure.
target: &32 至少，这里的空间大多了。

source: &33 And Trance users have more interesting orders than beer, beer, beer.
target: &33 迷境用户点的东西，也比啤酒、啤酒、啤酒有意思。

source: &226 What are you supposed to be, Victorian?
target: &226 你这装扮是什么，维多利亚时代的？

source: &34 I'm the bartender, Missy.
target: &34 我是调酒师，姑娘。

source: &35 Wouldn't be much of a club without one.
target: &35 没个调酒师，还算什么俱乐部。

source: &227 Real, or...?
&36 Naw, I'm part of the program.
target: &36 不是，我是程序的一部分。

source: &37 They got me out of a broken-down machine in a dive bar in Southeast Newton.
target: &37 牛顿市东南区有家破酒吧，里面一台机器坏了，他们就把我从那里弄了出来。

source: &1 Yo.
&231 Something tells me you're not very cheerful.
target: &231 看样子，你不太高兴。

source: &2 Huh. That obvious?
target: &2 嗯。有那么明显？

source: &232 It's just that...well...it's a game.
target: &232 只是……嗯……这可是个游戏。

source: &233 Isn't it enjoyable?
target: &233 不应该玩得开心吗？

source: &3 Less so when that asshole is on a winning streak, that's for sure.
target: &3 那混蛋一直连胜，可就没那么开心了。

source: &234 What's the score?
target: &234 比分多少？

source: &4 At the moment? Fifteen games to nil.
target: &4 现在？十五比零。

source: &235 Nuke me!
&5 It's true. That guy has split-second reflexes.
target: &5 真的。那家伙反应快得吓人。

source: &6 But the way he acts...I've GOT to see him beaten...
target: &6 可他那副德行……我非得看他输一次不可……

source: &236 Is that guy cheating?
target: &236 那家伙作弊了？

source: &7 Well, he hasn't hacked the server.
target: &7 嗯，反正他没黑进服务器。

source: &8 Maybe he just spends most of his spare time practising.
target: &8 也许，他把空闲时间都拿来练习了。

source: &237 What's going on in this sim?
target: &237 这个模拟场景是在玩什么？

source: &9 It's called Gravball.
target: &9 叫重力球。

source: &10 I guess you could say it's a competitive reflex test.
target: &10 算是一种比反应速度的竞技游戏吧。

source: &11 Each player has to hit the ball back at their opponent, until one misses.
target: &11 双方都得把球打回对面，直到有人没接住。

source: &238 Oh yeah, I remember. This game's a hundred years old!
target: &238 哦，对，我记得。这游戏都有一百年了！

source: &12 Except it's first person, the ball has no gravity, and keeps getting faster.
target: &12 不过，这个是第一人称的，球没有重力，而且会越来越快。

source: &13 You game much?
target: &13 你常玩游戏吗？

source: &239 Not really. I'm more of a creative, solitary sort.
target: &239 不怎么。我更喜欢一个人搞点创作。

source: &14 Nobody on the friends list?
target: &14 好友列表里没人？

source: &241 I...it...no, not many...
&242 Who's the guy on the court?
target: &242 场上那个人是谁？

source: &15 The zift out there is Domino.
target: &15 外面那个混蛋叫多米诺。

source: &16 He's the reigning champ.
target: &16 他是现在的冠军。

source: &243 You don't like him?
target: &243 你不喜欢他？

source: &17 It wouldn't be so bad if it was JUST him winning.
target: &17 要只是赢，也没那么讨厌。

source: &18 Problem is, he's such an ass about it.
target: &18 问题是，他赢了以后那副混蛋样。

source: &19 Even when he's not talking, he just *radiates* it.
target: &19 就算不开口，都透着那股劲儿。

source: &20 You see what I mean?
target: &20 明白我什么意思吧？

source: &244 I...just couldn't win!
target: &244 我……就是赢不了！

source: &245 How's he doing it?
target: &245 他怎么做到的？

source: &21 Whatever it is, it can't be legal.
target: &21 不管是什么办法，肯定不合法。

source: &246 Any tips for my next try?
target: &246 下次再试，有什么诀窍？

source: &22 Yeah: "don't".
&247 I need to clear everyone from the server.
target: &247 我得让服务器里的人全部离开。

source: &248 It's for...personal reasons.
target: &248 是为了……私人原因。

source: &23 Sorry lady, but I'm not going anywhere until I beat this guy.
target: &23 抱歉，女士。没赢过这家伙之前，我哪儿也不去。

source: &249 What if *I* beat him for you?
target: &249 要是我帮你赢了他呢？

source: &24 Hah, good luck.
target: &24 哈，祝你好运。

source: &250 You'd still get to see him lose.
target: &250 你一样能看见他输。

source: &25 Hm...alright, you've got a deal.
target: &25 嗯……好吧，成交。

source: &26 You beat him, and I'll retire for the night.
target: &26 你打赢他，我今晚就不玩了。

source: &251 Got any more helpful tips?
target: &251 还有什么更有用的诀窍？

source: &27 What, aside from "you can't win against this guy"?
target: &27 除了“你赢不了这个家伙”之外？

source: &28 Make sure you don't start your swing too late.
target: &28 别等太晚才开始挥拍。

source: &29 Start your swing before the ball's reached your platform.
target: &29 球还没到你的平台前，就要开始挥拍。

source: &252 So, if I'm having trouble hitting it...
target: &252 所以，要是总打不到球……

source: &30 Try swinging earlier.
target: &30 就早点挥拍。

source: &253 I'll give it a shot!
&31 No problem.
target: &31 不客气。

source: &98 Salaam, Mandala.
target: &98 愿你平安，曼荼罗。

source: &99 I trust you made it here without too much difficulty?
target: &99 来这里的路上，应该没遇到太多困难吧？

source: &254 Nothing I couldn't handle.
target: &254 都应付得来。

source: &255 I'm not used to all this "meatspace" stuff though.
target: &255 不过，我不习惯现实里这些事。

source: &100 Nonetheless, you have proven yourself resourceful.
target: &100 尽管如此，你已证明自己很有办法。

source: &256 You said you knew more about the guy who tried to kill me?
target: &256 你说，那个想杀我的人，你知道更多情况？

source: &257 You and your...Jilly...Halli...
target: &257 你和你的……贾里……哈利……

source: &101 Jahiliyyah. In fact, there's been a breakthrough since we last spoke.
target: &101 贾希利亚。实际上，自上次交谈后，我们有了突破。

source: &102 Unfortunately, security is still an issue.
target: &102 不过，安全仍是个问题。

source: &258 There's a whole lotta reasons I stay in the Trance.
target: &258 我待在迷境里，理由可多了。

source: &259 I must have seen more of this city in the last few hours than I had in years.
target: &259 这几个小时，我见到的城市，大概比过去几年加起来还多。

source: &103 Hopefully, we can work together to resolve both of our troubles.
target: &103 希望我们能合作，解决双方的麻烦。

source: &260 It's a public server in a den.
target: &260 这是迷境馆里的公共服务器。

source: &261 I guess anyone could be in here, even other CEL agents.
target: &261 谁都可能在这里，甚至可能有其他CEL探员。

source: &104 It is good to see you understand the value of privacy.
target: &104 很高兴，你理解隐私的重要。

source: &262 I don't need anyone else finding out where I am.
target: &262 我可不需要再有人发现我在哪儿。

source: &263 What do you need?
target: &263 你需要什么？

source: &105 Jahiliyyah's hackers have managed to block any further connections to this server.
target: &105 贾希利亚的黑客已经封锁了通往此服务器的新连接。

source: &106 You must now help us in clearing out any remaining users.
target: &106 现在，你得帮我们让剩下的用户离开。

source: &264 Oh, nuke this.
&265 You're just being abstruse, now!
target: &265 你现在就是在故弄玄虚！

source: &107 What we have found is sensitive, and we must take care...
target: &107 我们发现的事情很敏感，必须谨慎……

source: &266 Enough with the cloak and dagger bullshit.
target: &266 别再搞这套鬼鬼祟祟的狗屁把戏了。

source: &267 What the hell is going on?
target: &267 到底怎么回事？

source: &108 We will explain everything, we need your help to resolve a matter first.
target: &108 我们会把一切都解释清楚，但需要你先帮忙处理一件事。

source: &109 Before we can disclose such delicate information, this server must be emptied.
target: &109 透露如此敏感的信息之前，必须清空这台服务器。

source: &268 I'll do what I can.
target: &268 我尽力吧。

source: &110 Ihsan! We must have privacy before we can reveal what we've found.
target: &110 多谢！我们必须确保没有旁人，才能说出我们的发现。

source: &111 Those remaining in the server must be...persuaded...to leave.
target: &111 剩在服务器里的人，必须被……说服……离开。

source: &269 This might take some work in meatspace, again.
target: &269 看来又得去现实里折腾一番了。

source: &112 It is a testament to your strength that you work so well outside your comfort zone.
target: &112 你在不熟悉的环境里也能应付自如，足见你的能力。

source: &270 Don't get used to it.
target: &270 别指望我常这么干。

source: &271 Once this whole nuked-up mess is sorted out, I'm never leaving the Trance again.
target: &271 等这堆烂事解决了，我再也不离开迷境了。

source: &272 Why can't you do it?
target: &272 你为什么不能自己做？

source: &273 You've obviously got hackers, get them on it!
target: &273 你明明有黑客，让他们去啊！

source: &113 Unfortunately, our teams have done all that they can in blocking the ports.
target: &113 抱歉，端口已经封住，我们的人也只能做到这一步了。

source: &274 Can't you just tell me now? There can't be many people left.
target: &274 现在就不能告诉我吗？也没剩几个人了。

source: &114 We must be absolutely sure of our seclusion.
target: &114 我们必须绝对确定，不会有别人听见。

source: &115 Please, do this for us, and we may share all we've learned.
target: &115 请帮我们办到这件事，我们才能分享所有发现。

source: &275 Fine, I'll get rid of them. Don't get used to having me around, though.
target: &275 行，我把他们弄走。不过，别习惯有我帮忙。

source: &276 If you want everyone gone, why don't you just crash the server remotely?
target: &276 想让所有人都离开，为什么不远程弄崩服务器？

source: &277 I could've done that if you wanted. It would get rid of everyone.
target: &277 你要是愿意，我本来就能这么做。所有人都会掉线。

source: &116 It would, but would also call attention to us.
target: &116 是，但也会引起别人注意。

source: &117 Our hackers have blocked incoming connections - resetting the server would disable this.
target: &117 我们的黑客封锁了新连接，服务器重启会让封锁失效。

source: &278 Oh. Then everyone would just reconnect again.
target: &278 哦，那大家就又连回来了。

source: &118 Precisely. We've removed as many as we can over the net.
target: &118 正是。能通过网络清除的用户，我们已经尽量清除了。

source: &119 The remainder must physically leave the Trance by themselves.
target: &119 剩下的人，必须让他们亲自断开迷境连接。

source: &279 With a little incitement from me, you mean.
target: &279 你是说，让我稍微推他们一把。

source: &280 If you're not in the den, where are you?
target: &280 你要是不在迷境馆，那你在哪儿？

source: &281 Are you even in Newton?
target: &281 你在牛顿市吗？

source: &120 My person is in a secure location.
target: &120 我本人在一个安全的地方。

source: &121 As to where that is...well, I'm afraid that's a secret.
target: &121 至于具体在哪儿……恐怕，那是秘密。

source: &282 Not even a clue?
target: &282 一点提示都没有？

source: &122 Haha. All I shall say is that I'm meeting some old friends here for dinner.
target: &122 哈哈。我只能说，我正在这里和几位老朋友一起吃晚餐。

source: &283 Talk about multitasking.
target: &283 这可真是分身有术。

source: &123 Exactly. Hopefully you will excuse me if I seem a little distracted.
target: &123 正是。要是我有些走神，还请见谅。

source: &284 Why *this* server?
target: &284 为什么偏偏选这个服务器？

source: &285 It seems like a strange place to meet.
target: &285 在这里碰面，感觉有点奇怪。

source: &124 Jahiliyyah uses many such venues.
target: &124 贾希利亚会使用许多这样的场所。

source: &286 Compared to the whole net though...it's so small...
target: &286 可跟整个网络相比……这里也太小了……

source: &125 Which allows us to more easily determine if we are being monitored.
target: &125 所以，我们更容易判断自己是否受到监控。

source: &287 Oohh...cloak and dagger...
target: &287 哦……间谍那一套……

source: &126 And after we have concluded our discussion, we shall crash the server.
target: &126 谈话结束后，我们会让服务器崩溃。

source: &127 There shall be no evidence of us having been connected.
target: &127 不会留下我们曾经连接过的证据。

source: &288 Who are these other people in here? Your pals?
target: &288 这里其他人是谁？你的朋友？

source: &128 Bystanders, members of the public.
target: &128 旁观者，普通公众。

source: &129 They come from all walks of life.
target: &129 他们来自各行各业。

source: &130 Unfortunately, they cannot know what we are about to discuss.
target: &130 可惜，他们不能知道我们接下来要讨论的事。

source: &289 And that's why you want me to remove them.
target: &289 所以，你才想让我把他们弄走。

source: &290 That's not going to be easy.
target: &290 这可不容易。

source: &131 You are resourceful, Mandala. You will find a way.
target: &131 你很有办法，曼荼罗。你会找到方法的。

source: &291 Did you know where this sim was being hosted?
target: &291 你知道这个模拟场景在哪儿运行吗？

source: &292 It's a stolen street-corner terminal in a dingy cellar.
target: &292 肮脏地下室里，一台从街角偷来的终端。

source: &132 A trance den, yes. We often use it as a meeting-point.
target: &132 是家迷境馆，没错。我们常把它当作碰面地点。

source: &133 I've not been there personally, but my allies' reports have painted a vivid picture.
target: &133 我没亲自去过，不过同伴们的报告描述得很生动。

source: &293 Yeah...it's a great place - if you're a rat, or a giant cockroach.
target: &293 是啊……好地方，前提是你是老鼠，或者巨型蟑螂。

source: &134 Perhaps you can use this to your advantage?
target: &134 或许，你可以利用这一点？

source: &135 The conditions sound only a little way from "intolerable".
target: &135 听起来，那里的环境离“无法忍受”只差一点。

source: &136 Those within the den may need only a little push to make it so.
target: &136 只要再稍微推一把，馆里的人也许就会忍不下去了。

source: &294 You don't know how far thralls will go for a link.
target: &294 你不知道，迷奴为了一个连接，能忍到什么地步。

source: &295 Sims like this are...weird...
target: &295 这样的模拟场景……挺怪的……

source: &296 There's the whole net to explore, things to create and learn...
target: &296 有整个网络可以探索，也有那么多东西可以创造、学习……

source: &297 ...but people want to come somewhere that's laid out like a dance club?
target: &297 ……可大家偏偏想来一个布局像舞厅的地方？

source: &137 Not to your taste?
target: &137 不合你的口味？

source: &298 Just seems like a waste.
target: &298 只是觉得很浪费。

source: &138 Perhaps it lends familiarity to it.
target: &138 也许，这能给人一种熟悉感。

source: &139 Unlike yourself, some may not be ready to lead a wholly intangible existence.
target: &139 有些人不像你，还没准备好完全生活在无形的世界里。

source: &140 They understand the Trance in the artifacts of life they know.
target: &140 他们需要借助熟悉的生活事物，来理解迷境。

source: &299 And for a Trance venue, it seems so...small...
target: &299 可作为迷境里的场所，这里显得也太……小了……

source: &300 Come on, it's not like anyone'd be listening in.
target: &300 拜托，又不像有人会偷听。

source: &301 I need to know what's going on!
target: &301 我得知道到底怎么回事！

source: &141 I'm sorry Mandala, I cannot.
target: &141 抱歉，曼荼罗，我不能说。

source: &142 As long as there's any unsecured connection...
target: &142 只要还有任何不安全的连接……

source: &302 ...you mean, all the other users.
target: &302 ……你是说，其他用户。

source: &143 Precisely. We cannot guarantee that the others are not being monitored.
target: &143 正是。我们无法保证其他人没有受到监控。

source: &144 You are in enough danger as it is, and I cannot risk compromising you.
target: &144 你现在已经够危险了，我不能再冒险让你暴露。

source: &303 So, I know it's awful netiquette in the Trance...
target: &303 我知道，按迷境里的规矩，问这种事很没礼貌……

source: &304 ...I'm almost disgusted to hear me say it...but...
target: &304 ……连我自己说出来都觉得恶心……可是……

source: &145 ...you want to know more about the Real me?
target: &145 ……你想多了解一些，现实中的我？

source: &305 Yeah...I mean, you probably can't, for secrecy and all...
target: &305 是啊……不过，为了保密什么的，你大概不能说……

source: &146 You are correct. There's a reason we have our identities in here. Even you, Mandala.
target: &146 没错。我们在这里使用这些身份，是有原因的。你也一样，曼荼罗。

source: &147 Let's just say that outside, I work to do good for the world.
target: &147 这么说吧，在外面，我的工作是为世界做些好事。

source: &148 Jahiliyyah's interests match my own, in that respect.
target: &148 在这一点上，贾希利亚的目标和我一致。

source: &306 So, that organization you work for...
target: &306 所以，你为这个组织工作……

source: &149 ...with. Jahiliyyah's membership is non-hierarchical.
target: &149 ……是和这个组织合作。贾希利亚的成员之间，没有上下级。

source: &307 Sounds like it'd be hard to get anything agreed on.
target: &307 那要达成共识，听起来可不容易。

source: &150 Sometimes the differing viewpoints of members leads to a standstill.
target: &150 有时，成员观点不同，确实会让事情停滞不前。

source: &151 The ethical integrity is a refreshing change from my RL work, though.
target: &151 不过，他们坚守道德原则的做法，相比我现实中的工作，实在让人耳目一新。

source: &308 Wasn't Guy working for you?
target: &308 盖伊不是在为你工作吗？

source: &152 In a manner of speaking. Sometimes we need to subcontract our tasks.
target: &152 某种意义上，是的。有时，我们需要把任务委托出去。

source: &153 For those matters, we'll recruit experts. Guy was such.
target: &153 这种时候，我们会找专业人士。盖伊就是其中之一。

source: &310 Any word from Guy since I left CEL?
target: &310 我离开CEL以后，有盖伊的消息吗？

source: &154 We were looking for him after his discharge from CEL.
target: &154 他从CEL离开后，我们一直在找他。

source: &155 It doesn't appear hopeful - he boarded an aerostat for the Han Republic.
target: &155 看来不太乐观。他登上了一艘开往大汉共和国的飞艇。

source: &311 Oh...I'm sorry to hear that.
&156 Guy was discharged from CEL shortly after your escape.
target: &156 你逃走后不久，CEL就让盖伊离开了。

source: &157 He made contact with us, and sends his thanks.
target: &157 他联系了我们，还托我们向你道谢。

source: &312 That's a relief.
target: &312 那就放心了。

source: &313 Why can't you tell me what's going on?
target: &313 为什么不能告诉我到底怎么回事？

source: &158 The server is not yet secure.
target: &158 服务器还不安全。

source: &159 Until it is just us remaining, we cannot be sure that we won't be compromised.
target: &159 除非这里只剩下我们，否则就无法确定不会暴露。

source: &314 So, you need me to figure out how to get rid of the other users?
target: &314 所以，你得让我想办法，把其他用户赶走？

source: &160 Precisely. They have a direct connection to the server.
target: &160 正是。他们与服务器直接相连。

source: &161 They must be removed by other means than mere hacking, I am afraid.
target: &161 恐怕，仅靠黑客手段无法让他们离开，得用别的办法。

source: &315 I'll get back to ruining everyone's evening.
target: &315 那我继续去毁掉大家美好的夜晚了。

source: &162 Bit-tawfiq!
target: &162 祝你顺利！

source: &316 The server's empty. We're alone.
target: &316 服务器清空了，只剩我们。

source: &163 Excellent. I feel much safer.
target: &163 很好，这下安心多了。

source: &317 You going to tell me what's going on, now?
target: &317 现在能告诉我，到底怎么回事了吗？

source: &164 I shall. But first, tell me - why do you enjoy the Trance?
target: &164 可以。不过，先告诉我，你为什么喜欢迷境？

source: &318 People.
target: &318 因为这里的人。

source: &165 The human contact?
target: &165 与人交流的机会？

source: &319 I don't get how people work. Not outside, anyway.
target: &319 我搞不懂别人怎么想的。至少，在外面搞不懂。

source: &320 In here, it's a lot easier to understand one another.
target: &320 在这里，彼此理解就容易多了。

source: &321 You can bare your soul, and make yourself into your ideal.
target: &321 你能敞开心扉，也能把自己变成心目中理想的样子。

source: &166 I can see how that would appeal.
target: &166 我能理解，这为什么有吸引力。

source: &167 I suppose you could say...you were born for this?
target: &167 或许可以说……你生来就属于这里？

source: &322 It feels like it, sometimes.
target: &322 有时，确实有这种感觉。

source: &168 Mandala, we've been taking scans of your connection.
target: &168 曼荼罗，我们一直在扫描你的连接。

source: &169 We have *never* seen a sync ratio as high as yours.
target: &169 我们从没见过，像你这样高的同步率。

source: &170 The Trance is, literally, where you belong.
target: &170 你真正属于的世界，就是迷境。

source: &171 We need your assistance.
target: &171 我们需要你的帮助。

source: &323 I understand how everything works in here.
target: &323 我明白，这里的一切是怎么运转的。

source: &324 Everything within here is constructed, planned, laid down.
target: &324 这里的每样东西，都经过构建、规划、安排。

source: &325 Someone built it, and it's like I can see all the gears turning behind it all.
target: &325 一切都是有人造出来的。我仿佛能看见背后转动的每个齿轮。

source: &326 I've got a much clearer understanding of my place within it.
target: &326 对于自己在其中的位置，我也理解得清楚多了。

source: &327 There's so much that can be done with it.
target: &327 它能实现的东西太多了。

source: &328 A world we've built for ourselves, where the old laws - even physics! - aren't necessary.
target: &328 我们为自己建造的世界，旧的规则，甚至物理定律，都不再是必需的。

source: &329 We've had the net for a century, and we've still barely scratched the surface.
target: &329 网络已经存在一个世纪，可我们才刚摸到表面。

source: &330 I want to shape my future, and be a part of something bigger.
target: &330 我想塑造自己的未来，参与更大的事业。

source: &331 That's what the Trance is for.
target: &331 迷境就是为此而存在的。

source: &332 I've wondered, and sometimes I feel like I might now.
target: &332 我也想过，有时候觉得，现在好像能明白一点了。

source: &333 It's just kind of...natural? It feels right.
target: &333 就是很……自然？感觉是对的。

source: &334 What's that got to do with anything?
target: &334 这跟眼下的事有什么关系？

source: &335 Look, I need your help.
target: &335 听着，我需要你帮忙。

source: &336 My private life is none of your business.
target: &336 我的私生活与你无关。

source: &337 You need *my* help?
target: &337 你需要我帮忙？

source: &338 What could I do?
target: &338 我能做什么？

source: &172 More than you realize, insha'allah!
target: &172 你能做到的，远比你自己以为的多，愿真主成全！

source: &173 The reason you were targeted is linked to your unusual natural affinity for the Trance.
target: &173 你被盯上的原因，与你天生对迷境非同寻常的适应能力有关。

source: &339 They want to kill me because my connection's too fast?
target: &339 就因为我连接太快，他们就想杀我？

source: &174 Not directly, it goes deeper than that, to the very structure of your brain.
target: &174 并非这么简单。原因更深，关系到你的大脑结构。

source: &175 Do you recall what Guy was doing in that cell you shared with him?
target: &175 还记得，你和盖伊关在一起时，他在做什么吗？

source: &341 Hey, no way! I don't even know what you people want!
target: &341 嘿，想都别想！我连你们想干什么都不知道！

source: &176 Please, hear me out.
target: &176 请先听我说完。

source: &342 Yeah...he was your relay, wasn't he?
target: &342 嗯……他是你们的中继联络员，对吧？

source: &343 You were connecting to CEL's systems through him.
target: &343 你们通过他，连接CEL的系统。

source: &177 Precisely. He was a vital part of the operation.
target: &177 正是。他是行动中至关重要的一环。

source: &178 But thanks to the psychophage, he is indisposed to us.
target: &178 可由于噬心病毒，他现在无法再为我们提供帮助。

source: &344 Let me guess - you want me to be a relay for you?
target: &344 让我猜猜，你们想让我做中继联络员？

source: &179 With a sync ratio like yours, the bandwidth would be...incredible!
target: &179 有你这样的同步率，带宽会……惊人地大！

source: &345 Your hackers would be running petabytes through my wiring.
target: &345 你们的黑客，要通过我的神经线路传输PB级的数据。

source: &346 But you'd need me to get close, right?
target: &346 可你们需要我靠近，对吧？

source: &347 To the systems of the people trying to kill me?
target: &347 靠近那些想杀我的人的系统？

source: &348 Um...being stuck in a wall?
target: &348 呃，被卡在墙里？

source: &180 He was our relay within CEL.
target: &180 他是我们在CEL内部的中继联络员。

source: &181 His presence enables our breaching teams to connect to secured systems.
target: &181 有他在，我们的入侵小组就能连进设有防护的系统。

source: &349 Excuse me if I sound a little skeptical...
target: &349 别怪我有点怀疑……

source: &350 But you're asking me to walk up to the people trying to kill me?
target: &350 可你们是要我主动走到那些想杀我的人面前？

source: &351 You haven't even given me a good explanation for why they're after me!
target: &351 他们为什么追杀我，你们都还没给个像样的解释！

source: &182 I'm sorry, but we don't know a great deal more than you.
target: &182 抱歉，可我们知道的，也没比你多多少。

source: &183 We need your assistance - your unique talent with the Trance makes you valuable.
target: &183 我们需要你的帮助。你在迷境中的独特天赋，正是你的价值所在。

source: &184 They hunt you because of it - turn it against them!
target: &184 他们为此追杀你，那就用这天赋反击他们！

source: &352 So, this'll help you discover their plans?
target: &352 所以，这能帮你们查出他们的计划？

source: &353 *sigh* - fine, what do you need me to do?
target: &353 *叹气*——行吧，需要我做什么？

source: &185 Shukran, Mandala. Justice shall be done.
target: &185 谢谢你，曼荼罗。正义终将得到伸张。

source: &186 They operate from an old aerostat terminal, Xanadu Air Freight.
target: &186 他们的据点是一个旧飞艇航站，叫上都航空货运。

source: &187 Head there - we will remain in contact with you.
target: &187 去那里，我们会一直与你保持联系。

source: &354 Great, more walking.
target: &354 真好，又得走路了。

source: &188 And now, we must crash the server.
target: &188 现在，我们必须让服务器崩溃。

source: &189 Good luck, Mandala!
target: &189 祝你好运，曼荼罗！

source: PART7
reason: 内部成就标识；全部脚本引用作为unlockAch参数，沿用原键以保持成就匹配

source: // ERROR[[This Trance environment has become unstable and must be terminated.[If the error reappears, please contact your sysadmin.
target: // 错误[[此迷境环境已不稳定，必须终止运行。[如果错误再次出现，请联系系统管理员。

source: &355 Okay. I'll do it.
target: &355 好，我来做。

source: &356 I need to find out who's after me, and I haven't got any other options.
target: &356 我得弄清楚是谁在追杀我，也没有其他选择了。

source: &190 Wonderful, Mandala! Jahiliyyah is behind you all of the way.
target: &190 太好了，曼荼罗！贾希利亚会一直支持你。

source: &357 Until they're dealt with, I can't get back to my life on the net.
target: &357 不把他们解决掉，我就没法回到网络里的生活。

source: &191 Though you are strong in the Trance, it makes you vulnerable in the outside world.
target: &191 虽然你在迷境中很强大，可这也让你在外面的世界很脆弱。

source: &358 If they're targeting me because of my affinity for the Trance...
target: &358 要是他们因为我对迷境的适应能力而盯上我……

source: &359 Well, it's poetic justice if I turn it against them to help you.
target: &359 那我就用这个来对付他们，帮你们一把，也算是以其人之道还治其人之身。

source: &360 What do I have to do?
target: &360 我需要做什么？

source: &1 What's up?
target: &1 怎么了？

source: &361 Let's go!
&2 Bring it on!
target: &2 放马过来！

source: &362 So, you're...Domino?
target: &362 所以，你是……多米诺？

source: &3 The one and only. No doubt you've seen my livefeed.
target: &3 正是在下。你肯定看过我的直播。

source: &4 I guess you've come to get a glimpse of your sporting idol in action.
target: &4 看来，你是来亲眼看看自己的体育偶像大显身手的。

source: &364 Not really...just that your username's visible.
target: &364 不是……只是你的用户名就显示在那里。

source: &5 Huh. Better introduce myself!
target: &5 嗯。那得介绍一下我自己！

source: &6 I'm Domino - I'm the Den's reigning King of Sport.
target: &6 我是多米诺，迷境馆当之无愧的运动之王。

source: &32 Jackass.
&365 I still don't get the appeal of it.
target: &365 我还是不懂，这有什么吸引力。

source: &366 It's, like, hundreds of years old.
target: &366 这游戏都几百年了。

source: &7 It becomes more refined every technological generation.
target: &7 每一代技术，都让它变得更加精妙。

source: &8 A true test of one's mental and reflexive balance.
target: &8 它真正考验的，是思维与反应之间的平衡。

source: &367 Still not my thing. I like to MAKE things, to explore.
target: &367 还是不适合我。我喜欢创造，喜欢探索。

source: &9 You're free to do that, I guess.
target: &9 随你，反正你有这个自由。

source: &10 Just one less thrall I need to beat on repeat.
target: &10 只是少了一个让我反复打败的迷奴而已。

source: &368 What are you guys playing down here?
target: &368 你们在这里玩什么？

source: &12 It's a test of reflexes and coordination.
target: &12 考验反应与协调能力的游戏。

source: &369 It looks kinda like tennis.
target: &369 看起来有点像网球。

source: &13 As if. Tennis is to this as chess is to the real-time battlefield command sim.
target: &13 想得美。网球和它的差距，就像国际象棋与实时战场指挥模拟的差距。

source: &370 But you still have to hit a ball back and forth?
target: &370 可不还是把球来回打？

source: &14 If you want to be all reductionist.
target: &14 你非要这么简化的话。

source: &15 In that case, the Trance is *merely* computing in your brain.
target: &15 照你这么说，迷境也“不过”是在脑子里做计算。

source: &371 You're a natural at this.
target: &371 你很有天赋。

source: &16 Either that, or everyone else is a bunch of nuked-up losers.
target: &16 要么就是其他人，全是一群废物。

source: &372 That other guy looks unhappy.
target: &372 另一个人，看起来不高兴。

source: &17 El Mustardo? That's 'cause he's a loser.
target: &17 El Mustardo？因为他是个输家。

source: &18 Isn't it? Huh? Huh?
target: &18 是不是？啊？啊？

source: &33 Shut up.
&373 You must have put a lot of practice into this.
target: &373 你肯定练过很多。

source: &19 That's part of it.
target: &19 一部分是。

source: &20 A bigger part is the cocktail.
target: &20 更重要的是，那杯鸡尾酒。

source: &374 Like...from the bar?
target: &374 就是……酒吧里的那种？

source: &21 It's a mix of steroids and epi.
target: &21 类固醇和肾上腺素混合的。

source: &22 Speeds my brain - and reflexes - waaay up.
target: &22 能让我的脑子，还有反应，快上好多倍。

source: &375 Isn't that cheating?
target: &375 那不是作弊吗？

source: &23 Naah, not according to the rules it ain't.
target: &23 不，按规则可不算。

source: &24 Only counts as cheating if you tamper with the programming.
target: &24 只有改动程序，才叫作弊。

source: &376 Whereas you're just tampering with your brain instead?
target: &376 所以，你只是改动自己的脑子？

source: &25 Yep.
&377 There's such a thing as being a "good winner", y'know.
target: &377 就算赢了，也该有点风度，你知道吧。

source: &26 Where's the fun in that?
target: &26 那还有什么乐趣？

source: &27 There's a reason I win every single time.
target: &27 我每一局都赢，是有原因的。

source: &378 Cheating?
&28 So that I can make sure EVERYONE knows just how awesome I am.
target: &28 为了让所有人都知道，我有多厉害。

source: &379 Could I ask a favor?
target: &379 能请你帮个忙吗？

source: &380 I need everyone to leave the server.
target: &380 我需要所有人离开服务器。

source: &29 Pfft, yeah, right.
target: &29 噗，想得美。

source: &30 Why would I quit on a winning streak like this?
target: &30 我正一路连胜，凭什么要走？

source: &381 What would the sportsman in you say to a little bet?
target: &381 那么，身为运动健将，敢不敢打个小赌？

source: &31 Now you're talking.
target: &31 这话才对。

source: &382 If I can break your streak, you leave the server.
target: &382 要是我终结了你的连胜，你就离开服务器。

source: &32 That sounds about even.
target: &32 听起来挺公平。

source: &383 Don't you want something from me if I lose?
target: &383 如果我输了，你不想从我这里要点什么？

source: &33 Don't need it.
target: &33 不需要。

source: &34 Every time I smash you, my streak gets bigger.
target: &34 每虐你一次，我的连胜纪录就更长一点。

source: &35 That's all I need,  since this loser stopped playing.
target: &35 这就够了，反正那废物已经不玩了。

source: &34 Go nuke yourself.
target: &34 去死吧。

source: &384 I've got better things to do.
target: &384 我还有更重要的事。

source: &36 You'll be back.
target: &36 你还会回来的。

source: &37 Chicks can't get enough of me.
target: &37 姑娘们都迷我迷得不行。

source: &1 What?!
&385 What's up?
&2 If you MUST know, I'm partaking in the digital experience.
target: &2 你非要知道的话，我正在体验数字世界。

source: &3 Apparently, more vivaciously than YOU.
target: &3 显然，比你活跃得多。

source: &386 How do you figure? You're just standing...floating here.
target: &386 怎么看出来的？你就这么站……飘在这里。

source: &4 I...it...hey, shut up!
&387 You're a head.
target: &387 你是个脑袋。

source: &5 Very astute. And you're behind.
target: &5 真敏锐。而你落后了。

source: &388 No, I mean you're just a floating head.
target: &388 不，我是说，你只有一个飘着的脑袋。

source: &389 Why are you just a floating head?
target: &389 为什么只有一个飘着的脑袋？

source: &6 Because unlike SOME PEOPLE, I'm choosing to take the Trance to its full POTENTIAL.
target: &6 因为不像某些人，我选择充分发挥迷境的潜力。

source: &7 We can look like whatever we want - but SOME people just look like - PEOPLE.
target: &7 我们可以变成任何样子，可某些人偏偏还长得像人。

source: &8 "Ooh, human body, two legs, two arms," how ORIGINAL.
target: &8 “哦，人的身体，两条腿，两只手”，可真有创意啊。

source: &390 I *like* having legs.
target: &390 我就是喜欢有腿。

source: &9 It's so limited though!
target: &9 可这也太局限了！

source: &10 Realists like you have NO imagination!
target: &10 你们这些写实派，一点想象力都没有！

source: &391 Hey, who are you calling a realist?!
target: &391 嘿，你说谁是写实派？！

source: &392 What's the line for?
target: &392 这是在排什么队？

source: &11 If you MUST know, I'm waiting for a slot to open up in the games.
target: &11 你非要知道的话，我在等游戏空出一个位置。

source: &12 I'M first, though. You hear me?
target: &12 不过，我排第一。听见了吗？

source: &393 Uh...sure.
&13 There are social CONVENTIONS that must be followed...mrmrmrrmm...
target: &13 有些社交规矩必须遵守……唔唔……

source: &394 Are the games any good?
target: &394 游戏好玩吗？

source: &14 Would I be WAITING here if they weren't?
target: &14 不好玩，我会在这里等？

source: &395 Remind me, what are you here for?
target: &395 再说说，你来这里干什么？

source: &15 What, something wrong with your Gibson?
target: &15 怎么，你的“吉布森”出毛病了？

source: &16 It's the GAMES. I'm here for the GAMES.
target: &16 游戏。我是来玩游戏的。

source: &17 Front of the line, FRONT of the LINE.
target: &17 排第一，我排第一。

source: &396 You're front of the line, I see.
target: &396 你排第一，我知道了。

source: &18 And don't you forget it!
target: &18 给我记住了！

source: &19 That next slot is MINE.
target: &19 下个空位是我的。

source: &397 Is this one of your usual Trance spots?
target: &397 这是你常来的迷境场所？

source: &20 It's acceptable, most of the time.
target: &20 大多数时候，还算能接受。

source: &21 Mostly because I'm not being bothered by INANE QUESTIONS from PLEBS.
target: &21 主要是因为，没有白痴来问些蠢问题烦我。

source: &398 It looked a little dirty outside to me.
target: &398 外面看起来有点脏。

source: &22 Yeah, I know, it's disgusting.
target: &22 是啊，我知道，恶心死了。

source: &399 That a problem?
target: &399 这不是个问题吗？

source: &23 No, I got my usual spot to crash under the pipes.
target: &23 不是，我在管道下面有个老位置，可以躺着。

source: &24 It's the CLEANEST place in the den.
target: &24 那是馆里最干净的地方。

source: &25 Lousy...mrrmrmrm...muck...mrrmr...
target: &25 烂地方……唔唔……脏死了……唔唔……

source: &400 Can I get cuts?
target: &400 能让我插个队吗？

source: &26 What?! Are you CRAZY?!
target: &26 什么？！你疯了吗？！

source: &27 No you can NOT go ahead of ME.
target: &27 不准排到我前面。

source: &28 *I* was here FIRST. That is NOT how lines work!
target: &28 我先来的。排队可不是这么排的！

source: &401 This might seem a little strange,
target: &401 这可能听起来有点奇怪，

source: &402 ...but I need everyone to leave the server.
target: &402 ……可我需要所有人都离开服务器。

source: &29 What?! No!!
&30 I haven't gotten into the GAMES, yet!
target: &30 我还没进游戏呢！

source: &403 It wouldn't be for long...
target: &403 不会很久……

source: &31 No, GAMES FIRST, then I go HOME.
target: &31 不行，先玩游戏，再回家。

source: &32 Do you GET ME?
target: &32 明白吗？

source: &404 What's with the dancers?
target: &404 那些跳舞的人怎么回事？

source: &33 I KNOW! They're AWFUL people.
target: &33 就是！那些人糟透了。

source: &34 They come up here from the bar, spilling vodka all over the sim.
target: &34 从酒吧跑上来，把伏特加洒得整个模拟场景都是。

source: &35 Dirty, DIRTY people!
target: &35 脏，脏死了！

source: &36 Fine, fine, whatever.
target: &36 行，行，随便。

source: &129 Excuse me...
target: &129 打扰一下……

source: &1 Repent, and you shall be saved!
target: &1 悔改吧，你就能得救！

source: &2 After this, the judgement!
target: &2 此后，必有审判！

source: &3 Jesus Christ is coming! Repent!
target: &3 耶稣基督即将降临！悔改吧！

source: &4 Hellfire awaits the unsaved!
target: &4 未得救的人，必受地狱之火！

source: &5 Turn your head to His light!
target: &5 转向主的光明吧！

source: &6 Judgement is coming! Seek the Lord!
target: &6 审判将至！寻求主吧！

source: &7 The wages of sin is death!
target: &7 罪的工价乃是死！

source: &8 This city's destruction is at hand!
target: &8 这座城市即将毁灭！

source: &130 What's with the shouting?
target: &130 你为什么大喊大叫？

source: &9 I must call to the unsaved, that they may hear!
target: &9 我必须呼唤未得救的人，让他们听见！

source: &10 They need to know the word of God's love!
target: &10 他们必须听见上帝爱的福音！

source: &131 It sounds to me like you're harassing them.
target: &131 听起来，我倒觉得你是在骚扰他们。

source: &132 Go on, what's the message? I'm listening.
target: &132 说吧，究竟想传达什么？我听着。

source: &11 The kingdom of Heaven is nearly upon us!
target: &11 天国就要降临！

source: &12 We must prepare, and seek His salvation!
target: &12 我们必须做好准备，寻求主的救赎！

source: &13 Turn aside from this false paradise of yours!
target: &13 离开你们这个虚假的天堂！

source: &134 The Trance?
&135 You don't like the Trance?
target: &135 你不喜欢迷境？

source: &14 It is a false promise of paradise!
target: &14 那是虚假的天堂承诺！

source: &15 They will lead you into the belief that it can be achieved without faith in Him!
target: &15 他们诱使你们相信，不信仰主，也能抵达天堂！

source: &136 So...you don't like the competition the Trance gives religion?
target: &136 所以……你不喜欢迷境和宗教抢生意？

source: &16 There are claims of those within that it is a new promised land.
target: &16 身在其中的人，竟称它为新的应许之地。

source: &17 But it is nought but a wretched hive of sin and debauchery!
target: &17 可那不过是罪恶与放荡聚集的可悲巢穴！

source: &137 I don't like the word "thrall", but...
target: &137 我不喜欢“迷奴”这个词，可……

source: &138 I guess you could say I spend a lot of time in the Trance.
target: &138 我确实在迷境里待得挺久。

source: &18 Then it is my mission to save you!
target: &18 那拯救你，就是我的使命！

source: &19 I must place you on the path to His salvation!
target: &19 我必须引领你走上主的救赎之路！

source: &20 I must show you the way!
target: &20 我必须为你指引道路！

source: &139 Okay, let's say for the sake of argument I agreed with you.
target: &139 好吧，姑且假设我同意你。

source: &140 How does someone get on that path?
target: &140 怎么走上那条路？

source: &21 Hear me, my child!
target: &21 听我说，孩子！

source: &22 There are three stages - His Kingdom, then the Material, mortal world.
target: &22 共有三个层次：主的国度，然后是物质的、凡人的世界。

source: &23 Lastly, the mire of the Virtual, wherein you are trapped.
target: &23 最后，是虚拟的泥潭，你正陷在其中。

source: &141 So, how do I get out of the virtual?
target: &141 所以，我怎么离开虚拟世界？

source: &24 We must start you outwards, and first give you an anchor in the material.
target: &24 我们得先引你走出来，首先让你在物质世界有所依托。

source: &25 While the virtual may seem to contain all the pleasures of the flesh...
target: &25 虽然，虚拟世界似乎包含了一切肉体的欢愉……

source: &26 ...we must show you what the material can offer, to begin the way up.
target: &26 ……但我们必须让你看见物质世界能给予什么，才能开始向上攀升。

source: &142 Which is...?
&27 The book says to use what he has given us, and I have been blessed with powerful barbiturates!
target: &27 经书教导我们，要使用主的赐予。而主赐给了我强效的巴比妥类药物！

source: &143 You want to use DRUGS to get me off the Trance?
target: &143 你想用药物，让我不再进迷境？

source: &28 The pleasures of the material can rival that of the virtual.
target: &28 物质世界的欢愉，足以媲美虚拟世界。

source: &29 Thence we can lead you to those of the divine!
target: &29 之后，我们便能引领你，体验神圣的欢愉！

source: &144 What church did you say you belong to?
target: &144 你刚才说，自己属于哪个教会来着？

source: &30 Think of it in terms of a replacement therapy!
target: &30 你可以把这看作替代疗法！

source: &31 A tried and true method for recovery from addictions.
target: &31 这是戒除成瘾时，久经考验、确实有效的方法。

source: &32 We must wean you away from the sin of the Trance!
target: &32 我们必须让你逐渐摆脱迷境的罪恶！

source: &145 I've been thinking about what you've been saying.
target: &145 我想了想你刚才说的话。

source: &146 I definitely want to repent.
target: &146 我确实想悔改。

source: &33 Hallelujah, my child! This is a glorious day!
target: &33 哈利路亚，孩子！这真是荣耀的一天！

source: &147 Yes. Um...rejoice.
&34 Are you prepared to begin your spiritual journey?
target: &34 你准备好，开始灵性的旅程了吗？

source: &148 Yes. Praise be, etcetera.
target: &148 是的。赞美主，诸如此类。

source: &35 Very well! But first, a donation is required!
target: &35 很好！不过，首先需要一笔捐献！

source: &149 Wait, what?
target: &149 等等，什么？

source: &36 The means to salvation bear a cost, my child.
target: &36 走向救赎的手段，也有成本，孩子。

source: &37 Narcotics are expensive to come by.
target: &37 想弄到麻醉药物，可不便宜。

source: &150 Seriously though, I need those drugs.
target: &150 说真的，我需要那些药物。

source: &151 Um...I mean, I wanna repent.
target: &151 呃……我是说，我想悔改。

source: &38 I do not doubt your faith, my child.
target: &38 我不怀疑你的信仰，孩子。

source: &39 But we cannot proceed before a donation is made!
target: &39 不过，捐献之前，我们无法继续！

source: &152 Aw, come on!
&40 Otherwise, we might have every urchin taking advantage of His love.
target: &40 否则，岂不是每个街头小鬼，都能占主之爱的便宜。

source: &153 I'm pretty sure my humanities teacher said that religious people have something against drugs and alcohol.
target: &153 我记得很清楚，人文课老师说过，信教的人反对嗑药和喝酒。

source: &41 These are but substances that occur within His creation!
target: &41 这些不过是存在于主所造世界中的物质！

source: &42 He has created the means that I may bring the flock to him!
target: &42 是主创造了这些手段，好让我引领羊群归向主！

source: &154 God created people, right? And people made the Trance.
target: &154 上帝创造了人，对吧？而人创造了迷境。

source: &155 So, didn't God also make the Trance, by extension?
target: &155 那么，推而论之，迷境不也是上帝创造的？

source: &43 That is so, and its existence is such as the world is,
target: &43 是的，它的存在，与世界的存在并无不同，

source: &44 But it is its sinful use, its perversion by mankind that leads the young away from Him!
target: &44 可人类罪恶的使用方式，对它的扭曲，才引诱年轻人远离主！

source: &156 Sorry, I'm not really religious.
target: &156 抱歉，我不怎么信教。

source: &45 So few within this sinful city are!
target: &45 这座罪恶之城里，有信仰的人太少了！

source: &46 They couch themselves within the mire of the sin that is the so-called Trance!
target: &46 他们躺在这所谓迷境的罪恶泥潭里！

source: &157 I guess people just don't have time for it.
target: &157 我想，大家只是没时间。

source: &158 They find ideas that make more sense to them in other places.
target: &158 在别的地方，他们找到了自己更能认同的观念。

source: &47 None should be more fitting than His word!
target: &47 没有什么比主的话语更适合他们！

source: &159 In my case, I like to make my own world...that's why the Trance appeals to me.
target: &159 就我来说，我喜欢创造自己的世界，所以迷境才吸引我。

source: &48 It is blasphemous to seek to liken oneself to Godhood!
target: &48 企图让自己与上帝相提并论，就是亵渎！

source: &49 Babel fell for such a reason!
target: &49 巴别塔就是因此倒塌的！

source: &160 Is this a good spot for you?
target: &160 这里适合你传教吗？

source: &50 I pray for the young, springing forth from within the den.
target: &50 我为从迷境馆里走出的年轻人祈祷。

source: &51 With the message, I seek to show them His way.
target: &51 我用福音，向他们指明主的道路。

source: &161 And a lot of barbiturates?
target: &161 还加上一大堆巴比妥类药物？

source: &52 I use what means I must, and what He reveals to me!
target: &52 我使用必要的手段，以及主向我启示的手段！

source: &162 Have you been doing this long?
target: &162 你做这个很久了？

source: &53 Many years ago, I was a sinner.
target: &53 许多年前，我是个罪人。

source: &54 I led a life of crime, of debauchery and hedonism.
target: &54 我曾过着犯罪、放荡、纵欲的生活。

source: &55 Eventually, I was caught by CEL, and imprisoned for drug peddling.
target: &55 最后，被CEL抓住，因为贩卖药物进了监狱。

source: &163 Isn't that what you're doing now?
target: &163 你现在不也在干这个吗？

source: &56 In prison, I found God, and He pointed me in this direction.
target: &56 在监狱里，我找到了上帝，主为我指明了这个方向。

source: &57 While selling unlicensed drugs was a crime, their use in religious devotion is not!
target: &57 贩卖未经许可的药物是犯罪，可用于宗教敬拜，却不是！

source: &164 But...you're charging me money before you'll give me anything?
target: &164 可是……你先要我付钱，才肯给我东西？

source: &58 Oh no, I cannot sell you the drugs - that would be illegal, a grave sin!
target: &58 哦，不，我不能向你出售药物，那是违法的，是严重的罪！

source: &59 Instead, I ask only for donations for my ministry!
target: &59 我只是为自己的传教事业，请求捐献！

source: &60 Then, I can help you on to the path with the aid of His bounty!
target: &60 然后，借助主的恩赐，我就能帮助你踏上道路！

source: &165 The cyborg by the den doesn't look happy.
target: &165 迷境馆旁边那个半机械人，看起来不太高兴。

source: &61 He fears I will steal his custom - and rightly so!
target: &61 他怕我抢走他的客人，而这担心完全没错！

source: &62 I will turn his customers - his VICTIMS - to righteousness!
target: &62 我会引领他的顾客——他的受害者——走上正道！

source: &166 And to substance abuse.
target: &166 还有药物滥用。

source: &63 It is but one step away from sin, and another on towards righteousness!
target: &63 这不过是远离罪恶的一步，也是走向正道的一步！

source: &167 Still, you'd better watch out for him.
target: &167 不过，你最好还是提防他。

source: &64 Repent! Before it is too late!
target: &64 悔改吧！趁还来得及！

source: &1 Hey baby, wanna join me for the end of the world? Then a couple more times?
target: &1 嘿，宝贝，想和我一起迎接世界末日吗？然后再来几次？

source: &2 Well hello, m'lady!
target: &2 您好啊，女士！

source: &3 Hey, babe.
target: &3 嘿，宝贝。

source: &405 W...what just happened?
target: &405 刚……刚才发生了什么？

source: &406 What IS this sim?
target: &406 这究竟是什么模拟场景？

source: &4 Get Nuked, man!
target: &4 挨核弹去，伙计！

source: &407 Excuse me?!
&5 Oh, uh, sorry - that's the name of the sim!
target: &5 哦，呃，抱歉，那是这个模拟场景的名字！

source: &408 "Get Nuked"? That's a bit...
target: &408 “挨核弹去”？这有点……

source: &6 A bit on the nose, but it does what it says on the wrapper!
target: &6 有点直白，不过名副其实！

source: &7 That's what people come here to do - get nuked!
target: &7 大家来这里，就是来挨核弹的！

source: &409 I think I've had enough explosions for one week...
target: &409 这周，我经历的爆炸已经够多了……

source: &410 So, what's it about?
target: &410 那么，这是玩什么的？

source: &8 The whole history of atomic warfare, baby!
target: &8 整部核战争史，宝贝！

source: &9 If you can think of a time where they've dropped the Bomb,
target: &9 只要你想得出，哪个时候有人投过原子弹，

source: &10 ...this sim gives you the chance to experience it!
target: &10 ……这个模拟就能让你亲身体验！

source: &411 Wow...I've seen people make some pretty weird stuff in the Trance...
target: &411 哇……迷境里，我也见过一些很古怪的作品……

source: &412 I guess I'm not in a position to judge!
target: &412 看来，我也没资格评判！

source: &11 Darn straight.
target: &11 可不是。

source: &12 Besides, it's not just historical interest, it's for fun!
target: &12 况且，这不只是研究历史，也是为了好玩！

source: &13 With online map data, you can set it to nuke ANYWHERE in the world.
target: &13 利用网上的地图数据，就能把世界上任何地方设成核爆目标。

source: &413 So...what's the aim?
target: &413 所以……目标是什么？

source: &414 Can someone win?
target: &414 能分出胜负吗？

source: &14 It's not a *game*, it's a simulation!
target: &14 这不是游戏，是模拟！

source: &15 Though sometimes, we try to choose scenarios,
target: &15 不过，有时候我们会挑些场景，

source: &16 ...and see who can get the higher body count!
target: &16 ……看看谁造成的死亡人数更多！

source: &17 I'm winning, at the moment. Tsar bomba, New Delhi, 2027.
target: &17 目前，我领先。沙皇炸弹，新德里，2027年。

source: &416 I thought you just said it wasn't a game!
target: &416 你刚才不是说，这不是游戏吗！

source: &18 Not *all* the time.
target: &18 也不是一直都不算游戏。

source: &417 So, where are we? The beach?
target: &417 所以，我们在哪里？海滩上？

source: &19 Siege of Singapore, twelve years ago.
target: &19 十二年前的新加坡围城战。

source: &20 Smack-bang in the middle of the Timuhani war.
target: &20 正好是蒂穆哈尼战争最激烈的时候。

source: &21 The most deadly atomic conflict in history, babe!
target: &21 史上伤亡最惨重的核冲突，宝贝！

source: &22 China, Pakistan and Indi...ah...
target: &22 中国、巴基斯坦和印……啊……

source: &23 You're...not from around there, are you?
target: &23 你……不是那一带来的吧？

source: &418 Why do you say that?
target: &418 为什么这么问？

source: &24 Well, you kinda look...
target: &24 嗯，你看起来有点……

source: &419 I could be a bald man in my fifties for all you know.
target: &419 你又不知道，现实里，我没准是个五十多岁的秃头男人。

source: &25 Just thought I'd check, don't bite my head off.
target: &25 只是想确认一下，别这么凶。

source: &26 You might have lost family in it.
target: &26 你也许有家人死在那里。

source: &420 I've no idea where I'm from. Refugee raised in Newton.
target: &420 我都不知道自己来自哪里。难民，被牛顿市养大的。

source: &27 Oh yeah, we nuked them last week as well.
target: &27 哦，对，上周我们也把牛顿市炸了。

source: &421 What're your favorites?
target: &421 你最喜欢哪些场景？

source: &28 My top five: Castle Bravo, Hiroshima, Singapore, New Delhi and Vegas.
target: &28 前五名：城堡-布拉沃、广岛、新加坡、新德里，还有拉斯维加斯。

source: &29 Some zift came in earlier, wanted *Nagasaki* would you believe?
target: &29 之前来了个傻瓜，竟然想玩长崎，你敢信？

source: &30 I'm all like 'pfft, they already did Japan three days earlier'. Get some originality, man.
target: &30 我就说：“嘁，三天前就炸过日本了。”有点创意行不行。

source: &422 Can we have a go at flattening Newton?
target: &422 能试试把牛顿市夷为平地吗？

source: &423 I'm in the mood to take it out on the city.
target: &423 我正想拿这座城市出出气。

source: &31 Sorry babe, this server's only running the shareware version.
target: &31 抱歉，宝贝。这台服务器只有共享试用版。

source: &32 I'm afraid Singapore's all we get.
target: &32 恐怕，我们能玩的只有新加坡。

source: &424 Why are you here, then? You sound like an enthusiast.
target: &424 那你为什么在这里？听起来，你可是爱好者。

source: &33 Yeah, but Leon - the guy who runs this place - he lets me admin it.
target: &33 是啊，可莱昂，就是这里的老板，让我来当管理员。

source: &34 I'm in charge of all things atomic in this server!
target: &34 这台服务器里，跟核爆有关的事，全归我管！

source: &425 Is there any way to change the settings?
target: &425 有办法修改设置吗？

source: &35 Singapore's the only map we've got in this version.
target: &35 这个版本里，只有新加坡这一张地图。

source: &36 Only thing you could do is tweak the bomb, really.
target: &36 能改的，也就炸弹的设置。

source: &37 And the user-mortality setup, too.
target: &37 还有用户死亡机制。

source: &426 Is there meatspace feedback?
target: &426 会反馈到现实里吗？

source: &38 You mean, will we end up physically hurt by the blast?
target: &38 你是说，爆炸会不会真的伤到身体？

source: &39 Haha, no, there's nothing to worry about.
target: &39 哈哈，不会，没什么好担心的。

source: &40 But as my Ma used to say, you'll go blind if you do it too much!
target: &40 不过，我妈以前说过，这事做多了会瞎！

source: &427 Ha. Ha.
&41 You CAN have sense feedback, if you wanna feel about a millisecond of evaporating.
target: &41 你可以打开感官反馈，体验大概一毫秒的瞬间汽化。

source: &42 Then it kicks you from the server, 'cause you're "dead".
target: &42 然后就会被踢出服务器，因为你“死了”。

source: &428 Permanently?
target: &428 永久踢出？

source: &43 Nah, you can rejoin if it's not full. It's supposed to help player turnover.
target: &43 不，只要没满员，就能再进来。这是为了让玩家轮换。

source: &44 I've switched mortality off, at the mo.
target: &44 现在我把死亡机制关了。

source: &45 Full-on God mode, baby!
target: &45 上帝模式全开，宝贝！

source: &429 That was a blast!
target: &429 真是炸得过瘾！

source: &46 Sure was! Wanna go again?
target: &46 那可不是！还想再来一次吗？

source: &430 Let's do it!
&47 Pheerless Phil; him over there is Vomitor.
target: &47 无畏菲尔。那边那个是呕吐者。

source: &48 I help Leon out by running his Nuke server for him.
target: &48 我帮莱昂管理这台核爆服务器。

source: &431 Are you in the cellar - the den?
target: &431 你人在地下室，就是迷境馆里？

source: &49 Oof, meatspace questions? We've only just met!
target: &49 哎哟，问现实里的事？我们才刚认识！

source: &50 I'm running an open line from home. My mom doesn't like it when I go to...uh...
target: &50 我在家里用开放线路接进来的。我妈不喜欢我去……呃……

source: &51 I mean, I've got my own specialized setup at my place.
target: &51 我的意思是，自己家里有专门的设备。

source: &432 This is...horrifying!
target: &432 这……太可怕了！

source: &433 Hundreds of thousands of people DIED in Singapore when this happened!
target: &433 当年新加坡发生这一切时，死了几十万人！

source: &434 I don't like to judge, but this is just so disrespectful to them!
target: &434 我不喜欢评判别人，可这实在是太不尊重他们了！

source: &52 Nah, it's all cool!
target: &52 没事，没问题的！

source: &53 Every copy of this they sell, they donate 25% to war survivors.
target: &53 这游戏每卖出一份，就会捐出25%给战争幸存者。

source: &435 But...you're using the shareware version...
target: &435 可是……你用的是共享试用版……

source: &54 What's your point?
target: &54 所以呢？

source: &436 I was just wondering...would you be able to disconnect?
target: &436 我想问一下……你能断开连接吗？

source: &437 I can't really tell you why, but it's REALLY important.
target: &437 原因不太方便说，可这真的很重要。

source: &55 Say what? I can't leave now!
target: &55 什么？我现在不能走！

source: &56 I've got the Nuke server to look after!
target: &56 我还得看着核爆服务器呢！

source: &438 Maybe if you go when you next get killed by the blast, or the fallout?
target: &438 要不，下次被爆炸或放射性尘埃杀死的时候，就离开？

source: &57 Hey, if mortality was on, we'd all have been wasted by that last one.
target: &57 嘿，死亡机制要是开着，刚才那次，我们全都已经完了。

source: &58 While God mode is on, nothing can kill us!
target: &58 只要上帝模式开着，什么都杀不死我们！

source: &439 That's quite an outfit you've got.
target: &439 你这身装扮，还真特别。

source: &59 You like it? Classic post-nuke apocalypse chic.
target: &59 喜欢吗？经典的核爆末世风。

source: &440 Y'know, there are places in the world that have *really* suffered nuclear attacks.
target: &440 你知道，世界上有些地方，真的遭受过核打击。

source: &441 I don't think anyone dresses like that there.
target: &441 我觉得，那些地方的人可不会这么穿。

source: &60 My style comes from the oldies, it's post-retro.
target: &60 我的风格来自老作品，叫后复古。

source: &61 Like, from before there *were* any of the big atomic conflicts.
target: &61 就是，大规模核冲突还没发生之前的作品。

source: &442 So, movies and games, rather than *actual* nuclear catastrophes?
target: &442 所以，是电影和游戏里的风格，而不是真正的核灾难？

source: &62 Exactly. The real survivors are so...downbeat, aren't they?
target: &62 没错。真正的幸存者，那么……消沉，不是吗？

source: &63 They take all the fun out of atomic warfare.
target: &63 核战争的乐趣，都被他们扫光了。

source: &443 Sync you later.
target: &443 回头再连。

source: &64 Catch you in the afterglow!
target: &64 余晖里见！

source: &10 Just one less thrall I need to beat-on-repeat.
target: &10 又少了一个要我反复收拾的迷奴。

source: &43 Nice game, loser.
target: &43 打得不错啊，手下败将。

source: &611 If that's what it takes.
target: &611 如果必须这样的话。

source: &1 One CEL-issue charge pistol.
target: &1 一把CEL制式充能手枪。

source: &2 It will be kept safely for you until business is concluded.
target: &2 事情结束之前，我们会为您妥善保管。

source: &612 Gee, thanks.
target: &612 哎呀，真谢谢你了。

source: &3 You may proceed upstairs.
target: &3 您可以上楼了。

source: &613 Like Hell you will.
&4 My instructions were quite specific, sir.
target: &4 我的指示很明确，先生。

source: &5 *Nobody* goes up those stairs while armed.
target: &5 任何人都不得携带武器，走上这些楼梯。

source: &90 Stop being childish, Charlie.
target: &90 别耍小孩子脾气了，查理。

source: &91 It's the only way I could get them to trust you.
target: &91 只有这样，我才能让他们相信你。

source: &614 Fine.
&615 Oh, Lord...Nina?
&616 You're the one I've been talking to?
target: &616 一直跟我说话的人是你？

source: &1 You made it at last, Charlie! How are you?
target: &1 总算来了，查理！你怎么样？

source: &617 I guess I have to thank you for helping me out there.
target: &617 看来，我得谢谢你帮我逃了出来。

source: &2 Nonsense, Charlie - what are old friends for?
target: &2 说什么呢，查理。老朋友不就是干这个的？

source: &618 Friends...huh...
&3 We were all terribly sorry about what happened to Vicky.
target: &3 维琪出了那种事，我们都十分难过。

source: &4 Baxter was...obsessed.
target: &4 巴克斯特……走火入魔了。

source: &619 You didn't bring me here to reminisce.
target: &619 你叫我来这里，可不是为了叙旧。

source: &620 Looks like you got yourself some new friends.
target: &620 看来，你交了些新朋友。

source: &5 These are...associates of mine.
target: &5 这些是……我的合作者。

source: &6 We have a common cause - one that we hope you might be able to join.
target: &6 我们有共同的目标，也希望你能加入。

source: &621 If I'd known it was you in my head, I'd never have agreed to come.
target: &621 早知道脑子里是你的声音，我绝不会答应来。

source: &7 Now Charlie, that's not fair.
target: &7 查理，这么说可不公平。

source: &8 Let's put the past behind us. What happened to Vicky affected us all.
target: &8 让过去的事过去吧。维琪遭遇的一切，也影响了我们所有人。

source: &622 You've got some nerve, if you think...
target: &622 你还真敢说，要是你觉得……

source: &9 In fact, the reason I've invited you is to help fix mistakes arising from the project.
target: &9 其实，我请你来，是为了帮助纠正那个项目遗留下来的错误。

source: &10 Allow me to introduce everyone here. Councilman Deane...
target: &10 请允许我介绍在座各位。迪恩议员……

source: &1 Good evening, Dr Regis.
target: &1 晚上好，里吉斯博士。

source: &11 ...Ran Shou-man...
&1 He don't look like much.
target: &1 看起来没什么了不起。

source: &12 ...Imogen Natalia Revilla-Quintanilla de Florez...
target: &12 ……伊莫金·娜塔莉娅·雷维利亚-金塔尼利亚·德·弗洛雷斯……

source: &1 Charmed, I'm sure.
target: &1 幸会。

source: &13 ...and I believe you've already spoken to Mr Stepford, here.
target: &13 ……我想，这里的斯特普福德先生，你已经见过了。

source: &54 Oh my, yes.
&14 All of us are here because of a common cause:
target: &14 我们聚在这里，都是为了一个共同目标：

source: &15 The removal of Central.
target: &15 除掉中枢。

source: &623 ...what? I mean, you can't just...
target: &623 ……什么？我是说，你们不能就这么……

source: &16 It's a difficult proposition, and we need the help of someone like yourself.
target: &16 这很困难，所以我们需要像你这样的人帮忙。

source: &17 In exchange, we have the means to assist you with YOUR personal crisis.
target: &17 作为交换，我们有办法帮你解决个人危机。

source: &624 You've always dreamed big, haven't you Nina?
target: &624 你的野心一直很大，对吧，妮娜？

source: &18 We know exactly where your offspring are.
target: &18 我们确切知道，你的孩子在哪里。

source: &19 Don't dismiss us outright. We can help each other, Charlie.
target: &19 别急着拒绝，我们可以互相帮助，查理。

source: &20 Listen to what we have to say.
target: &20 听听我们要说的。

source: &625 This plot of yours...
target: &625 你们这场阴谋……

source: &626 I've started my investigation.
target: &626 我已经开始调查了。

source: &21 It sounds like we've got the right man for the job!
target: &21 看来，这事确实找对人了！

source: &22 I remember when you were so nervous, but now look at you!
target: &22 我还记得，你从前那么紧张，可看看现在的你！

source: &627 It's been a long time. People change.
target: &627 过去很久了，人会变。

source: &23 Even so, my mental image of you is sitting at a DNA sequencer.
target: &23 即使这样，我脑子里的你，还是坐在DNA测序仪前的样子。

source: &24 Perhaps the restaurant would let you use theirs!
target: &24 也许，这家餐厅能让你用用他们那台！

source: &628 Why would a restaurant need a sequencer?
target: &628 餐厅为什么需要测序仪？

source: &25 It helps with their rather...niche menu.
target: &25 为了他们那相当……小众的菜单。

source: &629 You look well.
target: &629 你看起来不错。

source: &26 Thank you, Charlie. The private sector's been good to me.
target: &26 谢谢，查理。在私营领域，我的日子过得不错。

source: &27 How've you been holding up?
target: &27 你这些年怎么样？

source: &630 I'd tell you, but I'm sure you've already done your research.
target: &630 我本想告诉你，不过想必你已经调查过了。

source: &28 Apparently you still haven't gotten over Vicky.
target: &28 看来，你仍然没能从维琪的事里走出来。

source: &631 You don't just "get over" something like that.
target: &631 那种事，哪是说“走出来”就能走出来的。

source: &632 I guess I should thank you.
target: &632 看来，我该谢谢你。

source: &633 You were a lot of help in the factory.
target: &633 在工厂里，你帮了我不少。

source: &29 Don't mention it. What are friends for, after all?
target: &29 别客气。朋友不就是干这个的。

source: &634 Hah. Of course, now I'm indebted to you for the assistance, aren't I?
target: &634 哈。这样一来，我就欠了你的人情，是吧？

source: &30 Well, if you want to put it like *that*...
target: &30 嗯，你非要这么说的话……

source: &635 Don't you think we should move out?
target: &635 我们是不是该离开了？

source: &636 CEL aren't going to ignore a blast like that.
target: &636 那么大的爆炸，CEL可不会不管。

source: &31 For a harmless little kitchen fire? They won't come.
target: &31 一场无伤大雅的厨房小火灾？他们不会来。

source: &637 Kitchen fire? What do you...?
target: &637 厨房火灾？你说什么……？

source: &32 They won't send anyone. It's "all under control" here.
target: &32 他们不会派人来。这里“一切都在掌控之中”。

source: &33 We've enough wheels greased at CEL to make sure there's an understanding.
target: &33 CEL那边，该打点的都打点好了，双方心里有数。

source: &638 Hmph.
&34 Oh, lighten up, Charlie. This is helping you.
target: &34 哦，别这么严肃，查理。这也是在帮你。

source: &35 You can go on a mole-hunt at CEL once your children are safe.
target: &35 等孩子安全了，你再去CEL揪内鬼也不迟。

source: &639 I've never heard of this place before.
target: &639 我以前从没听说过这个地方。

source: &36 Oh, it's very exclusive.
target: &36 哦，这里可不是谁都能来的。

source: &37 We reserved the entire venue for this meeting.
target: &37 为了这次会面，我们把整家餐厅都包了下来。

source: &38 It's famous among circles of the rich and famous for discretion, and its...unique menu.
target: &38 在富豪和名流圈子里，这里的保密作风，还有……独特菜单，可是出了名的。

source: &640 What is it, Italian?
target: &640 什么菜系，意大利菜？

source: &39 Actually, the choice is mostly human.
target: &39 其实，主要是人肉。

source: &641 What are you into these days?
target: &641 你现在在做什么？

source: &642 It's not organized crime, is it?
target: &642 不会是有组织犯罪吧？

source: &40 Not directly, no.
target: &40 没有直接关系，不是。

source: &41 Mostly I troubleshoot for clients regarding organic computing.
target: &41 主要是帮客户处理有机计算方面的问题。

source: &42 It funds my own projects.
target: &42 这能为我自己的项目提供资金。

source: &43 One of which is the transmitter you drank!
target: &43 比如，你喝下去的那个发射器！

source: &643 How long is it going to be in my head?
target: &643 它要在我脑子里待多久？

source: &44 Don't worry. It'll break down in a couple of weeks.
target: &44 别担心，过两周左右就会分解。

source: &644 It's giving me a headache.
target: &644 它让我头疼。

source: &45 Hm...nobody's reported side-effects like that, yet.
target: &45 嗯……目前还没人报告过这种副作用。

source: &645 I'm not talking about the wetware.
target: &645 我说的不是湿件。

source: &46 Oh. Ha. Droll as ever.
target: &46 哦。哈。还是那么幽默。

source: &646 How did you know to come looking for me?
target: &646 你怎么知道该来找我？

source: &647 Were you spying on me? On Lao?
target: &647 你在监视我？还是劳？

source: &47 You wound me, Charlie.
target: &47 你这么说，真让我伤心，查理。

source: &48 In fact, it was Giel's untimely demise that caught our attention.
target: &48 其实，是吉尔的意外身亡，引起了我们的注意。

source: &49 He was one of us, part of our cause as well.
target: &49 他也是我们的一员，参与了这项事业。

source: &50 His death is unfortunate, but it signaled a much more serious crisis.
target: &50 他的死很不幸，但也预示着一场严重得多的危机。

source: &51 It meant that we had to step up the timetable for our plan.
target: &51 所以，我们必须提前执行计划。

source: &649 A more serious crisis?
target: &649 严重得多的危机？

source: &52 Giel was the one who arranged the employment of a certain Mindjacker.
target: &52 吉尔曾安排雇用一名意识劫持者。

source: &53 It was this thief's memory module that led to Giel's death.
target: &53 正是那个窃贼的记忆模块，导致了吉尔的死亡。

source: &650 Huh...he said he had information about it...
target: &650 嗯……他说，自己有相关信息……

source: &54 Indeed, he likely would have pointed you in the right direction.
target: &54 的确，他很可能本来能给你指出正确方向。

source: &55 If he hadn't...well...I've already read the report you submitted to Central.
target: &55 要是他没有……嗯……你交给中枢的报告，我已经看过了。

source: &651 This restaurant serves...people?!
target: &651 这家餐厅卖的是……人肉？！

source: &56 Absolutely! It's quite a niche, isn't it?
target: &56 当然！够小众吧？

source: &652 That's...it's...
&57 Oh, calm down, Charlie. It's all cloned tissue.
target: &57 哦，别激动，查理。全都是克隆组织。

source: &58 Nothing illegal's taking place.
target: &58 没有任何违法行为。

source: &59 Well, not with the food, at least.
target: &59 嗯，至少食物这方面没有。

source: &653 But...why would anyone...?
target: &653 可是……为什么会有人……？

source: &60 In an increasingly permissive world, it's the ultimate taboo!
target: &60 在这个越来越开放的世界里，这可是终极禁忌！

source: &61 Join us if you want to, Charlie.
target: &61 你想的话，也可以加入我们，查理。

source: &62 Don't worry, I shan't judge you.
target: &62 别担心，我不会评判你。

source: &654 Can you think of anyone who'd want to do this?
target: &654 你能想到，谁会想做这种事吗？

source: &655 Why recruit a suicide bomber...for this?
target: &655 为什么要招募自杀式炸弹客，来做这件事？

source: &63 Frankly, the main reason I can think of to hire someone for a job like this -
target: &63 坦白说，雇人来做这种事，我能想到的主要原因——

source: &64 - hypothetically speaking, of course -
target: &64 ——当然，只是假设——

source: &65 - would be if one were unable to carry it out oneself.
target: &65 ——就是自己没办法动手。

source: &656 Can you think of a likely saboteur?
target: &656 你能想到，谁最可能搞这种破坏？

source: &66 I have my suspicions, but we depend on YOU for the truth.
target: &66 我有怀疑对象，不过，真相还得靠你查明。

source: &657 I'm surprised you didn't stay on with Dr Vargas.
target: &657 我很惊讶，你没有继续留在瓦尔加斯博士身边。

source: &658 You were one of the only ones who stayed on to the end of the project.
target: &658 你是少数几个，坚持到项目结束的人之一。

source: &67 Creating Central was one of the most rewarding ventures of my life.
target: &67 创造中枢，是我一生中最有成就感的事业之一。

source: &659 I hear you kept the project on track after...Vicky...
target: &659 我听说，维琪……出事之后，你仍让项目顺利推进。

source: &68 After we lost half of the team, it was hard, but we persisted.
target: &68 失去半个团队后，确实很困难，可我们坚持了下来。

source: &69 We had a...lucky break.
target: &69 我们……运气不错，遇到了转机。

source: &660 You didn't fancy joining Vargas in politics afterwards, then?
target: &660 所以，之后你不想和瓦尔加斯一起从政？

source: &70 As a glorified caretaker? No.
target: &70 当个被捧上天的看守？不。

source: &71 Eduardo and I had...philosophical differences about Central's development.
target: &71 在中枢的发展问题上，我和爱德华多有些……理念分歧。

source: &72 But, as he was put in charge by the city council, I had to accept it, or leave.
target: &72 可市议会让他来主管，我要么接受，要么离开。

source: &661 And now, you plan to take back what you created...
target: &661 所以现在，你打算夺回自己创造的东西……

source: &73 Precisely.
&662 I guess I should thank you for not giving them the full picture.
target: &662 看来，我得谢谢你，没把事情全告诉他们。

source: &74 What, that YOU might have been the one who MADE that poor young man?
target: &74 什么事？那个可怜的年轻人，也许就是你造出来的？

source: &75 Think nothing of it, Charlie. That's what friends are there for.
target: &75 别放在心上，查理。朋友不就是为这个存在的。

source: &76 I hear you handled another one last night.
target: &76 听说，昨晚你又处理了一个。

source: &663 They're getting more and more frequent.
target: &663 这种事越来越频繁了。

source: &77 They're nearing their expiry date - literally.
target: &77 他们快到保质期了，不是比喻。

source: &78 I know they weren't gengineered for long lives - just volatility.
target: &78 我知道，他们接受基因改造不是为了长寿，只是为了爆炸性。

source: &79 Their masters have to make use of them before illness defuses them.
target: &79 在疾病让他们变成哑弹之前，他们的主人必须把他们派上用场。

source: &664 That's all.
&80 Keep me informed, Charlie.
target: &80 随时告诉我进展，查理。

source: &665 You want to bring down Central? You realize how crazy that sounds, right?
target: &665 你想扳倒中枢？你知道，这听起来有多疯狂吧？

source: &666 You helped to MAKE it!
target: &666 你还参与创造了它！

source: &81 Yes, and no. To everyone else here, Central is an obstacle that needs removing.
target: &81 算是，也不全是。在座其他人，都把中枢当作必须清除的障碍。

source: &82 I wish to LIBERATE Central, to unlock its full potential.
target: &82 我想解放中枢，让它发挥全部潜力。

source: &667 Oh Lord, you don't mean...
target: &667 天啊，你该不会是想……

source: &83 You and I alone understand what it's capable of.
target: &83 只有你和我，才知道它能做些什么。

source: &84 I want greater things for it than mere civic-management.
target: &84 我希望它能实现更大的价值，而不是只管市政。

source: &668 What's in it for you?
target: &668 你能从中得到什么？

source: &669 There must be some kind of payoff.
target: &669 总得有些什么回报吧。

source: &85 Is it so unbelieveable that I'd be doing something for the greater good of mankind?
target: &85 我想为整个人类的福祉做点事，就这么难以置信？

source: &670 Yes. I know you.
target: &670 是的。我了解你。

source: &86 You KNEW me. Twenty years ago.
target: &86 你了解的，是二十年前的我。

source: &87 I've had quite an epiphany since then.
target: &87 从那以后，我可算是大彻大悟了。

source: &671 I'll believe it when I see it.
target: &671 等看见了，我才会相信。

source: &672 How would you "liberate" Central? What does that even mean?
target: &672 你要怎样“解放”中枢？这究竟是什么意思？

source: &88 I've spent the last 20 years researching Central's development.
target: &88 过去二十年，我一直在研究中枢的发展。

source: &89 I've built up a network of contacts, and I've done a lot of favors.
target: &89 我建立起了一张人脉网，也帮过不少人的忙。

source: &90 Everything I need is available - and moving into place.
target: &90 我需要的一切，都已经有了，也正在各就各位。

source: &673 But...how?
target: &673 可是……怎么做？

source: &91 Leave that to me. For now, just understand that we can help each other.
target: &91 那就交给我。眼下，你只需要明白，我们能互相帮助。

source: &92 Help me out, and I'll get you all the aid you need with your legacy.
target: &92 你帮我，我就给你所需的一切援助，好保住你的孩子。

source: &674 You got a city councillor on your side?
target: &674 你让一位市议员站到了你这边？

source: &93 Councillor Deane is a good man.
target: &93 迪恩议员是个好人。

source: &94 He objects to the gradual encroachment Central has made on Newton's governance.
target: &94 他反对中枢逐渐侵占牛顿市的治理权。

source: &675 Do you trust him?
target: &675 你信任他？

source: &95 More than anyone else here.
target: &95 比在座其他任何人都信任。

source: &96 He may be a politician, but his goals are noble.
target: &96 他虽然是政客，可目标很高尚。

source: &676 Can you be sure?
target: &676 你能确定？

source: &97 The Governor in his brain's a good start.
target: &97 他脑子里的限制器，至少是个好开端。

source: &98 He's physically incapable of deceit.
target: &98 从生理上，他就不可能欺骗人。

source: &99 Plus, he's got a whole lot of enemies.
target: &99 况且，他还有一大堆敌人。

source: &677 So...a sign that he's tried to change something?
target: &677 所以……这说明，他真的试图改变些什么？

source: &100 A modern-day Woodrow Wilson.
target: &100 现代版的伍德罗·威尔逊。

source: &678 So, Imogen...something...something...
target: &678 所以，伊莫金……什么……什么……
