source: &679 ...yeah. How is someone like THAT on your team?
target: &679 ……嗯。那样的人，怎么会加入你们？

source: &101 It's a terrible shame...she likely wasn't aware of what she was getting into.
target: &101 真是太遗憾了……她大概并不知道，自己卷进了什么。

source: &680 Then why was she here?
target: &680 那为什么她会在这里？

source: &102 She gave the impression of a vacant socialite, but she was smarter than she looked.
target: &102 她看起来像个没脑子的名媛，可实际比表面上聪明。

source: &103 Make no mistake, if any of us were to be lost, it's her that I'll miss the most.
target: &103 别误会，要说我们中间失去了谁，我最想念的一定是她。

source: &681 You USED her, Nina.
target: &681 你利用了她，妮娜。

source: &104 We are all users here, Charlie.
target: &104 我们在座的，谁没利用过别人呢，查理。

source: &105 It's how we got where we are. Even dear Imogen.
target: &105 我们就是这么走到今天这一步的。连亲爱的伊莫金，也一样。

source: &106 I know you're probably not up to date on these things, but she's a celebrity.
target: &106 你大概不太关注这些事，可她是一位名人。

source: &107 And besides, we go back a LONG way.
target: &107 况且，我们认识很久了。

source: &682 You're using her, then?
target: &682 所以，你是在利用她？

source: &108 Charlie, I'm hurt! Does that sound like something I'd do?
target: &108 查理，真让我伤心！听起来，我像是会做那种事的人吗？

source: &109 Well. I can assure you she's not here for her personality.
target: &109 好吧。我可以保证，让她加入可不是因为她的人格魅力。

source: &110 She volunteered her assistance in any capacity she could offer.
target: &110 她自愿提供一切力所能及的帮助。

source: &684 Ran Shou-man...Chinese?
target: &684 冉·寿曼……中国人？

source: &111 Nearly. Greater Han Republic.
target: &111 差不多。大汉共和国。

source: &112 Mr Ran operates one of the largest manufacturing dynasties in Asia.
target: &112 冉先生经营着亚洲规模最大的制造业家族企业之一。

source: &685 Completely putting aside his politics, of course?
target: &685 当然，要完全撇开他的政治立场？

source: &113 Of course. If I need something made, I speak to Mr Ran.
target: &113 当然。需要制造什么，我就找冉先生。

source: &114 Trust me, this project needs a lot of specialized capital.
target: &114 相信我，这个项目需要大量专用资源。

source: &686 We'll see how nice he is if you get your way, and get Central out of the picture.
target: &686 等你如愿，把中枢赶出局，再看看他到底有多好。

source: &687 Stepford's an...unusual man, isn't he?
target: &687 斯特普福德……挺不寻常，是吧？

source: &115 That's one way of putting it.
target: &115 也可以这么说。

source: &116 Don't discount him, though - he's smarter than he looks.
target: &116 不过，别小看他。他比看起来聪明。

source: &688 I get the feeling a lot of his behavior's an act...constructed...
target: &688 我总觉得，他很多表现都像是在演……刻意构造出来的……

source: &117 You have no idea how close you are with that.
target: &117 你不知道，自己猜得有多接近。

source: &118 He's the one who found where your embryo-snatcher's hiding, though.
target: &118 不过，找到绑走你胚胎的人藏在哪儿的，正是他。

source: &689 He's a hacker?
target: &689 他是黑客？

source: &119 You might say he has a mutual understanding with data systems.
target: &119 可以说，他和数据系统之间，彼此很了解。

source: &690 Let's change the subject.
target: &690 换个话题吧。

source: &691 I found one of your heavies in the kitchen.
target: &691 我在厨房里找到了你的一名打手。

source: &692 Looks like something's knocked it out cold.
target: &692 看起来，不知道什么东西把它弄昏过去了。

source: &55 Oh my, a technical fault no doubt.
target: &55 哦，天哪，肯定是技术故障。

source: &56 May I ask you to show me the defective platform?
target: &56 能请您带我看看有故障的机体吗？

source: &693 Sure, I guess.
target: &693 行吧，应该可以。

source: &57 Excellent! We can't have our firm slandered by accusations of low-quality units.
target: &57 太好了！我们可不能让别人以产品质量差为由，诋毁公司。

source: &694 I've started my investigation of the bombing.
target: &694 我已经开始调查爆炸案了。

source: &58 Oh my, yes?
&59 I can assure you, I had no part in this terrible tragedy.
target: &59 我可以向您保证，这场可怕的悲剧，与我毫无关系。

source: &695 I hear that a lot.
target: &695 这话，我常听。

source: &60 In fact, my core programming prevents me from harming a human being!
target: &60 事实上，我的核心程序禁止我伤害人类！

source: &696 Huh...a synthetic...
&697 I guess you'd be the only one leaving lubricant-oil instead of DNA evidence.
target: &697 看来，只有你会留下润滑油，而不是DNA证据。

source: &61 Oh my no, Dr Regis. My outer dermis is organic tissue.
target: &61 哦，不是这样的，里吉斯博士。我的外层皮肤是有机组织。

source: &62 It's the top of the line, patterned from my creator, Dr Arthur Stepford.
target: &62 这是最高端的产品，照着我的创造者，亚瑟·斯特普福德博士的皮肤做的。

source: &698 Huh. I've been learning a lot about synths these past few days.
target: &698 嗯。这几天，我可学到了不少合成人的知识。

source: &699 So...you have DNA?
target: &699 所以……你有DNA？

source: &63 Indeed. It's delightful skin, don't you think?
target: &63 当然。这皮肤很漂亮，您不觉得吗？

source: &700 Uh...sure?
&64 I go to great pains to keep it moisturised.
target: &64 为了保持水润，我可是费尽心思。

source: &701 So, you want to bring down Central?
target: &701 所以，你想扳倒中枢？

source: &65 Oh my, yes. As does everyone here!
target: &65 哦，当然。在座各位都这么想！

source: &66 Though, for differing reasons.
target: &66 不过，原因各不相同。

source: &702 What does a synth-manufacturer have against Newton's city controller?
target: &702 一个合成人制造商，跟牛顿市的管理者有什么过节？

source: &67 A stake in that which follows, oh yes.
target: &67 中枢之后的局面，会影响我们的利益，当然。

source: &68 If Dr Jeong were simply to remove Central, there would be chaos!
target: &68 郑博士要是直接移除中枢，城市可就要大乱了！

source: &703 The city's central infrastructure would break down...
target: &703 城市的核心基础设施，会停止运转……

source: &69 Precisely! Therefore a replacement would be needed.
target: &69 正是！所以，需要一个替代者。

source: &704 You want to replace Central with a new AI?
target: &704 你想用一个新AI替换中枢？

source: &705 With what?
&70 The new version is simply a retooled model of an existing system.
target: &70 新版本，是把一个现有系统重新改造而成的。

source: &706 Your...own?
target: &706 你……自己的系统？

source: &71 Aha, oh my, no.
target: &71 啊，天哪，不是。

source: &72 It's built from a commercial "Archimedes" model, as used in Eurofed cities.
target: &72 它基于商用的“阿基米德”型号，欧洲联邦的城市也在用。

source: &707 It'll do the job?
target: &707 能胜任吗？

source: &73 Oh my, yes. As well as any civic management AI in Europe.
target: &73 哦，当然。和欧洲任何一个市政管理AI一样好。

source: &74 But, thanks to Stepford's personality-matrix engineering,
target: &74 而且，凭借斯特普福德的人格矩阵工程技术，

source: &75 ...it shall act and speak just as its predecessor, Central.
target: &75 ……它的言谈举止，都将与前任中枢毫无差别。

source: &708 With you holding its leash.
target: &708 只是牵绳子的人，换成了你们。

source: &76 Every system needs fine-tuning, Dr Regis.
target: &76 每个系统都需要微调，里吉斯博士。

source: &709 Won't services suffer?
target: &709 城市服务不会受影响？

source: &710 I know Central, it's orders of magnitude more powerful than an Archimedes.
target: &710 我了解中枢，它比阿基米德强了好几个数量级。

source: &77 All unnecessary for its role, Dr Regis.
target: &77 统筹市政，用不上那些能力，里吉斯博士。

source: &78 Our Archimedes-in-Central's-clothing will perform as needed, oh yes.
target: &78 我们这个披着中枢外衣的阿基米德，会按需要履行职责，当然。

source: &711 Your connection to Giel - it was more than synth-salesman, wasn't it?
target: &711 你跟吉尔的关系，不只是合成人销售员和客户吧？

source: &79 Oh my, yes. Very astute, Dr Regis.
target: &79 哦，是的。真敏锐，里吉斯博士。

source: &80 Giel was a key part of our group.
target: &80 吉尔是我们团体中的关键人物。

source: &712 Huh...a co-conspirator.
&81 Oh yes, and our link to the criminal underworld, where necessary.
target: &81 哦，是的。必要时，他也是我们联系地下犯罪世界的纽带。

source: &82 I was most disturbed to receive your call regarding his demise.
target: &82 接到您关于他死亡的来电，我十分不安。

source: &83 It signaled to us that immediate action was required.
target: &83 那告诉我们，必须立即行动。

source: &713 You had to step up your plan before things went any further South.
target: &713 在情况进一步恶化之前，你们必须提前执行计划。

source: &140 Oh my, yes.
&714 How did you fall in with someone like Nina Jeong?
target: &714 你怎么和妮娜·郑这样的人扯上关系？

source: &84 Dr Jeong has been freelancing with our firm for a number of years.
target: &84 多年来，郑博士一直以自由职业者的身份与本公司合作。

source: &85 Her work in AI has proven invaluable to increased platform survivability.
target: &85 她在AI方面的研究，对提高机体的存活能力，价值无可估量。

source: &715 Working in mental health for synthetics?
target: &715 研究合成人的心理健康？

source: &86 Oh my, yes. She has a number of unique theories of synthetic cognitive development.
target: &86 哦，是的。关于合成人认知的发展，她有一系列独特理论。

source: &87 When she proposed this project to the leadership of the firm...
target: &87 她向公司领导层提出这个项目的时候……

source: &716 She'd wormed her way up the power structure to whisper in management's ear.
target: &716 她早就钻进了权力核心，能在管理层耳边吹风了。

source: &88 Dr Regis, that's a shameful way of putting it!
target: &88 里吉斯博士，您这种说法太不体面了！

source: &89 Though she certainly has a talent for networking.
target: &89 不过，她确实很擅长经营人脉。

source: &90 She has brought together a multitude of skills needed for this role.
target: &90 她聚集了完成这项任务所需的各种人才。

source: &717 You're not just a synthetic salesman, are you?
target: &717 你不只是个合成人销售员，是吧？

source: &91 Oh my, no. Not this particular platform, certainly.
target: &91 哦，不是。至少，这个机体肯定不只是。

source: &718 How do you mean?
target: &718 什么意思？

source: &92 Well, I'm not the only instance of the "Sons of Stepford".
target: &92 嗯，“斯特普福德之子”可不止我这一个实例。

source: &93 There are currently twenty-six platforms running this personality.
target: &93 目前，有二十六个机体运行着这个人格。

source: &719 There's...more than one of you?
target: &719 不止……一个你？

source: &94 Alphabetically ordered, delegated to different roles within the firm.
target: &94 按字母顺序排列，分派到公司里的不同岗位。

source: &95 I, Liam,  handle special tasks, oh my yes.
target: &95 我，利亚姆，负责特殊任务，当然。

source: &96 But we all run the same personality.
target: &96 不过，我们运行的都是同一个人格。

source: &720 Huh...synthetics...
&721 You're a synthetic?
target: &721 你是合成人？

source: &97 Quite so, Dr Regis.
target: &97 正是，里吉斯博士。

source: &722 I should have guessed...there's something not quite right...
target: &722 我早该猜到的……有点不太对劲……

source: &723 I think it's the eyes.
target: &723 我觉得，是眼睛。

source: &98 A specially-built feature of the "Sons" of Stepford, oh my yes.
target: &98 那是斯特普福德“之子”系列的特制设计，当然。

source: &99 Much of my composition, however, is state of the art.
target: &99 不过，我的许多部件，都用的是最先进的技术。

source: &724 A walking advertisement.
target: &724 一块会走路的广告牌。

source: &100 I illustrate the potential for what one can do with a synthetic, Dr Regis.
target: &100 我展示了一个合成人能实现的潜力，里吉斯博士。

source: &101 Many customers have been swayed by the demonstration.
target: &101 很多客户看过演示，就动心了。

source: &725 Feeling better?
target: &725 好些了吗？

source: &102 Oh my, yes. My most sincere thanks, Dr Regis.
target: &102 哦，是的。衷心感谢您，里吉斯博士。

source: &103 You have no idea how uncomfortable I find the wrong body.
target: &103 您根本不知道，待在不合适的身体里，让我有多难受。

source: &726 The outfit makes the man.
target: &726 人靠衣装。

source: &104 Very literally, in my case.
target: &104 在我这个情况里，真就是字面意思。

source: &105 I suppose I shall have to avoid the kitchen.
target: &105 看来，我得避开厨房。

source: &106 I shall instruct the security platforms to do likewise.
target: &106 我也会让安保机体照做。

source: &727 You're the one who found my embryos?
target: &727 找到我胚胎的人，是你？

source: &107 Oh my, yes. We...
&728 Where are they?!
target: &728 他们在哪里？！

source: &108 Dr Regis, while it pains me to say this...
target: &108 里吉斯博士，虽然说这话，我也很难过……

source: &109 We simply can't tell you. Then we would have no bargaining position.
target: &109 可我们确实不能告诉您，否则就没有谈判筹码了。

source: &110 Please, Dr Regis, be assured that they are in no danger at this time.
target: &110 请放心，里吉斯博士。目前，它们没有任何危险。

source: &111 Dr Jeong is the one with whom you must discuss the release of the information.
target: &111 关于透露这条信息的事，您得找郑博士谈。

source: &112 I have been asked not to speak any more of this matter, oh my, no.
target: &112 我被要求，不得再谈论此事，哦，不行。

source: &730 Could the guards have arranged the bombing?
target: &730 守卫们有没有可能策划了爆炸？

source: &731 They're obviously synthetics, but I imagine they're more comfortable with hurting people.
target: &731 显然，他们是合成人，不过，我想他们伤害起人来，会自在得多。

source: &113 They would not be worth much as protection otherwise, oh my, no.
target: &113 不然，他们做护卫可就没什么用处了，当然不行。

source: &114 But each security platform maintains a constant connection to my own systems.
target: &114 不过，每个安保机体，都与我的系统保持着持续连接。

source: &115 Their degree of independence is...limited.
target: &115 它们的自主程度……有限。

source: &732 So if one of them were responsible, I'd have to consider you complicit.
target: &732 所以，如果某个守卫是凶手，我就得把你也列为同谋。

source: &141 Oh my, yes.
&733 Were you aware that this establishment serves HUMAN meat?
target: &733 你知道，这家餐厅供应人肉吗？

source: &116 Oh my, yes. It's delightfully macabre, isn't it?
target: &116 哦，是的。这种阴森的趣味，多迷人，不是吗？

source: &117 I'm sure the experience would be enhanced by being able to eat, of course.
target: &117 当然，要是能吃东西，体验想必会更好。

source: &734 You don't eat?
target: &734 你不吃东西？

source: &118 Some models can simulate digestion, but this platform is unable to.
target: &118 有些型号可以模拟消化，不过，这个机体不行。

source: &119 Go on, Dr Regis. Try something for me.
target: &119 来吧，里吉斯博士。替我尝点。

source: &735 Uh...I'll pass...
&736 I'll get back to you.
target: &736 我晚点再来找你。

source: &142 Oh my, yes.
&1306 Mr Ran?
&46 What you want?
target: &46 你要什么？

source: &2 You find who try to kill me.
target: &2 找出谁想杀我。

source: &737 Who tried to kill ALL of us, Mr Ran.
target: &737 是想杀我们所有人，冉先生。

source: &3 This city dangerous. Police do lousy job.
target: &3 这城市很危险，警察干得太差。

source: &738 Hmph. Can you recall anything suspicious?
target: &738 哼。能想起什么可疑的事吗？

source: &4 No. Stop asking stupid questions.
target: &4 没有，别问蠢问题。

source: &739 What's your part in this conspiracy?
target: &739 你在这场阴谋里负责什么？

source: &5 Dr Jeong wants to capture biggest AI in the world.
target: &5 郑博士想抓住世界上最大的AI。

source: &6 It's going to take enormous memory and processor.
target: &6 那需要极大的存储和处理能力。

source: &740 And you're going to furnish her with these?
target: &740 这些都由你提供？

source: &7 With all the capital she need. Money, guns, labor...
target: &7 她需要的一切资源。钱、枪、人手……

source: &741 It sounds like you're on board with her plan.
target: &741 看来，你很支持她的计划。

source: &742 What do you get out of it?
target: &742 你能得到什么？

source: &8 Newton is lousy place to do business, Regis.
target: &8 牛顿市这地方，做生意太糟了，里吉斯。

source: &743 You reckon it's Central's fault?
target: &743 你觉得是中枢的问题？

source: &9 Central watches too close.
target: &9 中枢盯得太紧。

source: &744 You can't bribe anyone, you mean?
target: &744 你是说，没法贿赂谁？

source: &10 Exactly. Can't make things work.
target: &10 没错，事情没法办。

source: &745 Sometimes it's nice not to have a government driven by the wealthy.
target: &745 有时候，政府不受富人摆布，倒是件好事。

source: &11 Bah. We will control new Central.
target: &11 呸。新的中枢，会由我们控制。

source: &12 It's a great opportunity for us.
target: &12 这对我们是个大好机会。

source: &746 What do you think of Dr Jeong?
target: &746 你觉得郑博士怎么样？

source: &13 She's very clever. She know what she's doing.
target: &13 很聪明。她知道自己在干什么。

source: &747 I worked with her in the past.
target: &747 我以前跟她共事过。

source: &748 I guarantee, the only ones she's looking out for are her, and her plans.
target: &748 我保证，她在乎的只有自己，还有自己的计划。

source: &14 So? That's how to get ahead.
target: &14 那又怎样？想出人头地，就是这么做。

source: &15 Cooperation happen when we want same thing.
target: &15 想要同样的东西，才会合作。

source: &16 I want Central gone, she wants Central gone.
target: &16 我想让中枢消失，她也想让中枢消失。

source: &749 Don't say I didn't warn you...
target: &749 别说我没警告过你……

source: &750 Did you know Giel Van der Waal?
target: &750 你认识吉尔·范德瓦尔？

source: &17 Sure, everyone here know Giel.
target: &17 当然，这里谁不认识吉尔。

source: &18 We work together.
target: &18 我们合作过。

source: &19 He have connections EVERYWHERE.
target: &19 他的人脉，到处都有。

source: &751 He was a middleman for criminals.
target: &751 他是犯罪分子的中间人。

source: &20 Exactly! Any specialist, he could find.
target: &20 没错！什么专家，他都能找到。

source: &21 Even *Mindjackers*, Dr Regis.
target: &21 连意识劫持者也能，里吉斯博士。

source: &752 You're one of the richest men in Greater Han, aren't you?
target: &752 你是大汉共和国最富有的人之一，对吧？

source: &22 Damn straight.
target: &22 那还用说。

source: &5001 What are you doing here?
target: &5001 你来这里做什么？

source: &23 I like this restaurant. I suggest it.
target: &23 我喜欢这餐厅，是我推荐的。

source: &753 No, I mean, why in person, at this meeting?
target: &753 不，我是说，为什么亲自来参加这次会面？

source: &24 That is how we always do it.
target: &24 我们一直这样做。

source: &25 Cannot trust anyone else. Other people stupid.
target: &25 别人信不过。其他人都蠢。

source: &26 If too many people know, then Central will find out.
target: &26 知道的人太多，中枢就会发现。

source: &754 What sort of business do you run?
target: &754 你经营什么生意？

source: &27 Some of everything. Factory, guns, biochem, industry farming...
target: &27 什么都做一点。工厂、枪械、生化、工业化农业……

source: &755 A hands-on manager there, too?
target: &755 那些生意，你也亲自管理？

source: &28 Hell no. Give that job to cousins.
target: &28 才不，交给堂表亲去管。

source: &29 You ever see Han? Is lousy country.
target: &29 你见过大汉吗？烂国家。

source: &30 Everything poisoned. Sky is BLACK.
target: &30 什么都被污染了，天都是黑的。

source: &756 Maybe it's all those factories you're running...
target: &756 也许，就是你那些工厂造成的……

source: &757 Probably a stupid question, but did you know what they serve here?
target: &757 这问题大概挺蠢的，不过，你知道这里卖的是什么吗？

source: &31 Of course. It's people!
target: &31 当然，是人肉！

source: &758 The idea of eating human meat appeals to you?
target: &758 你觉得吃人肉很有吸引力？

source: &32 Absolutely! It is why I like to come to Newton.
target: &32 当然！所以我才喜欢来牛顿市。

source: &33 You have some crazy laws, but almost nowhere else will allow things like this.
target: &33 你们有些法律很荒唐，可这种事，几乎没别的地方允许。

source: &759 It's cloned meat apparently, so technically no harm done...that's the legal foundation.
target: &759 据说是克隆肉，所以理论上没有造成伤害。这就是法律依据。

source: &34 A shame. Would rather eat real human.
target: &34 可惜。我更想吃真正的人肉。

source: &35 Ultimate sign of control of people.
target: &35 这是控制人的极致表现。

source: &760 "Eat the poor".
&36 Exactly! That will teach them.
target: &36 没错！让他们长点教训。

source: &24 What do you know about Giel's links to the Mindjacker?
target: &24 吉尔和那个意识劫持者的联系，你知道些什么？

source: &57 Van der Waal set people up with...specialist talent. Famous for it.
target: &57 范德瓦尔替人牵线，找……专业人才。这方面，他很有名。

source: &58 In this case, a third party needed a mindjacker. He fixed that up for them, got the best.
target: &58 这一次，有个第三方需要意识劫持者。他替他们找了最好的。

source: &25 But eventually, he discovered something that made him regret introducing them?
target: &25 可后来，他发现了一些事，开始后悔介绍他们认识？

source: &59 He found what the client's plans were in the long run.
target: &59 他发现了客户的长远计划。

source: &60 If they succeed, our plan to remove Central will fail.
target: &60 他们成功，我们移除中枢的计划就会失败。

source: &26 So he tried to stop the Mindjacker.
target: &26 所以，他试图阻止意识劫持者。

source: &61 Exactly. Took the memory module he was using to store minds of his targets.
target: &61 没错。拿走了那人储存目标心智的记忆模块。

source: &27 ...and it cost him his life.
target: &27 ……结果，赔上了自己的命。

source: &62 Pity he's working against us. Good mindjackers are hard to find!
target: &62 可惜他在跟我们作对。好的意识劫持者，可不好找！

source: &28 Who hired the Mindjacker from Van der Waal?
target: &28 谁通过范德瓦尔，雇用了那个意识劫持者？

source: &63 Hah. Like everything else, information is not free, Regis.
target: &63 哈。跟其他东西一样，情报也不是免费的，里吉斯。

source: &37 Stop wasting my time!
target: &37 别浪费我的时间！

source: &98 Dr Regis! How can I help?
target: &98 里吉斯博士！有什么可以帮忙？

source: &761 I've begun my investigation into the bombing.
target: &761 我已经开始调查爆炸案了。

source: &2 If anyone can resolve this, it's you, Dr Regis.
target: &2 要说谁能解决此事，那一定是您，里吉斯博士。

source: &762 Thank you for the vote of confidence, Councillor.
target: &762 谢谢你的信任，议员。

source: &763 I don't know how much closer I am to figuring out who's behind it, though.
target: &763 不过，我也不知道，离查出幕后主使还差多远。

source: &3 Because of the pool of suspects, it might be better to think about exclusion.
target: &3 考虑到嫌疑人都是些什么人，或许从排除入手更好。

source: &4 Perhaps you can find evidence to rule out those not involved?
target: &4 也许，您能找到证据，排除没有参与的人？

source: &764 I'm surprised to see a city Councillor in a conspiracy like this.
target: &764 在这样的阴谋里看见一位市议员，真让人惊讶。

source: &5 Desperate times call for desperate measures, Dr Regis.
target: &5 非常时期，只能采取非常手段，里吉斯博士。

source: &765 I guess you've been facilitating things for the plot?
target: &765 看来，你一直在为这项计划提供便利？

source: &6 Much as it pains me to misuse my position, that is the case.
target: &6 尽管滥用职位让我痛心，可确实如此。

source: &7 I've been able to expedite import permits for equipment necessary to Dr Jeong's plans.
target: &7 郑博士计划所需的设备，我帮忙加快了进口许可的审批。

source: &766 And Central hasn't noticed?
target: &766 中枢没发现？

source: &8 In my role, I'm given considerably more privacy than the average civil servant - no offense, Doctor.
target: &8 我的职务，给了我比普通公务人员更多的隐私，博士，无意冒犯。

source: &767 None taken. I just cover the camera in my office with paste.
target: &767 没关系。我只会往办公室的摄像头上糊东西。

source: &768 So, I understand what you're doing for it, but why?
target: &768 所以，我明白你在做什么了，可是为什么？

source: &769 How does someone in government decide that Central needs removing?
target: &769 一个政府里的人，为什么会认定必须移除中枢？

source: &9 I've read your bio, Dr Regis. I know that you have no great love for Central.
target: &9 我看过您的履历，里吉斯博士。我知道，您并不喜欢中枢。

source: &10 But in practical terms, I believe it has become a threat to our democratic society.
target: &10 可从实际情况来看，我认为，它已开始威胁我们的民主社会。

source: &770 A threat? How so?
target: &770 威胁？怎么说？

source: &11 Over the course of its twenty years of operation, Central has begun to develop...opinions.
target: &11 运转的这二十年里，中枢开始形成……自己的观点。

source: &12 For an individual to have done so is natural, for an AI it is impressive.
target: &12 对个人来说，这是自然的事。对AI来说，则令人赞叹。

source: &13 But in its position, coordinating the actions of government, it poses a risk.
target: &13 可它负责协调政府行动，这样的位置，就会带来风险。

source: &771 Wouldn't someone notice? Call it out?
target: &771 难道没人发现？没人指出来？

source: &14 There isn't enough to address as yet. It's clever.
target: &14 目前，还没有足够的依据正式提出问题。它很聪明。

source: &15 It's designed to carry out the policies of the Council, and it cannot fail to do so.
target: &15 它被设计用来执行议会政策，不能拒绝执行。

source: &16 But it can drag its metaphorical feet, badly implement plans it disagrees with.
target: &16 可它能拖拖拉拉，把不赞同的计划执行得很差。

source: &772 You've seen it do this?
target: &772 你见过它这么做？

source: &17 I've had suspicions. Dr Jeong's research confirms the extent to which Central is developing its own conscience.
target: &17 我一直有所怀疑。郑博士的研究，确认了中枢自身的良知已发展到什么程度。

source: &18 I believe that your yourself recently had a disagreement with it over its handling of a crisis...another bombing?
target: &18 我相信，您最近也因为它处理危机的方式，跟它有过分歧……另一次爆炸事件？

source: &19 Central has done well, but there exist many other options today that are equally valid.
target: &19 中枢做得不错，可如今，也存在许多同样可行的替代方案。

source: &20 We need a system that will effectively manage the city, and carry out its instructions.
target: &20 我们需要一个能够有效管理城市，并执行指示的系统。

source: &21 Not one that cherry-picks what policies it believes appropriate.
target: &21 而不是按自己的判断，挑拣哪些政策合适的系统。

source: &774 How did you get on board with Nina?
target: &774 你怎么跟妮娜合作上的？

source: &22 I, and others in the Cosmopolitan party, have suspected changes in Central's behavior.
target: &22 我和世界主义党的其他成员，都怀疑中枢的行为正在变化。

source: &23 We sought the assistance of one of its original creators.
target: &23 我们找到了它的一位最初创造者，请求帮助。

source: &775 Obviously not Vargas, he loves that thing.
target: &775 显然不是瓦尔加斯，他可爱死那东西了。

source: &24 Indeed. Her research confirmed that, thanks to the scale of its operations...
target: &24 正是。她的研究证实，由于其运作规模……

source: &25 ...Central has been able to form its own opinion on the ideal state of affairs.
target: &25 ……中枢已能对理想的社会状态，形成自己的看法。

source: &26 Regardless of the democratic consensus.
target: &26 而不顾民主共识。

source: &776 So when she said that she would remove Central...
target: &776 所以，她说自己会移除中枢时……

source: &27 It was a difficult decision, but we had to take it.
target: &27 这是个艰难的决定，可我们必须做。

source: &28 Central's replacement will carry out its role more appropriately.
target: &28 替代中枢的系统，会更恰当地履行职责。

source: &777 And Nina will get to continue her research on Central.
target: &777 而妮娜，就能继续对中枢做研究。

source: &778 Why haven't you simply raised this in the Council?
target: &778 为什么不直接把这件事提交议会？

source: &29 Can you imagine what that would mean? Political suicide.
target: &29 您能想象，那意味着什么吗？政治上的自杀。

source: &30 Not just for myself, but it would undermine confidence in Newton's world-leading AI industries.
target: &30 不只是我自己，也会动摇大家对牛顿市全球领先的AI产业的信心。

source: &779 Did you know Giel Van der Waal?
target: &779 你认识吉尔·范德瓦尔？

source: &31 Indeed I did. He was a big donor in politics all over Africa.
target: &31 认识。他是非洲各地政界的重要捐助人。

source: &780 And you knew about what he did? His criminal connections?
target: &780 你也知道他做的事？他跟犯罪分子的联系？

source: &32 I'm the one who introduced him to the group.
target: &32 正是我，把他介绍进这个团体的。

source: &33 I'm also aware that he introduced the Mindjacker you're after to his current employer.
target: &33 我也知道，您追查的意识劫持者，是他介绍给如今的雇主的。

source: &781 You know about that?!
target: &781 你知道这个？！

source: &34 You will need our help to find him, and we need your help to stop him, and Central.
target: &34 您需要我们的帮助找到他，我们也需要您帮忙，阻止他，还有中枢。

source: &782 You're on the City Council, aren't you?
target: &782 你在市议会里，对吧？

source: &35 Indeed I am, Dr Regis.
target: &35 正是，里吉斯博士。

source: &36 Rep for the Southwest Ward, and Co-chair of the Cosmopolitan Party.
target: &36 西南选区的代表，世界主义党的共同主席。

source: &783 I remember when you got elected.
target: &783 我记得你当选的时候。

source: &784 They called you "Mr Incorruptable"? I never got that.
target: &784 大家叫你“廉洁先生”？我一直没弄懂。

source: &37 That's because of the device in my head, Dr Regis.
target: &37 那是因为我脑子里的装置，里吉斯博士。

source: &785 What *is* that in your head, Councillor?
target: &785 你脑子里的那个，到底是什么，议员？

source: &38 Why, it's a neural Governor, Dr Regis.
target: &38 是神经限制器，里吉斯博士。

source: &786 As in...what paroled felons are fitted with?
target: &786 就是……装在获准假释的重罪犯身上的那种？

source: &39 Similar. While most of those are designed to limit violent behavior,
target: &39 类似。他们用的大多是限制暴力行为，

source: &40 ...mine prevents me from lying. Thoughts of deceit are met with tremendous pain.
target: &40 ……我这个，则让我不能撒谎。只要产生欺骗的念头，就会感到极度痛苦。

source: &787 Were you...inside?
target: &787 你以前……坐过牢？

source: &41 Oh my, no. This was a voluntary choice. After all, most Governors are subdermal.
target: &41 哦，没有。这是我自愿选择的。毕竟，大部分限制器都埋在皮下。

source: &42 I wanted my constituents to see it as a sign of my integrity.
target: &42 我希望选民能看见它，把它当作我诚实正直的证明。

source: &788 I knew someone with one...
target: &788 我认识一个装过这种东西的人……

source: &43 Dr Baxter, I recall reading about his release last month.
target: &43 巴克斯特博士，我记得上个月读过他获释的消息。

source: &789 I thought it must have malfunctioned...that he was out for revenge.
target: &789 我还以为，它一定出了故障……他是来复仇的。

source: &790 Turns out he's just dead. It's like someone's just...inherited...his hatred.
target: &790 结果，他只是死了。像是有人……继承了……他的仇恨。

source: &791 Councillor, were you aware that this restaurant serves HUMAN meat?
target: &791 议员，你知道这家餐厅供应人肉吗？

source: &44 Indeed, it's quite distasteful, don't you think?
target: &44 知道。相当倒胃口，不是吗？

source: &45 Still, I suppose it's a matter of personal taste, since nobody's been hurt.
target: &45 不过，既然没人受伤，我想这也是个人口味的问题。

source: &46 We must respect the freedoms allowed by the laws of this city.
target: &46 我们必须尊重本市法律允许的自由。

source: &792 You're not having any, then?
target: &792 所以，你不吃？

source: &47 Oh no, but I shan't judge anyone for it.
target: &47 哦，不吃。不过，我也不会为此评判别人。

source: &48 They're quite whimsical about it in some ways.
target: &48 有些地方，他们的想法也挺奇巧的。

source: &49 I heard good things about their "Billy con carne".
target: &49 我听说，他们那道“比利辣肉酱”很不错。

source: &793 Eurgh.
&794 So, because of your neural Governor, you're unable to lie?
target: &794 所以，有了神经限制器，你就没法撒谎？

source: &50 That is correct.
&795 Then, forgive me for being so forward, Councillor:
target: &795 那么，原谅我问得直接，议员：

source: &796 Did you hire a suicide bomber to attack this meeting?
target: &796 你雇了自杀式炸弹客，来袭击这次会面吗？

source: &51 No. I did not.
target: &51 没有。我没有。

source: &52 Satisfied?
target: &52 满意了吗？

source: &797 Personally, I'm not sure. It'd probably stand up in court, though.
target: &797 我自己不太确定。不过，法庭大概会接受这种说法。

source: &798 Just to let you know, I voted for the other guy.
target: &798 只是想告诉你，我投的是另一个人的票。

source: &53 Ah, well! That's your prerogative.
target: &53 啊，当然，这是您的权利。

source: &54 Any concerns I might be able to address for next time?
target: &54 有没有什么问题，我能解决，好争取您下次的票？

source: &799 I guess I've just always voted Metro, since I've lived here.
target: &799 我搬来以后，好像一直都投都市党。

source: &55 Ah, inertia. Something difficult to overcome.
target: &55 啊，惯性。很难克服的东西。

source: &56 Give our site a read. You might find you agree with us more than you think!
target: &56 看看我们的网站吧。也许，您会发现，自己比想象中更赞同我们的主张！

source: &29 I've discovered how the bomber managed to get into the restaurant.
target: &29 我已经弄清楚，炸弹客是怎么进入餐厅的。

source: &30 Apparently, someone here let them in through the vent in the bathroom.
target: &30 看来，是在座某个人，从洗手间的通风口放炸弹客进来的。

source: &114 A sound approach. They could enter unseen, if they did it before Mr Stepford's men arrived.
target: &114 办法很合理。赶在斯特普福德先生的手下到来之前，确实能悄悄进入。

source: &31 Whoever opened it did a number on their hand. Left a lot of blood.
target: &31 打开通风口的人，伤了手，留下了很多血。

source: &115 You wish to check my hands, Dr Regis?
target: &115 您想检查我的手，里吉斯博士？

source: &32 Nah. Whoever it was will have slapped on a medipatch.
target: &32 不。那人早就会贴上医疗贴片了。

source: &33 Any visible injury will have been gone in ten minutes.
target: &33 十分钟内，看得见的伤口就会消失。

source: &116 How unfortunate.
&800 I'll get back to you, Councillor.
target: &800 我晚点再来找你，议员。

source: &57 Anything I can do to help, Dr Regis.
target: &57 能帮得上的，我一定帮，里吉斯博士。

source: &1305 Ms Florez, can I have a moment?
target: &1305 弗洛雷斯女士，能占用一点时间吗？

source: &35 Of course, darling.
target: &35 当然，亲爱的。

source: &1871 Good evening, Ms...?
target: &1871 晚上好，女士……怎么称呼？

source: &36 Dame Imogen Natalia Revilla-Quintanilla de Florez.
target: &36 伊莫金·娜塔莉娅·雷维利亚-金塔尼利亚·德·弗洛雷斯女爵士。

source: &1872 Yeah, that.
target: &1872 对，就是这个。

source: &37 You may call me Imogen, darling.
target: &37 叫我伊莫金就好，亲爱的。

source: &801 If you don't mind my saying, you don't look like any conspirator I've ever seen before.
target: &801 恕我直言，您看起来不像我见过的任何阴谋家。

source: &2 Thank you, darling. It's my own unique style.
target: &2 谢谢，亲爱的。这就是我的独特风格。

source: &802 I'm sure Nina's got a use for everyone here.
target: &802 我相信，在座每个人，妮娜都用得上。

source: &803 What part are you playing in her plan?
target: &803 您在她的计划里，扮演什么角色？

source: &3 All we ever do in life is play a role, Dr Regis.
target: &3 人生里，我们无非都在扮演角色，里吉斯博士。

source: &4 I promised I would assist her when she required.
target: &4 我答应过，她需要的时候，我会帮忙。

source: &5 And thus, here I am.
target: &5 所以，我就来了。

source: &804 Not as heavy muscle, I guess?
target: &804 想必，不是来当打手的？

source: &6 I am VERY good at networking, Dr Regis. I taught her everything she knows about it.
target: &6 我很擅长经营人脉，里吉斯博士。这方面，她懂的都是我教的。

source: &7 I lend credibility to her mission with my very presence!
target: &7 光是我出现在这里，就能为她的事业增添信誉！

source: &805 I could understand why some people would want Central removed.
target: &805 我能理解，为什么有些人想移除中枢。

source: &806 The kind of folks who see it as an obstacle to their work.
target: &806 那些觉得中枢妨碍自己做事的人。

source: &807 But what good would it do a..."celebrity"...like yourself?
target: &807 可对您这样的……“名人”……有什么好处？

source: &8 You think in such cynical terms, Dr Regis.
target: &8 您想事情的方式，可真世故，里吉斯博士。

source: &9 It benefits me, because it benefits dear Nina.
target: &9 因为这能帮助亲爱的妮娜，所以，也能帮助我。

source: &808 ...you're doing this out of...altruism?
target: &808 ……您是出于……利他之心，才这么做？

source: &10 Is that so surprising, Dr Regis?
target: &10 很让人惊讶吗，里吉斯博士？

source: &809 Frankly, it is.
target: &809 坦白说，是的。

source: &810 Do you know Dr Jeong?
target: &810 您认识郑博士？

source: &811 You go back a long way?
target: &811 认识很久了？

source: &12 One might say that. We were lovers, Dr Regis.
target: &12 可以这么说。我们曾是恋人，里吉斯博士。

source: &13 My, they'd said you came from backwards parts, but I hadn't quite expected a display like this!
target: &13 哎呀，他们说您来自落后的地方，可我还真没想到，您会是这种反应！

source: &813 Forgive me Ms Florez, I just find it hard to picture Dr Jeong loving anything.
target: &813 原谅我，弗洛雷斯女士。我只是很难想象，郑博士能爱上什么。

source: &14 We were close, close enough that I came to her aid now that she needs it.
target: &14 我们曾很亲密。所以，她如今需要帮助，我便来了。

source: &814 You knew Giel Van der Waal, as well?
target: &814 您也认识吉尔·范德瓦尔？

source: &15 Only within this gathering.
target: &15 只是在这个团体里认识的。

source: &16 I'd had no use for his services in...talent acquisition.
target: &16 他那……招揽人才的服务，我用不上。

source: &815 You mean, facilitating criminal skills with buyers?
target: &815 您是说，替犯罪行家和买家牵线？

source: &17 Indeed, his history in the underworld sounded so...thrilling!
target: &17 正是。他在地下世界的经历，听起来真……惊险刺激！

source: &18 But personally, he was so dull, everything was business to him.
target: &18 不过，他本人太无趣了，什么都当作生意。

source: &19 That husband of his, on the other hand...mmm...
target: &19 倒是他的丈夫……嗯……

source: &816 So I hear you're a...celebrity?
target: &816 所以，听说您是位……名人？

source: &20 Oh, Dr Regis, such an understatement!
target: &20 哦，里吉斯博士，您说得太轻了！

source: &817 You'll have to forgive me, Ms Florez. I'm not big on pop culture.
target: &817 请原谅，弗洛雷斯女士。我不怎么关注流行文化。

source: &21 How refreshing! It's such a shame what the net's doing to the young of today.
target: &21 真让人耳目一新！网络把今天的年轻人弄成这样，实在可惜。

source: &22 Though if it wasn't, I wouldn't have nearly the profile I do.
target: &22 不过，要不是如此，我也不会有如今这么高的知名度。

source: &818 So...what do you *do*, exactly?
target: &818 所以……您究竟是做什么的？

source: &23 I come from a wide background of European nobility,
target: &23 我身上有着众多欧洲贵族的血统，

source: &24 ...but, I can do anything that's asked of me, my dear.
target: &24 ……不过，亲爱的，大家需要我做什么，我就能做什么。

source: &25 Music, talent contests, endorsements...
target: &25 音乐、才艺比赛、代言……

source: &819 So essentially, you're famous for...being famous?
target: &819 所以基本上，您出名，是因为……您很出名？

source: &26 Precisely. Though much of the work is *so* tiresome, darling.
target: &26 正是。不过，很多工作实在太累人了，亲爱的。

source: &27 I delegate a great deal to simulations, lookalikes and synthetics.
target: &27 很多事情，我都交给模拟体、替身和合成人。

source: &820 Were you aware this restaurant serves HUMAN meat?
target: &820 您知道，这家餐厅供应人肉吗？

source: &28 It's a giddy thrill, isn't it?
target: &28 令人心醉的刺激，不是吗？

source: &29 Have you seen their celebrity selection?
target: &29 您看过他们的名人菜单吗？

source: &821 Celebrities?
&30 They have cloned tissue from influential figures of the past two centuries.
target: &30 过去两个世纪里的一些名人，这里都有他们的克隆组织。

source: &31 Would you care for leg of John F. Kennedy?
target: &31 要来点约翰·F·肯尼迪的腿肉吗？

source: &822 That's...appalling...
&32 I know! Nonentities like that, and *I'm* nowhere to be found!
target: &32 我知道！连这种无名小卒都有，却偏偏没有我！

source: &33 I must complain to the management. Perhaps offer them a sample...
target: &33 我必须向管理层投诉。也许，给他们提供一份样本……

source: &823 That's all for now, Ms Florez.
target: &823 暂时就这些，弗洛雷斯女士。

source: &34 Please darling, just Imogen.
target: &34 拜托，亲爱的，叫我伊莫金就好。

source: &1 Yes?
target: &1 什么事？

source: &825 I'm Dr Regis. Nina's asked me to investigate the explosion.
target: &825 我是里吉斯博士。妮娜请我调查这次爆炸。

source: &2 A CEL agent? Well, alright.
target: &2 CEL探员？嗯，好吧。

source: &3 Just be careful what you touch. This place is half kitchen, half lab.
target: &3 小心别乱碰。这里一半是厨房，一半是实验室。

source: &826 There are...human bodies...in your kitchen...
target: &826 你的厨房里……有人类的尸体……

source: &4 Yes, there are. It's a freezer. What are you, the food inspector?
target: &4 是啊，那是冷冻柜。你是食品检查员吗？

source: &827 Give me a good reason I shouldn't haul your ass down to CEL!
target: &827 给我个理由，为什么不该把你直接拖回CEL！

source: &5 It's all legal, I guarantee.
target: &5 全都合法，我保证。

source: &6 They're aneural clones - grown without brain tissue.
target: &6 都是无神经克隆体，培育时不形成脑组织。

source: &828 I know what it means...I guess the presentation was a shock.
target: &828 我知道那是什么意思……只是这个场面，有点震撼。

source: &829 Why is this restaurant serving cloned human tissue?
target: &829 为什么这家餐厅供应克隆的人体组织？

source: &7 I trained in gengineering at Darwin.
target: &7 我在达尔文接受过基因工程培训。

source: &8 We'd flash-grow human bodies to test DNA alterations.
target: &8 我们会快速培育人体，用来测试DNA改动。

source: &9 So, I guess human tissue's what I'm most familiar with.
target: &9 所以，人体组织大概就是我最熟悉的东西。

source: &830 You're a gengineer?
target: &830 你是基因工程师？

source: &10 Well, I dropped out before my PhD.
target: &10 嗯，拿到博士学位前，我就退学了。

source: &11 I'd learned enough to sample DNA, and use it to grow flash-clones.
target: &11 不过学到的，已经足够让我采集DNA，再用它快速培育克隆体。

source: &831 No kidding. My background's in gengineering as well.
target: &831 真巧，我的专业也是基因工程。

source: &832 You altered these bodies?
target: &832 你改动过这些身体？

source: &12 None of these. They're all template.
target: &12 这些都没改过，全是标准模板。

source: &13 Caucasian, male, twenties, brown hair.
target: &13 白人、男性、二十多岁、棕发。

source: &833 This is quite the setup you've got.
target: &833 你这套设备，很不错。

source: &834 Combined sampler/growth chamber?
target: &834 采样器和培养舱一体的？

source: &14 That's right. We usually use the template.
target: &14 没错。我们一般都用标准模板。

source: &15 Sometimes get specialist orders, though.
target: &15 不过，偶尔也有特殊订单。

source: &835 Like if someone wants to eat...themselves?
target: &835 比如有人想吃……自己？

source: &16 Sometimes. We can ready up a new cadaver in about a week with it.
target: &16 有时有。用这设备，一周左右就能准备好一具新遗体。

source: &836 I can't access CEL at the moment.
target: &836 我现在没法访问CEL的系统。

source: &837 I might need to use your equipment.
target: &837 可能得用用你的设备。

source: &17 Do you have to? You know you'd have to flush the current growth.
target: &17 非用不可吗？那样就得清除当前正在培育的东西。

source: &838 Sorry about that.
target: &838 对不住了。

source: &839 Tell you what - Nina will reimburse you.
target: &839 这样吧，妮娜会补偿你。

source: &18 Well, okay.
&840 Going from gengineering to catering - that's quite a switch.
target: &840 从基因工程转行餐饮，这跨度可不小。

source: &19 Most of my family are cooks. They run a restaurant in Vietnam.
target: &19 我家里大多数人都是厨师，他们在越南开餐厅。

source: &20 When I was at med school, someone found out about my family.
target: &20 读医学院时，有人知道了我家里的情况。

source: &21 Dared me to make something out of human muscle tissue.
target: &21 激我，说敢不敢用人的肌肉组织做一道菜。

source: &22 And it turned out my human bolognese was really, really good.
target: &22 结果我的人肉版博洛尼亚肉酱，真的特别好吃。

source: &23 Not just being immodest, or anything.
target: &23 我可不是在自吹。

source: &842 You said you dropped out - is that why?
target: &842 你说自己退学了，就是因为这个？

source: &24 Yeah, turns out the academy had regulations about "improper disposal of remains".
target: &24 是啊。原来，学院有关于“遗体处置不当”的规定。

source: &25 But, now I had an idea, and I knew there'd be a market for it somewhere.
target: &25 不过，我已经有了主意，也知道总有地方会需要这种生意。

source: &26 My family are great chefs, and I can make human bodies - bingo!
target: &26 家人厨艺精湛，我又会制造人体，这不就成了！

source: &843 A suicide bomber attacked the gathering upstairs.
target: &843 一名自杀式炸弹客，袭击了楼上的聚会。

source: &844 He was disguised as one of your waiters.
target: &844 他伪装成了你的一名侍者。

source: &27 Whoa...I wondered what that was.
target: &27 哇……我还在想，刚才那是怎么回事。

source: &28 What did he look like?
target: &28 他长什么样？

source: &845 Blond, about 1.65 meters, might have looked uncomfortable, or limping.
target: &845 金发，大约1.65米高，可能显得不舒服，或者走路一瘸一拐。

source: &29 Huh. Biobomber?
target: &29 嗯。人体炸弹客？

source: &846 That's...right. How did you guess?
target: &846 没错……你怎么猜到的？

source: &30 You mentioned the limp. They've got pretty serious health problems, don't they?
target: &30 你说他一瘸一拐。那些人身体的问题挺严重的，不是吗？

source: &73 Maybe he chose Henry for his appearance...or he was just in the wrong place.
target: &73 也许是看中亨利的外貌……或者，只是他运气不好，碰上了。

source: &847 Yeah. He might have replaced one of your staff.
target: &847 是啊。可能替换了你的一名员工。

source: &31 Huh. They all checked in.
target: &31 嗯。他们都签到过了。

source: &848 If he...incapacitated...one of your staff...can you think of where they'd do that?
target: &848 如果他……放倒……了你的一名员工，你能想到，会在哪里下手吗？

source: &32 It'd have to be somewhere you could hide a body, I guess.
target: &32 我想，肯定得是能藏住尸体的地方。

source: &849 You get a lot of clandestine meetings like this taking place?
target: &849 这种秘密会面，在这里常有吗？

source: &33 You'd be surprised. This place is popular with the wealthy.
target: &33 多得你都会惊讶。富人很喜欢这里。

source: &34 Haven't had an assassination before, though.
target: &34 不过，暗杀倒是头一回。

source: &850 You know what they're discussing up there?
target: &850 你知道，他们在楼上讨论什么吗？

source: &35 They don't tell me, and I don't ask about anything but their orders.
target: &35 他们不告诉我。除了点菜的事，我也什么都不问。

source: &36 Dr Jeong pays me enough to know I probably shouldn't.
target: &36 郑博士付的钱够多，我也知道，自己大概不该问。

source: &851 What's with the bouncer?
target: &851 那个看门人怎么回事？

source: &37 He came with Mr Stepford's party, along with a few others.
target: &37 他跟斯特普福德先生一行来的，还有几个别的人。

source: &38 I think he was supposed to be guarding the kitchen, but...
target: &38 本来应该负责守厨房，可是……

source: &852 What happened?
target: &852 发生了什么？

source: &39 Well, he wasn't very talkative, but...
target: &39 嗯，他不怎么说话，不过……

source: &40 After I started working, he just kind of zoned out.
target: &40 我一开始干活，他就像是出了神。

source: &41 Couldn't get an answer out of him.
target: &41 怎么问，都没回应。

source: &853 I like the glowing fish in the tank you've got.
target: &853 我喜欢你鱼缸里，那些发光的鱼。

source: &42 Thanks! I made those myself.
target: &42 谢谢！都是我自己做的。

source: &43 They were my first gengineering project.
target: &43 那是我的第一个基因工程项目。

source: &854 Luciferin/luciferase from fireflies?
target: &854 萤火虫的萤光素和萤光素酶？

source: &44 Well spotted. I imported the sequence into red snappers, and kept them viable.
target: &44 好眼力。我把相关序列导入红鲷体内，还保证它们能正常存活。

source: &45 Ten generations, now!
target: &45 到现在，已经十代了！

source: &855 A lot of academies use those as a starter project, but that's impressive.
target: &855 很多学院都拿这个作为入门项目，不过，你做得挺出色。

source: &46 We keep them as a reminder of where we came from.
target: &46 留着它们，是为了提醒自己从哪儿起步。

source: &47 Or, in case the power goes out.
target: &47 或者，以防停电。

source: &856 The sequencer's a different model to my usual.
target: &856 这台测序仪，跟我常用的型号不一样。

source: &48 CEL's probably got something more impressive than that thing.
target: &48 CEL那台，大概比这东西厉害得多。

source: &49 You have to purge the current project before you can do anything.
target: &49 得先清除当前项目，才能做其他事。

source: &50 Then you can submit genetic material to start a new growth project.
target: &50 然后，就能放入遗传材料，开始新的培育项目。

source: &857 What kind of material will it take?
target: &857 什么材料都能用？

source: &51 Blood, dermal tissue, almost anything.
target: &51 血液、皮肤组织，几乎什么都行。

source: &52 Makes it easier to get a sample from customers.
target: &52 这样，从顾客身上取样就方便多了。

source: &858 What's your advice for cooking human meat?
target: &858 烹饪人肉，有什么建议？

source: &53 Planning on going into competition with me?
target: &53 打算跟我抢生意？

source: &54 Well, you know how they say everything tastes like chicken?
target: &54 你知道，大家总说，什么东西吃起来都像鸡肉？

source: &55 It's actually better if you treat human tissue like pork.
target: &55 其实，把人体组织当猪肉来做，效果更好。

source: &859 Like...pork?
&56 Yeah - sausages, slices, fillet...
target: &56 是啊，香肠、肉片、里脊……

source: &57 There's a lot you can do with it.
target: &57 花样多着呢。

source: &860 It's restaurants like this that make me glad everyone in this city just uses automeals these days.
target: &860 有这样的餐厅，还真让我庆幸，现在城里人都用自动食品机。

source: &58 Oh, come on, it's not that bad!
target: &58 哎，别这样。没那么糟！

source: &59 It's not harming anyone, after all.
target: &59 毕竟，又没伤害谁。

source: &861 Something about it still doesn't feel right.
target: &861 可还是，总觉得哪里不对。

source: &60 You probably don't feel nearly so angry talking to me as those automeal personalities, right?
target: &60 跟我聊天，你应该不会像跟那些食品机人格说话时那么生气吧？

source: &862 ...you have a point.
target: &862 ……你说得有道理。

source: &61 Whatever I can do to help.
target: &61 能帮得上的，我一定帮。

source: &6 Yes?
target: &6 什么事？

source: &864 What's the situation?
target: &864 情况怎么样？

source: &7 Perimeter secure. Guest behavior within tolerable parameters.
target: &7 周边安全。宾客行为处于可容忍范围内。

source: &865 I guess that's one way of putting it.
target: &865 这么说倒也没错。

source: &866 Are you alright? That was quite a blast.
target: &866 你没事吧？刚才那爆炸可不小。

source: &8 Systems operating at 97%.
target: &8 系统运行状态：97%。

source: &868 You synthetics give me the creeps, y'know that?
target: &868 你们这些合成人真让人心里发毛，知道吗？

source: &869 Huh, guess you're not easily riled up.
target: &869 哼，看来你还挺沉得住气。

source: &870 I found one of your buddies in the kitchen.
target: &870 我在厨房找到你的一位同伴。

source: &871 He doesn't look well.
target: &871 他看着不太好。

source: &10 Please report technical issues to management.
target: &10 技术故障请向管理人员报告。

source: &872 Who's in charge?
target: &872 谁负责指挥？

source: &11 Situational command has been assigned to Mr Liam Stepford.
target: &11 现场指挥权已交由利亚姆·斯特普福德先生。

source: &873 Huh. Fancy taking orders from a guy like that.
target: &873 哈，亏你们还听那种人的指挥。

source: &874 Did you see the bomber when he came in?
target: &874 炸弹袭击者进来的时候，你看见了吗？

source: &12 Negative. His appearance was a match for a member of the serving staff.
target: &12 否。他的外貌与一名服务人员相符。

source: &875 And you call yourself a bodyguard.
target: &875 就这，你还好意思当保镖。

source: &13 It is likely that the suspect prepared this operation in advance.
target: &13 嫌疑人很可能事先策划了此次行动。

source: &14 To achieve this, he would have to supplant a member of staff before our arrival.
target: &14 为此，他必须在我们抵达前替换掉一名工作人员。

source: &876 Question is, where did he hide the waiter he replaced?
target: &876 问题是，被他顶替的服务员藏哪儿去了？

source: &877 Keep up the good work.
&17 Oh my, yes?
target: &17 哎呀，有什么事？

source: GOLDFARB
reason: 内部成就标识；全部脚本引用作为unlockAch参数，沿用原键以保持成就匹配

source: &18 Just dandy, my good man.
target: &18 好得很啊，老兄。

source: &878 Are you alright?
target: &878 你没事吧？

source: &19 My system log shows a mind-state alteration made moments ago.
target: &19 系统日志显示，我的意识状态刚刚遭到修改。

source: &20 I don't think it's anything to worry about.
target: &20 我想没什么可担心的。

source: &21 Just a little tweak, oh my, yes.
target: &21 只是稍作调整，哎呀，没错。

source: &879 You sound...really different from your colleagues.
target: &879 你说话……跟你的同事差别可真大。

source: &22 You know what they say, variety is the spice of life! Hm hm.
target: &22 俗话说，生活多点花样才有滋味嘛！呵呵。

source: &23 Oooh, dear - does Mr Stepford know?
target: &23 哎呀，不妙。斯特普福德先生知道吗？

source: &24 He's a lovely man, he'll get it sorted right out, oh my yes.
target: &24 他人可好了，一定能处理妥当。哎呀，当然。

source: &880 Actually...he's kind of broken as well.
target: &880 其实……他也有点儿故障。

source: &881 You're wearing his personality.
target: &881 你用的就是他的人格。

source: &25 Well, that *does* explain a thing or two.
target: &25 哦，那就*说得通*了。

source: &26 Oh my, no.
target: &26 哎呀，没有。

source: &27 That little sod must've gotten in before us.
target: &27 那个小混蛋肯定在我们之前就进来了。

source: &15 Don't worry Sir, we're big and strong.
target: &15 别担心，先生，我们个头大，力气也大。

source: &16 We'll protect you, oh my, yes.
target: &16 我们会保护您的。哎呀，当然。

source: &58 We're alone?
target: &58 没别人了吧？

source: &882 As alone as we're going to get. What do you want?
target: &882 再怎么避人耳目，也就这样了。你想干什么？

source: &59 Your investigation is drawing to an end, is it not?
target: &59 你的调查快结束了，是吧？

source: &883 Might be. Why?
target: &883 也许吧。怎么？

source: &884 There are still leads to chase up. Why?
target: &884 还有些线索要查。怎么？

source: &60 You are, without a doubt a skilled detective, Dr Regis.
target: &60 里吉斯博士，你无疑是一位出色的警探。

source: &61 I am proud that the city employs only the finest.
target: &61 本市只聘用最优秀的人才，我深感自豪。

source: &62 I believe that your inquiry will find only one credible suspect - myself.
target: &62 我相信，你的调查只会指向一名有理由怀疑的人：我。

source: &885 You're going to plead your innocence? Tell me it's a mistake?
target: &885 你想替自己喊冤？说我搞错了？

source: &63 Not at all. You see, I am indeed responsible for the attack.
target: &63 并非如此。事实上，这次袭击确实是我策划的。

source: &886 You lied to us. The Governor's a fake, then?
target: &886 你骗了我们。那限制器是假的？

source: &887 I'm sure your voters'd love to find that out.
target: &887 你的选民一定很想知道这件事。

source: &888 You killed Imogen, and almost got the rest of us as well!
target: &888 你杀了伊莫金，还差点把我们其余的人也搭进去！

source: &64 I can assure you, it wasn't my first choice, but a last resort.
target: &64 我可以向你保证，那不是我的首选，而是最后的手段。

source: &889 Huh, you've been lying to us about your involvement.
target: &889 哼，原来你一直在撒谎，隐瞒自己跟这事的关系。

source: &890 Why should I trust you? The Governor's obviously not doing its job.
target: &890 我凭什么信你？限制器显然没起作用。

source: &65 The Governor is working as well as it ever has.
target: &65 限制器的功能一直完全正常。

source: &66 I have not once lied to you, Dr Regis.
target: &66 我从未对你撒过谎，里吉斯博士。

source: &891 I asked you if you hired the bomber!
target: &891 我问过你，是不是你雇的炸弹袭击者！

source: &67 I did not. My ASSISTANT hired the bomber, at my request.
target: &67 不是。我提出要求，由我的助手雇了他。

source: &892 Politicians...
&68 People have to phrase their questions to me very carefully.
target: &68 向我提问时，用词必须格外谨慎。

source: &893 You'd better have a real good reason for all this.
target: &893 你最好有个说得过去的理由。

source: &69 For various values of "good". You recall Giel Van der Waal?
target: &69 那要看你怎么定义“说得过去”了。你还记得吉尔·范德瓦尔吗？

source: &894 Of course. Things have gone downhill since he got involved in my case.
target: &894 当然。他一掺和进我的案子，事情就越来越糟。

source: &70 Two years ago, much to my shame, I did something terrible.
target: &70 两年前，我做了一件十分可耻的事。

source: &71 I took part in a vote-fixing program for the Cosmopolitan party,
target: &71 我参与了世界主义党的选票舞弊计划，

source: &72 ...and they promised me this office in the next election.
target: &72 ……他们则承诺，在下一次选举中让我坐上这个位子。

source: &73 Giel discovered this, and has been blackmailing me ever since.
target: &73 吉尔发现了这件事，从那以后就一直勒索我。

source: &895 But why the suicide bomber?
target: &895 可为什么要搞自杀式爆炸？

source: &74 He realized that Nina's project might lead to his death.
target: &74 他意识到，妮娜的项目可能会让他丧命。

source: &75 He was a spiteful man, and he needed a guarantee that he could strike back against her if that happened.
target: &75 他这人睚眦必报，必须确保自己就算死了，也能报复她。

source: &896 ...from beyond the grave...
target: &896 ……死后也不放过她……

source: &76 Essentially, I was his guarantee.
target: &76 基本上，我就是他的那道保险。

source: &897 He wanted you to kill Nina for him?
target: &897 他要你替他杀了妮娜？

source: &77 Or the materials he has on me would be released to the public.
target: &77 否则，他掌握的那些有关我的材料就会公之于众。

source: &78 My career, my family, would be ruined.
target: &78 我的事业和家庭都会毁掉。

source: &898 So, instead of turning you in, I should...?
target: &898 所以，我不把你交出去，还得……？

source: &79 Tell them that Ran Shou-Man was responsible.
target: &79 告诉他们，这事是冉·寿曼干的。

source: &899 What!? Frame an innocent man?
target: &899 什么！？栽赃一个无辜的人？

source: &80 You've spoken to him, Dr Regis.
target: &80 你跟他谈过了，里吉斯博士。

source: &81 He is a truly, objectively despicable individual.
target: &81 客观地说，他确实是个卑鄙至极的人。

source: &900 You're one to talk.
target: &900 你倒好意思说别人。

source: &82 What I've done was terrible, but I wish to make reparations for what I've done.
target: &82 我做的事确实罪大恶极，但我希望能够弥补。

source: &113 After this is done, I shall devote my life's work to annihilating corruption in our city.
target: &113 等这件事结束，我会用毕生精力铲除本市的腐败。

source: &83 Ran wishes no more than to desecrate and pollute our nation as he has done his own.
target: &83 冉一心只想糟蹋我们的国家，就像他糟蹋自己的国家一样。

source: &901 What does Van der Waal have to do with this?
target: &901 这事跟范德瓦尔有什么关系？

source: &902 You nearly killed us all with that bomber!
target: &902 你找来的炸弹袭击者差点杀了我们所有人！

source: &84 I apologize most sincerely for that, Dr Regis.
target: &84 对此，我向你致以最诚挚的歉意，里吉斯博士。

source: &85 Had I known someone such as yourself would be present, I would have found other means.
target: &85 要是知道像你这样的人也会在场，我一定会另想办法。

source: &86 Please, consider what this means for the city.
target: &86 请你想一想，这对整座城市意味着什么。

source: &903 I'm unsure who I feel worse about.
target: &903 我真说不准，你们两个谁更让我反感。

source: &87 Please, Dr Regis!
target: &87 求你了，里吉斯博士！

source: &88 You know as I do how it is to be the victim of blackmail.
target: &88 被人勒索是什么滋味，你跟我一样清楚。

source: &89 Do the right thing...
target: &89 做正确的选择吧……

source: &120 Charlie! What have you found?
target: &120 查理！你发现了什么？

source: &904 I've completed my investigation.
target: &904 我的调查已经结束。

source: &120 That was most swift!
target: &120 真够快的！

source: &90 Though effective, I've no doubt.
target: &90 想必也很有成效。

source: &38 Who try to kill us?
target: &38 谁想杀我们？

source: &905 After finding enough evidence to exclude all other parties...
target: &905 我找到的证据足以排除其他所有人的嫌疑……

source: &906 ...the only conclusion possible is that Councillor Deane is responsible.
target: &906 ……所以，唯一可能的结论是：这次袭击由迪恩议员策划。

source: &39 What!?
&121 My word!
&121 Andrew, is this true?
target: &121 安德鲁，这是真的吗？

source: &40 See? He not say anything.
target: &40 看，他什么也不说。

source: &41 Otherwise, he have to tell truth.
target: &41 一开口，就得说真话。

source: &92 Yes. Yes, I am responsible.
target: &92 是。是我干的。

source: &93 I acted to save my family from my mistakes.
target: &93 我这么做，是为了不让自己的过错毁了家人。

source: &94 I joined this project to protect the city that I love.
target: &94 我加入这个项目，是为了保护我深爱的城市。

source: &95 The rest of you are backstabbing cowards, out to loot Newton for your own gain.
target: &95 而你们全都是背后捅刀的懦夫，只想从牛顿市捞取私利。

source: &122 I'm sorry you feel that way, Councillor.
target: &122 很遗憾你这么想，议员。

source: &123 That leaves us only one option, I'm afraid. Liam?
target: &123 那么，恐怕我们只剩一个选择了。利亚姆？

source: &907 What...what are you doing?
target: &907 什么……你们要干什么？

source: &908 Wait, stop!
target: &908 等等，住手！

source: &124 Poor dear Councillor Deane.
target: &124 可怜的迪恩议员。

source: &125 Tragically thrown from the building by the blast.
target: &125 不幸被爆炸的冲击抛出了大楼。

source: &909 This is...you're completely insane!
target: &909 这简直……你们全都疯了！

source: &126 We're doing what we have to, Charlie.
target: &126 我们也是迫不得已，查理。

source: &127 As promised, the information you require.
target: &127 按照约定，告诉你需要的情报。

source: &128 The man who has your kids - your Mindjacker - is a contractor, Jayam Kreisel.
target: &128 抓走你孩子的那个人，也就是那个意识劫持者，是个受雇办事的人，名叫贾亚姆·克赖塞尔。

source: &129 He's based out of an aerostat, currently moored at the Xanadu dockyard.
target: &129 他以一艘浮空艇为据点，目前停靠在上都船坞。

source: &910 You haven't changed one bit, Nina.
target: &910 你一点儿也没变，妮娜。

source: &130 I hope you find what you're looking for, Charlie.
target: &130 希望你能找到你要的东西，查理。

source: &131 Remember - I'm always here if you need my help.
target: &131 记住，需要我帮忙，随时可以来找我。

source: &911 ...the only conclusion possible is that Ran Shou-Man is responsible.
target: &911 ……所以，唯一可能的结论是：这次袭击由冉·寿曼策划。

source: &181 Ran, is this true?
target: &181 冉，这是真的吗？

source: &42 WHAT?! NO! He's lying!
target: &42 什么？！不是！他撒谎！

source: &43 Someone pay him to frame me!
target: &43 有人给他钱，让他栽赃我！

source: &182 I trust Regis' judgement.
target: &182 我相信里吉斯的判断。

source: &122 As do I.
target: &122 我也一样。

source: &97 Dr Regis is a man of good character.
target: &97 里吉斯博士为人正直。

source: &44 What are you doing?
target: &44 你们干什么？

source: &132 Poor dear Mr Ran.
target: &132 可怜的冉先生。

source: &133 By the way - that's an interesting choice that you made.
target: &133 顺便说一句，你刚才的选择很有意思。

source: &134 Perhaps we're more alike than you'd admit.
target: &134 也许我们比你愿意承认的更相像。

source: &1 Wh...where am I?
target: &1 我……我在哪儿？

source: &2 How did I even get here?
target: &2 我怎么到这儿来了？

source: &914 Hnngh...grr...rrr...
&29 What's that? I can't hear you.
target: &29 说什么？我听不见。

source: &37 It's quite a powerful paralytic, isn't it?
target: &37 这麻痹药效力挺强的，是吧？

source: &38 An unfortunate, yet necessary part of our mutual friend here's role.
target: &38 要干我们这位共同朋友的工作，少不了这道程序。遗憾，但也没办法。

source: &30 My targets have to be conscious when I pull the contents of their minds.
target: &30 我抽取他们脑子里的东西时，目标必须保持清醒。

source: &31 I'd love to rip the "Regis" clean out of your head, as well.
target: &31 我也很想把你脑子里的“里吉斯”给挖个干净。

source: &39 I told you, he's not wired.
target: &39 我说过了，他没有神经接口。

source: &32 I know. But, I know what'll really get to him.
target: &32 我知道。不过，我知道怎样才能真正让他痛苦。

source: &33 What's this? An embryo?
target: &33 这是什么？一个胚胎？

source: &915 Nnnggh...
&34 It's rather a contentious issue for us, isn't it?
target: &34 对我们来说，这可是个争议不小的话题，是吧？

source: &35 Rather a bit of history between us over these little things.
target: &35 这些小东西，跟我们过去的纠葛可深着呢。

source: &36 Oops. Fragile things, the unborn.
target: &36 哎呀。还没出生的小生命，真脆弱。

source: &37 Don't worry. Plenty more where that came from.
target: &37 别担心。这儿还有好多呢。

source: &916 GGNNNGGHH!
&38 I think *this* one is going to grow up to be a great success.
target: &38 我觉得*这个*长大以后一定大有作为。

source: &39 World leader? Nobel laureate? Maybe follow in their father's footsteps?
target: &39 世界领袖？诺贝尔奖得主？还是子承父业？

source: &40 Oops. All gone.
target: &40 哎呀。全没了。

source: &41 Vicky would be *so* proud, wouldn't she?
target: &41 维琪一定会*非常*骄傲，对吧？

source: &40 Kreisel...
target: &40 克赖塞尔……

source: &42 After all, you showed her how important those things were.
target: &42 毕竟，是你让她明白了这些东西有多重要。

source: &43 More than anything else in the world, apparently...
target: &43 显然，比世上任何东西都重要……

source: &41 BAXTER!
target: &41 巴克斯特！

source: &42 You seriously need professional help.
target: &42 你真的该去找专业人士治治了。

source: &1 Sir, Ma'am, smart-cam feed shows another CEL agent just boarded the aerostat.
target: &1 先生，女士，智能摄像头显示，又有一名CEL探员登上了浮空艇。

source: &2 Female, about one-point-seven-five meters.
target: &2 女性，身高约一点七五米。

source: &43 Huh. Should have known she'd still be after her partner.
target: &43 哼，早该知道，她不会放弃找自己的搭档。

source: &44 Commander, prepare to weigh anchor.
target: &44 指挥官，准备起锚。

source: &45 Kreisel, deal with our new CEL intruder.
target: &45 克赖塞尔，去处理新来的那位CEL入侵者。

source: &46 Then...resolve whatever issues you have with Dr Regis.
target: &46 然后……把你跟里吉斯博士之间的问题解决掉。

source: &44 With pleasure...
target: &44 乐意效劳……

source: &45 Don't go anywhere...
target: &45 别乱跑哦……

source: &591 Nobody home.
&6591 Nobody home.
&593 Hello?
&1 USER I.F.F. NOT FOUND - CONSIDER HOSTILE
target: &1 未找到用户敌我识别信息——视为敌对目标

source: &2 Hi there!
target: &2 你好啊！

source: &594 How do you feel?
target: &594 感觉怎么样？

source: &3 POWER SYSTEMS: NOMINAL
target: &3 动力系统：正常

source: &4 PRIMARY MISSION HEURISTICS: ACTIVE
target: &4 主要任务启发式程序：已启用

source: &5 AMMUNITION: DEPLETED
target: &5 弹药：耗尽

source: &595 Hungry, then?
target: &595 那就是饿了？

source: &6 I'm just dandy, thanks!
target: &6 好得很，谢谢！

source: &7 'cept I'm all outta ammo.
target: &7 就是弹药全打光啦。

source: &596 Sorry about that. I'll see what I can do.
target: &596 抱歉啊。我看看能不能帮你。

source: &8 I feel...powerful!
target: &8 我感觉……浑身都是力量！

source: &597 Ready to go?
target: &597 准备好出发了吗？

source: &9 All loaded with 16mm DUP armor-piercing, and ready for action!
target: &9 16毫米DUP穿甲弹已装填完毕，随时可以行动！

source: &598 What's your primary mission?
target: &598 你的主要任务是什么？

source: &10 OBJECTIVE: NEUTRALIZE INTRUDERS
target: &10 目标：消除入侵者的威胁

source: &11 I'm here to blast any and all intruders!
target: &11 我来这儿就是为了轰掉所有入侵者！

source: &12 If someone tries to get into the command section - pow!
target: &12 有人敢进指挥区，就给他一炮！

source: &13 OBJECTIVE: ASSIST CASEWORK - CEL CSO DRs REGIS AND LAO
target: &13 目标：协助CEL的CSO里吉斯博士与劳博士办案

source: &14 You asked me to come help on your case, Dr Max!
target: &14 麦克斯博士，是你叫我来帮你办案的呀！

source: &599 Blast that door.
target: &599 把那扇门轰开。

source: &15 ERROR - UNAUTHORIZED USER
target: &15 错误——用户未获授权

source: &600 Oh, so you won't take my orders?
target: &600 哦，所以你不听我的指令？

source: &602 Well?
&16 Um, I'm real sorry Dr Max...
target: &16 呃，真对不起，麦克斯博士……

source: &17 I just don't know how to drive this thing!
target: &17 我不知道怎么驾驶这玩意儿！

source: &603 What?!
&18 I could make you a martini though...would that help?
target: &18 不过我可以给你调杯马天尼……能帮上忙吗？

source: &19 *click*
&20 Sorry, I'm all outta bullets!
target: &20 抱歉，子弹全打光啦！

source: &604 Keep at it. Don't let anyone out.
target: &604 继续守着。别让任何人出去。

source: &125 Roger that!
&605 Don't go anywhere.
target: &605 待在这儿。

source: &22 ERROR - LOCOMOTIVE SYSTEMS NOT ENABLED
target: &22 错误——移动系统未启用

source: &23 Okie dokie!
&917 Hi there. Are you alright?
target: &917 你好。你没事吧？

source: &169 Get nuked! You're the one who tried to kill me in the first place!
target: &169 挨核弹去！一开始就是你想杀我！

source: &918 You're awake! How do you feel?
target: &918 你醒了！感觉怎么样？

source: &919 Are you alright? Does it hurt anywhere?
target: &919 你没事吧？哪儿疼吗？

source: &920 Why would you say that?
target: &920 你为什么这么说？

source: &170 I SAW the datafeed from 14-E! You were there!
target: &170 我看了14-E的监控！你就在那儿！

source: &171 YOU planted the bomb!
target: &171 炸弹是你放的！

source: &921 Who showed you that feed? Do you trust THEM?
target: &921 谁给你看的监控？你信得过他们吗？

source: &173 It's still a pretty big coincidence you being here too!
target: &173 可你居然也在这儿，还是太巧了吧！

source: &922 I'm a CEL agent. I came looking for a missing girl. It's my job.
target: &922 我是CEL探员。我来找一个失踪的女孩，这是我的工作。

source: &174 All I know is, you're still following me, and I need to get outta here.
target: &174 我只知道，你还在跟着我，我得离开这儿。

source: &175 Get outta my way, or I'll shoot!
target: &175 让开，不然我开枪了！

source: &923 No you won't.
target: &923 不，你不会的。

source: &924 I don't know what you're talking about!
target: &924 我不知道你在说什么！

source: &176 And you keep showing up! At CEL, here...you're following me!
target: &176 你总是出现！在CEL，在这里……你一直在跟踪我！

source: &177 I need to get outta here...get outta my way! I'll shoot!
target: &177 我得离开这儿……让开！不然我开枪了！

source: &925 Yes. I planted the bomb.
target: &925 是的，炸弹是我放的。

source: &926 I apologize for what I did, but I can't take it back.
target: &926 我为自己的所作所为道歉，但发生过的事没办法挽回。

source: &178 Why are you trying to kill me?
target: &178 你为什么想杀我？

source: &927 I wasn't...specifically. But...something very important was on the line.
target: &927 我并不是……专门冲着你来的。可是……当时有件非常重要的事受到威胁。

source: &928 My judgement was affected, but now that's been...resolved. You're safe with me now.
target: &928 当时我的判断受了影响，不过问题已经……解决了。现在有我在，你是安全的。

source: &179 Nuke you, man!
target: &179 你挨核弹去吧！

source: &929 It's a signature weapon.
target: &929 这是把生物识别武器。

source: &930 It's locked to my genetic fingerprint.
target: &930 它绑定了我的基因指纹。

source: &931 I'm the only one who can fire it.
target: &931 只有我能用它开枪。

source: &181 I don't believe you! You're bluffing!
target: &181 我不信！你在唬我！

source: &932 It's empty. Out of charge.
target: &932 它已经空了。没电了。

source: &933 Otherwise, I'd have had a heck of an easier time getting in here.
target: &933 不然，我进来的时候也不用这么费劲。

source: &934 I can see it in your eyes, and the way you're holding that weapon.
target: &934 从你的眼神，还有你拿枪的样子，我就能看出来。

source: &935 You don't want to shoot, you're a good person.
target: &935 你不想开枪。你是个好人。

source: &182 You don't know me!
target: &182 你根本不了解我！

source: &936 Deep down, you know I just want to help you, and you want that help too.
target: &936 其实你心里清楚，我只是想帮你，而你也希望有人帮你。

source: &472 I'm finally at the site.
target: &472 我终于到地方了。

source: &473 You were right, I can feel the connection.
target: &473 你说得没错，我能感觉到连接。

source: &192 That is good to hear.
&193 You managed to avoid detection in your journey?
target: &193 路上没有被发现吧？

source: &474 Yeah, nobody noticed me.
target: &474 嗯，没人注意我。

source: &475 Just some thrall, wandering the Southwest city.
target: &475 不过是个在城市西南闲逛的迷奴。

source: &476 What is it you need me to do here?
target: &476 你需要我在这儿做什么？

source: &194 We have the ID for their system, but are unable to access it.
target: &194 我们拿到了他们系统的ID，但无法接入。

source: &195 You must get close enough to it to act as a relay point.
target: &195 你必须靠得足够近，充当中继节点。

source: &477 Then your tech-teams break into it, and find out what their plans are?
target: &477 然后，你的技术团队就能侵入系统，查出他们的计划？

source: &478 Remind me, what am I doing here?
target: &478 再提醒我一下，我来这儿是要干什么？

source: &196 Just getting close enough to their main server.
target: &196 只要靠近他们的主服务器就行。

source: &197 We suspect it to be based on the aerostat.
target: &197 我们怀疑它就在那艘浮空艇上。

source: &479 Then when I'm near enough to it...
target: &479 那么，等我靠得足够近……

source: &198 We shall use your wiring as a relay for our hackers.
target: &198 我们就能利用你的神经接口，为黑客提供中继。

source: &480 Okay, I think I got it.
target: &480 好，我想我明白了。

source: &481 I can sense the signal you mentioned.
target: &481 我能感觉到你提过的那个信号。

source: &482 I've got a visual representation in my Trance hub.
target: &482 我的迷境中心里也能看到它的图示。

source: &199 Good, you'll know how close you are to your goal.
target: &199 很好，这样就能知道你离目标还有多远。

source: &483 If they're trying to hide, why are they broadcasting like this?
target: &483 既然想躲起来，他们为什么还要这样广播信号？

source: &200 Like much of hacking, we must look for mistakes our target makes.
target: &200 跟很多黑客行动一样，我们要寻找目标犯下的错误。

source: &201 What you sense is not intentional on their part.
target: &201 你感知到的信号，并不是他们有意发出的。

source: &484 Oh, so it's seepage? Like, inter-system connections they haven't noticed.
target: &484 哦，是泄漏的信号？比如，他们没注意到的系统间连接。

source: &202 Precisely. Many of their own devices communicate wirelessly.
target: &202 正是。他们自己的许多设备都通过无线方式通信。

source: &203 Their attempt at security involves limiting the range.
target: &203 他们的防护措施，就是限制信号范围。

source: &204 They therefore avoid attacks from the net at large.
target: &204 这样就能避开来自外部网络的攻击。

source: &485 But if you can get a relay close enough...
target: &485 可要是让中继靠得足够近……

source: &205 Then we may study their signal as though we were by your side.
target: &205 我们就能分析他们的信号，如同站在你身边一样。

source: &486 The guard wouldn't let me in.
target: &486 守卫不让我进去。

source: &206 I shouldn't think that surprising.
target: &206 我倒不觉得意外。

source: &207 They are a clandestine operation.
target: &207 他们做的事见不得光。

source: &487 Hey, if they're after me, why didn't he just shoot me?
target: &487 嘿，既然他们想杀我，他为什么不直接开枪？

source: &208 Most likely, he doesn't know who you are.
target: &208 很可能，他不知道你是谁。

source: &209 He won't have been instructed beyond his current role.
target: &209 他得到的指令，应该只有眼下这份差事。

source: &488 Which is, "stop people getting in".
target: &488 也就是，“不让人进去”。

source: &489 I guess their secrecy's working in our favor.
target: &489 看来他们严守秘密，反倒帮了我们。

source: &210 For now.
target: &210 暂时是这样。

source: &490 Do you have any idea why they're after me?
target: &490 你知道他们为什么盯上我吗？

source: &211 We've suspicions that it's related to your unusually high sync rate.
target: &211 我们怀疑，这跟你异常高的同步率有关。

source: &212 I don't think I've seen a mind-machine interface work so fast outside of a laboratory.
target: &212 除了实验室，我想我还没见过运作这么快的心智与机器接口。

source: &491 Aha! So you're a scientist!
target: &491 啊哈！所以，你是科学家！

source: &213 I thought it was considered poor netiquette to pry into one's outside life?
target: &213 打听别人现实中的生活，好像不太符合网络礼仪吧？

source: &492 I...uh...yeah...sorry...
&493 Just that this isn't the kind of thing I normally get into.
target: &493 只是，我平时不会卷进这种事情。

source: &214 You feel unsafe, and believe that a greater comprehension would alleviate it.
target: &214 你感到不安，觉得多了解一些就能安心一点。

source: &215 I understand perfectly. All you need to know about me is that I'm on your side, Mandala.
target: &215 我完全理解。关于我，你只需要知道：我站在你这边，曼荼罗。

source: &494 You said CEL wasn't out to get me;
target: &494 你说CEL并不想杀我；

source: &495 So why was a CEL agent trying to blow me up?
target: &495 那为什么有个CEL探员想把我炸死？

source: &216 If he's acting independently of CEL, it means one of two things:
target: &216 如果他的行动与CEL无关，就只有两种可能：

source: &217 Something about your death would benefit him.
target: &217 你的死能给他带来某种好处。

source: &218 Or, he is being compelled to act in such a way.
target: &218 或者，他是被迫这么做的。

source: &496 I hope it's number two.
target: &496 我希望是第二种。

source: &497 If we can stop whoever's behind this first,
target: &497 只要我们先阻止幕后的人，

source: &498 ...then it means he's got no reason to come after me.
target: &498 ……他就没有理由再来追杀我了。

source: &219 Let us hope.
target: &219 但愿如此。

source: &499 What is your breaching team going to do?
target: &499 你的入侵团队打算做什么？

source: &500 When I reach the systems, I mean.
target: &500 我是说，等我靠近那些系统以后。

source: &220 We aim to rip their memory drives.
target: &220 我们要抽取他们存储设备中的数据。

source: &221 Cloning them on to another system allows us to perform more destructive analytics.
target: &221 把数据克隆到另一套系统，就能采用破坏性更强的分析手段。

source: &501 Plus the process would wreck their whole system as well.
target: &501 而且，这个过程也会毁掉他们整套系统。

source: &502 Ugh...better hope they haven't got any people connected to the system.
target: &502 呃……最好祈祷没有人连在系统上。

source: &503 Anyone wired's going to find their brains fried, and stored in a mem-capsule.
target: &503 有神经接口的人，脑子会被烧坏，意识还会被装进记忆胶囊。

source: &222 Of course, before this takes place, we will secure a backdoor to the system.
target: &222 当然，在此之前，我们会先取得系统的后门。

source: &223 That way, we will not depend upon you as a relay.
target: &223 这样，就不用依赖你提供中继。

source: &224 You will therefore be able to escape once this has been accomplished.
target: &224 完成这一步以后，你就可以逃走了。

source: &504 So...the people trying to kill me are working out of an old aerodrome?
target: &504 所以……想杀我的人，就藏在一座旧机场里？

source: &225 Quite so. This air-freight business collapsed last year.
target: &225 正是。这家航空货运公司去年倒闭了。

source: &226 We suspect that it was bought up as a front for this criminal enterprise.
target: &226 我们怀疑，有人买下了它，为这些犯罪活动打掩护。

source: &505 They're storing their data-systems in the aerostat?
target: &505 他们把数据系统放在浮空艇里？

source: &506 Why don't they just split it up and hide it in the Trance?
target: &506 为什么不把它拆散，藏进迷境？

source: &227 Physical security is as much a concern for admins as system integrity.
target: &227 对管理员来说，实体安全和系统完整性一样重要。

source: &228 If they suspect someone of getting too close...
target: &228 如果他们怀疑有人靠得太近……

source: &507 ...they can just take off. Huh.
target: &507 ……直接飞走就行了。哈。

source: &508 I think I found a way to get closer to the systems on the aerostat.
target: &508 我想，我找到办法靠近浮空艇上的系统了。

source: &509 They won't load the cargo crate I was hiding in, though.
target: &509 可他们不肯装上我藏身的货箱。

source: &229 Hm...did they scan it?
target: &229 嗯……他们扫描过货箱吗？

source: &510 Only a little.
target: &510 稍微扫了一下。

source: &230 Perhaps they won't handle it because it does not match their expectations?
target: &230 也许是因为里面的东西与他们预期不符，才不肯接收？

source: &511 Well, I've got to hide in it. I can't change that.
target: &511 可我得藏在里面。这一点改不了。

source: &231 Then, you need to change what they expect to find.
target: &231 那就改变他们预期会发现的东西。

source: &513 I'll get back to you.
target: &513 我再联系你。

source: &232 Good luck!
target: &232 祝你顺利！

source: &617 Hey, Regis.
target: &617 嘿，里吉斯。

source: &948 Yes, Dr Lao?
target: &948 什么事，劳博士？

source: &618 You feeling any better?
target: &618 感觉好点了吗？

source: &949 A little...how did you know to come to my rescue?
target: &949 好了点……你怎么知道要来救我？

source: &619 I broke their comms channels. Figured I owed it to them.
target: &619 我破解了他们的通信频道。总得回敬一下嘛。

source: &620 Cracked the bug they put in my system, and rode the signal back to theirs.
target: &620 我破解了他们植入我系统的窃听程序，再沿着信号摸回他们那里。

source: &950 I'll never be able to figure out how you do these things, Max.
target: &950 麦克斯，我永远也弄不明白你是怎么做到这些事的。

source: &621 Which guarantees my job security!
target: &621 所以我的饭碗才稳啊！

source: &951 We need to get after the people running this aerostat - and this conspiracy.
target: &951 我们得去追这艘浮空艇的负责人，还有整个阴谋的主使。

source: &952 I'll see what I can do for this girl.
target: &952 我看看能为这个女孩做些什么。

source: &632 So, Nina Jeong led us to these people.
target: &632 所以，是妮娜·郑让我们找到这些人的。

source: &633 She's helping us find whoever set you up for Baxter's murder, right?
target: &633 她在帮我们找出谁把巴克斯特谋杀案栽赃给了你，对吧？

source: &964 There's that...and...
target: &964 是有这回事……还有……

source: &965 Max, I haven't been completely honest with you.
target: &965 麦克斯，我没有对你完全坦白。

source: &634 There's a surprise. Dr Cryptic has been witholding info.
target: &634 真稀奇啊。“神秘博士”居然还藏着事。

source: &966 Ah, cram it, Lao. These people...they took something from me.
target: &966 啊，闭嘴吧，劳。这些人……他们拿走了我的东西。

source: &967 Embryos fertilized by myself, and by Vicky...my wife...
target: &967 我和维琪……我妻子共同培育的胚胎……

source: &635 These people stole your embryos? Your KIDS?
target: &635 他们偷走了你们的胚胎？你的孩子？

source: &968 They needed me to get their memory module for them from Van der Waal...
target: &968 他们要我替他们从范德瓦尔手里拿到记忆模块……

source: &969 And they knew exactly what my price would be...
target: &969 而且，他们清楚该拿什么跟我交换……

source: &636 Wait, they tried to get you to HELP them?
target: &636 等等，他们还想让你帮他们？

source: &970 They FORCED me, Max! There was no way I could say no!
target: &970 他们逼我的，麦克斯！我根本没办法拒绝！

source: &971 Those embryos...they were all I had left of her...
target: &971 那些胚胎……是她留给我的最后一点东西……

source: &972 And because of those people...of all this...
target: &972 可是，因为那些人……因为这一切……

source: &637 I hate to say it Regis, but you're in serious trouble.
target: &637 我也不想这么说，里吉斯，可你的问题很严重。

source: &638 They broke you with this...they nearly compromised this case because of it!
target: &638 他们拿这件事压垮了你……差点毁了整个案子！

source: &639 You should have told me! I'd have done what I could!
target: &639 你该告诉我的！我一定会想办法！

source: &973 Nobody could have helped me, Max.
target: &973 没人能帮得了我，麦克斯。

source: &974 I was...obsessed...I panicked...
target: &974 我当时……满脑子都是这件事……慌了……

source: &975 I felt like I was doing it for...her...for my wife...
target: &975 我觉得，我是在为……她……为我妻子这么做……

source: &640 Regis, I hate to say this so bluntly -
target: &640 里吉斯，我也不想把话说得这么直——

source: &641 Your wife is dead. You have an obsession with these ARTIFACTS of her.
target: &641 你妻子已经死了。你执着的，只是她留下的这些东西。

source: &642 The garden, the embryos...
target: &642 花园，还有那些胚胎……

source: &643 You need to FOCUS, Regis. People need our help, right now.
target: &643 你得专心办案，里吉斯。现在还有人需要我们帮助。

source: &644 We've been led straight to our lead suspect.
target: &644 我们已经顺着线索，直接找到了头号嫌疑人。

source: &645 Can I count on you to do the right thing?
target: &645 我能指望你作出正确的选择吗？

source: &977 ...the embryos are gone. He destroyed them.
target: &977 ……胚胎已经没了。他毁了它们。

source: &978 There's nothing else they've got to twist me.
target: &978 他们再也没东西能拿来要挟我了。

source: &646 Okay. Good.
target: &646 好。那就好。

source: &647 I hate to say it Regis, but...I kind of understand.
target: &647 我也不想这么说，里吉斯，不过……我有点能理解你。

source: &979 They asked me to do...terrible things...for the return of the embryos.
target: &979 为了换回胚胎，他们让我去做……很可怕的事……

source: &648 Whether it's because they're a link to Viksha, or because you're their FATHER...
target: &648 不管是因为它们把你跟维克莎连在一起，还是因为你是它们的父亲……

source: &649 I don't even want to think of what I'd have done in your position.
target: &649 我都不敢想，换成我会做出什么事。

source: &650 Regis, I'm sorry...
target: &650 里吉斯，真对不起……

source: &980 There's nothing left. There's nothing else he can twist me with.
target: &980 什么也不剩了。他再也没东西能拿来要挟我了。

source: &981 All we can do is bring that monster in...for them...
target: &981 我们唯一能做的，就是抓住那个畜生……为了它们……

source: &651 Nina's led us right to the Mindjacker?
target: &651 妮娜让我们直接找到了那个意识劫持者？

source: &982 He was the blond one Chantelle took down.
target: &982 就是尚特尔制服的那个金发男人。

source: &983 I heard him gloat about what he'd done.
target: &983 我听到他得意洋洋地炫耀自己的所作所为。

source: &984 He stores the targets' information within his own wiring until he can offload it.
target: &984 他把目标的信息暂存在自己的神经接口里，之后再卸载出去。

source: &652 Looks like he's got quite an operation behind him.
target: &652 看来他背后的组织还挺有规模。

source: &653 I guess it's not surprising - he's been robbing synapses all over the world.
target: &653 倒也不意外。他都在全世界到处偷别人的神经信息了。

source: &654 Gotta be for something more than corporate espionage, at this rate.
target: &654 搞这么大阵仗，肯定不只是商业间谍活动。

source: &655 So...the Mindjacker tried to blackmail you because you're on this case?
target: &655 所以……意识劫持者勒索你，是因为你在查这个案子？

source: &985 It's more than that...it sounded personal...
target: &985 不只是这样……听起来像有私仇……

source: &656 Maybe you've crossed paths before?
target: &656 也许你们以前打过交道？

source: &986 No...not with him.
target: &986 没有……跟他没有。

source: &987 But the way he talked...it was like he was out for REVENGE.
target: &987 可他说话的样子……就像要找我报仇。

source: &988 Not just that - it's as if he were BAXTER looking for revenge.
target: &988 还不只是这样。简直就像巴克斯特本人来找我报仇。

source: &657 That's impossible - Baxter's dead, for one thing!
target: &657 不可能。首先，巴克斯特已经死了！

source: &658 Maybe he's his son?
target: &658 也许他是巴克斯特的儿子？

source: &989 No...he's a Mindjacker.
target: &989 不是……他是意识劫持者。

source: &990 When he drained Baxter, he didn't just get information...
target: &990 抽空巴克斯特的意识时，他得到的并不只是信息……

source: &991 He got his motivation, as well - and it stuck.
target: &991 还有巴克斯特的动机，而那些动机留在了他脑子里。

source: &659 Sounds like he got more than he bargained for.
target: &659 听起来，他捞到的比自己想要的还多。

source: &660 So, we've caught up with our Mindjacker.
target: &660 所以，我们追上了那个意识劫持者。

source: &661 We know that he's apparently ripped dozens of prominent individuals in a number of fields.
target: &661 我们知道，他显然抽取过各个领域数十位知名人士的意识。

source: &992 Including Baxter, some of whom has apparently stuck.
target: &992 包括巴克斯特。而且，巴克斯特的一部分显然留在了他脑子里。

source: &993 Question is, what's all this setup?
target: &993 问题是，这整套设备到底要干什么？

source: &662 What do they plan on doing with the data they've stolen?
target: &662 他们打算拿偷来的数据做什么？

source: &663 Straight neural data's hard to process.
target: &663 未经处理的神经数据很难解析。

source: &664 That is, unless you've got an AI to read it.
target: &664 除非有个人工智能帮忙读取。

source: &994 Whatever it is, it must involve this girl...
target: &994 不管是什么，肯定跟这个女孩有关……

source: &665 Who was escaping through the ceiling hatch?
target: &665 从天花板舱口逃走的那个人是谁？

source: &666 It wasn't the Mindjacker, was it?
target: &666 不是那个意识劫持者吧？

source: &995 No, he's the one Chantelle caught...briefly.
target: &995 不是。意识劫持者是被尚特尔抓住的那个……暂时抓住了。

source: &996 By the sound of it, the Mindjacker's working for her.
target: &996 听起来，他在替她干活。

source: &667 His work is part of a larger plan of hers, then?
target: &667 那么，他干的事是她更大计划的一部分？

source: &997 Possibly. She's the one running this lab, for sure.
target: &997 有可能。这间实验室肯定归她管。

source: &668 Chantelle's really pulling her weight in this job.
target: &668 尚特尔这次可帮了不少忙。

source: &999 I'm not going to make any promises about taking her on full-time.
target: &999 我可没答应让她当正式员工。

source: &1218 That's a shame. She's useful.
target: &1218 真可惜。她挺有用的。

source: &1706 For what, her shining wit?
target: &1706 什么用？靠她那出众的机智吗？

source: &1219 Never underestimate having someone around who'll do anything you say.
target: &1219 身边有个对你言听计从的人，可别小看这种好处。

source: &1707 Why else do you think I keep *you* around?
target: &1707 不然，你以为我为什么把*你*留在身边？

source: &1220 Ouch. Walked right into that one, didn't I?
target: &1220 嘶。我这不是自己往枪口上撞吗？

source: &998 It's a shame it couldn't hold down Kreisel - the Mindjacker.
target: &998 可惜它没能按住克赖塞尔，那个意识劫持者。

source: &669 Hey, cut her some slack!
target: &669 嘿，别对她太苛刻！

source: &670 She took down two heavies on the tarmac.
target: &670 她可是在停机坪上放倒了两个打手。

source: &671 Pfft. You're just worried about synthetics stealing your job.
target: &671 嘁。你就是怕合成人抢了你的饭碗。

source: &1000 You may as well take this now.
target: &1000 这个现在交给你好了。

source: Downloaded: PERSONALITY SPLITTER
target: 已下载：人格分离器

source: &1001 You seem to be the maid-wrangler.
target: &1001 看来，调教女仆是你的专长。

source: &672 So, this Kreisel guy - the Mindjacker - HE killed Baxter?
target: &672 所以，这个克赖塞尔，也就是意识劫持者，才是杀死巴克斯特的人？

source: &1002 And by the sound of it, ripped the contents of his mind first.
target: &1002 听起来，他先抽走了巴克斯特脑子里的东西。

source: &673 Hm...when I saw Baxter's head, I thought that either his killer REALLY hated him...
target: &673 嗯……我看到巴克斯特的脑袋时，觉得凶手要么恨他恨得要死……

source: &1003 Like *I* would. Or, he was covering up evidence of a mindjacking by destroying his brain tissue.
target: &1003 就像*我*那样。要么，是在破坏脑组织，掩盖意识劫持的证据。

source: &674 It's a theory. Sounds like we might be able to back it up.
target: &674 这是个推测。听起来，也许能找到证据支持。

source: &675 So...what do we do from here?
target: &675 所以……接下来怎么办？

source: &1004 Now we know this is where the Mindjacker's operating from.
target: &1004 现在，我们知道这里就是意识劫持者的据点。

source: &676 We need to find out what their plans for all those stolen memories are.
target: &676 我们得查出他们打算怎样利用那些偷来的记忆。

source: &1005 We'd better find where this aerostat's going, too.
target: &1005 还得查出这艘浮空艇要去哪儿。

source: &677 The best way of covering all of those would be apprehending these people.
target: &677 最好的办法，就是把这些人抓住。一并解决。

source: &1006 Good plan. We'd need to get to the upper deck.
target: &1006 好主意。我们得上到上层甲板。

source: &678 How? They've locked the hatches, and I haven't seen any cutting tools.
target: &678 怎么上？舱口都锁了，我也没看见能切开它们的工具。
