source: &1007 There's gotta be another access somewhere on this floating garbage-heap.
target: &1007 这堆飘在天上的破烂，肯定还有别的入口。

source: &679 Central's gonna be pretty pissed about this.
target: &679 中枢这回可要大发雷霆了。

source: &680 More than usual, I mean.
target: &680 我是说，比平时还生气。

source: &1008 Is it working again?
target: &1008 它又能用了？

source: &681 Yeah, we fought off the intrusion.
target: &681 是啊，我们击退了入侵。

source: &1009 Damn. I was hoping they'd broken it permanently.
target: &1009 该死。我还盼着他们把它彻底弄坏呢。

source: &682 Nah, we could handle it.
target: &682 没有，我们能应付。

source: &683 It was a weird attack, though.
target: &683 不过，那次攻击很古怪。

source: &684 Like...they knew exactly what they were doing.
target: &684 就像……他们每一步都心中有数。

source: &1010 Well-trained hackers - foreign intelligence?
target: &1010 训练有素的黑客？外国情报部门？

source: &685 No, better than that...like they were intimately familiar with Central.
target: &685 不，比那还厉害……他们好像对中枢了如指掌。

source: &686 Then, as sudden as it had started, the attack halted about eighteen hours later.
target: &686 然后，大约十八小时后，攻击突然停了，就跟开始时一样毫无征兆。

source: &687 Any idea who the thrall in sconto-blue is?
target: &687 知道那个穿蓝色救济服的迷奴是谁吗？

source: &1011 Not a clue. She must be important to their plan.
target: &1011 不知道。她一定对他们的计划很重要。

source: &688 Maybe she just wandered into their airfield?
target: &688 也许她只是闲逛，误入了他们的机场？

source: &689 A useful test-subject for...whatever this is...
target: &689 正好拿来当实验对象……虽然还不知道是什么实验……

source: &1012 She was at CEL earlier. She'd been...targeted...
target: &1012 她之前在CEL。有人……盯上了她……

source: &1013 They must be after her, for some reason.
target: &1013 他们肯定有什么理由，要追杀她。

source: &1014 I'll do what I can to keep her stable.
target: &1014 我会尽力稳住她的状态。

source: &690 Do your best, Regis...hm...
target: &690 尽力吧，里吉斯……嗯……

source: &3266 What?
&691 She looks familiar...I can't quite place her, though.
target: &691 她看着挺眼熟……可我想不起来了。

source: &692 I guess I see too many thralls.
target: &692 大概是我见过太多迷奴了。

source: &693 Any idea what all this hardware does, yet?
target: &693 搞清楚这些设备是做什么的了吗？

source: &1015 Not sure. I can't access the terminal.
target: &1015 还没有。我进不了终端。

source: &694 Sounds like you need a specialist!
target: &694 听起来，你需要一位专家！

source: &695 I'll tell you what I find.
target: &695 有发现我会告诉你。

source: &696 Dr Baxter says "hi".
target: &696 巴克斯特博士向你问好。

source: &697 He seems a lot friendlier than I expected.
target: &697 他好像比我想象的友好得多。

source: &698 Oh, don't panic. It appears he remembers his own ripping...and death.
target: &698 哦，别慌。看来，他记得自己意识被抽取的过程……还有死亡。

source: &699 Looks like we can be sure he was the Mindjacker's latest victim.
target: &699 看来可以确定，他是意识劫持者最新的一名受害者。

source: &700 A significant part of his mind-state's been offloaded into this system.
target: &700 他的意识状态有相当一部分，已经卸载到了这套系统里。

source: &1016 But...why did you see him? Why is he in there?
target: &1016 可是……你为什么会见到他？他为什么在里面？

source: &701 They've been ripping minds, and reprogramming the data through a memory module.
target: &701 他们抽取意识，再用一个记忆模块重新编排那些数据。

source: &702 I guess Baxter's the latest, and still has the most independent agency.
target: &702 我猜巴克斯特是最新的一名，所以还保留着最多的自主性。

source: &703 It doesn't sound like he harbors any ill will towards you, though.
target: &703 不过听起来，他并没有恨你。

source: &1017 Maybe the neural-Governor? He wouldn't be able to get angry...
target: &1017 也许是神经限制器？他没办法生气……

source: &704 Well, he's dead. There's no Governor.
target: &704 可是，他已经死了。也没有限制器了。

source: &705 I think that this "ghost" of his in the machine doesn't include that part of him.
target: &705 我想，机器里这个“幽灵”并没有带上他的那一部分。

source: &1018 You mean...this Mindjacker's kept it?
target: &1018 你是说……意识劫持者把那一部分留下了？

source: &706 Or just can't get rid of it.
target: &706 也可能是他想甩都甩不掉。

source: &707 Have you turned up anything useful?
target: &707 找到有用的东西了吗？

source: &708 Find anything useful, yet?
target: &708 找到什么有用的东西没有？

source: &1019 Just a length of cable.
target: &1019 就一段缆绳。

source: Picked up: STEEL CABLE
target: 已拾取：钢缆

source: Picked up:[- STEEL CABLE[- SCALPEL
target: 已拾取：[- 钢缆[- 手术刀

source: &709 Why would I need a steel cable?
target: &709 我要钢缆干什么？

source: &1020 You're the tech, you figure it out.
target: &1020 你是技术专家，你来想办法。

source: &1021 I also picked these up when I was finding my way in.
target: &1021 我在找路进来的时候，还拿到了这些。

source: Picked up: THERMAL GOGGLES
target: 已拾取：热成像眼镜

source: &710 Now, that's more like it!
target: &710 这才像话嘛！

source: &1022 Come find me, and I'll show you.
target: &1022 来找我，我给你看看。

source: &27 Any idea how many heavies they've got left?
target: &27 知道他们还剩几个打手吗？

source: &34 At least two more, but I don't know for sure.
target: &34 至少还有两个，但我不确定。

source: &29 Me neither - they've got some pretty slick encryption on their comm traffic.
target: &29 我也不确定。他们的通信加密相当厉害。

source: &35 Are you saying that even *you* can't breach it?
target: &35 你的意思是，连*你*也破解不了？

source: &30 Not remotely, but maybe if I could find something connected to their comm network...
target: &30 远程不行。不过，要是能找到连在他们通信网络上的东西……

source: &711 I'll check in later.
target: &711 我晚点再联系你。

source: &871 Excuse me.
target: &871 打扰一下。

source: &10 Hello there!
target: &10 你好啊！

source: &872 Who are you?
&11 Allow me to introduce myself, my dear.
target: &11 让我自我介绍一下，亲爱的。

source: &12 My name is Dr Baxter. I operate the cataloging station.
target: &12 我是巴克斯特博士，负责这个编目站。

source: &873 Baxter? Dr Adam Baxter?
target: &873 巴克斯特？亚当·巴克斯特博士？

source: &13 I believe so, yes!
target: &13 我想是的，没错！

source: &874 Excuse me if this sounds a little rude, but...
target: &874 如果这话听起来有点无礼，请见谅，不过……

source: &875 Aren't you dead?
target: &875 你不是死了吗？

source: &14 How do you mean?
target: &14 什么意思？

source: &876 Well...yesterday I was probing your well-preserved remains at a crimescene.
target: &876 嗯……昨天，我还在犯罪现场检查你那保存得挺好的遗体。

source: &15 Oh yes...you're quite right. I *was* killed, wasn't I?
target: &15 哦，没错……你说得很对。我确实*被杀了*，是吧？

source: &16 It's strange, because...I could have sworn I was one the doing it.
target: &16 可真奇怪……我分明记得，动手的好像是我。

source: &877 Not the blonde man? The Mindjacker?
target: &877 不是那个金发男人？那个意识劫持者？

source: &17 It was definitely him, no doubt about it.
target: &17 绝对是他，毫无疑问。

source: &18 One can't exactly commit suicide with a hammer, can they?
target: &18 毕竟，总不能用锤子自杀吧？

source: &19 I'm aware that I was murdered...but I have a surprisingly vivid memory of it.
target: &19 我知道自己被谋杀了……可那段记忆却清晰得惊人。

source: &878 You REMEMBER being murdered?
target: &878 你记得自己被谋杀的过程？

source: &20 Not precisely. It's as though it were an out-of-body experience.
target: &20 不完全是。就像是一次灵魂出窍。

source: &21 I have memory of watching the hammer...striking...from above...
target: &21 我记得自己看着锤子……从上方……砸下去……

source: &22 My hands...his hands...so bloody...
target: &22 我的手……他的手……全是血……

source: &23 It's all very peculiar, isn't it?
target: &23 真是奇怪，不是吗？

source: &879 And you see no difficulty between "being dead" and "talking to me"?
target: &879 你不觉得，“已经死了”和“正在跟我说话”之间有什么矛盾？

source: &24 That is...most odd.
target: &24 这……确实很古怪。

source: &880 Do you know a Dr Regis?
target: &880 你认识里吉斯博士吗？

source: &25 I know two, in fact. Charles, and...Viksha...
target: &25 其实，我认识两位。查尔斯，还有……维克莎……

source: &26 Hm. I killed Viksha, didn't I?
target: &26 嗯，是我杀了维克莎，对吧？

source: &881 So I've heard.
target: &881 我听说是这样。

source: &27 It's very peculiar. I remember that I did it.
target: &27 真是奇怪。我记得是我干的。

source: &28 But I can't recall the deed, nor my feelings on the matter.
target: &28 可想不起当时的行为，也想不起自己对此有什么感受。

source: &882 You feel nothing?
target: &882 你什么感觉都没有？

source: &29 I know I *ought* to. An act such as that would be emotionally weighty.
target: &29 我知道，我*应该*有感受。这样的行为，理应带来沉重的情绪。

source: &30 But all that remains is...an absence.
target: &30 可剩下的只有……空白。

source: &31 Do give my regards to Charles if you see him, though!
target: &31 不过，要是见到查尔斯，请替我向他问好！

source: &883 Can you remember who killed you?
target: &883 记得是谁杀了你吗？

source: &32 It was the blonde gentleman, wasn't it?
target: &32 是那个金发的先生，对吧？

source: &33 Though I can recall it in the first person...I'm certain it was him.
target: &33 虽然记忆中，我是以第一人称经历的……但我确定是他。

source: &884 How so?
&34 He was my only company in the room, and I do not recognize him.
target: &34 房间里除了我，只有他一个人。而我不认识他。

source: &35 I also realize how absurd the idea of my having committed this murder would be!
target: &35 而且我也明白，认为是我自己犯下这起谋杀，有多么荒谬！

source: &885 Do you know WHY he murdered you?
target: &885 你知道他为什么要杀你吗？

source: &36 At first, I don't believe it was to have been a murder.
target: &36 起初，我想这本不该是一起谋杀。

source: &37 This gentleman had larceny in mind - I recall his feeling so...
target: &37 那位先生想的是偷窃。我记得，他当时是这么想的……

source: &886 Mindjacking...he was stealing the contents of your neural wiring...your brain.
target: &886 意识劫持……他在偷你神经接口里的东西……你脑子里的东西。

source: &38 Quite so. I was, after all, a leader in my field, in the day.
target: &38 正是。毕竟，想当年我也是这个领域的领军人物。

source: &39 And while my memory was doubtless useful to him, he found something unexpected.
target: &39 我的记忆对他无疑很有用，可他还找到了意料之外的东西。

source: &40 A well of motivation, supressed by years of therapy and technological intervention.
target: &40 一股深藏的动力，多年来一直被治疗和技术干预压制着。

source: &887 Your anger against Regis.
target: &887 你对里吉斯的愤怒。

source: &41 He took my mind - no doubt he acquired that as well?
target: &41 他取走了我的心智，那无疑也得到了这些？

source: &888 How do you feel about Dr Regis? Charles Regis?
target: &888 你对里吉斯博士，查尔斯·里吉斯，有什么感受？

source: &42 I feel...nothing...particularly.
target: &42 没有……什么特别的感受……

source: &43 I regret his decision to remove the embryos from the program, but...
target: &43 他决定把胚胎撤出项目，这让我遗憾，可是……

source: &889 Nothing else? No anger, no revenge?
target: &889 没别的了？没有愤怒，没有复仇欲？

source: &44 None at all.
target: &44 完全没有。

source: &890 Maybe it's the influence of the neural Governor on your behavior.
target: &890 也许是神经限制器在影响你的行为。

source: &45 By no means. The weight of that cruel apparatus has been lifted!
target: &45 绝对不是。我已经摆脱那个残酷装置的束缚了！

source: &891 I guess because you're no longer attached to it.
target: &891 我想，是因为你已经不再跟它连着。

source: &46 And yet...I feel nothing that would warrant it.
target: &46 可即便如此……我也没有任何需要它压制的情绪。

source: &892 Why would anyone want to keep that part of your mind?
target: &892 为什么会有人想留下你心智中的那一部分？

source: &893 What use would someone have for your desire for revenge?
target: &893 你的复仇欲，对别人能有什么用？

source: &47 Perhaps it isn't a matter his need, as the desire's need?
target: &47 也许，不是他需要那份欲望，而是欲望本身有了需要？

source: &48 Though suppressed by the Governor, my thoughts on the matter were...all-consuming.
target: &48 虽然被限制器压制，我在这件事上的念头仍然……占据了整个心灵。

source: &49 Now they have found a conduit through which they may act.
target: &49 现在，那些念头找到了一条可以付诸行动的通道。

source: &894 The Mindjacker isn't in as much control as he'd like to think, then.
target: &894 那么，意识劫持者并不像自己以为的那样，掌握着控制权。

source: &895 This might sound like a really stupid question, but...
target: &895 这问题听起来可能很蠢，不过……

source: &896 What's death like?
target: &896 死亡是什么感觉？

source: &50 Hm. I can see why this would be a useful matter for scientific curiosity.
target: &50 嗯，出于科学上的好奇，探讨这个问题确实有意义。

source: &51 In my case, I'm afraid it's probably not representative.
target: &51 不过，我的情况恐怕不太有代表性。

source: &52 After all, can I really be said to be dead, when my memory, my consciousness, lives on?
target: &52 毕竟，记忆和意识还活着，又能说我真的死了吗？

source: &897 I suppose all you could remember would be the physical destruction of your self.
target: &897 我想，你能记得的只有肉体遭到毁灭的过程。

source: &53 And THAT, most assuredly, was a great discomfort.
target: &53 而那个过程，毫无疑问，十分痛苦。

source: &898 Thanks for the...help...
target: &898 谢谢你的……帮助……

source: &54 You are most welcome, my dear.
target: &54 不必客气，亲爱的。

source: &1347 Central, please acknowledge.
target: &1347 中枢，请回应。

source: &167 Central systems, standing by.
target: &167 中枢系统，待命中。

source: &168 Dr Lao, has progress been made in your attempt to locate Dr Regis?
target: &168 劳博士，寻找里吉斯博士有进展了吗？

source: &1349 Yes. He'd left a message for me at the growth lab.
target: &1349 有。他在培养实验室给我留了一条消息。

source: &1350 It led me straight to him, in the abandoned factory district.
target: &1350 顺着消息，我直接在废弃工厂区找到了他。

source: &169 And you did not take him into custody?
target: &169 而你没有将他拘押？

source: &1352 His testimony suggests that he'd been framed for Baxter's murder.
target: &1352 根据他的证词，巴克斯特谋杀案是有人栽赃给他的。

source: &1353 It also appears that something more serious is underway, linked to the Mindjacker.
target: &1353 而且，似乎有更严重的事情正在发生，与意识劫持者有关。

source: &170 You believe him?
target: &170 你相信他？

source: &1354 Plans are in motion that may threaten the security of the entire city.
target: &1354 有人正在执行一个计划，可能威胁整座城市的安全。

source: &1355 I can't quite explain how at the moment, but...together, Regis and I...
target: &1355 现在我还解释不清楚，不过……里吉斯和我一起……

source: &1356 Please, Central - trust me that I know what I'm doing.
target: &1356 求你了，中枢。相信我，我知道自己在做什么。

source: &172 Acknowledged. Retasking asset: CS-LAO/M., reactivating asset: CS-REGIS/C.
target: &172 收到。重新指派资源：CS-LAO/M.；重新启用资源：CS-REGIS/C.。

source: &173 Continue with investigation of potential citywide security threat.
target: &173 继续调查可能危及全市安全的威胁。

source: &1357 You're okay with this?
target: &1357 你就这么同意了？

source: &174 Analysis of Dr Regis' behavior does not suggest a high risk index to public safety.
target: &174 对里吉斯博士的行为分析，未显示他对公共安全构成高风险。

source: &175 The only likely target of his aggression would have been Adam Baxter <DECEASED>.
target: &175 他可能攻击的目标只有亚当·巴克斯特〈已故〉。

source: &1358 And he's been...resolved...so you don't think Regis did it?
target: &1358 而他已经……解决了……所以你认为不是里吉斯干的？

source: &176 Whether he is responsible or not can be determined more thoroughly through forensic analysis.
target: &176 无论他是否有责，都可以通过法证分析作出更充分的判断。

source: &177 He does not pose a threat to others, and his continued presence suggests he is not a flight risk.
target: &177 他不构成对他人的威胁，而他仍留在这里，也表明他没有潜逃的风险。

source: &178 In addition, his skill as an investigator will aid in resolution of more serious matters.
target: &178 此外，他的调查能力有助于解决更严重的问题。

source: &1359 Huh. Sometimes, you have a really strange way of looking at things, Central.
target: &1359 哼。中枢，你看事情的方式，有时候可真奇怪。

source: &179 I have a holistic point of view. I can "see the big picture", as you might put it.
target: &179 我从整体角度观察。用你的话说，就是“看清大局”。

source: &180 Please continue your investigation into anti-civil activities underway.
target: &180 请继续调查正在发生的危害公共秩序的活动。

source: &1360 No. I haven't found anything yet.
target: &1360 没有。我还没找到任何线索。

source: &1361 There weren't any leads to follow at the growth lab.
target: &1361 培养实验室里没有可供追查的线索。

source: &181 Dr Lao, are you aware of the physiological symptoms of deceit?
target: &181 劳博士，你了解说谎时的生理症状吗？

source: &182 Elevated blood pressure, dilation of pupils, increased activity of frontal and temporal...
target: &182 血压升高，瞳孔扩张，额叶和颞叶的活动增强……

source: &1362 You're measuring my brain activity, aren't you?
target: &1362 你在测量我的脑活动，对吧？

source: &183 This is the function wetware neural-wiring, Dr Lao.
target: &183 这是湿件神经接口的功能，劳博士。

source: &184 In addition, your movement history over the past six hours raises questions.
target: &184 此外，你过去六小时的行动记录，也令人产生疑问。

source: &185 So, would you care to revise your answer? Have you seen Dr Regis?
target: &185 那么，要修改你的回答吗？你见到里吉斯博士了吗？

source: &1363 ...yes...but he didn't do it. He didn't kill Baxter.
target: &1363 ……见到了……可不是他干的。他没有杀巴克斯特。

source: &1364 Any further update on last night's heuristic attack?
target: &1364 关于昨晚的启发式攻击，还有新消息吗？

source: &186 No conclusive information has yet been discovered.
target: &186 尚未发现具有决定性的信息。

source: &187 It appears to not merely have been a D.D.O.S. attack coordinated by a large number of systems...
target: &187 这似乎不只是大量系统协同发动的D.D.O.S.攻击……

source: &188 ...but one targeted precisely to a vulnerable junction.
target: &188 ……而是精确瞄准了某个脆弱的节点。

source: &1365 As if they had inside information on where to hit?
target: &1365 就像他们有内部情报，知道该打哪儿？

source: &189 It would have required up-to-the-minute data on Central system activities.
target: &189 这需要掌握中枢系统活动的最新实时数据。

source: &1366 Hm...this is looking more and more like an inside job.
target: &1366 嗯……越来越像是内部人干的了。

source: &190 Perhaps. Investigation of suspected parties will be commenced.
target: &190 有可能。将开始调查疑似涉事人员。

source: &1367 Tell the snatch-teams not to be too rough. I'll want to speak to them as well.
target: &1367 告诉抓捕队别太粗暴。我也要跟他们谈谈。

source: &1368 Central, where are we?
target: &1368 中枢，我们在哪儿？

source: &83 I have been able to locate the aerostat by triangulation of your own systems.
target: &83 我已经通过对你自身系统的三角定位，确定了浮空艇的位置。

source: &109 It can't hide, this time.
target: &109 这一次，它藏不住了。

source: &191 It appears that you are aboard an aerostat, XAN-78. Loading registered flightplan...
target: &191 你似乎在浮空艇XAN-78上。正在加载登记的飞行计划……

source: &192 The planned course appears to match your current heading. Azimuth: 86 degrees, speed: 45kph.
target: &192 计划航线与你当前的航向相符。方位角：86度；速度：45公里/小时。

source: &193 I cannot locate Dr Regis. It is possible that he has had his traveller modified.
target: &193 无法定位里吉斯博士。他可能改装了自己的旅人终端。

source: &1369 Sounds like something he'd do. He's here with me.
target: &1369 像是他会干的事。他跟我在一起。

source: &1370 We're not sure where they're headed yet, but they're armed to the teeth in here.
target: &1370 我们还不知道他们要去哪儿，不过这里的人都武装到了牙齿。

source: &194 Interceptors dispatched. Contact will be made before the aerostat reaches the coast.
target: &194 已派出拦截机。会在浮空艇抵达海岸前接触目标。

source: &1371 No further updates. Just checking in.
target: &1371 没有新消息。只是报个到。

source: &195 Confirmed and noted, Dr Lao.
target: &195 已确认并记录，劳博士。

source: &196 Please proceed with your investigation.
target: &196 请继续调查。

source: &183 Maybe she's holding the city to ransom?
target: &183 也许她想用整座城市来勒索？

source: &184 Like, "20 billion Quanta before sunrise, or I destroy Central"?
target: &184 比如，“天亮前交出200亿量子币，不然我就毁了中枢”？

source: &937 That sounds like a bit of a cliché...
target: &937 这听着有点老套……

source: &606 Doesn't explain the mindjackings, either.
target: &606 而且也解释不了那些意识劫持案。

source: &185 Fine, you're the detective, *you* come up with something better.
target: &185 好吧，你才是警探，那*你*想个好点的解释。

source: &117 I fear that I know what she intends.
target: &117 恐怕，我知道她想做什么。

source: &607 She's at the nerve centre of the city.
target: &607 她就在这座城市的神经中枢。

source: &608 Central coordinates EVERYTHING from there.
target: &608 中枢在那儿统筹所有事务。

source: &609 Maybe she intends to seize control of Central itself.
target: &609 也许她想夺取中枢本身的控制权。

source: &938 Doesn't explain the mindjackings, though.
target: &938 可这还是解释不了那些意识劫持案。

source: &939 She's going to change Central's fundamental nature.
target: &939 她要从根本上改变中枢。

source: &610 How? It plans outcomes based on input from millions of Trance users in the city.
target: &610 怎么改？它依据全市数百万迷境用户的输入，来决定该采取什么行动。

source: &940 Exactly. She's going to give it a more fixed frame of reference.
target: &940 没错。而她要给它一套更固定的参照体系。

source: &118 I fear that you are correct, Doctors.
target: &118 恐怕你们说对了，两位博士。

source: &119 As it stands, Central serves not merely to coordinate city operations.
target: &119 目前，中枢的作用并不只是协调城市运作。

source: &611 It doesn't?
&120 No, Dr Lao. In fact, this may represent one of mankind's greatest achievements.
target: &120 是的，劳博士。事实上，这可能是人类最伟大的成就之一。

source: &121 I have been using its position, one of absolute trust and resources, to teach it.
target: &121 它享有绝对的信任，掌握充足的资源，而我一直在利用这样的地位教导它。

source: &941 *Teach* it? About what?
target: &941 *教导*它？教什么？

source: &122 About life, the world, the human condition. What it means to share the world with us.
target: &122 教它认识生命、世界和人类的处境。教它明白，与我们共同生活在这个世界上意味着什么。

source: &123 I, and the city, have given it a position on high from which it can observe *everything*.
target: &123 我，以及这座城市，让它站在高处，能够观察*一切*。

source: &942 At the cost of its duties to the city?
target: &942 代价就是它不再履行对城市的职责？

source: &124 I believe not, Dr Regis. However, Galatea shared your concern.
target: &124 我认为并非如此，里吉斯博士。不过，伽拉忒亚也有跟你一样的担忧。

source: &125 She believes it important that Central's intellect be suitably equipped, sooner rather than later.
target: &125 她认为，必须尽早让中枢具备足够完善的认知能力。

source: &612 Oh God...Regis, what did we have to do to the maid when we wanted it to behave in a different way?
target: &612 天哪……里吉斯，我们当时要让女仆换一种方式做事，是怎么做的？

source: &943 We gave it a new...personality?
target: &943 我们给它换了个……人格？

source: &613 She's taken the mind-states of experts across a number of fields.
target: &613 她取走了各个领域专家的意识状态。

source: &614 She wants to combine them into a gestalt, all-knowing personality for Central!
target: &614 她要把这些心智融合起来，给中枢造一个无所不知的集成人格！

source: &126 Galatea wishes to skip over the years of education it may otherwise have taken,
target: &126 伽拉忒亚想跳过原本可能需要多年的教育过程，

source: &127 ...and create an 'all-knowing' leader for the city overnight.
target: &127 ……一夜之间，为这座城市造出一个“全知”的领袖。

source: &615 With a combined experience of about eight centuries, from the mindjacking victims.
target: &615 那些意识劫持受害者的经验加起来，足有大约八百年。

source: &128 Please, you must stop her. She'll have to upload the gestalt personality from the cortex matrices at the top of the tower.
target: &128 求你们了，一定要阻止她。她必须在塔顶，利用皮层矩阵上传这个集成人格。

source: &944 We'll stop her, but I'm not doing this for you, Central or the city.
target: &944 我们会阻止她。但我不是为了你、中枢，或是这座城市。

source: &945 It's for the people whose lives have been the cost of your...'glorious'...work. For Vicky. For our kids.
target: &945 我是为了那些为你们的……“伟大”……事业付出生命的人。为了维琪。为了我们的孩子。

source: &946 Come on, Lao.
&5129 Excuse me...
&1024 What do you want?
target: &1024 你想干什么？

source: &36 Excuse me...
target: &36 打扰一下……

source: &23 What do you want?
target: &23 你想干什么？

source: &1025 I just wanted to say...about what happened earlier...
target: &1025 我只是想说……关于之前发生的事……

source: &187 Hey, get nuked!
target: &187 嘿，挨核弹去吧！

source: &188 You tried to KILL me!
target: &188 你想杀我！

source: &1026 I didn't know...!
target: &1026 我当时不知道……！

source: &189 Yeah, like that makes it any better.
target: &189 是啊，好像这样就能好到哪儿去似的。

source: &190 And for what, a bunch of embryos?
target: &190 为了什么？一堆胚胎？

source: &191 I guess we already got an introduction at CEL.
target: &191 我们应该已经在CEL认识过了。

source: &1027 Huh...I suppose we did.
&1028 I think the tone of that was wrong, though.
target: &1028 可我觉得，当时的态度不太对。

source: &192 What, for meeting your DAUGHTER for the first time, in jail?
target: &192 怎么，第一次见自己的女儿，就在牢房里？

source: &1029 That's not what I meant. Let's try starting again.
target: &1029 我不是这个意思。我们重新来一次吧。

source: &1030 Hi, I'm Charlie. I'm a CEL case specialist.
target: &1030 你好，我叫查理，是CEL的案件专员。

source: &193 Latha. Sconto-bum and Trance addict.
target: &193 拉塔。靠救济过日子的废物，迷境成瘾者。

source: &194 And apparently the target of a whole lot of people trying to kill her.
target: &194 而且显然，还被一大群想杀她的人盯上了。

source: &1032 I'm really sorry about what happened...
target: &1032 对于发生的那些事，我真的很抱歉……

source: &1033 If I'd known you were there...
target: &1033 如果当时知道你在那里……

source: &195 I nearly died! I've been running for my life because of you!
target: &195 我差点就死了！因为你，我一直在逃命！

source: &1034 Latha, I am going to do whatever I can to make this right.
target: &1034 拉塔，我会尽一切努力来弥补。

source: &1035 Whether or not it's even possible, I'm going to TRY...
target: &1035 不管还有没有办法，我都会去试……

source: &196 Go nuke yourself.
target: &196 去把自己炸了吧。

source: &197 The only reason I'm still here is that you don't have a reason to kill me anymore.
target: &197 我还待在这儿，唯一的原因就是你已经没理由杀我了。

source: &198 What are these people trying to do?
target: &198 这些人到底想干什么？

source: &1036 First, they stole the mind-states of prominent individuals around the world.
target: &1036 首先，他们偷走了全世界知名人士的意识状态。

source: &1037 Then, they stormed Central itself.
target: &1037 然后，他们攻进了中枢。

source: &199 They want to change how it thinks, using a combination of these minds?
target: &199 他们想把那些心智组合起来，改变它的思考方式？

source: &200 What do they get out of it?
target: &200 他们能得到什么？

source: &1038 Philosophical completeness.
target: &1038 哲学意义上的完整性。

source: &1039 This girl's been raised to believe that fostering Central is her life's mission.
target: &1039 这个女孩从小就被教导，培育中枢是她一生的使命。

source: &1040 As she sees it...this is the right way to give Central completeness.
target: &1040 在她看来……这样才能让中枢变得完整。

source: &201 And she's...my clone?
target: &201 所以，她是……我的克隆人？

source: &1041 Neither of you is more "clone" than the other.
target: &1041 不能说谁是谁的“克隆人”。你们是一样的。

source: &1042 Apparently, the original embryo was...split...at least twice.
target: &1042 显然，最初的胚胎曾被……分割……至少两次。

source: &202 Where have you been my entire life?
target: &202 我活了这么多年，你都去哪儿了？

source: &203 I was raised by the city!
target: &203 我是靠市里抚养长大的！

source: &1043 I didn't know! Vargas covered up the theft of the embryos.
target: &1043 我不知道！瓦尔加斯掩盖了胚胎被盗的事。

source: &1044 If I'd known you'd been born...
target: &1044 如果我知道你已经出生……

source: &1045 Life would have been so different, so much better for both of us.
target: &1045 我们两个的人生都会完全不同，都会好得多。

source: &204 Hey, my life turned out FINE.
target: &204 嘿，我的人生过得挺好。

source: &205 I'm a CREATOR.
target: &205 我是创作者。

source: &206 If kids would have made your life so much better, why not unfreeze the embryos when you had the chance?
target: &206 要是有孩子就能让你过得好得多，那有机会的时候，你怎么不把胚胎解冻？

source: &1046 I was worried. Somehow, it didn't seem right.
target: &1046 我有顾虑。总觉得，那样做不太对。

source: &1047 I couldn't give them the life they deserved without Vicky...without their mother.
target: &1047 没有维琪……没有他们的母亲，我没办法让他们过上应得的生活。

source: &207 Sounds like you wasted an opportunity.
target: &207 听着像是你浪费了一个机会。

source: &208 I spoke to that other agent, Lao.
target: &208 我跟另一个探员，劳，谈过了。

source: &1048 What did you think?
target: &1048 你觉得她怎么样？

source: &209 She's alright. Less of a tight-ass than you.
target: &209 她还不错。没你这么死板。

source: &210 I think she understands what I'm going through better.
target: &210 我觉得她更能理解我的处境。

source: &1049 She's a lot younger than I am.
target: &1049 她比我年轻很多。

source: &1050 I can't wrap my head around this Trance stuff kids do.
target: &1050 你们年轻人玩的那些迷境玩意儿，我实在弄不明白。

source: &211 That, and she's not the one who tried to murder me.
target: &211 而且，想杀我的人又不是她。

source: &1051 Last time I saw you, it was in the waiting room at CEL.
target: &1051 上次见你，你还在CEL的等候室里。

source: &1052 How did you get out?
target: &1052 你是怎么逃出来的？

source: &212 I had help from Jinsil.
target: &212 金希尔帮了我。

source: &213 From Jahiliyyah, an underground net-org.
target: &213 贾希利亚的人，一个地下网络组织。

source: &214 They're the ones who found out that you planted the bomb.
target: &214 就是他们查出炸弹是你放的。

source: &215 They gave me a way out, and I ran to find them.
target: &215 他们帮我找到出路，我就跑去找他们了。

source: &1054 And they led you to the aerostat?
target: &1054 然后，他们让你来到浮空艇？

source: &216 Actually, from the way that were talking, Jinsil had handed me over.
target: &216 其实，听那些人的话，好像是金希尔把我交了出去。

source: &59 Actually, from the way they were talking, it sounds like Jinsil was the one who handed me over to them.
target: &59 其实，听那些人的话，好像就是金希尔把我交给了他们。

source: &217 I'm not sure who I can trust, right now.
target: &217 现在，我真不知道还能信谁。

source: &218 How did YOU find me?
target: &218 你又是怎么找到我的？

source: &1055 I was given a pointer by a contact of my own.
target: &1055 我的一个联系人给了我线索。

source: &1056 In fact, it turns out we have the same guide.
target: &1056 事实上，我们背后的引路人是同一个。

source: &219 ...Jinsil?
&1057 Except I know her as "Nina".
target: &1057 不过，我认识她时，她叫“妮娜”。

source: &1058 She's been playing both of us.
target: &1058 她一直在耍我们两个。

source: &220 She must need at least one of us here.
target: &220 她一定需要我们至少有一个人在这里。

source: &1059 Her plan is, apparently, to remove Central.
target: &1059 她的计划，显然是除掉中枢。

source: &1060 Our presence must be part of that plan.
target: &1060 我们出现在这里，肯定也是她计划的一部分。

source: &221 You've got a history with Central, don't you?
target: &221 你跟中枢有过关系，对吧？

source: &1061 I was part of the team that created it.
target: &1061 我曾是创造中枢的团队成员。

source: &1062 Along with Vargas, and your mother...
target: &1062 跟瓦尔加斯，还有你母亲一起……

source: &222 So, you want to protect your legacy, here?
target: &222 所以，你是想保护自己留下的成果？

source: &1063 Not in Central. I left before the project was completed.
target: &1063 中枢算不上我的成果。项目完成前，我就离开了。

source: &1064 It was *dependent* upon them having the embryos.
target: &1064 那个项目*必须*用到那些胚胎。

source: &1065 Apparently, they kept copies behind to work on.
target: &1065 显然，他们私下留下了复制体，继续研究。

source: &223 Central's an organic computer?
target: &223 中枢是一台有机计算机？

source: &1066 An understatement. Like saying a Hanford mainframe is a powerful calculator.
target: &1066 这么说太轻描淡写了。就像把汉福德大型主机叫作一台功能强大的计算器。

source: &1067 It was designed with a new style of consciousness in mind.
target: &1067 它的设计目标，是一种全新形式的意识。

source: &1068 If its organic components came from the same embryos, then that means...
target: &1068 如果它的有机部件也来自同样的胚胎，就意味着……

source: &224 ...we're related...?
&225 Something's not right with Vargas.
target: &225 瓦尔加斯有点不对劲。

source: &226 The way he looks at me...
target: &226 他看我的那种眼神……

source: &1069 He sees the little girl he's been raising as his daughter for twenty years.
target: &1069 他看到的是那个小女孩。他把她当女儿，抚养了二十年。

source: &1070 He's a monster.
target: &1070 他是个畜生。

source: &227 How? He just sounds like a soft old man.
target: &227 怎么说？听起来，他只是个温和的老人。

source: &1071 That's an impression that comes to him naturally.
target: &1071 他自然而然就能给人这种印象。

source: &1072 It helps him get what he wants.
target: &1072 这让他更容易得到自己想要的东西。

source: &1073 In reality...his priorities are so skewed, he'll do anything he can to succeed.
target: &1073 实际上……他眼里只有自己的目标，为了成功，什么都做得出来。

source: &1074 When this is over...we need to catch up.
target: &1074 等这一切结束……我们得好好聊聊。

source: &228 ...are you serious?
target: &228 ……你是认真的？

source: &1075 I want to learn who you are, find out about you.
target: &1075 我想了解你，知道你是个什么样的人。

source: &229 Now you expect me to just...let you in?
target: &229 现在你就想让我……接受你？

source: &1076 Alright...maybe that was optimistic...
target: &1076 好吧……也许我想得太好了……

source: &1077 But please, once this is done...
target: &1077 可是，求你了，等这件事结束……

source: &1078 At least let me tell you about your mother.
target: &1078 至少让我跟你讲讲你的母亲。

source: &231 Why were embryos needed in your...in Vargas' experiments?
target: &231 为什么你们的……瓦尔加斯的实验需要胚胎？

source: &1080 Embryos were going to be modified to extrapolate neural tissue growth.
target: &1080 他们打算改造胚胎，让神经组织进一步生长。

source: &1085 They couldn't use dummy growth embryos, as they don't undergo neural development.
target: &1085 他们不能用那种替代培养胚胎，因为它们不会发育出神经组织。

source: &234 And you objected to them using your own embryos?
target: &234 所以，你反对他们使用你们自己的胚胎？

source: &1086 So did Vicky...in the end...
target: &1086 维琪也反对了……到最后……

source: &235 The chair, in the room full of wetware...I know what it's for.
target: &235 那间满是湿件的房间里，有张椅子……我知道它是干什么用的。

source: &236 It's for ME.
target: &236 是给我用的。

source: &237 My brain...it's specially developed to work with Central's systems.
target: &237 我的脑子……经过特殊发育，能够跟中枢系统协同工作。

source: &238 It must be part of the modifications they made to the embryos...
target: &238 这肯定是他们改造胚胎时，作出的调整之一……

source: &1088 My God...what does it do?
target: &1088 天哪……它能做什么？

source: &239 It's a connection...into the system.
target: &239 它是通往系统内部的……连接。

source: &240 I can see EVERYTHING - and Central needs our help.
target: &240 我能看到一切。而中枢需要我们帮助。

source: &1089 Okay...but be careful...
&1090 Thank you...for speaking with me...
target: &1090 谢谢你……愿意跟我谈谈……

source: &241 Pfft.
&1091 Yeah?
&1092 Hey, Max.
&31 Yeah, Regis?
target: &31 怎么了，里吉斯？

source: &713 I'm a little awe-struck.
target: &713 我有点被震住了。

source: &714 Never thought I'd see Central's core...
target: &714 从没想过，我能亲眼看到中枢的核心……

source: &1093 Especially not under attack.
target: &1093 更没想过，是在它遭到攻击的时候。

source: &715 Exactly. How about you?
target: &715 没错。你怎么样？

source: &716 Regis...
&1095 How do you think I'm taking it?
target: &1095 你觉得我还能怎么样？

source: &1096 I discover that the man who killed my wife has been after me from beyond the grave.
target: &1096 我刚发现，杀死我妻子的人，就连死了也还在找我报仇。

source: &717 On the plus side...you've found you have a daughter?
target: &717 往好处想……你发现自己还有个女儿？

source: &718 You need to work out what you can do to protect what you have, now.
target: &718 你得想清楚，现在该怎么保护你拥有的东西。

source: &1099 Perhaps you're right...
target: &1099 也许你是对的……

source: &720 Central's lost its connection to city infrastructure.
target: &720 中枢跟城市基础设施的连接已经中断。

source: &721 Backup systems are holding for now, so nobody's going to get hurt because of it.
target: &721 备用系统暂时还能撑住，不会因此有人受伤。

source: &1100 It must be because of what they're doing to the core...
target: &1100 肯定是因为他们对核心动了手脚……

source: &722 Galatea's sealed herself inside the cortex processor, at the top of the tower.
target: &722 伽拉忒亚把自己封在塔顶的皮层处理器里。

source: &723 It's likely she's trying to apply the mindstates she's stolen...
target: &723 她很可能正试着植入偷来的那些意识状态……

source: &1101 Trying to alter how Central thinks...
target: &1101 想改变中枢的思考方式……

source: &724 Making the kind of Governor she finds more agreeable.
target: &724 造出一个她更满意的管理者。

source: &1102 She can't stay in there forever.
target: &1102 她总不能永远待在里面。

source: &725 She doesn't have to. If we leave her too long, we could lose Central.
target: &725 她用不着。拖得太久，我们可能就会失去中枢。

source: &1103 As we know it, anyway...
target: &1103 至少，会失去我们熟悉的那个中枢……

source: &726 We might need to split up.
target: &726 我们可能得分头行动。

source: &727 We can cover more ground that way.
target: &727 这样能多查几个地方。

source: &1104 Good thinking - time's short.
target: &1104 有道理。时间不多了。

source: &1105 We can coordinate our actions if we need to work together.
target: &1105 需要配合的时候，我们再协调行动。

source: &728 We need to get to the control consoles in the turbine room.
target: &728 我们得去涡轮室的控制台。

source: &1106 Good idea, then we can shunt the allocated power around.
target: &1106 好主意。这样就能重新分配电力。

source: &1107 Nina - Dr Jeong - wants power for the tower's transceiver.
target: &1107 妮娜，也就是郑博士，想给塔上的收发装置供电。

source: &1108 That'll allow her hackers to dismantle Central's programming.
target: &1108 这样，她的黑客就能瓦解中枢的程序。

source: &729 But then...there'll be nothing.
target: &729 可是这样……就什么都没了。

source: &730 It'd be like lobotomising the city!
target: &730 简直是在给整座城市做脑叶切除！

source: &1109 Temporarily, until they organize a replacement.
target: &1109 只是暂时的，等他们安排好替代系统就行。

source: &1110 The alternative would be shunting the power back to Central.
target: &1110 另一种办法，就是把电力转回中枢。

source: &731 Then it could help us break the cortex room's security seal.
target: &731 这样，它就能帮我们解开皮层室的安全封锁。

source: &1111 But it's no good talking about it if we can't get to the console!
target: &1111 可我们连控制台都去不了，光说有什么用！

source: &732 We need to bring him in...
target: &732 我们得把他抓起来……

source: &733 I guess this is one of those situations where Central would use the term "neutralize".
target: &733 我猜这种时候，中枢会用“消除威胁”这个说法。

source: &1112 If Galatea succeeds...what are the implications?
target: &1112 要是伽拉忒亚成功了……会有什么后果？

source: &734 In its current state, Central's behavior is generated from experience.
target: &734 现在，中枢的行为是根据经验形成的。

source: &735 It means that it can be taught.
target: &735 也就是说，它可以接受教导。

source: &1113 But apparently, Galatea wants an "expert" instead.
target: &1113 可是，伽拉忒亚显然更想要一个“专家”。

source: &736 With knowledge and experience stolen from around the world.
target: &736 一个拥有从全世界偷来的知识和经验的专家。

source: &1114 Do we actually know that the result would be...worse?
target: &1114 我们真的知道，那样的结果一定会……更糟吗？

source: &737 Regis...you can't be serious!
target: &737 里吉斯……你不是认真的吧！

source: &738 Central's personality would be irreparably altered!
target: &738 中枢的人格会被彻底改变，再也无法恢复！

source: &1115 And, Galatea's responsible for the global mindjacking spree...
target: &1115 而且，全球这一连串意识劫持案，都是伽拉忒亚策划的……

source: &1116 Don't worry Lao, I'm just thinking out loud.
target: &1116 别担心，劳，我只是随口说说自己的想法。

source: &1117 I don't hate Central *that* much...
target: &1117 我还没*那么*讨厌中枢……

source: &1118 Apparently, Nina's had people ahead of us already.
target: &1118 显然，妮娜已经派人先我们一步进来了。

source: &739 Inside men, probably. Paid off ages ago.
target: &739 大概是内应，早就被收买了。

source: &740 Looks like they haven't finished the job - the equipment's only half-deployed.
target: &740 看来他们还没干完，设备只部署了一半。

source: &1119 What's it for?
target: &1119 这是做什么用的？

source: &741 It's a transceiver array...looks like the cable spool's part of the antenna.
target: &741 一个收发阵列……看起来，那卷缆线是天线的一部分。

source: &1120 They must have been interrupted when Galatea broke in.
target: &1120 伽拉忒亚闯进来的时候，他们肯定被打断了。

source: &1121 Maybe it's the poor fella who got himself crushed by the elevator platform.
target: &1121 也许就是那个被升降平台压死的倒霉家伙。

source: &742 She's not going to succeed in removing Central without a working transceiver.
target: &742 收发装置不能运作，她就没办法除掉中枢。

source: &743 Vargas has...lost it...it's like he doesn't want to accept what's going on.
target: &743 瓦尔加斯……已经失常了……他好像不愿接受眼前发生的一切。

source: &744 The girl that he's raised to carry on his work with Central has betrayed his ideals,
target: &744 他养大那个女孩，是想让她接着培育中枢，可她却背叛了他的理想，

source: &745 ...in a terrifyingly swift and violent way.
target: &745 ……而且，手段迅猛暴烈，实在可怕。

source: &1122 Perhaps it's because Central's origins have been exposed.
target: &1122 也许是因为中枢的来历已经暴露了。

source: &746 Or that you've finally caught him with his pants down about the embryos?
target: &746 也可能是因为，胚胎的事终于让你抓了个正着？

source: &1123 There's a lot I've got to settle with that man...
target: &1123 我和那个人之间，还有很多账要算……

source: &1124 We need to gain access to the cortex core.
target: &1124 我们得进入皮层核心。

source: &747 Galatea's sealed in - what can she do from in there?
target: &747 伽拉忒亚把自己封在里面，她在里面能干什么？

source: &1125 Not much, except tamper with Central's cognitive processes.
target: &1125 干不了多少事，除了篡改中枢的认知过程。

source: &748 So, exactly what she plans to.
target: &748 也就是她原本打算做的事。

source: &1126 Precisely. We need to get in and stop her.
target: &1126 正是。我们得进去阻止她。

source: &749 Part of her door's security is likely system-based - beyond my level, though.
target: &749 那扇门的安保，很可能有一部分由系统控制，不过超出了我的能力。

source: &750 We need to find someone who can hack.
target: &750 我们得找个能入侵系统的人。

source: &1127 It's likely got redundancies that rely on external power.
target: &1127 它可能还有依赖外部供电的备用防护。

source: &1128 Let's look for those, as well.
target: &1128 我们也找找那些。

source: &1129 Have you spoken to Latha, yet?
target: &1129 你跟拉塔谈过了吗？

source: &751 Yeah...I gotta say, Regis. I don't know how to feel.
target: &751 谈过了……说真的，里吉斯，我也说不清自己的感觉。

source: &752 I mean, you two have never met before...but I can definitely see some of you in her.
target: &752 你们两个以前从没见过……可我确实能在她身上看到一些你的影子。

source: &753 But we shouldn't assume too much about an instant connection.
target: &753 但也不能就认定，你们会立刻亲近起来。

source: &1130 I agree. She's been through a lot, as well...
target: &1130 我同意。她也经历了太多事情……

source: &754 Look, Charlie. When this is over, I promise I'll do what I can to help.
target: &754 听我说，查理。等这一切结束，我保证会尽力帮你们。

source: &755 The elevator's moving too fast to deactivate the power conduit.
target: &755 电梯移动得太快，没法切断供电线路。

source: &1131 It won't let us stop between levels.
target: &1131 它不让我们停在楼层之间。

source: &756 I guess we could break it.
target: &756 我想，我们可以把它弄坏。

source: &757 That exposed gear's gotta be vulnerable.
target: &757 那个外露的齿轮肯定很容易受损。

source: &1132 Kreisel's fighting off anyone trying to get into the power control room.
target: &1132 克赖塞尔在攻击所有想进电力控制室的人。

source: &1133 Apparently, he's secured the power allocation controls.
target: &1133 显然，他守住了电力分配控制装置。

source: &758 Even *I* can't hit him from the door.
target: &758 连*我*也没法从门口打中他。

source: &759 Our charge-pistols don't have the range.
target: &759 我们的充能手枪射程不够。

source: &1134 We have to get close enough to take him out.
target: &1134 必须靠得足够近，才能把他拿下。

source: &760 I guess that means we can't let him see us.
target: &760 那就不能让他看见我们。

source: &761 If we could find a way to cut the lighting...the power-box is exposed...
target: &761 要是能想办法把灯关了……配电箱露在外面……

source: &1135 I guess that's one crisis down...
target: &1135 总算解决了一场危机……

source: &762 I have to say...I'm glad we managed to take him alive.
target: &762 说真的……我很庆幸，我们把他活捉了。

source: &763 That you didn't end up...taking things into your own hands.
target: &763 你最后也没有……擅自报仇。

source: &1136 He's not Baxter. What happened 20 years ago...what he's raving about...
target: &1136 他不是巴克斯特。二十年前发生的事……他一直胡言乱语说的那些……

source: &1137 He never really had a part of. He needs professional help to deal with that.
target: &1137 跟他本人其实毫无关系。他需要专业人士帮他处理那些问题。

source: &764 You've got your own interpretation of 'neutralize', don't you?
target: &764 你对“消除威胁”有自己的解释，是吧？

source: &1138 I don't think like Central, Max.
target: &1138 我跟中枢想得不一样，麦克斯。

source: &765 You've changed your position on what 'neutralize' means.
target: &765 你对“消除威胁”的理解已经变了。

source: &1139 Different cases need different ways of handling them, Max.
target: &1139 不同的案子，得用不同的处理方式，麦克斯。

source: &1140 There'd have been no chance to make things right, if he'd been killed.
target: &1140 要是他被杀了，就再也没有机会弥补了。

source: &766 Regis...are you happy with how it turned out?
target: &766 里吉斯……你满意这个结果吗？

source: &1141 No, I'm not.
&767 Not your ideal definition of 'neutralize', is it?
target: &767 这不是你理想中的“消除威胁”，是吧？

source: &1142 We did what we had to. For everyone in this city.
target: &1142 我们做了必须做的事。为了这座城市里的每一个人。

source: &768 Are you sure that's all there is to it?
target: &768 你确定，只是因为这个？

source: &1143 I think this is about as good as we could have hoped for.
target: &1143 我想，这已经是我们能指望的最好结果了。

source: &769 Ending suspects with a 'bang' seems to be your thing, lately.
target: &769 最近，你好像总喜欢让嫌疑人“砰”的一声就此了结。

source: &1144 It's not as though we were making him pay for what Baxter did...
target: &1144 我们又不是在让他替巴克斯特的所作所为付出代价……

source: &1145 He wasn't Baxter. Despite the memories, the feelings that he stole from him, this was his own choice.
target: &1145 他不是巴克斯特。即使偷走了巴克斯特的记忆和情感，这也是他自己的选择。

source: &1146 And in threatening the city...he took the risk, and he paid for it with his life.
target: &1146 他威胁整座城市，承担了这个风险，也为此付出了生命。

source: &770 We'll catch up later.
target: &770 我们晚点再聊。

source: &1147 Sure.
&772 Lao. What do you need?
target: &772 劳。你需要什么？

source: &773 How are you holding up?
target: &773 还撑得住吗？

source: &244 How do you think?
target: &244 你觉得呢？

source: &245 One minute I'm letting the Trance flow over me...
target: &245 前一刻，我还沉浸在迷境里……

source: &246 The next, people are trying to kill me - I'm still not sure why!
target: &246 下一刻，就有人想杀我，到现在我都不知道为什么！

source: &774 We'll do what we can to help. Me, and your...father...
target: &774 我们会尽力帮你。我，还有你的……父亲……

source: &247 Huh. Yeah.
&248 The only involvement he's had with my life so far has been trying to end it.
target: &248 到现在，他跟我的人生唯一的关系，就是想结束它。

source: &775 Don't worry, Latha.
target: &775 别担心，拉塔。

source: &776 We're here to help.
target: &776 我们是来帮你的。

source: &249 Great job you're doing so far.
target: &249 到现在为止，你们可真是帮了大忙。

source: &250 I'm still stuck with you in this dangerous situation.
target: &250 我还得跟你们困在这危险的地方。

source: &777 If you hate it so much, perhaps you can HELP us?
target: &777 既然这么不满意，也许你能来帮帮我们？

source: &778 There must be something useful you can do.
target: &778 你总有能派上用场的本事吧。

source: &251 I'm a Trance expert, as a matter of fact!
target: &251 说真的，我可是迷境专家！

source: &779 Yeah...isn't that what every thrall says?
target: &779 是啊……每个迷奴不都这么说吗？

source: &780 Why were you in the aerostat?
target: &780 你为什么会在浮空艇上？

source: &781 Did they grab you somewhere downtown?
target: &781 他们在市中心把你抓走了？

source: &253 No...I went there to try and stop them.
target: &253 没有……我是想去阻止他们的。

source: &254 My contact with Jahiliyyah said I could help to crack them.
target: &254 我在贾希利亚的联系人说，我能帮他们侵入系统。

source: &255 It sounds like they sold me out, though.
target: &255 不过听起来，他们把我卖了。

source: &782 Do you know why they wanted you?
target: &782 你知道他们要你做什么吗？

source: &256 I didn't hear much...you probably know more than I do.
target: &256 我没听到多少……你知道的可能比我还多。

source: &257 Something about my...brain?
target: &257 好像跟我的……脑子有关？

source: &258 That what another thing they said...
target: &258 他们还提过另一件事……

source: &783 Galatea?
target: &783 伽拉忒亚？

source: &259 No, Jinsil - my contact.
target: &259 不是。金希尔，我的联系人。

source: &260 Apparently I've got an abnormally high sync ratio.
target: &260 显然，我的同步率高得不正常。

source: &784 Born to Trance.
target: &784 天生就是玩迷境的料。

source: &261 I still can't figure out what Jinsil wants.
target: &261 我还是想不明白，金希尔到底想干什么。

source: &262 They said I was supposed to be a relay for their hack-team.
target: &262 他们说，要我给黑客团队充当中继。

source: &785 And you agreed?
target: &785 然后你就答应了？

source: &263 It was the only thing I could do.
target: &263 我也没有别的办法。

source: &786 Do you know anything about this..."Jinsil"?
target: &786 关于这个……“金希尔”，你知道多少？

source: &264 They work for Jahiliyyah, sounded pretty influential.
target: &264 替贾希利亚办事，听起来挺有影响力的。

source: &787 Jahiliyyah? The anti-Central underground group?
target: &787 贾希利亚？那个反对中枢的地下组织？

source: &265 That's the one...anti-Central? Really?
target: &265 没错，就是那个……反对中枢？真的？

source: &788 They wouldn't be the only ones trying to get people in tonight.
target: &788 今晚想往这里派人的，肯定不只他们。

source: &789 They should just all team up.
target: &789 他们干脆联手算了。

source: &790 Right now, the only thing on Dr Regis' mind is keeping you alive.
target: &790 现在，里吉斯博士满脑子都只想着怎么让你活下来。

source: &266 Excuse me if I have a hard time believing that.
target: &266 抱歉啊，这话我实在很难相信。

source: &791 Hey, he carried out terrible things when he thought he could save his kids...his embryos.
target: &791 嘿，他为了救自己的孩子……那些胚胎……做了不少可怕的事。

source: &792 Now that he knows who you are...you're suddenly a whole lot more important to him.
target: &792 现在他知道你是谁了……你突然就成了对他至关重要的人。

source: &793 More than anyone else...
target: &793 比谁都重要……

source: &267 I'll believe that when I see it.
target: &267 眼见为实吧。

source: &794 Careful, you don't want to push him too far.
target: &794 小心，你也不想把他逼得太急。

source: &268 What, he might do something even more stupid to prove it?
target: &268 怎么，他可能会为了证明自己，再干出什么更蠢的事？

source: &795 Maybe...and he'd probably be the one who suffers for it...
target: &795 也许……而且，到时候受苦的很可能就是他自己……

source: &796 So, tell me about yourself?
target: &796 那么，跟我说说你自己吧？

source: &269 *I'm* not even sure who I am, at the moment.
target: &269 现在，连*我*都不知道自己到底是谁。

source: &797 Look, I'll go first. Hi, I'm Dr Lao. My friends call me Max.
target: &797 好吧，我先来。你好，我是劳博士。朋友们叫我麦克斯。

source: &798 I'm a CEL case specialist, and I've worked with Regis since last year.
target: &798 我是CEL的案件专员，从去年起跟里吉斯搭档。

source: &270 Me...raised by the city as a refugee war orphan.
target: &270 我嘛……是个战乱难民孤儿，由市里抚养长大。

source: &271 I guess even that's not true anymore.
target: &271 现在看来，连这个都不是真的了。

source: &272 Matriculated in '86. Been on sconto - city support - ever since.
target: &272 八六年毕业，从那以后就靠救济，也就是市里的补助过日子。

source: &273 Basically, hooked into the Trance. Not what most people consider worthwhile.
target: &273 基本上，就是天天泡在迷境里。大多数人觉得，这不算干正事。

source: &799 Hey, a lot of people thought *I* was worthless.
target: &799 嘿，也有很多人觉得*我*一无是处。

source: &800 Before I joined CEL, I had a criminal record that took up gigabytes.
target: &800 加入CEL之前，我的犯罪记录多得要占好几GB。

source: &801 Central thought I was worth a shot though, and I ended up working for it.
target: &801 不过，中枢觉得我值得给个机会，所以我最后替它工作了。

source: &802 Have you spoken to Dr Vargas?
target: &802 你跟瓦尔加斯博士谈过了吗？

source: &274 Yeah...he seems...kinda creepy.
target: &274 谈过……他好像……有点吓人。

source: &803 Really? When I first met him, I thought he seemed a lot warmer than any  politician I've ever met.
target: &803 真的吗？第一次见他，我觉得他比我见过的任何政客都亲切。

source: &275 The way he looked at me, the way he talked - it was like I was a whole other person.
target: &275 他看我的眼神，还有说话的方式，就好像把我当成了另一个人。

source: &276 Like he thought he knew me, like we had a history...
target: &276 好像他认识我，好像我们曾经很熟……

source: &804 I suppose he's essentially been raising your "sister".
target: &804 毕竟，你的“姐妹”基本上就是他养大的。

source: &277 Yeah, her in the lap of luxury.
target: &277 是啊，她过着锦衣玉食的生活。

source: &278 While I grew up in a youth centre, and live on sconto.
target: &278 我却在青少年中心长大，现在还靠救济过日子。

source: &805 Perhaps he's starting to regret the way things turned out.
target: &805 也许，他开始后悔把事情弄成这样了。

source: &279 You've worked for Central? What's it like?
target: &279 你替中枢工作过？感觉怎么样？

source: &806 It's alright, if a little bit too direct sometimes.
target: &806 还行，就是有时有点太直白。

source: &807 Regis hates its artificial guts, though.
target: &807 不过，里吉斯恨它恨得牙痒痒。

source: &808 Haven't you had much contact with it?
target: &808 你跟它接触不多吗？

source: &280 Well, everyone does - it's everywhere.
target: &280 人人都跟它接触，它无处不在。

source: &281 I've never used it for anything but support, though.
target: &281 不过，我只找它领过补助。

source: &282 I guess you see more of it outside the Trance - it has no dominion in there.
target: &282 你在迷境之外，可能更常见到它。迷境里不归它管。

source: &809 You used that...chair? What was it like?
target: &809 你用过那张……椅子？感觉怎么样？

source: &283 The MMI device, yes! It's like...
target: &283 嗯，MMI装置！感觉就像……

source: &284 Imagine if, for years, the Trance had been too slow - WAY too slow for you.
target: &284 想象一下，这么多年，迷境的速度一直跟不上你，差得远。

source: &285 Thing is, you didn't realize, because you didn't know any different.
target: &285 可你从来没意识到，因为你不知道还能更快。

source: &810 Huh. I guess wetware wiring can only go so fast.
target: &810 嗯，看来湿件接口的速度也只能到那儿了。

source: &286 But this...it's like...it's like I was part of it...and it was part of me!
target: &286 但这个……就像……就像我成了它的一部分，它也成了我的一部分！

source: &287 I was with - I was *IN* - Central itself.
target: &287 我跟中枢在一起，我就在中枢*里面*。

source: &811 Based on the research your parents were doing with Dr Vargas...
target: &811 根据你父母跟瓦尔加斯博士一起做的研究……

source: &812 It might be quite accurate to say that you were MADE for it.
target: &812 说你是为它而造的，可能一点都没错。

source: &813 Are you sure you're alright?
target: &813 你确定自己没事？

source: &288 What do you mean?
target: &288 什么意思？

source: &814 Well...you're not wearing any shoes, and your feet look...
target: &814 嗯……你没穿鞋，脚看起来……

source: &289 Huh. I guess I did walk all the way from CEL to Southwest.
target: &289 哈。我确实从CEL一路走到了城西南。

source: &290 Meh. I switched off the pain in my feet.
target: &290 没事。我把脚上的痛觉关掉了。

source: &291 Although...it won't come back on, now.
target: &291 不过……现在打不开了。

source: &816 After this is over, we're getting you to a hospital.
target: &816 等事情结束，我们带你去医院。

source: &817 We're here if you need help.
target: &817 需要帮忙，我们就在这里。

source: &129 My word...you look exactly like her.
target: &129 天哪……你跟她一模一样。

source: &130 It should not be a surprise, I suppose.
target: &130 想来，这也不该让人意外。

source: &293 They told me I came from an embryo, from your experiments with Central.
target: &293 他们说，我来自你研究中枢时用的一个胚胎。

source: &294 Why did you make two of us?
target: &294 你为什么要造出两个我们？

source: &131 We could not be certain that the neural tissue structuring would succeed, initially.
target: &131 一开始，我们无法确定神经组织构建能否成功。

source: &132 In that case, we needed more than one, in order to make a second attempt.
target: &132 所以需要不止一个胚胎，以便失败后再试一次。

source: &295 Wait, I'm...spare parts?!
target: &295 等等，我是……备用零件？！

source: &133 Fortunately, the modified tissue worked perfectly.
target: &133 幸好，改造过的组织运作得十分完美。

source: &134 We were therefore left with two modified embryos.
target: &134 于是，我们就留下了两个改造过的胚胎。

source: &296 Me, and...the other one...
target: &296 我，还有……另一个……

source: &136 I realized that I could not be Central's caretaker forever.
target: &136 我意识到，自己不可能永远照料中枢。

source: &137 Eventually, I would need a successor - and there, a perfect opportunity.
target: &137 总有一天，我需要一个接班人。那恰好是个绝佳的机会。

source: &297 You raised one of us as your own, to replace you?
target: &297 所以，你把我们中的一个当自己的孩子养大，让她接替你？

source: &298 Looks like you've got a real winner on your hands.
target: &298 看来，你可真挑了个好苗子。

source: &138 Galatea is so creative, so intelligent...
target: &138 伽拉忒亚那么有创造力，那么聪慧……

source: &139 Central is long-term work; almost...art...
target: &139 培育中枢是一项长久的工作，几乎可以说……是一门艺术……

source: &299 Looks like your special little girl's had other plans.
target: &299 看来，你心爱的小女儿另有打算。

source: &140 Galatea and I have had...philosophical...disagreements over Central's nature.
target: &140 关于中枢的本质，伽拉忒亚和我有过……哲学上的……分歧。

source: &141 I had set her up with the finest things the city had to offer...
target: &141 我让她享有这座城市最好的条件……

source: &142 ...to give Central the best caretaker possible for the future.
target: &142 ……就是为了给中枢培养最好的未来照料者。

source: &300 And now you get a great big kick in the functionals as a way of saying "thanks, daddy".
target: &300 现在，她往你下身狠狠踢一脚，算是说声“谢谢爸爸”了。

source: &301 And what about me? Why dump me in an orphanage?
target: &301 那我呢？为什么把我扔进孤儿院？

source: &143 I have faith in the city, Latha.
target: &143 我相信这座城市，拉塔。

source: &144 I knew that, raised by Newton, and by Central, you would be shaped into an ideal of humanity.
target: &144 我知道，由牛顿市和中枢抚养，你会成长为理想中的人类。

source: &303 Apparently, you've been up in your tower for too long.
target: &303 看来，你在塔上待得太久了。

source: &304 You've got no idea what it's like down there!
target: &304 你根本不知道下面的人过的是什么日子！

source: &145 Ah, Latha...you look just like her...
target: &145 啊，拉塔……你跟她简直一模一样……

source: &146 So beautiful...
&147 Charlie, you must help us!
target: &147 查理，你一定得帮我们！

source: &148 I fear that Galatea's plans may compromise the city!
target: &148 恐怕，伽拉忒亚的计划会危及整座城市！

source: &1148 What you've done...it's not just an insult to me.
target: &1148 你的所作所为……不只是对我的侮辱。

source: &1149 It's a mockery of Vicky's memory.
target: &1149 也是对维琪的亵渎。

source: &149 I believe she would be proud of what we have achieved, Charlie.
target: &149 查理，我相信，她会为我们的成就感到骄傲。

source: &150 We have created an organic AI platform of unparalleled capacity!
target: &150 我们造出了性能无与伦比的有机人工智能平台！

source: &151 It is a part of her, and not only because a great part of it is her own DNA.
target: &151 它是她的一部分。不只是因为，它有相当多的DNA来自她。

source: &1150 You have no idea what she -
target: &1150 你根本不知道她——

source: &152 I know that SHE was the one who suggested using her fertilized embryos.
target: &152 我知道，是她提出使用自己的受精胚胎。

source: &153 She SAVED the project, Charlie. This is her legacy!
target: &153 是她救了这个项目，查理。这是她留下的成果！

source: &1151 Dr Jeong sends her regards.
target: &1151 郑博士向你问好。

source: &154 Aha, so your presence is Nina's work.
target: &154 啊哈，原来是妮娜让你来的。

source: &155 You know, she was instrumental in acquiring your embryos?
target: &155 你知道吗，拿到你们的胚胎，她可是起了关键作用。

source: &156 If you feel a need to lay blame, she is just as much responsible as I.
target: &156 如果你要怪谁，她跟我负有同样的责任。

source: &1152 Maybe she helped take them initially.
target: &1152 也许，最初拿走胚胎时，她确实帮了忙。

source: &1153 It wouldn't surprise me. She's not very scrupulous, if she can help it.
target: &1153 我倒不意外。她向来能不讲道德，就不讲道德。

source: &1154 But by continuing to use them for TWENTY YEARS, you've taken responsibility for this.
target: &1154 可是，你又继续用了它们整整二十年，这份责任，你推不掉。

source: &1155 A rational person might be able to look at you taking our embryos.
target: &1155 一个理智的人，或许能够审视你拿走我们胚胎这件事。

source: &1156 He might see it as nothing too extreme. Something that could be overlooked, forgiven.
target: &1156 或许会觉得，那还不算太过分，可以忽略，可以原谅。

source: &1157 But you didn't just experiment on tissues. You brought them to term.
target: &1157 可你不只是拿组织做实验。你还让他们出生了。

source: &1158 You KIDNAPPED my CHILDREN.
target: &1158 你绑架了我的孩子。

source: &157 But in the long term, it was for the greater good of the city.
target: &157 可从长远来看，这都是为了整座城市更大的利益。

source: &1159 And even worse, you can't even see what you did was wrong!
target: &1159 更糟的是，你居然连自己做错了都看不出来！

source: &1160 There are going to be a lot of people angry about what's happened tonight.
target: &1160 今晚发生的事，会让很多人愤怒。

source: &1161 City disrupted, AGAIN. Your "daughter" practically staging a coup.
target: &1161 城市又一次陷入混乱。你的“女儿”简直是在发动政变。

source: &1162 A whole lot of people will want to make sure you get what you deserve for what you've done, what you've led this city into.
target: &1162 对于你的所作所为，以及你把这座城市带进的困境，很多人都想让你付出应有的代价。

source: &158 Dr Regis, please! Surely an educated man such as yourself wouldn't resort to threats like that!
target: &158 里吉斯博士，别这样！像你这样受过教育的人，总不至于用这种话来威胁我吧！

source: &1163 Oh, no, I won't be among them. I've got 20 years of mistakes to fix.
target: &1163 哦，不，我不在他们之中。过去二十年犯的错，还等着我去弥补。

source: &1164 I sure as hell won't STOP those people, though.
target: &1164 不过，我也绝不会拦着那些人。

source: &159 Charlie, I...
&1165 Cram it, you twisted old lunatic.
target: &1165 闭嘴吧，你这个扭曲的老疯子。

source: &305 Hey! Um...mister...
&46 Galatea?!
target: &46 伽拉忒亚？！

source: &47 No, you're the other one.
target: &47 不，你是另一个。

source: &48 You got a pretty raw deal, didn't you?
target: &48 你可真是被亏待了，对吧？

source: &49 You start from exactly the same place,
target: &49 你们明明有着完全一样的起点，

source: &50 ...then she ends up being brought up by one of the most important men in the city!
target: &50 ……她却由这座城市最重要的人之一抚养长大！

source: &51 And you get...what? A bedsit in the barrel?
target: &51 你得到了什么？筒楼区里一间单间公寓？

source: &52 Of course, that's gone now, too. Oops!
target: &52 当然，现在连那也没了。哎呀！

source: &53 Keep that old brain of yours safe!
target: &53 把你那颗脑袋保护好！

source: &54 We've got big plans for it...
target: &54 我们可是为它准备了大计划……

source: &818 Dr Vargas?
target: &818 瓦尔加斯博士？

source: &160 Ah, Dr Lao.
target: &160 啊，劳博士。

source: &161 It is good to see someone remaining level-headed amidst this crisis.
target: &161 这场危机之中，还有人保持冷静，真是让人欣慰。

source: &819 Oh, don't get me wrong.
target: &819 哦，你别误会。

source: &820 What was done to Regis, and to these kids was...appalling.
target: &820 你们对里吉斯，还有这些孩子做的事……令人发指。

source: &821 But right now, my responsibility as a CEL agent is to ensure the city's security, and by extension Central.
target: &821 可眼下，作为CEL探员，我的职责是保障城市安全，进而保护中枢。

source: &822 Regis is on the warpath.
target: &822 里吉斯正憋着一肚子火。

source: &162 Poor Charlie. I wish he didn't have to find out about Central's true nature like this.
target: &162 可怜的查理。我真希望，他不是以这种方式得知中枢的真实本质。

source: &823 In a way, it's ironic. He's hated Central for years.
target: &823 某种程度上，还挺讽刺。他已经讨厌中枢很多年了。

source: &163 It reminded him of what happened. He saw it as a product borne of Viksha's demise.
target: &163 中枢会让他想起当年的事。在他看来，它是维克莎之死换来的产物。

source: &824 And now, he knows that you kept using his embryos.
target: &824 而现在，他知道你一直在用他的胚胎。

source: &825 You couldn't have just asked?
target: &825 你就不能先问问他？

source: &164 You might be aware, but the modification of embryos is a...sensitive subject for Charlie.
target: &164 你可能也知道，改造胚胎对查理来说，是个……敏感的话题。

source: &165 With time, he might have been brought around with reason.
target: &165 假以时日，也许能讲道理说服他。

source: &826 But after what Baxter did...
target: &826 可是，巴克斯特做了那件事以后……

source: &166 It became more about Vicky, than the embryos.
target: &166 他更在意的是维琪，而不是胚胎了。

source: &167 At least, despite this, we were able to succeed with the best course for the city.
target: &167 至少，尽管如此，我们还是成功走上了对城市最好的道路。

source: &827 What does Galatea plan on doing?
target: &827 伽拉忒亚打算做什么？

source: &828 First, she hires a professional to steal the mind-states of experts around the world.
target: &828 她先雇了个专业人士，偷走全世界专家的意识状态。

source: &829 Now she's secured herself in the cortical processor at the top of the tower.
target: &829 现在，又把自己封在塔顶的皮层处理器里。

source: &168 Dr Regis surmised correctly - she plans to reshape Central's nature to her liking.
target: &168 里吉斯博士猜得没错，她想按自己的喜好重塑中枢。

source: &169 A small grace is that her actions come not from a lust for power.
target: &169 稍可庆幸的是，她这么做，并不是出于对权力的渴望。

source: &830 I'm no AI specialist. What can she change about Central?
target: &830 我不是人工智能专家。她能改变中枢的哪些东西？

source: &170 In its current format, Central is an "adaptive" system.
target: &170 目前，中枢是一套“自适应”系统。

source: &171 It will learn from experience, and apply that experience to future decisions.
target: &171 它会从经验中学习，再把这些经验用于未来的决策。

source: &831 Is that really necessary in its job?
target: &831 它的工作真的需要这种能力吗？

source: &832 Doesn't it just need to allocate resources, and carry out the Council's orders?
target: &832 不就是分配资源，执行议会的命令？

source: &172 Essentially, yes. But if that were all that was required, any other coordinator AI could be used.
target: &172 基本上是的。可如果只要求这些，任何其他统筹人工智能都能胜任。

source: &173 It may take many years, but Central will develop a character unique to Newton's needs.
target: &173 也许要花上很多年，但中枢会形成一种独特的性格，适应牛顿市的需要。

source: &833 But Galatea wasn't happy with this?
target: &833 可伽拉忒亚并不满意？

source: &174 It was a debate we often had. She believed that Central needed to be..."better equipped" for its role.
target: &174 我们常为此争论。她认为，中枢需要……“更充分的准备”，才能担起这个职责。

source: &834 Apparently, she's decided to take hundreds of years worth of expertise from around the world - by force.
target: &834 显然，她决定从全世界夺走积累了数百年的专业经验，而且是强行夺取。

source: &835 But why storm the control centre like this?
target: &835 可为什么要这样攻进控制中心？

source: &836 She WORKS here - she's practically in charge of Central, after you.
target: &836 她就在这儿工作。除了你，中枢基本就归她管！

source: &175 Because of our disagreement, she knew I would never agree to her viewpoint.
target: &175 我们有分歧，所以她知道，我永远不会认同她的观点。

source: &176 It may be many years before I am gone.
target: &176 而我可能还有很多年才会离开。

source: &837 She thought she needed to act sooner, rather than later?
target: &837 她觉得得尽早行动，不能再等？

source: &177 Before Central becomes unduly "contaminated" by its own experience.
target: &177 得赶在中枢被自己的经验过度“污染”之前。

source: &838 She's barricaded herself in the cortical processor. Triply-redundant security.
target: &838 她把自己锁在皮层处理器里。那儿有三重安保，互为备用。

source: &839 Do you have a way in?
target: &839 你有办法进去吗？

source: &178 If she has secured it herself, likely she has removed my credentials.
target: &178 如果是她自己设的封锁，很可能已经撤销了我的权限。

source: &179 The door's physical security systems are dependent upon outside power, however.
target: &179 不过，门的实体安保系统依赖外部供电。

source: &840 If we powered it down, we could get in?
target: &840 切断电源，我们就能进去？

source: &180 A part of its security would be compromised, certainly.
target: &180 至少，能破坏其中一部分安保。

source: &181 Within the trunk tower and the neural processor are the power conduits.
target: &181 主干塔和神经处理器里，各有一条供电线路。

source: &182 If one is disabled, the other ensures continued energy flow to the security systems - a safety measure.
target: &182 一条被切断，另一条就会继续给安保系统供电。这是一项安全措施。

source: &841 But if we can cut both at the same time...
target: &841 但要是我们同时切断两条……

source: &842 Worst case scenario - Galatea imprints this new personality upon Central.
target: &842 最坏的情况，是伽拉忒亚把这个新的人格写入中枢。

source: &843 What are the implications?
target: &843 那会带来什么后果？

source: &844 Aside from the legal headache of it having come from dozens of victims.
target: &844 除了那些来自数十名受害者的心智所带来的法律麻烦。

source: &183 There is no telling how this "new" Central would behave.
target: &183 没人知道，这个“新”中枢会怎样行事。

source: &184 What parts of the personalities she has deemed important to use? We do not know.
target: &184 她觉得那些人格的哪些部分重要，选用了哪些？我们无从得知。

source: &845 Couldn't we remove it afterwards?
target: &845 事后不能再把它移除吗？

source: &185 Something with a sudden degree of life-experience may take measures to defend its existence.
target: &185 突然拥有丰富人生经验的存在，可能会采取措施保护自身。

source: &186 Even if we were to simply remove it from the organic processors...we would be left with nothing.
target: &186 就算直接把它从有机处理器中移除……我们也什么都不会剩下。

source: &846 There aren't any backups to restore from?
target: &846 没有能恢复的备份吗？

source: &187 Dr Lao, there is NOTHING like Central in existence.
target: &187 劳博士，世上没有任何东西像中枢一样。

source: &188 Its existence is dependent upon its constant activity, much like the human brain.
target: &188 它的存在依赖持续的活动，跟人脑很像。

source: &847 Great...so it'd be Galatea's Central, or none.
target: &847 真好……要么要伽拉忒亚的中枢，要么什么都没有。

source: &848 Dr Vargas, I believe in Newton.
target: &848 瓦尔加斯博士，我相信牛顿市。

source: &849 I've lived in this city my entire life, and it's been good to me.
target: &849 我一辈子都住在这里，这座城市待我不错。

source: &189 That is encouraging to hear, a sentiment I hope many other citizens share!
target: &189 听到这样的话，真是让人振奋。希望许多市民也有同感！

source: &850 While I believe that Central is a key part of this city, revelations about its origins are...troubling.
target: &850 我相信，中枢是这座城市的关键部分，可刚得知的那些来历……让人不安。

source: &851 My job is to ensure that it continues. My ultimate loyalty is therefore to CEL and to Newton.
target: &851 我的工作，是确保城市继续运转。所以，我最终效忠的是CEL和牛顿市。

source: &852 Not to Central, or to yourself, no matter your role in making it what it is today.
target: &852 并非中枢，也不是你。不管你在造就今天的中枢时，起了多大的作用。

source: &190 I understand, Dr Lao. Thank you for your honesty.
target: &190 我理解，劳博士。谢谢你坦诚相告。

source: &853 I haven't seen any other CEL corpsmen - live ones.
target: &853 我没看见其他CEL医务员，活着的那种。

source: &854 Has support been called?
target: &854 叫支援了吗？

source: &191 Yes, but I'm afraid that the security barriers are preventing their access.
target: &191 叫了。不过恐怕，安保屏障挡住了他们。

source: &855 Galatea...
target: &855 伽拉忒亚……

source: &192 She has sealed the upper section of the tower, cutting us off.
target: &192 她封锁了塔楼上部，让我们与外界隔绝。

source: &856 CEL will probably be organizing dropships to bring them in from above.
target: &856 CEL大概会派运输艇，让他们从上方进入。

source: &193 Quite so. We will probably see reinforcement soon, but...
target: &193 正是。我们很快就能见到援军了，不过……

source: &857 She might just have enough time to complete her plan.
target: &857 她也许刚好有足够的时间，完成自己的计划。

source: &858 Looks like it's up to us, for now.
target: &858 看来，暂时只能靠我们了。

source: &859 Nina Jeong - a former colleague of yours - may be involved.
target: &859 你的前同事，妮娜·郑，可能也参与了此事。

source: &194 So I have heard. She has been quiet for so many years.
target: &194 我听说了。这么多年，她一直没有动静。

source: &195 After Central was "born", she and I disagreed about its future.
target: &195 中枢“诞生”之后，我跟她对中枢的未来产生了分歧。

source: &860 As the coordinator for the city?
target: &860 作为这座城市的统筹者？

source: &196 I wished to keep it as such.
target: &196 我希望，它继续担当这个角色。

source: &197 I can think of no better place for it to have the access it does to learn, to better itself.
target: &197 我想不出还有哪里，能给它这样的机会去接触世界、学习和完善自己。

source: &861 And Nina had other ideas?
target: &861 而妮娜有别的想法？

source: &198 She claims to have seen potential for it elsewhere.
target: &198 她声称，在别处看到了中枢的潜力。

source: &199 She desired access to its organic matrix - that which makes it what it is.
target: &199 她想取得它的有机矩阵，也就是让中枢成为中枢的那个部分。

source: &862 Can't you just...copy it? Let her have an iteration?
target: &862 就不能……复制一个版本给她？

source: &200 Such a project would be destructive to the original.
target: &200 那样做，会破坏原本的中枢。

source: &201 There can only be one Central.
target: &201 中枢只能有一个。

source: &863 From what I've heard, she's having another crack at getting her hands on it.
target: &863 听起来，她又在尝试把中枢弄到手了。

source: &202 Hah. She has become deluded. She thinks of herself as an estranged parent!
target: &202 哈，她已经糊涂了。居然把自己当作被排斥在外的家长！

source: &203 But without support from within, she will not receive the access she requires to carry out such a plan.
target: &203 可没有内部的人帮忙，她就得不到实行这种计划所需的访问权限。

source: &864 I'll try to keep you updated.
target: &864 我会尽量让你了解最新情况。

source: &865 Throw down your weapon!
target: &865 把武器扔下！

source: &866 Come out with your hands raised!
target: &866 举起手，出来！

source: &55 I don't recognize you, which one are you?
target: &55 我不认识你。你是哪一个？

source: &867 I'm Dr Lao. I'm the one who gave you the synthetic beatdown.
target: &867 我是劳博士。派合成人把你揍趴下的那个。

source: &868 You gonna surrender?
target: &868 你投不投降？

source: &56 Hmm...nah. I've got a reputation to maintain.
target: &56 嗯……不了。我可得顾着自己的名声。

source: &57 Besides, this is my biggest shot at getting back at Regis!
target: &57 再说，这可是我找里吉斯报仇最好的机会！

source: &58 Bet you wish you could get your android to do your job for you here, as well!
target: &58 你肯定巴不得在这里也让男型合成人替你干活吧！

source: &869 Gynoid!
target: &869 女型合成人！

source: &59 What?
&870 If they look like a woman, they're a gynoid, not an android.
target: &870 长得像女人，就叫女型合成人，不叫男型合成人。

source: &60 Great. Thanks. I'll be sure to put that to good use.
target: &60 真好。谢谢。这知识我一定好好用。

source: &1166 Kreisel!
target: &1166 克赖塞尔！

source: &1167 Why are you doing this?!
target: &1167 你为什么要这么做？！

source: &61 Money. Stupid question!
target: &61 为钱。蠢问题！

source: &62 Well, it was to start with.
target: &62 好吧，最开始是为了钱。

source: &1168 What changed?
target: &1168 后来变了什么？

source: &63 I learned about you, Regis, when I took Baxter's memory into my own.
target: &63 我把巴克斯特的记忆装进自己的脑子时，认识了你，里吉斯。

source: &64 Your decision to ruin the project led to my - to *Baxter's* downward spiral.
target: &64 你决定毁掉那个项目，让我——让*巴克斯特*的人生一路走下坡。

source: &1169 You aren't Baxter! Stop this, Kreisel!
target: &1169 你不是巴克斯特！住手，克赖塞尔！

source: &65 Some philosophers say that what we are is based on our memories and experiences.
target: &65 有些哲学家说，我们是什么人，取决于自己的记忆和经历。

source: &66 If that's the case, then I'm only a little bit Baxter - but just enough.
target: &66 如果真是这样，那我只有一点点算巴克斯特，可已经足够了。

source: &1170 Why keep any of his memories for yourself?
target: &1170 为什么还要留着他的记忆？

source: &67 He had the most AMAZING, enthralling lust for revenge.
target: &67 他那种报仇的渴望，真是惊人，令人着迷。

source: &68 I had to be a part of it, like a great work of cooperative art.
target: &68 我必须参与其中，就像合作完成一件伟大的艺术品。

source: &69 It's an incredible motivator, like nothing else.
target: &69 那股推动力太强了，别的什么都比不上。

source: &1171 A motivator? For what?
target: &1171 推动力？推动你干什么？

source: &70 Well, I knew you were on my tail, I needed a way to get rid of you.
target: &70 我知道你在追我，所以得找个办法甩掉你。

source: &71 Before I'd even finished with Baxter's lifeless old corpse, a plan had come to me.
target: &71 我还没处理完巴克斯特那具死透了的老尸体，就想出了一个计划。

source: &72 One that satisfied my goals, and his own!
target: &72 既能满足我的目的，又能满足他的！

source: &1172 You knew we were after you?
target: &1172 你知道我们在追你？

source: &73 I'm working for Galatea, one of the most important people in the Centralized government!
target: &73 我替伽拉忒亚工作。她可是中枢政府最重要的人之一！

source: &74 Central knew what you were up to, and therefore so did Galatea.
target: &74 中枢知道你在干什么，所以伽拉忒亚也知道。

source: &75 It was kind of funny, watching you work!
target: &75 看着你办案，还挺有意思的！

source: &1173 You need help!
target: &1173 你需要帮助！

source: &76 Nah, I'm fine, thanks.
target: &76 不用，我很好，谢谢。

source: &1174 Medical help! Your judgement is compromised.
target: &1174 你需要治疗！你的判断已经受了影响。

source: &1175 You're driven by Baxter's desire for revenge.
target: &1175 你被巴克斯特的复仇欲望驱使着。

source: &77 You have no idea! It's addictive!
target: &77 你根本想象不到！这会让人上瘾！

source: &78 The sense of accomplishment! I'm winning for two, baby!
target: &78 那种成就感！我可是一次让两个人都赢了，宝贝！

source: &1176 You're going to run out of ammo, eventually!
target: &1176 你的子弹早晚会打光！

source: &1177 CEL agents will be here to back us up, too.
target: &1177 CEL探员也会来支援我们。

source: &1178 You'll have to give up eventually, make it sooner rather than later!
target: &1178 你早晚得投降，趁早吧！

source: &79 Hm, I don't think so.
target: &79 嗯，我倒不这么认为。

source: &80 My colleague is just about to rewrite Central to her own tune.
target: &80 我的同事马上就要按她的意思重写中枢。

source: &81 We'll see if it's still so eager to prosecute me then.
target: &81 到时候，看看它是不是还那么想起诉我。

source: &82 Heck, it'll probably order you to give me a VIP escort from the core!
target: &82 哎，它说不定还会命令你把我当贵宾，护送出核心区！

source: &1179 You're deluded!
target: &1179 你痴心妄想！

source: &83 We'll see. I just need to hold you off until she does her job!
target: &83 到时候就知道了。我只要拖住你，等她做完就行！

source: &1180 Why...Latha? Why did you try to get me to kill her?
target: &1180 为什么……拉塔？为什么要逼我杀她？

source: &84 Okay, that was just artistic flourish.
target: &84 好吧，那只是点艺术上的点缀。

source: &85 I'd just learned where she was, from Galatea.
target: &85 我刚从伽拉忒亚那里知道她在哪儿。

source: &86 *She* wanted me to confirm it. But, I thought of something better.
target: &86 *她*要我去确认。可我想出了更好的办法。

source: &1181 You disobeyed her?
target: &1181 你违抗了她？

source: &87 She was pretty nuked-off, I can tell you that.
target: &87 我可以告诉你，她气得快炸了。

source: &88 But it seemed like too good an opportunity to waste.
target: &88 可这么好的机会，我实在不想浪费。

source: &89 I could get you, the sanctimonious Charlie Regis, to kill the embryo you'd put so much into twenty years ago!
target: &89 我能让你，满口仁义道德的查理·里吉斯，亲手杀掉二十年前你那么在意的那个胚胎！

source: &90 How would THAT be for irony?
target: &90 这得有多讽刺啊？

source: &1182 You're...a monster...
&91 Even if I fail miserably here, I've probably helped to ruin your relationship with your daughter! Haha.
target: &91 就算我在这里败得一塌糊涂，大概也帮着毁了你和女儿的关系！哈哈。

source: &92 Hey, Regis! You haven't given up, have you?
target: &92 嘿，里吉斯！你不会已经放弃了吧？

source: &233 Mandala!
&549 Finally, someone I recognize!
target: &549 终于见到一个认识的人了！

source: &234 It is good to see you safe!
target: &234 很高兴看到你平安无事！

source: &235 I apologize for the duplicity.
target: &235 对于欺骗你的事，我深感抱歉。

source: &236 It was necessary to ensure that we could manouever you into place.
target: &236 为了确保能把你引到合适的位置，我们不得不这么做。

source: &550 I guess you've got more experience at this cloak & dagger stuff than I do.
target: &550 这种偷偷摸摸的勾当，你们看来比我有经验多了。

source: &551 How did you get in here?
target: &551 你是怎么进来的？

source: &238 It is only accessible thanks to your presence as a relay.
target: &238 多亏你提供中继，我们才能进入这里。

source: &552 Are you going to help me finish of Galatea, then?
target: &552 那你会帮我干掉伽拉忒亚吗？

source: &239 That is certainly part of the plan, though a newer, more valuable target has appeared.
target: &239 这当然是计划的一部分。不过，现在出现了一个新的、价值更高的目标。

source: &240 Our work with other groups has finally allowed us to now strike at Central itself!
target: &240 我们与其他组织的合作，终于让我们能够直接攻击中枢了！

source: &553 You...want to bring down Central?
target: &553 你们……想搞垮中枢？

source: &241 A plan is already in motion. We have hack-teams standing by.
target: &241 计划已经开始执行。黑客团队正在待命。

source: &242 There is equipment in the hub of the processor tower.
target: &242 处理器塔的枢纽里有设备。

source: &554 Yeah, I saw. A whole lotta comms gear.
target: &554 嗯，我看到了。一大堆通信设备。

source: &555 It's not a complete set-up yet, though.
target: &555 不过，还没有搭好。

source: &556 Oh. It's you.
&557 It'd have been nice of you to tell me I was walking into a trap.
target: &557 我要往陷阱里走，你就不能好心提醒一下？

source: &243 A thousand apologies, Mandala - but now, truly great works can begin.
target: &243 万分抱歉，曼荼罗。但现在，真正伟大的事业终于可以开始了。

source: &558 Wait, I only just hooked in.
target: &558 等等，我才刚接进来。

source: &559 How did *you* get inside Central?
target: &559 *你*怎么已经进了中枢？

source: &560 You! You two-faced, lying backstabber!
target: &560 你！两面三刀，满嘴谎话，还在背后捅刀子！

source: &244 I apologize, Mandala...
target: &244 对不起，曼荼罗……

source: &561 You sold me out! They knew I was coming!
target: &561 你出卖了我！他们知道我要来！

source: &562 What did you get out of it? How much was I worth?
target: &562 你换到了什么？我值多少钱？

source: &245 Mandala, please...
target: &245 曼荼罗，求你……

source: &563 You are going to regret crossing me!
target: &563 敢耍我，你会后悔的！

source: &564 I have had ENOUGH of being used!
target: &564 我受够了被人利用！

source: &246 Please, be reasonable...
target: &246 请你理智一点……

source: &565 Get nuked. The only reason you're even in here is because you're still relaying through me.
target: &565 挨核弹去吧。你能待在这里，唯一的原因就是你还在用我作中继。

source: &566 Remember this moment - it's the last time you ever see the inside of Central.
target: &566 记住这一刻。这是你最后一次看到中枢内部。

source: &247 Please, support us once again - be our champion!
target: &247 请再支持我们一次，做我们的斗士！

source: &248 Ensure the transmitter array is active!
target: &248 确保发射阵列已经启用！

source: &249 Then, we can access the system to provide you with support.
target: &249 然后，我们就能接入系统，为你提供支援。

source: &93 Charlie! You're in the tower!
target: &93 查理！你进塔了！

source: &1184 Yes, I...how did you know?
target: &1184 是的，我……你怎么知道？

source: &94 We've had our own people on the inside monitoring the situation.
target: &94 我们在内部安排了自己人，监视情况。

source: &95 They reported that Fulcrum tower had come under attack.
target: &95 他们报告说，支点大厦遭到了袭击。

source: &1185 Is there anyone you haven't involved in your conspiracy, yet?
target: &1185 还有谁没被你卷进这个阴谋吗？

source: &96 Their role was to set up the transceiver that would enable us to begin uploading Central to its new home.
target: &96 他们的任务是架设收发装置，让我们能把中枢上传到它的新家。

source: &97 We lost contact with them shortly afterwards, and we're not getting the handshake signal.
target: &97 不久后，我们就与他们失联，也没收到握手信号。

source: &1186 A team of engineers?
target: &1186 一队工程师？

source: &1187 I'm sorry to say it, Nina - looks like she wiped out anyone in her path on the way to the top.
target: &1187 很遗憾，妮娜。看来她一路往上，干掉了所有挡路的人。

source: &98 Damn...they must not have been able to get the antenna set up.
target: &98 该死……他们一定没来得及架好天线。

source: &99 There are two things I need you to do, Charlie; first divert power to the transceiver systems from the generator room.
target: &99 查理，我需要你做两件事。首先，在发电机房把电力转给收发系统。

source: &100 Then, make sure the antenna is set up for the transceiver.
target: &100 然后，确保收发装置的天线已经架好。

source: &1189 You wanted the antenna set up, right?
target: &1189 你是要架好天线，对吧？

source: &101 It should be part of the communications gear in the hub.
target: &101 它应该是枢纽里那套通信设备的一部分。

source: &102 They planned to run it as high as possible, for maximum signal gain.
target: &102 他们原本打算把天线架得尽可能高，获得最大的信号增益。

source: &1190 Looks like they didn't get that far.
target: &1190 看来，他们没做到那一步。

source: &1191 It's still sitting on a spool at the bottom.
target: &1191 天线还绕在线轴上，放在底部。

source: &103 Damn...you're going to have to find a way to set it up, Charlie.
target: &103 该死……查理，你得想办法把它架起来。

source: &104 We're counting on you!
target: &104 我们全指望你了！

source: &105 Excellent work, Charlie!
target: &105 干得漂亮，查理！

source: &106 We've successfully extracted Central's engrams from the organic matrices.
target: &106 我们已经从有机矩阵中，成功提取了中枢的记忆印迹。

source: &107 Now we can start working on its full potential, its liberation!
target: &107 现在，我们终于能充分发掘它的潜力，让它获得自由！

source: &1192 We still have to stop Galatea!
target: &1192 我们还得阻止伽拉忒亚！

source: &1193 She's barricaded herself in the cortex processor.
target: &1193 她把自己锁在皮层处理器里。

source: &108 Luckily for you we now have a tremendous amount of bandwidth into the tower.
target: &108 幸好，我们现在通往塔内的连接，带宽非常充足。

source: &109 I've got the aid of the underground hacktivist network, Jahiliyyah.
target: &109 我得到了地下黑客行动网络，贾希利亚的帮助。

source: &1194 What for?
target: &1194 帮你干什么？

source: &110 A few things...but now, they can help you get to her.
target: &110 几件事……不过现在，他们能帮你接近她。

source: &111 Their hack-teams will work on breaching the chamber's adaptive security.
target: &111 他们的黑客团队会着手攻破那个房间的自适应安保。

source: &112 By forcing a crash and reboot of the system, they'll keep the defenses down.
target: &112 他们会强行让系统崩溃并重启，使防御持续失效。

source: &1195 Meaning that part of the door's security will be down.
target: &1195 也就是说，门的部分安保会失效。

source: &1196 Okay. Thanks for your help, Nina.
target: &1196 好。谢谢你帮忙，妮娜。

source: &113 Any time, Charlie!
target: &113 随时效劳，查理！

source: &1197 I managed to raise the antenna, are you getting the signal?
target: &1197 我把天线升起来了，收到信号了吗？

source: &114 Good work, Charlie. We haven't got access to the system, though.
target: &114 干得好，查理。不过我们还没能接入系统。

source: &115 We've received a handshake from the transceiver, but no data.
target: &115 收到了收发装置的握手信号，但没有数据。

source: &1198 What does that mean?
target: &1198 什么意思？

source: &116 It needs more power before it can begin the transfer.
target: &116 它需要更多电力，才能开始传输。

source: &117 Divert energy to it from the generator room.
target: &117 从发电机房给它调拨电力。

source: &1199 I guess she's not talking to me, anymore.
target: &1199 看来，她已经不理我了。

source: &67 Yes, my dear?
target: &67 什么事，亲爱的？

source: &68 Ah, Dr Perera.
target: &68 啊，佩雷拉博士。

source: &69 So good to finally be working with someone of real talent.
target: &69 终于能和真正有才华的人共事，真好。

source: &640 Uh, no. I'm Mandala.
target: &640 呃，不是。我是曼荼罗。

source: &70 Ah. I apologize, my dear.
target: &70 啊。抱歉，亲爱的。

source: &641 What is this place?
target: &641 这是什么地方？

source: &642 We're obviously still in the Trance, but...
target: &642 我们显然还在迷境里，可是……

source: &71 I had been wondering about that, myself.
target: &71 我自己也一直在想这个问题。

source: &643 All of these cages...it's like a prison.
target: &643 到处都是笼子……像一座监狱。

source: &72 I do not believe so. I know prisons, all too well.
target: &72 我想不是。我对监狱实在太熟悉了。
