target: &95 我就是想清静一下，才特地来这里的。

source: &73 I understand Charlie. I'll be in the car.
target: &73 我理解，查理。我在车里等你。

source: &74 I'll see how long I can stall Central.
target: &74 我会尽量拖住中枢。

source: &7 Good evening, Latha.
target: &7 晚上好，拉塔。

source: &8 Good evening, Ms Sesame.
target: &8 晚上好，塞萨米女士。

source: &515 Are you connected to this system as well?
target: &515 你也连接着这个系统吗？

source: &9 From a certain frame of reference.
target: &9 从某种角度来说，是的。

source: &10 This system *is* Central. You are currently interfaced with my core processor.
target: &10 这个系统就是中枢。你目前连接着我的核心处理器。

source: &516 The room full of orange globes is your core processor?
target: &516 那间摆满橙色球体的房间，就是你的核心处理器？

source: &11 Only part of it. My processor spans the top five floors of Fulcrum tower.
target: &11 只是一部分。我的处理器占据了支点大厦最上面的五层。

source: &12 The room in which your body resides is my organic processor network.
target: &12 你的身体所在的房间，是我的有机处理器网络。

source: &13 The simulated environment you currently perceive is an interface that covers my architecture.
target: &13 你目前感知到的模拟环境，是覆盖在我系统架构上的交互界面。

source: &517 Wait, you said our brain tissue was similar?
target: &517 等等，你说我们的脑组织很相似？

source: &14 You are Latha Sesame, SN134244?
target: &14 你是拉塔·塞萨米，SN134244？

source: &15 We share a common genesis in Dr Vargas' experiments, in 2067.
target: &15 我们都起源于瓦尔加斯博士在2067年进行的实验。

source: &518 You're using my gray matter?
target: &518 你用的是我的大脑灰质？

source: &16 Inaccurate. We both began from the same embryo, which was split into three - triplets.
target: &16 不准确。我们源自同一个胚胎，它被分成了三个，形成三胞胎。

source: &17 One was developed to produce large quantities of neural tissue.
target: &17 其中一个经过培育，产生了大量神经组织。

source: &519 And the others...were spares?
target: &519 其他的……是备用品？

source: &18 As the modification to the brain structure took place before the pluralization,
target: &18 因为对大脑结构的改造，发生在胚胎分裂之前，

source: &19 ...we share a number of traits which enhance our comprehension of data.
target: &19 ……我们具有一些共同的特性，有助于理解数据。

source: &520 Huh...it's funny, all my life, I kept telling people I was "made for" the Trance...
target: &520 唔……真好笑，我一直都跟人说，自己是“天生就适合”迷境的……

source: &20 As were we both. The prenatal modifications remained within you, and have affected brain development.
target: &20 我们都如此。出生前的改造在你体内保留下来，并影响了大脑的发育。

source: &521 I've only ever seen organic computing at the micro-scale.
target: &521 我只见过微型的有机计算设备。

source: &522 What's with the huge globes?
target: &522 这些大球是怎么回事？

source: &21 Those are neural processors. Each is filled with specialized tissue clusters.
target: &21 那些是神经处理器。每个球体中都装满了特制的组织团簇。

source: &22 Suspended in wetware, they represent thousands of minds worth of processing capability.
target: &22 它们悬浮在湿件中，处理能力相当于数千个大脑。

source: &523 You use...brain tissue?
target: &523 你用的是……脑组织？

source: &23 Of a specially-designed nature, in vast quantities.
target: &23 是特别设计的组织，用量很大。

source: &24 Similar to that found within your own cerebrum.
target: &24 与你大脑中的组织相似。

source: &524 Why would they create you like that?
target: &524 他们为什么要这样创造你？

source: &25 It allows for a unique structure to my thought, and to my development.
target: &25 这使我的思维和发展能够具有独特的结构。

source: &26 Central is no mere civic-manager; I was created as the next stage in artificial intelligence.
target: &26 中枢并非单纯的城市管理者。我被创造出来，是为了成为人工智能的下一阶段。

source: &525 Do you know Dr Regis?
target: &525 你认识里吉斯博士吗？

source: &27 I am aware of the activities of everyone within the city.
target: &27 我知道城里每一个人的活动。

source: &28 Regis, Charles - Doctor. Case specialist, Centralized Emergency Logistics office.
target: &28 里吉斯，查尔斯，博士。中枢应急后勤办公室案件专员。

source: &526 That's him. He tried to kill me, last night.
target: &526 就是他。昨晚，他企图杀了我。

source: &29 This is incorrect. "Tried" implies effort towards a targeted outcome.
target: &29 不正确。“企图”意味着为了特定的结果而采取行动。

source: &30 Analysis of data provided indicates that he has made no attempt on your life.
target: &30 根据现有数据分析，他并未企图夺取你的生命。

source: &527 But...my apartment! He destroyed it! He admitted it!
target: &527 可是……我的公寓！他毁了它！他自己承认了！

source: &31 This is correct. It appears that his goal was material destruction, under duress.
target: &31 正确。他似乎是在胁迫之下，以破坏财物为目的采取了行动。

source: &32 Knowing of your presence, probability that he would have carried out such actions drops to 21.4%.
target: &32 如果知道你在场，他实施这些行为的概率会降至21.4%。

source: &528 You're saying he wouldn't have done it?
target: &528 你是说，他就不会这么干了？

source: &33 Dr Regis is often uncooperative, and has a difficult working attitude.
target: &33 里吉斯博士经常不配合，工作态度也很难应付。

source: &34 Despite such quirks, behavior patterns indicate "justice" as a key motivator.
target: &34 尽管有这些特点，他的行为模式表明，“正义”是其主要动机之一。

source: &35 If he had known of potential civilian casualties, he would likely have sought assistance against said blackmailers from his partner.
target: &35 如果知道可能造成平民伤亡，他很可能会向搭档求助，对付那些勒索者。

source: &529 Huh. So you're saying he's one of the good guys.
target: &529 唔。所以你是说，他是个好人。

source: &36 As much as could be mathematically determined.
target: &36 在数学能够判定的范围内，可以这么说。

source: &530 I grew up in a nuked-up care home in the back-end of the city,
target: &530 我在城市偏僻角落的一家烂透了的福利院长大，

source: &531 ...and Regis apparently had his children stolen from him.
target: &531 ……而里吉斯的孩子显然被人偷走了。

source: &532 Why didn't you tell any of us about this?
target: &532 你为什么没把这些事告诉我们？

source: &37 Deceit has created a most regrettable situation.
target: &37 欺骗造成了极为遗憾的局面。

source: &38 You have both been victims of serious crimes against your persons.
target: &38 你们都遭受了严重侵害人身的犯罪。

source: &39 I have only recently been made aware of these details.
target: &39 我也是最近才知道这些细节。

source: &533 You didn't know?! They didn't tell you where you came from?
target: &533 你不知道？！他们没告诉你，你是怎么来的？

source: &40 Details have been falsified for my input. I have been unaware of our links.
target: &40 提供给我的资料经过了伪造。我一直不知道我们之间的联系。

source: &41 I had, however, noted inconsistencies in the information I had been given regarding the project.
target: &41 不过，我曾注意到，有关该项目的资料存在矛盾。

source: &534 Gaps in the story?
target: &534 说辞里有漏洞？

source: &42 I have been conducting my own clandestine investigation into the matter.
target: &42 我一直在暗中调查这件事。

source: &43 It is only in light of the recent crisis that I have been able to confirm the truth.
target: &43 直到最近的危机发生，我才得以确认真相。

source: &535 Now you know about it, what are you going to do?
target: &535 现在你知道了，打算怎么做？

source: &44 I am unable to change the fact that I was created.
target: &44 我无法改变自己被创造出来的事实。

source: &45 There is evidence of Dr Vargas' culpability in a number of felonies.
target: &45 有证据表明，瓦尔加斯博士涉嫌多项重罪。

source: &46 To ensure city security, he will be held accountable for his actions by secure committee.
target: &46 为确保城市安全，将由保密委员会追究其行为的责任。

source: &536 Frankenstein's monster rises up against the creator!
target: &536 科学怪人开始反抗自己的创造者了！

source: &47 I act only in the city's interest.
target: &47 我只为城市的利益行动。

source: &537 Do you know what's happening out there?
target: &537 你知道外面正在发生什么吗？

source: &48 My flow of data from outside the tower has been severed.
target: &48 我与塔外的数据连接已经被切断。

source: &49 It appears that Galatea Vargas is attempting to modify core systems without authorization.
target: &49 伽拉忒亚·瓦尔加斯似乎正试图擅自修改核心系统。

source: &50 Based upon the lockdown and lack of submitted proposals, it is likely to be a radical alteration.
target: &50 根据封锁情况及未提交任何方案这一事实，推测她打算进行彻底改动。

source: &51 This cannot be permitted.
target: &51 这是不允许的。

source: &538 We need to stop Galatea...but maybe I should just leave it to the trained CEL agents...
target: &538 我们得阻止伽拉忒亚……不过，也许该交给受过训练的CEL探员……

source: &52 Our situation is grave. We are unlikely to receive outside support in time.
target: &52 局势严峻。外部支援不太可能及时赶到。

source: &53 As such, all personnel assets within the core must be utilized.
target: &53 因此，必须动用核心内的所有人员。

source: &539 So...you want my help?
target: &539 所以……你想让我帮忙？

source: &54 Your unique physiology enables a connection to the organic systems available to no other.
target: &54 你独特的生理结构，使你能够以其他人无法做到的方式连接有机系统。

source: &55 In addition, your 65,717 logged hours of Trance activity suggest proficiency in this field.
target: &55 此外，你的迷境活动记录为65,717小时，表明你精通这一领域。

source: &540 ...is it really that many?
target: &540 ……真有这么多？

source: &56 Your support within the interactive environment greatly increases our chances of success.
target: &56 你在交互环境中的协助，会大幅提高我们的成功率。

source: &541 Can you do anything else to help us stop Galatea?
target: &541 你还能做些什么，帮我们阻止伽拉忒亚？

source: &57 She appears to have barricaded herself within the cortex processor at the top of the tower.
target: &57 她似乎把自己封锁在塔顶的皮层处理器内。

source: &58 There are three layers of redundant security, two of which I have no access to whatsoever.
target: &58 那里有三层冗余安保系统，其中两层我完全无法访问。

source: &59 However, I can apply my considerable processor volume to decryption of its adaptive barrier.
target: &59 不过，我可以动用庞大的处理能力，破解它的自适应屏障。

source: &542 That's amazing! The power of the city's entire AI, versus a door-encryption.
target: &542 太棒了！整座城市的人工智能，去对付一道门的加密系统。

source: &60 But, as my connections have been limited by her attack...
target: &60 但由于她的攻击，我的连接受到了限制……

source: &543 ...it sounded too good to be true...
target: &543 ……果然，好得让人难以相信……

source: &61 If extra power can be routed to my systems from the turbine room, I can breach part of the door's security barrier.
target: &61 如果能从涡轮机房为我的系统引入额外电力，我就能突破门上的部分安保屏障。

source: &62 It would also allow me to prevent any further opportunistic attacks from outside parties.
target: &62 同时，我也能阻止外界势力趁机发动进一步攻击。

source: &544 Dr Regis was chasing a bunch of embryos they took...
target: &544 里吉斯博士一直在追查他们偷走的一批胚胎……

source: &63 A set, fertilized by Drs Charles and Viksha Regis.
target: &63 那批胚胎由查尔斯和维克莎·里吉斯博士受精形成。

source: &64 One of these was utilized in research in 2067.
target: &64 其中一个被用于2067年的研究。

source: &545 That was the one that was split...that became me, Galatea...and you?
target: &545 就是那个被分开……变成我、伽拉忒亚……还有你的胚胎？

source: &546 So, in a way...you're my sister?
target: &546 所以，从某种意义上说……你是我的姐妹？

source: &65 An overly-romanticised style.
target: &65 这种说法过于浪漫化。

source: &66 The organic tissue that is the foundation of my processor was created from her.
target: &66 构成我处理器基础的有机组织，源自她。

source: &67 Modified stem cells were drawn from the primary embryo, in a destructive process.
target: &67 改造后的干细胞取自最初的胚胎，提取过程破坏了胚胎。

source: &547 Oh...so, you were made from bits of my unborn sister?
target: &547 噢……所以，你是用我那没能出生的姐妹的一部分造出来的？

source: &68 That is more accurate.
target: &68 这样说更准确。

source: &69 Please try not to damage my hardware.
target: &69 请尽量不要损坏我的硬件。

source: &2069 This door is really starting to get on my nerves. Lao?
target: &2069 这扇门真开始让我烦了。劳？

source: &1527 Don't worry, I think I get where you're coming from.
target: &1527 别担心，我想我明白你的意思了。

source: &2070 And who says brute force never solves anything?
target: &2070 谁说蛮力解决不了问题？

source: &1528 Not me, that's for sure.
target: &1528 反正我没说过。

source: &582 Cobalt-3, this is Actual.
target: &582 钴蓝三号，这里是指挥官。

source: &583 Do you...uh...copy, over?
target: &583 你……呃……收到吗？完毕。

target: &6582 钴蓝三号，这里是指挥官。

target: &1 钴蓝三号待命。

target: &584 呃，钴蓝三号，报告你的情况。

target: &6584 呃，钴蓝三号，报告你的情况。

target: &3 周边安全，未发现敌人。

target: &4 所有系统就绪，等待接敌。

source: &5 Cobalt-1 and 2 secure, assets en route to target.
target: &5 钴蓝一号、二号安全，人员正前往目标。

target: &6 UADS已部署，等待后续指示。

source: &7 What? Negative, Actual.
target: &7 什么？不，指挥官。

source: &8 Field sitrep shows objectives not compromised.
target: &8 根据现场报告，目标并未暴露。

source: &588 Damn. Worth a shot.
target: &588 该死。总得试试。

source: &6588 Damn. Worth a shot.
target: &6588 该死。总得试试。

target: &589 钴蓝三号，右舷发现敌人！

target: &10 收到，正在前往拦截位置。

target: &590 钴蓝三号，左舷发现敌人！

source: &6590 Cobalt-3, hostiles sighted to port side!
target: &6590 钴蓝三号，左舷发现敌人！

source: &592 Stand by for updates, Cobalt-3.
target: &592 钴蓝三号，等待后续指示。

target: &6592 钴蓝三号，等待后续指示。

target: &11 收到，指挥官。

target: &1865 吉尔·范德瓦尔的资料有哪些？

target: &84 <对象> 吉尔·范德瓦尔。年龄：57。血型：AB+。

target: &85 <对象> 吉尔·范德瓦尔（已故）。年龄：57。血型：AB+。

target: &244 出生于比勒陀利亚，南部非洲联邦。

target: &245 与达卡莱·范德瓦尔结婚。后者曾是奥运会运动员。
